'dul ba/ 1zlortsi (2)0001 'dul ba gzhi/ 3bde chen gyi sde tshan/ 3rgyal po'i khab kyi sde tshan/ 30'od ma'i tshal gyi sde tshan/ 111shing mkhan gyi sde tshan/ 140yid tsa nang ga la'i sde tshan/ 142kum pi la'i sde tshan/ 222sngon rgyal po'i sde tshan/ 282gzhon nu bskyed sogs kyi sde tshan/ 360nga las nu'i sde tshan/ 393legs mthong chen po'i sde tshan/ 424dus dpog gi sde tshan/ 433ku shu'i sde tshan/ 4381

gdol pa'i sde tshan/ 450lha chen po'i sde tshan/ 453rgyal po mu khyud kyi sde tshan/ 457me long gdong gi sde tshan/ 461nor bzang gi sde tshan/ 470thams cad sgrol gyi sde tshan/ 510'dum byed kyi sde tshan/ 542nad pa'i sde tshan/ 546gtam du gyur pa'i sde tshan/ 560glang chen mche ba drug ldan sogs bstan pa/ 571sangs rgyas mang po'i skabs bstan pa/ 641sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rnams bstan pa/ 651shā ri'i bu dang mod gal gyi bu'i le'u/ 652dang po/ 'od srung gi le'u/ 665gnyis pa/ shā ri'i bu'i le'u/ 667gsum pa/ pang nas skyes kyi le'u/ 669bzhi pa/ mdzes ldan gyi le'u/ 670lnga pa/ sna ma'i me tog gi le'u/ 672drug pa/ bye ba nyi shu pa'i le'u/ 674bdun pa/ ngag dbang gi le'u/ 675brgyad pa/ bha ra dhā dza bsod snyoms len gyi le'u/ 676dgu pa/ legs 'ongs kyi le'u/ 677bcu pa/ ma 'gags pa'i grogs po dga' yod kyi le'u/ 680bcu gcig pa/ gnas brtan grags pa'i le'u/ 681bcu gnyis pa/ dpal skyed kyi le'u/ 684bcu gsum pa/ ba klu la'i le'u/ 686bcu bzhi pa/ gnas brtan gnas brtan zhes pa'i le'u/ 687bcu lnga pa/ ga yā 'od srung rnams kyi le'u/ 688

bcu drug pa/ gnas brtan grags pa'i le'u/ 689bcu bdun pa/ me skyes kyi le'u/ 691bcu brgyad pa/ yul 'khor skyong gi le'u/ 694bcu dgu pa/ sa ga'i le'u/ 697nyi shu pa/ 'od srung byin pa can gyi le'u/ 700nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ lam phran bstan gyi le'u/ 701nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ sprul khol gyi le'u/ 702nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ ma 'gags pa'i le'u/ 705nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu nag po'i le'u/ 707nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ sgra can zin gyi le'u/ 709nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ dga' bo'i le'u/ 710nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ gyad bu nor gyi le'u/ 711nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ nye sde'i le'u/ 714nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyi le'u/ 717sum cu pa/ mdzes bzang gi le'u/ 719sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ gnas 'jog sprang rtsi can gyi le'u/ 721sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ gnas brtan rgyu can gyi le'u/ 723sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ kornyi rgya'i le'u/ 726sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ nye ba 'khor gyi le'u/ 728sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ 'od byed kyi le'u/ 732sum cu rtsa drug pa/ nam gru'i le'u/ 734sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u/(stod) 737bsdur mchan/(746) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(868)

pa/ sna rig —— tsha pa ༷bye gosgos — ci spyo lho 5 — —44 cing ༷tho — — — — — bye /ོ ༷༷ 42 4 tswa ji bye che ṅgā / 77ri dzi —— byu ci 7 pa ci — ——— — — —7po sa choX 'i sme ri na byu chod gu sa rdo ru ne+e lta se spyo rdo — 2 ci — 4 ) ci / ri brnyeX/ ci ci — 3 4 ci na sno li ci ci smra lta / sdere ge/ kyi sa dz+wa 〉〉caci ri gestsu — bye〉ciXng sna rkang dz+wa nga — — ——— — — 3 —— — — —— —— — —— —— — — —— ༷ nga ci ཿ / jo sgo snye ma 4 rje 54 ci ju trī bhe ci la —— — shā 44 mo rila~X thos pa 'dzin mchog mdo sde yi/ /sde snod legs sdud kun dga' bo/ /

༄tshon /'dul ba gzhi/ bam po nyi shu lnga pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul brgya/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang thabs cigashetu slo ma lta bur gshegs so/ /de nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na gnas pa'i lha des ba ku la'i yal ga zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das la grib ma byed cing rjes bzhin rjes bzhin du song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pasredang / bag la nyalasnyedang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun ①pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad deX/ thos nas7lha des7'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas par gyur to0/ /ji tsam na phyogs gzhan zhig na yugs sa mo lnga brgya 8tsam gnas pa de dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu 2—3

chen po'i mtshan sum bcu ①ma gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad ②bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bur7kun nas bzang bar mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu yang de rnams bcom ldan 'das la sems dang bshechen po skyes so/ /'di ni0chos nyid yin te/ ji ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa'i rgyu can gyi ⑦sems can gyis dang por sangs rgyas mthong ba ltar lo bcu gnyis su zhi gnas kyi sems goms par byas pa dang /bu med pas bu rnyed pa dang / dbul pos gter mthong ba dang / rgyal srid la mngon par dga' ba rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur ba ⑧ni de ltar nyams dga' ba skyed pa ma yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi gdul7ba'i dus la gzigs nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod gnye/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas zhes 8bya ba nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas lan gsum du ched du brjod pas ched du brjod pa/ btsun pa bdag cag la 'di lta bu ni mas ma bgyis te pas ma lags/ rgyal pos ma lags/ lhas ma lags/sdug pas ma lags/ rang gi skye bo dang gnyen gyichatshogs kyis ma lags/ sngon gyi 'das pas ma lags/ dge sbyong dang / bram zes ma lags pa gang lags pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la mdzad de/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho 2—4

ni bskams①/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo ni bkum/thar pa dang mtho ris kyi sgo ni phye nas bdag cag lha dang mi rnams su ni bkod de/btsun pa bdag cag 'phags so/ / mngon par 'phags so/ /②bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis / bcom ldan 'das kyisaphubadag cag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ de dag stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la cung zad cig stsol cig dang / de la bdag cag bgyi ba dag bgyi'o0/ / de nasashebacom ldan 'das kyi7rdzu 'phrul gyis dbu spa dang sen mo bregs te byin no/ /de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten zhig brtsigs so/ /de nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na gnas pa'i lha gang yin pa des mchod rten de'i 'khor sar ba ku la'i yal ga de bskyed de/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni mchod rten 'di la bgyi ba bgyid cing mchis so zhes de de nyid na gnas so/ /de la kha cig gis ni yugasarnyus mo'i mchod rten no zhes bya bar shes so/ /kha cig gis ni ba ku la'i 'khor sa zhes bya bar shes te/ mchod rten la phyag byed pa'i dge slong dag da dung yang phyag byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa dang / ji tsam na bste gnas gzhan zhigatson drang srong lnga brgya gnas te/ de dag gikhebaste gnas de ni me tog dang 'bras bu dang chu phun sum tshogs pas de dag des rgyags nas ci yang mi sems so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi gdul ba'i dus la gzigs nas bste gnas der gshegs te byon pa 2—5

dang / rdzu 'phrul gyis bsti gnas de'i me tog dang 'bras bu ni brlag① /chu ni bskams②/ ne'u gsing rnams ni glogasal/ 'dug gnas dag ni brtib bo/ /de nas drang srong de dag lag pa 'gram pa lakhugatad nas sems khong du chud cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ci'i phyir sems khong du chud cing 'dug /de rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bsod nams kyi zhing rkang gnyis khyed ༷'dir gshegs nas ⑦bdag cag ni gnas skabs 'di 'dra bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/drang srong dag bsti gnas me tog dang 'bras bu dang chu7phun sum tshogs pa ci ste ma rung / ji sngon gyi ji lta ba de bzhin du bya'am/ bcom ldan 'das mdzad du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul brtul ba dang sngon gyi ji lta ba bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas de dag mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad pa bskyed rga/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong lnga brgya po de dag gi bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang / khams dang ske/ rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i chos bshad pa mdzad7de/de thos nas de dag gis phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te rdzu 'phrul mngon par bsgrubs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ()ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob pa lta na/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag cag tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la dge slong tshur shog ces bya bas dge 2—6

slong dag tshur shog ②tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'i mod la skra dang kha spu ②byi ba dang snam sbyar gyon par gyur te/lag na lhung bzed dang / bya ma bum thogs pa dang / skra dang kha spu zhag bdun skyes pa tsam dngashe/ dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /skra byi snam sbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhir gnas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur/ /de dag gis 'bad pa dang brtsal bas 0brtson 'grus brtsams pas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba 'di nyid rig ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad ces bya ba nas mngon du smra bar bya bar dugyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de dag la 'doms par byed pa'i drang srong gang yin pa des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis0cha byad 'dis skye bo'i tshogs chen po bslus pa de dag je dad pa skyes7par bgyis la slad kyis rab tu dbyung7bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das drang srong lnga brgya dang sngon gyi dge slong rnams kyis zla ba kham7pa lta bur bskor nas de nyid nas7rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' las gshegs te rim gyis gtun ri la byon to/ /de'i tshe gtun ri la drang srong shing gos can zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ drang srong des bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba nas/ kun nas mdzes pa rgyang ring po kho na nas mthong ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /mthong ma thag tu de bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad par gyur te/ de dad pa skyesalgenas bsams pa ma la 2—7

bdag ri las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das blta zhing 'gror ni bcom ldan 'das gdul ba la gzigs pas 'das par 'gyur gyis①/ ma la bdag nyid mchong b.rasabya'o snyam nas/ des7ri las bdag nyid mchongs pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos can yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos nas shing gos can gyis phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te rdzu 'phrul mngon par bsgrubs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob pa lta na zhes bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong tshur shog ces bya bas rab tu phyung ⑧ngo zhes bya ba dang /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par7gyur ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag nga'i dge slong dad pas rnam par grol ba rnams kyi mchog ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste dge slong shing gos can no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong stong gis yongs su bskor te/ cho7'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs mdzad cing grong khyer slo ma lta bur gshegs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gal te sgorwanyegacig nas zhugs na gzhan dag5)gzhan du sems par 'gyur bas ma la nga rdzu 'phrul kho nas 'jug par bya'o snyam nas/ de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' las grong khyer7slo ma lta bu'i dbus su gshegs so/ /de nas slo ma 2—8 cho

lta bu'i bdag po rgyal po dang / tshe dang ldan pa gang po dang / shing gi rna chanyecan dang / rgya skegs kyi rna cha can dang / zha nye'i rna cha can dang / rgyal po'i sras bcu bdun po de dag kyang rang rang gi 'khor dang / srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das srog chags brgya stong phrag du mas zham ring byas shing tsan dan gyi phreng ba'i khang bzangs gang na⑧ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs te/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po des bcom ldan 'dasasnyemathong ngo / /tsan dan gyi phreng ba'i khang bzangs zhig la thug pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gal te tsan dan gyi phreng ba'i khang bzangs zhig par gyur na sbyin bdag rnams kyi0bsod nams kyi bar chad du 'gyur gyisaX/ma la ngas 'di shel gyi rang bzhin du sprul par bya'o snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de ji ltar skye bo'i tshogs des sangs rgyas kyi sku sgrib pa med par mthong bar 'gyur bar shel gyi rang bzhin du sprul to/ /de nas 'khor de dag gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyalakhudang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang 'dra ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ desathos nas srog chags brgya stong phrag du mas khyad par chen po dag rtogs te/ kha cig gis ni thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed/ kha cig gis ni nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas/ kha cig gis ni lan gcig7phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas/ kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu 2—9

sems bskyed/ kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu7/ kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu'o/ /'khor de phal cher sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bab pa dang / dge 'dun la bab par bkod do/ /de nas shing gi rna cha can dang / rgya skegs kyi rna cha can dang /zha nye'i rna cha can gyis gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta gon byas nas gdan bshams te/ nor bu'i chu snod bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa gdugs tshod lags shing mchis na②/ bcom ldan 'das dasnyede'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po nag po dang / go0ta ma zhes bya ba rgya mtsho chen po na gnas pa desaganyis kyis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer slo ma lta bu na chos 'chad kyis0dong la mnyan par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas de gnyis klu lnga brgya'i 'khor dang grong khyer slo ma lta bur chu bo lnga brgya phab nas chas so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos can yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ klu'i rgyal po nag po dang / gi⑥ta ma 'di gnyis gal te grong khyer slo ma lta bur 'ongs par gyur na/ yul phung bar byed par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de nas7bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rings pa'i bsod snyoms long shig /mod gal gyi bu de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rings pa'i bsod snyoms ni lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ glo bur ba dang / 'gro bar chas pa dang / nad pa dang / nad g.yog dang / dge skos so/ /skabs 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das dge skos su dgongs te/ bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyis 2—10

de nyid nas steng gi nam mkha' las gshegs so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang mod gal gyi bu gnyis klu'i rgyal po nag po dang / gituta ma gang na⑧ba der gshegs te byon nas bka' stsal pa/ klu'i dbang po grong khyer slo ma lta bu la soms la yul phung bar ma bya7shig /de gnyis kyis gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag cag gang srog chags grog sbur la yang gnod pa mi bgyid pa de lta bu'i dad pas mchis na/slo ma lta bu na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po nag po dang / gi ta ma la de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos nas sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su song zhing bslab pa'i gzhi rnams bzungasango / /bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal zas gsol ba'i mdzad pa brtsams pa dang / klu re re nas bsams pa kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das la bdag gi chu'i btung ba gsol lo snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gal te gcig gi chu gsol na ni des na gzhan dag yigazhan du sems par 'gyur bas thabs shig bsham 8par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu song la gang na chu bo lnga brgya 'dres pa de las chu 0lhung bzed khong tsol khyer te shog shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas gang du chu bo lnga brgya 'dres pa de nas chus lhung bzed bkang nas khyer te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lhung bzed bkang ba'i chu phul ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhesalgete gsol lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bsams pa bcom ldan 2—11

'das kyis7sngon gyisabaka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag pha dang mas ni bu gsos/bsrings bskyedakhunu mas bsnun/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sna0tshogs ston par byed pa yin pas shin tu dka'abab byed pa ste/ bus phrag pa gcig la ni ma bzhagakhucig shos la ni pha bzhag nas lo brgya tshang bar khur du thogs sam/ sa chen po 'di'i nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya7dang / man shel dang /byi ru dang / dngul dang / gser dang / rdo'i snying po dang / spug dang /pad ma 'o⑧ga dang / dung g.yas su 'khyil pa ste/ de lta bu'i dbang phyug la bdag por bcug kyang / bus pha ma la de tsam gyis phan thogs pa'am lan lon par mi 'gyur gyi/ gang gis pha ma dad pa med pa dad pa phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug la 'dul zhing 'dzud7de so sor 'god par byed pa dang / tshul khrims 'chal pa tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang / ser sna can gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / shes rab 'chal (nyepa/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug la 'dul zhing 'dzud de so sor 'god par byed na/ de tsam gyis bus pha dang ma la phan thogs pa dang lan lon pa yin no zhes gsungs na/ bdag gis5)ni ma la lan gcig yang ma lon gyis8/ ma la bdag gis bdag gi ma gang du skyes pa bsam mo snyam nas bsam pa la zhugs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer can du skyes par mthong ngo / / des de su'i gdul bya yin pa brtags na/⑩ bcom ldan 'das kyi yin par mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag lam ring po nas 'dir 'ongs pas ci nas kyang bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la don 'di gsol lo snyam nas / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 2—12

'das kyis sngon dge slong dag pha dang ma ni bu la shin du dka'atub byed pa yin no zhes gsungs na/ bdag gi ma 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer can du skyes te/de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul bar 'gyurakhulags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse ba nye7bar bzung ste gdul bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu su'i rdzu 'phrul gyis dongakyi/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ri rab kyi rtse mo la gom pa dubor zhing gshegs pa dang /zhag bdun gyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer can du byon to/ /bu mo bzang mo des tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu rgyang ring po kho na nas mthong ngo mthong nas kyang dga' ba dang bcas pas de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ kye ma'o yun ring7zhig lon nas bu mthong ngo / /kye ma'o yun ring mo7zhig lon nas bu mthong ngo / /de nas skye bo'i tshogs chen pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag rab tu byung ba 'di ni rgan na ji ltar bu mo 'di de'i ma yinayi/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bo'i lus 'dinye'adis bskyed de/des na kho bo'i0ma yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo bzang mo de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i 8'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos nas bu mo bzang mo des 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas lan gsum du ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do zhes bya ba nas lha dang mi rnams su rab tu bzhag ces bya 2—13

ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pas mi bzad pa'i①/ /ngan song lam ni khyod kyisamathus bcad de / /mtho ris 'gro ba bsod nams bzang ldan phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdagasnyigis thob/ /khyed la brten nas shin tu rnam dag mig /nyes dang bral bas dag pa deng 'dir thob/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i go 'phang zhi thob nas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha rol bdag gis rga'adzo/ /'gro bar lha min lha dang mis mchod pa/ /skye rga 'chi dang nadakhudang rnam bral ba/ /srid pa stong du mthong bturnyed dka' ba/ /thub pa khyod mthong deng 'dir 'bras bur bcas/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags shing mngon par 'phags te/ bdag bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis yidage bsnyen du gzung du ⑫gsol / deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsam pa thag pas skyabs su mchi bar mngon par spro lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mod gal gyi bu chen po dang thabs cig tu deng5nyebasod snyoms sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo bzang mo de la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas bu mo bzang mos bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar rig ste/ bcom ldan 'das dang tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po gdan la bde bar bzhugs par rig nas/ gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de/ rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang / bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas bstabs0shing tshim par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag gnyis bcabs te/lhung bzed gyu bar〈 )rig nas stan dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das 2—14

kyi spyan sngar bting nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug pa dang / de la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi lhung bzed tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos blangs te lhung bzedatu'akhru bar byed pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyisabu 'dong ngamanya/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs so/ /su'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi'o/ /gal te de lta na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal soms shig /bcom ldan 'dasabaskol byon lags sam/ mod gal gyi bu yu bu phyin zin noni/ /de nas ngo mtshar du dad pa'i yid kyisashegasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul 'di'i ming ci lags/mod gal gyi bu yid mgyogs yin no/ /btsun pa sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo de lta bu ni bdag gis glo bar ma chud do/ /gal te bdag gis glo bar chud par gyur na/ bdag gi lus til gyi phye ma ltar bgyis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems las7mi ldog par 'gyur ba zhig na/ da ni shing tshig pa bzhin ci bgyir yang ma mchis so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes te / the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa gang pos las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug pa nor mang ba longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes lags/ las ci zhig bgyis na des bran mo'i mngal du skyes shing rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gang po nyid kyis0las tshogs rnyed pa/rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas gang pos las byas shing bsags 2—15

pa dgashegazhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi / 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed nas lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'ikhutshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dulasaba'i kha lo sgyur0ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr nye bar rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i bstan pa la 'di rab tu byung nas sde snod gsum par gyur te/ chos bzhin gyisasnyedage 'dun gyi zhal ta ba byed do/ /re zhig7cig na dgra bcom pa zhig la dge skos7bab ste/ des gtsug lag khang phyag dar bya bar brtsams pa dang / rlung langs pas phyag dar phan tshun du khyer bar gyur to(rnya/ /des bsams pa re zhig rlung zhi bar gyur gyi bar salgegazhag go snyam pa las/ ji tsam na gtsug lag khang de ma phyagasalgepa zhal ta ba des mthong nas de kun nas dkris pa drag pos/ 0rtsub po'i ngag phyung ba/ bran mo'i bu gang zhig dge skos〈 7byed/ dgra bcom pa des thos nas / des bsams pa/ 'di kun nas dkris pa yin pas re zhig bzhag la 2—16

phyis go bar bya'o snyam nas/ gang gi tshetukun nas dkris pa dang bral ba de'i tshe/de'i drung du song ste smras pa khyod kyis7kho bo su yin shes sam/ des smras pa shes te khyod dang kho bo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba yin no/ /des smras pa gal te de lta yin mod kyi kho bos ni rab tu byung ba'i bya ba byas te①/ kho bo ni 'ching ba mtha' dag las grol ba yin la/khyod ni 'ching ba mtha' dag gis bcings pa yin pas khyod kyis ngag rtsub po'i las phyung gis0nyes pa la nyes par shogasasnyishig dang / des na las de bsrabasalgepa dang / yongs su zad pa dang / gtugs par 'gyur ro/ /des nyes pa la ①nyes par bshags pas lasems can dmyal bar skye ①zhing bran mo'i bur 'gyur ba las/ de sems can dmyal bar ma skyes pas(nye/ tshe rabs lnga brgyar bran mo'i mngal du skyes te da ltar gyi bar du srid pa tha ma la yang bran mo'i mngal du skyes par gyur to/ /gang yang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byas pa des na phyug pa dang nor mang ba dang / longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes so/ /gang yang de na bklags shing bton pas phung po la mkhas pa dang / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas par byas pa des na nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa nisnyegacig tu gnag pa yin/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba yin/ 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams dang 'dren ma ni spangs la las gcig tu dkar ba la brtsal 2—17

bar7bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyisakhude lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dudag yi rangs teX/bcom ldan 'das kyisalgegasungs pa la mngon par bstodakyido// //gleng gzhi ni rgyal po'i khab na'o/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab na klu'i rgyal po grogashemakhar dang ri bo gnas so/ /de gnyis7kyi mthus dka' thub kyi chu lnga brgya yang rtag tu 'bab la/ chu mig dang / mtsho dang / mtshe'u rnams kyang skam par mi 'gyur/ lhas dus dus su char gyi rgyun legs par phab pas lo tog rnams kyang lhag par legs par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo7gnyis btularwarnyab na de gnyis ri rab kyi bang rim nas nyi ma re re zhing bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byed du 'ong ngo /de nas klu'i rgyal po grog mkhar dang ri bo 'di snyam du sems te/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo 'di gnyis ri rab kyi bang rimanyenas nyi ma re re zhing bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byed cing 'ong na/ bdag cag 'di nyid na gnas bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur mi byed pa ni bzang po ma yin gyis()ske/ ma la bdag cag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam nas/ de gnyis bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis la de 'dra ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos nas de gnyis sangs rgyas la skyabs su dong zhing / chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su dong nas bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das las skyabs su 'gro ba dang /2—18

bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs pa de'i tshe/ lus dang longs spyod lhag par 'phel bar gyur to/ /de gnyis kyis ①bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gang gi ③tshe bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchis shing / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams mnos pa de'i tshe lus dang longs spyod lhag par 'phel bar gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang na bdag cag⑧rgya mtsho chen por 'jug lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ klu'i dbang po dag khyed rgyal po'i yul na gnas pa yin gyis ༷rgyal po la rtogs shig /de gnyis kyis bsams pa dang / don gyis na⑤bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang ngo zhes smras nas de nyid na gnas so/ /klu'i rgyal po grogashemakhar dang ri bo'i kun du spyod pa ni/gal te nub mo bcom ldan 'das ltar〈'gro na ni lha'i bu'i cha byad kyis so/ /'on te nyin par na ni khyim bdag gi cha byad kyis so/ /de gnyis khyim bdag gi cha byad du byas shing nyin re zhing bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byed do/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po rgyal rigs kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gyi kun du spyod pa ni de gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das lta7bar 'gro ba de'i tshe 'ga' zhig bdaganemathong na ldang bar mi byed pa med grang zhes mi gnang chen gtong bar byed rga/ /des mi gnang chen zhig mngags te/ kye nang rje song la bcom ldan 'das la su dag bsnyen bkur byed ltos shig /de song ba las ji tsam na khyim bdag gnyis shigasamathong nas des bsams pa/ 'di gnyis ni lha'i yul na gnas pas/ci'i phyir ldang bar mi byed snyam nas des rgyal po la smras pa/ lha khyim bdag 2—19

gnyis shig mchis pa ni lha'i yul nyid na gnas pa lags so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bsams pa/ de gnyis kyis bdag mthong na ci'i phyir ldang bar mi byed kyisatu'agro'o snyam nas de nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ba dang /klu'i rgyal po grog mkhar dang ri bosakhurgyal po gzugs can snying po mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po gzugs can snying po mchi na ci ①re zhig rgyal po la bste ①stang bgyi'am/ 'on te chos la bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ klu'i dbang po dag chos la bstibastang byos shig /dam pa'i chos la ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang bla mar byed rga/ /chos la ni dgra bcom pa rnams kyang bla mar byed do/ /tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang yin dang / /ma byon sangs rgyas gang yin dang / /da ltar sangs rgyas gang yin pa/ /mang po'i mya ngan 'joms mdzad pa/ /bzhud dang bzhugs dang byonasa'agyur ba/ /thams cad dam chos bla mar byed//'di ni sangs rgyas chos nyid yin/ /de bas 'dir bdag phan 'dod pa/ /bdag nyid chen por 'dod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dran byas te/ /dam pa'i chos la bkur ste bya/ /de gnyis kyis ldang ba ma byas so/ /de nas rgyal po mi bzod pa skyes te/ des gsol pa bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ zhe snang dang ni 'khrugashepa dang / /ma dad pa yi sems kyis ni/ /rdzogasalosangs rgyas kyis bshad pa yonye/ /dam chos shes par mi nus so/ /gang gis khrosadang bag med pa'i/ /sems ni dul bar byas pa dang / /'di la mnar sems spangs pa 2—20

des/ /legs par gsungs pa shes par nus①/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ khyim bdag 'di gnyis 'ongs pas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi chos nyan pa'i bar yang chad par gyur to snyam nas/ de stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das kyisnyezhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te song ngo / /de song nas blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ rikhyim bdag 'di gnyis gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ba de'i tshe/ khyed gnyis nga'i yul na ma 'dug shig ces bsgos7shig /de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas song ba dang / blon po dag gis bsgo ba/70 lha'i zhal nas khyed cag gnyis nga'i yul na ma 'dug shig ces gsung ngo / /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ bka'akhubazhin 'tshal mchi'o/ /bsams pa bdag cag gnyis kyis yun ring po zhig nas bsams pa gang yin pa de ni tshegs chung ngus grub bo snyam mo/ /de nas 'od pa'ishechu chen posaphyung nas grog po7chung ngu'i nang du zhugs so/ /grog po chung ngu nas grog po chen por ro/ /grog po chen po nas chu bran du'o/ /chu bran nas chu chen por ro/ /chu chen po nas rgya mtsho chen por te/ gang gi tshe rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa de'i tshe de gnyis phyir zhing lus dang longs spyod shin tu 'phel bar gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po'i khab kyi dka' thub kyi chu lnga brgya dang / chu mig dang mtsho dang / mtshe'u rnams kyang chung ba dang / yongs su zad pa dang / gtugs par gyur la thug /lhas kyang dus dus su char gyi rgyun legs par ma phab pas lo nyes par gyur te/ mu ge nyam nga ba dgon pa'i slong7mo pas zas rnyed par dka' ba byung bar gyur to/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/rgyal po'i khab 'di na klu'i rgyal po ri bo dang / grog mkhar gnas te/ de 2—21

gnyis kyi mthus dka' thub kyi chu lnga brgya yang 'bab/ chu mig dang / mtsho dang / mtshe'u rnams kyang chu che/ lhas kyang dus dus7su char gyi rgyun legs par phab pa nyid kyis7lo tog legs parasagyur na/ da ni dka' thub kyi chu lnga brgya dang / chu mig dang mtsho dang / mtshe'u rnams kyang chung ba dang /yongs su zad pa dang / gtugs par gyur la thug /lhas kyang dus dus su char gyi rgyun legs par ma phab pas lo nyes par gyur te/ mu ge nyam nga ba dgon pa'i slongasamo pas zas rnyed par dka' ba byung bar gyur na/ klu'i rgyal po ri bo dang / grog mkhar shi'am/ bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding gis khyer ba'am / sbrul khas sdigs kyis bzung ba'am/ des 'jigs nas bros par ma gyur grang / de lta mod kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa yin gyisaX/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la zhu'oshesnyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ saphyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das la don de rgyas par gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po desheganyis ni shi ba yang ma yin/ bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding gis kyang ma khyer/ sbrul khas sdigs kyis kyang ma bzung / des 'jigs pas kyang ma bros mod kyi rgyal po khyod nyid kyis yul nas bskrad do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de gnyis mthong bar yang7mi dran na de gnyis yul nas bskrad pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ rgyal po chen po ngas khyod dran par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis khyim bdag gnyis shig yul nas bskrad tu)pa dran nam/2—22

bcom ldan 'das dran lags so/ /de gnyis ni klu'i rgyal po ri bo dang / grog mkhar yin no/ /btsun pa de gnyis gang du mas/ rgya mtsho chen por dong ngo / /bdag gi yul ma rung bar gyur lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de gnyis la bzod pashebyin cig dang ma rung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis7rgya mtsho chen po na mchisakyin ji ltar bzod pa stsal/ de gnyis tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi la khyim bdag gi cha byad du byas nas/ nga'i zhabasakyil phyag 'tshal du 'ongs pa0dang ngas rtags bstan gyis khyod kyis bzod pa byin cig /bcom ldan 'das ci bdag gis rkang pa gnyis la gtug⑧par bgyi'am/ rkang 5 gnyis la gtugashepar mi bya ste/'on kyang lag pa rkyong la klu'i dbang po bzod par gsol lo zhes smos shig dang bzod par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos de gnyis 'ong baspel 'bad de sdod cing 'dug pa dang / ji tsam na de gnyis khyim bdag gi cha byad du byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'ongs pa dang de ma thag tu rgyal po yang 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rtags bstan pa dang rgyal pos lag pa mngon du brkyang nas smras pa/ klu'i dbang po gnyis bzod par gsol lo/ /rgyal po chen po bzod par bgyi'o / /gal te bzod par gyur na nica'adir spyon cig /rgyal po chen po gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das las bdag cag gis skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi 8rnams blangs pas de nyid kyi tshe bdag cag gi lus dang longs spyod skyes te/ gal te da che bzhin du 'dir 'ongs na yul ma ga d+mar7yang mi shong bar 'gyur ro/ /'o na yul ma ga dhā ma rung bar 'gyur med/ ma rung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar mi 'gyur8/ khyod kyis kho bo cag gi khang bzangs gnyis rtsigs yil zla ba drug cing dus mchod gyis shig dang / kho bo cag gi 'khor 2—23

bzhag la dus mchod kyi tshe yang 'du bar bya'o/ /rgyal pos de bzhin du byas7pa dang / de gnyis kyis 'khor dag kyang bzhag la dus mchod kyang rang nyid nyams susamyong bar byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na de dag gi 'khor bag med par gnas pa na klu gdug⑧pa dag gis glags rnyed nas/ de dag gis ser ba dbab par brtsams so/ /rgyal po'i khab na bram ze ser ba'i sngags la mkhas pa gzhan zhig yod de/ des de bab cing bab pa dag bcad pa dang / de la yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis dbang thang byin no/ /lho phyogs na bram ze mes byin zhes bya ba ser ba'i sngags la mkhas pa zhig yod pa des byang phyogs na yul nus pa can zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na rgyal po sde mchog ces bya ba rgyal srid byedakyidu 'jug go/ /de'i yul na klu'i rgyal po rab mdzes kyi gnas yod de/ de na sman mthu che ba pha rol gnon pa yod par thos nas de'i ched dukhu'agro'o zhes de chas te rim gyis rgyal po'i khabatsatu phyin nas bram ze ser ba'i sngags 'chang ba7de'i gnas su zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na ser ba chen po bab pa bram ze gnyug mar gnas pa des gcad par ma nus nas de phyir byung nang du zhugs5)byed pa dang bram ze mes byin gyis dris pa/ mkhan po ci'i slad du mkhan po 'dicaphyir byung nang du zhugs par mdzad/ des smras pa/ bu ser ba chen po bab pa gcad par ma nus parasnyibs med/ bdag gis dgum mo/ /bu legs so/ /des chu nyung zhig la bzlas7te gtor bas tshal pa brgyar gyes sol/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur nas / rngan pa thogs te bram ze de'i khyim du songaspenas smras pa/ mkhan po rgyal po'i khab kyi skye bo'i tshogs mngon par dga' bar gyur gyisakyi rngan pa long nyeshig /2—24

ci'i phyir/ khyod kyis ser ba chen po khums pa'i slad du'o/ /des smras pa/ kho bos ni ma bcad de/ 'on kyang bram ze 'dis bcad do/ /de dag bram ze de'i drung du dong nas bram ze'i khye'u 'di nyid du 'dug shig dang dbang thang sbyin no/ /de bzhin du gnas par bya'o zhes de gnas so/ /des ser ba de dus tha gi7tsam zhig gi bar dusasngags kyis bgags te mi 'bab par gyur to/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag nyid kyi bsod nams kyis ser ba mi 'bab na ci'i phyir de la dbang thang sbyin zhes de rnams kyis bcad dol/ /bram ze0des sngags brtul nas yul nus pa can du song ba dang phyir yang ser ba bab par gyur to/ /de rnams bram ze de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ mkhan po bram ze'i khye'u de gar mchis/ des smras pa/ khyed cag gis de la bkur steshem byas pas de song ngo / /mkhan po gal te mchis na bdag cag la spron cig /de bzhin du bya'o/ /de yang rim gyis rgyal po sde mchog gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ rgyal po sde mchog la rgyal ba dang tshe spel ba dag byas nas smras pa/ lha khyod kyi yul na klu'i rgyal po rab mdzes zhes bgyi ba mchis pa de'i gnas na mod la mthu skyed ⑤pa zhes bgyi ⑨ba'i sman mchis kyis lha0 de ston cigayi /lha'i skal ba yang dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ kye bram ze klu'i rgyal po rab mdzes ni gtum po7yin pas des khyod brlagatsopar mi byed grang / lha re zhig bdag la sngags kyi mthu dang sman gyi mthu mchis te / gal te klu'i rgyal po rab mdzes dang 'dra ba'i klu rnams kyis 'dzam bu'i ⑫gling 'di lta ste/ bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ 'dam bu'i tshal bzhin gang bar gyur kyang bdag gi yib spu gcig kyang bskyod ⑩par rngo mi thog tson klu'i rgyal po 2—25

rab mdzes kyis lta smos kyang ci 'tsha'9/ 'on kyang lha'i mi dgum pa la thug pa 'ga' mchis sam/ bram ze yod do/ /lha de bkrisashig dang des de'i gnas ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal pos mi de la bos te bsgo ba/ kye nang rje bram ze 'di la klu'i rgyal po rab mdzes kyi gnas ston cig /lha bka'akhebazhin 'tshal zhes mi0des rgyal po'i ltar mnyan nas bram ze de khrid de chas so/ /ji tsam na mi ring ba zhig tu bsdad nas de la smras pa/ bram ze tshal sngo zhing sngo ba dag bsgrengs pa pha bi mthong ngam/ mthong ngo / /de ni klu'i rgyal po rab mdzes kyi gnas yin no/ /de song ste des der mod la mthu skyedakyipa zhes bya ba'i sman las khur du gragasashenas/ des de thogs te yul nus pa can du song nas rgyal po sde mchog gi skal ba byin te/ rim gyis rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas bram ze de nyid kyi khyim du zhugs so/ /de nas des rgyal po'i khab kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la sbran pa dang / de dag mchod yon thogs te lhags nas bram ze'i⑧khye'u 'di nyid du 'dug shig dbang thang sbyin no/ /des smras pa/ khyed cag gis bkur sti ma byas pas kho bo mi 'dug go/ /de rnams kyis de gzhag par gal gyis gcu7bar brtsams te gsol ba btab pa dang khas blangs nas de dag gis 'tsho ba'i ris bcad do/ /'jig rten ni phun sum tshogs pa 'dod kyi rgyad pa dang mi mthun pas/ des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgurarnyuspyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa na khye'u zhig btsas te/ des de'i ming ri bo can zhes bya bar btags so/ /de yang rtse0bar byed dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa na bu mo 2—26

zhig btsas te/ de'i ming ni ser7ba zhes bya bar btags7so/ /bram ze mo ni 'khor bral zhes bya'o/ /mna' ma ni glogasaces bya'o/ /des bsams pa/yang dang yang du ser ba gcod cing ci las medaX/ yun ring rab tu sngags kyis dgag ⑤par bya'o zhes des yun ring por ⑦sngags kyis dgag ⑦pa byas te bzhag⑧pas ser ba mi 'bab par gyur to/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cagashekho na'i bsod nams kyi mthus ser ba mi 'bab na/ ci'i phyir dbang thang sbyin zhes de rnams kyis bcad ṭaha/ /bram ze de phrag dog gi zil gyis non pas bu yang sngags kyi tshig rnams 'dzin du ma bcug go/ /bde ba la chags pas kha ton yang ma byas la sman yang skam du ma bcug go/ /des sngags kyi tshig rnams ni bsams na brjed sman ni ma bskamasalgepas rul bar gyur to8/ /de rgyal po'i khab kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la snying na ches nas/ de rnams la klan ka btsal ba'i phyir mu stegs kyi gnas dang dka' thub kyi tshal de dang de dag tu song nas dris pa/ shes ldan dag gang gisasnyigang bsams pa dang / gang don du gnyer ba de la thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba'i thabs lta ci yod/ de na kha cig gis smras pa/ mer zhugs shig /kha cig gis smras pa/ dug zo shig /kha cig gis smras pa/ g.yang sa nas bdag nyid mchongs shig /kha cig gis smras pa/ bdag rang gi ske la thag pa thogs te shing gi yal ga phyelas 'phyang du chug shig ces thams cad kyis 'chi ba'i thabs bstan gyi/ nges par 'byung ba'i thabs ni ma yin pas de rim gyis 'od ma'i tshal du song ngo / /des dge slong zhig mthong nas dris pa/ 'phags pa gang gis gang bsams pa dang / gang don du gnyer ba de thams cad 2—27

'grub par 'gyur ba'i thabs lta 'ga' mchis sam/ desanyesmras pa/ bcom ldan 'das las rab tu byungakhushig /der ci zhig bgyi/ der ji srid 'tsho'i bar dukhutshangs par spyod pa yang spyad par bya/ bsam gtan dang gdon pa dang ldan par yang gnas par bya ste/ gal te re zhig mthong ba'i chos nyid la kun shes pa thobakyin/ de nas0de nyid khyod kyi sdug bsngal gyi mthar phyin pa yin no/ /'on te sbyor ba'i lhag ma dang bcas bzhin dus byed na gang bsams pa dang / gang don du gnyer ba de⑥thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa de ni rngo mi thogasnyen/ gzhan yang cung zad ci mchis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drongs la gdugs tshod gsol cig /de yang rngo mi thog nashegazhan bstan du gsol/ bum pa bzang po lta bu'i nyan thos chen po bzhi spyan drongs la gdugs tshod gsol te smon lam thob shig dang gang bsams pa dang / gang don du gnyer ba de thams cad 'grub bo/ /'phags pa de ni rngo thog gis bgyi'o zhes des7bum pa bzang po lta bu'i nyan thos chen po bzhi spyan drangs te/ gdugs tshod gsol nas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rab mdzes klu'i gnas nas bsad la bdag der skye zhing de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi mi rnams la gnod pa byed par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de la chung mas dris pa/ rje'i sras smon lam 47zhig btab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rab mdzes klu'i gnas nas bsad la bdag der skye zhing de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi mi rnams la gnod pa byed par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /legs te bdag kyang khyod kyi chung mar gyur cig /bus smras pa bdag kyang khyod kyi bur gyur cig /de bzhin du bu mos smras pa/ bdag kyang khyod kyi bu7mor 2—28

gyur cig /de bzhin du mna' mas smras pa/ bdag kyang mna' mar gyur cig ces byas nas de rnams khyim rnying7pa zhig tu zhugs te nyal ba dang sprin kha dog lnga pa las char pa bab stel/ rtsig pa 'gyel bas non te kha dgashego/ /klu rab mdzes shi 'phos nas 'khor klusadrug khri dang der0skyes nas de yang rab mdzes zhes bya bar grags so/ /chung ma ni 'khor bral zhes bya'o/ /bu ni ri bo can zhes bya'o/ /bu mo ni ser ba zhes bya'o/ /mna' ma ni glog ces bya'o/ /chos nyid kyis klu'am klu'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon paraphugasum dran par 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis yin pa'o / /des bltas na mi las shi 'phos so/ /gang du skyes she na/ klu rnams su'ol/ /las gang gis7she na/ smon lam gyi dbang gis so/ /ci'i phyir snyam na/ rgyal po'i khab kyi mi rnams la gnod pararnyubya ba'i phyir ro/ /des bsams pa / ci lo tog ci lta ba bzhin du skyes pa la byas na mi rnams kyi sdug bsngal skye bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te ma skyes pa rnams la 'gyur snyam na/ des ji ltar skyes pa la byas pa ltar ma skyes pa la ni de lta5)ma yin par mthong nas/ des 'khor rnams la bsgo ba shes ldan dag0tshur shog /yul ma ga ṅgār deng la char pas lo tog thams cad bskrun cig /de rnams kyis lo tog thams cad bskrun pa dang / de nas drug stong gi 'khor dang gshol mda' tsam gyi char gyi 0rgyun gyis 47ltar yul ma ga sgyur sog ma yang khyer ba de lta bu'i char gyi rgyun dbab par brtsams so/ /de nas de dag phan tshun du smras pa/ sog ma yang klu 'dis phrogs so zhes de'i ming sog ma med ces bya bar0thogs so// //2—29

sdom la/ rgyal po'i khab dang na ①lan da/ /'od ma'i dbyug pa dmar bu'i grong / /chu bo gang hākhusprin brtsegs dang / /sgra chenasayangs pa tha ma yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan dbaka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe gzhon nu ma skyes dgra lha0sbyin gyis sbadakyinas pha chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa bsad de rang nyid kyis ⑧cod pan ⑨bcings nas rgyal por zhugs pa de'i tshe de yi bcom ldan 'das la bkur ste ma yin pa mang po bya bar brtsams te/ dgrongs pa man chad bya ba'i phyir glang po che nor skyong dang khyirwa)gtum po za ba dag sbad pa dang /de'i ma lus 'phags mas smras pa/ bu bcom ldan 'das la bkur ste ma yin pa ma byed cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bkur ste ma yin pas bsnyengs pa yin gyis8/ rgyal po'i khab nas bzhud de gnod par gyur ta re/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus yul ang ga dang / ma ga dhā rnams 'byor cing nyams dga' ba yin no/ /snying rnyog pa can des smras pa/ci gang na bcom ldan 'das med pa'i yul de dag zhig pa dang stongs par gyur tam / de mas 0thams cad kyi thams cad du bzlog 0kyang ma btub nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gzhon nu ma skyes dgra 'di bsod nams ma yin pa mang tsodu sogs kyis phyengs 'di gzhi med pa'i dad pa la gzhag tu re zhig de'i dus la ma bab pas mnyan yod du gshegs so snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na mnyan 0yod du byon nas / mnyan duyod na durgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi 2—30

kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mtha'i rgyal phran dag gis bcom ldan 'das la ma skyes dgras bkur ste ma yin pa byas pas de bkur ste ma yin pas bsnyengs nas rgyal po'i khab nas gshegs te mnyan yod du byon to zhes thos nas/de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ re zhig rgyal po sdig can des pha chos kyi rgyal po ①chos dang ldan pa bsad na/ des kyang ma chog nas bcom ldan 'das lha dang lha ma yin dang / mi rnams kyis mchod pa de la yang bkur ste ma yin pa byas te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bkur ste ma yin pas bsnyengs ②pa yin pas/ des na ③bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab nas gshegs te mnyan yod du byon par gyur pas de yong ye rgyal srid las dbyung bar bya'o snyam nas de dag gis phan tshun pho nyas bzlugs0nas blo gros gcig tu byas te dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon pa glang po che'ikhutshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs dang /rgyal po'i khab tu dong ste/ lo bcom nas phru mar bskor te 'khod dog/ /klu'i rgyal po sog ma med kyis kyang ser ba'i rgyun phab pas7lo tog lhag ma rnams ma rung bar byas so/ /dka' thub kyi chu lnga brgya dang / chu mig dang / mtsho dang /mtshe'ushernams skams la thug pas mu ge byung bar gyur to/ /chu lhag ma gzhan dag kyang mtha'i rgyal phranacadag gis ma rung bar byas so/ /de nas ma skyes dgra sdug bsngal mi bzad ④pa 8nyam nga bar gyur pa la mi ma yin pa dag gis glags rnyed de/ rma la thal ba btab pa ltar mi ngas byung ste/ khyogs dang khyogs 'drud 8par gyur toyi/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra gnod pa brgya phrag du mas snying dkrugs pas lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de sems khong du chud cing 2—31

'dug go/ /de nas lus 'phags mas smras pa/ bu ci'i phyir sems khong du chud/ yum gnod pa brgya phrag du ma dag byung bar gyur to/ /bu kho mos sngar khyod la bcom ldan 'das la bkur sti ma yin pa ma byed cig/ //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po nyi shu drug pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bkur ste ma yin pas bsnyengs7pa yin gyis②/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab nas bzhud de gnod par gyur ta re zhes ma smras sam/ de ni 'di yin no/ /yum de la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ bu bcom ldan 'das la bzod par gsol cig /yum bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchis pa'i rngo mi thogasalags so/ /bu khyod kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni tsan dan dang ste'ur mnyam pa khong khro ba dang rjes su chags pa spangs pa yin no zhes ma thos sam / gal te 'ga' zhig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag dpung pa gcig la ste'u yis bzhig par byed la/ cig shos la tsan dan sa mchog gis nyug par byed na/ de la bcom ldan 'das rjes su chags pa yang mi mnga'/ khong khro ba yang mi mnga'o/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu rgyal po ma skyes dgras mi zhig la smras pa/ kye nang rje tshur shog /khyod bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song la/son dunas kho bo'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi 0bos phyag byas te ⑦gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam /'tsho'am / gnod pa mi mnga' 'am/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par bzhugs sam zhes snyun gsol la 'di skad ces kyang gsol cig /btsun pa lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i mchid nas btsun pa bu ngan pa ni mchis kyi pha ngan pa ni ma mchis pasarnyubacom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye 2—32

bar bzung ste rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs par gsol/ gal te bcom ldan 'das ma gshegs na ring po7mi thogs pa kho nar rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer stongs te ming lus par 'gyur ro zhes gsol cig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po rgyam skyes dgra'i ltar mnyan nas chas te rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas mi des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra ③bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ gnod pa chung ngam/nyam nga ba nyung ngam zhes bya ba nas dureg par bzhugs sam zhes snyun gsol lags so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /kye mi khyod dang lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra bde bar gyur cig /btsun pa lus 'phags ma'i tsobu yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i mchid nas btsun pa bu ngan pa ni mchis kyi pha ngan pa ni ma mchis pas bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse'ub nye bar bzung ste rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol/ gal te bcom ldan 'das ma gshegs na zhes bya ba nas ming lus par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gong masnyibazhin du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas7mi de la gnang ngo / /de nas mi des7bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas teganang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ji srid bzhed7kyi bar du mnyan yod du7bzhugs nas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu rgyal po'i khab gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu 2—33

zhing gshegs pa na yul ma ga sgyur byon to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyikhumathus rlung gtong ba'i lha'i bu rnams kyis ni dug gis ②ma rung bar byas pa'i chu de dag bskams so/ /char pa 'bebs pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis ni yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus bkang ngo / /lha rnams ni char pa 'bebs pa la zhugs so/ /sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa'i lha rnams kyis ni rgyal po'i khab nas mi ma yin pa rnams bskrad nas mi ngas zhi bar gyur to/ /mtha'i rgyal phran dgashegis ni bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa mthong nas grong khyer bskor ba btang ste dong ngo / /tshong pa rnams kyis ni zong dag bkram mo/ /bzo phal pa gzhan dag gis ni rang rang byed par brtsams so/ /yul so so na gnas pa'i tshong pa rnams dang /ded dpon rnams ni zong dang 'jug par brtsams so/ /lo ni legs par gyur to / /lam po che dang srang dang / sum mdo dang / bzhi mdo rnams su nisnyebacom ldan 'das kyi bdag nyid chen po sgrogs0par gyur to/ /mu stegs pa rnams ⑦ni bag 'khums par gyur to/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams ni rab tu dga' bar gyur to/ /lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga d+mar gshegs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang snying dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba rgya chen po dang /yid bde ba skyes nas blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag dengasal bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir dpag tshad phyed dang gsum gyi lam bstar7ba dang / grong khyer dag bzang por byos shig /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer thams cad kyang rdo ba dang / gsog ma dang / gyo mo sol te tsan dan gyi chus chag chag thob la dar gyi chun 'phyang mang po dpyongasanyeshig /dri zhim po'i pog por dag shoms 2—34

la/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dag tshugs shig /bar bar du7me tog gi gzhal med khangasamadzes pa dag byos shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes blon po rnams kyis lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i ltar mnyan nas thams cad rgyas par byed du bcug go/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra rgyal po chen po'i 'byor pa dang / rgyal po chen po'i mthus bdag nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bsur song ngo de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba/ zhi ba 'khor zhi bshegrol ba 'khor grol ba/ dbugs phyin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa/ rnam par dul ba 'khor rnam par dul ba/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba/ mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa khyu mchog ba glang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ glang po che glang po che'i phru gu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ seng ge mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ngang pa'i rgyal po ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nam mkha'0lding 'dab0chags kyi tshogasashekyis bskor ba lta bu/ bram ze slob ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ sman pa mkhas pa nad pa'i tshogs kyis7bskor ba lta bu/ dpa' bo dmag mi'i ①tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ lam mkhan 'gron po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ ded dpon tshong pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ tshong dpon rang gi skye bos bskor ba lta bu/ rgyal phran blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/'khor los sgyur ba bu stong gis bskor ba lta bu/ zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyisalgebaskor ba lta bu/ nyi ma 'od zer stong gis bskor ba lta bu/ yul 'khor skyong dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ lus 'phags po grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor 2—35

ba lta bu/ mig mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ ri nor sbyin gnod sbyin gyinyetshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ thagasasazangs ris lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ brgya byin sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis7bskor ba lta bu/ tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rgya mtsho mi g.yo ba lta bu/ sprin chu dang bcas pa lta bu/ glang po che dam pa rgyags pasredang bral ba ltar dbang po rnams shin tu dul bas ma g.yengs 0pa'i spyod lam gyi ༷spyod pa can/ sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/dpe byad7bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ sku 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong gi 'od zer bas lhag pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas mdzes pa/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa gsum dngasnye/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa7dang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun rab tu mang po dang lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra dang / lha brgya stong phrag du mas zham ring byas te rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du gshegs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs te/ mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas pas grong khyer gyi sgo'i them pa la zhabs g.yas pas mnan pa de'i tshe sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur te / sa chen po 'di g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg cing / shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma' / byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma'/dbus mtho na mtha' dma' bar gyur to/ /'jig rten 'di 'jig rten gyi bar 2—36

dang bcas pa thams cad kyang snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /lhas kyang bar snang la rnga dgatubardungs so/ /nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi steng nas lha'i me tog ut+pa la dang / pad ma dang /ku mu dakhudang / pad ma dkar po dang / a gsheru'i phye ma dang / rgya spos kyi phye ma dang / gur kumasagyi phye ma dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye ma dang / lha'i me tog man drabar ba dang / gos dag 'thor bar byed de/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du gshegs pa na de lta bu'i ya mtshan dag byung bar gyur to0/ /gzhan yang dog pa dag ni yangs par gyur to/ /dma' ba dag ni mtho bar gyur to/ /mtho ba dag ni phya le bar gyur to/ /glang po che dag ni skad 'byin par gyur to/ /rta dag kyang skad 'byin par gyur to/ /khyu mchog dag kyang skad 'byin par gyur to / /khyim gyi nang na bzhag pa'i snod sna tshogs dag ni ma brdungs par rang sgra 'byin par gyur tol/ /long ba rnams kyis ni mig thob par gyur to/ /'on pa rnams ni rna bsakhuthosal/ lkugs pa rnams ni smra nus par gyur to/ /dbang po lhag ma ma tshang ba rnams ni dbang po so sor thob par gyur to/ /chang gis myos pa rnams ni myos pa dang bral bar gyur to/ /dug 'thungs pa dag ni dugatsozhi bar gyur to/ /phan tshun khon byung ba rnams ni mdza' bar gyur to/ /sbrum pa dag ni bde bar btsas par gyur to/ /btson du bcings pa dag ni thar bar gyur to/ /nor med pa dag ni nor rnyed par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i 'byor pa de mthong nas dge bsnyen zhig gis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ yul gang zhig tu 'jig rten gtso bo gshegs pa der/ /lo nyes mi ngas dang ni phyi dgra'i 'jigs pa med/ /lha rnams char 'bebs skye bo bsod nams rab tu byed/ /2—37

deratuni ya mtshan brgya phrag gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur//de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs te/ skye bo'i tshogs dbugs phyung nas rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste 'od ma'i tshal du gshegs so/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs ston⑧par mdzad ces bya ba nas yang dag par rabashetu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangs ④nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar dunas/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to①/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la bdag gis dgung zla ⑦gsum du na bza' chos gos dang /bsod snyomasaXdang / gzims7cha dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang /yo byad rnams 'bul zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 2—38

'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te stan las langs te song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras zla ba gsum du na bza' chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun7dpyad kyi rkyen smanasridang /yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen⑧bkur byas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis mi ngas de bskrad dunas rgyal po'i khab nas byung nas sgra sgrogs zhes0bya ba'i nang du byung ste/ yangs pa can du 'dug nas/༷ yangs pa can gyi skye bo'i tshogs la mi ngas byung bar7gyur te/ khyogs dang khyogs 'drud par gyur to/ /yangs pa can na bram ze mdun na7'don mda' bo che zhes bya ba zhig gnas pa de'i rmi lam na yangs pa can na gnas pa'i lha zhig gis smras pa/ gal te mi 'dul kha lo sgyur ba'i mchog /shākya'i rigs dag pa7yi bcom ldan 'das/ /yangs pa can du gshegs par gyur rten ni/ /gnod pa rnams ni rnam par 'jig par 'gyur/ /desalgenam nangasalgenas yangs pa can gyi li ts+tsha bī ⑩rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag gis 8mi lam 'di 'dra ba zhig mthong ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ ⑥bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pho nya su zhig gtang0zhes phan tshun bgro bar brtsams pa dang / mdun na 'don mda' bo che 'di nyid thams cad du nus pa yin la/ bdag cag la yang byams pa yin gyis gtang ngo / /de la de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song la phyin nas bdag cag gi tshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byos la/ gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam zhes bya ba nas snyun gsol la 2—39

zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /'di skad ces kyang gsol cig /btsun pa yangs pa can gyi ①tshogs kyi mchid nas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can du gshegs su gsol/ gal te bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can dukhum gshegs na ring por7mi thogs pa kho nar yangs pa can stongs shing ming lus par 'gyur ro zhes gsol cig /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra ni khyed la ⑤yun ring du gnod pa byed pa yiphyir rgal ⑦ba dgra bor gyur pa yin pas bdag la gnod pa byed par mi 'gyur grang / de dag gis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ yul 'khor gzhan yangasa'agyed par yang / /pho nya mi gsod ces grag na/ /khyod ni rgyal ba'i pho nya yin/ /kun gyis mi gsod smos ci dgos/ /de nas mdun na 'don mda' bo che dge mtshan7dang bkra shis dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dag byas te/ rim gyis rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas de lam gyis dub pa bsal〈nyete/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas mdunanyen 'don mda' bo ches bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye go7ta ma yangs pa can gyi tshogs bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma'i zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal tebya/ gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par spyod dam zhes snyun gsol lags so/ /mda' bo che khyod dang yangs pa can gyi tshogs bde bar gyur cig /kye gau ta ma yangs pa can gyi tshogs kyi mchid 2—40

nas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can du gshegs su gsol/ gal te bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can du ma gshegs na ring po mi thogs pa kho nar yangs pa can stongs shing ming tsam lus par 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mda' bo che 'dir nga nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig latulus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras zla ba gsum du yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs pas rgyal po la rtogs shig /gal te rgyal pos gnang na nga de bzhin du gshegs par bya'o/ /des yangs pa can du bcom ldan 'das ni 'di skad ces gsung ngo zhes spring ngo / /de rnams kyis kyang spring ba de nyid kyi phyir khyod lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra gang na ba der song la son nas/ bdag cag gi tshig gis lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgrakhul gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes kyang dris la 'di skad ces/ lha bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can du gshegs par bcom ldan 'das la rjes su gnang bar mdzad du gsol / lhas gal te bcom ldan 'das la rjes su ma gnang na ring po7mi thogs pa kho nar yangs pa can stongs shing ming lus par 'gyur ro zhes smos shig /de nas mdun na 'don mda' bo ches bsams pa/ ci re zhig rgyal po la bsnyen par bya'am/ 'on te blon po rnams la bya snyam du bsams pa dang / de 'di snyam du sems te/ 'ga' zhig gi dngags las bsnyen par mi bya ste/ 'on kyang bsnyen pa0byed pa la bsnyen par bya'o zhes 'byung bas/ mdor na blon po rnams la bsnyen par0bya'o snyam nas/ des blon po rnams la bsnyen par bya 2—41

bar brtsams so/ / de nas7blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ mdun na 'don dgos pa ci zhig la 'ongs/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bo ni bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir lha la gsol ba 'debs su mchis kyisarkyukhyed cag gis grogs mdzod cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ de bzhin du byasasakho bo cag gis ji tsam na bos pa de'i tshe khyod shog cig0 /de nas de dag gis skabs shes nas bos pa dang de nas mdun na 'don mda' bo che lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra gang na ba der song ste song(rnes lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la rgyal ba dang tshe spel ba dag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas mdun na 'don mda'algebo ches lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha yangs pa can gyi tshogs kyi mchidashenas lha la gnod pa chung ngam/ reg par gnas sam zhes bya ba rgyas par gyesnyan gsol lo9/ /mda' bo che khyod dang /yangs pa can gyi tshogs bde bar gyur cig /lha yangs pa can gyi tshogs kyi mchid nas 'di skad ces/ lha bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can du gshegs par bcom ldan 'das la rjes su gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ lhas gal te bcom ldan 'das lanyerjes su ma gnang na ring po mi thogs pa kho nar yangs pa can stongs shing ming lus par 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ mda' bo che kho bos yun ring mo zhig nas kye ma yangs pa can gyi gnas stongs kyang ci ma rung snyam du bsams pa de gal te yangs pa can gyi gnas stongs par gyur na kho bo yid la bsamasapa tshegs chung ngus rdzogs par ma gyur tam/ de skad ces smras pa dang / mda' bo che song ngo / /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bcom 2—42

ldan 'das kyis sems can gcig kyang yongs ①su btang ba lta mchis sam/shes ldan dag med do/ /de lta na lhas bcom ldan 'das la bkur ste ma lags pa bgyis so/ /lhas bcom ldan 'das la rjes su gnang yang rung / ma gnang yang rung gho/ bcom ldan 'das ni yangs pa can gyi sems can la thugs brtse ba'i phyir gshegs par 'gyur bshenyid do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bos ma shes kyis gal te de lta0na khug shig /de dag gis mda' bo che bkug nas rgyal pos smras pa/ mda' bo che kho bos dam bcas tekhubacom ldan 'das rjes su gnang bar bya'o/ /gal te kho bos bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur ci 'dra ba byas pa de kho na 'dra bar yangs pa can gyikhutshogs kyis bya na/ de lta na kho bos rjes su gnang ngo / /des yangs pa can7rnams la rgyal po 'di skad ces gsung ngo zhes spring ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ rgyal po mi gcig pur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dang bkur sti byed na/bdag cag tshogs su gyur pas ci ste mi bya zhes de dag gis bcom ldan 'das gshegs su gsol cig dang / bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das la de bas kyang ches khyad par du tso'aphags pa'i tsomachod pa dang bkur ste bgyi'o zhos spring ngo / /de nas mda' bo ches don0de dag rgyal po la rig par byas so/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang 2—43

thabs cig la bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyomasatudang / gzims cha dang / snyan⑧dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid par spro lags mod kyi/ bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la thugs brtse bsalgeganang bar mi 'gyur lags na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi dugadugs tshod ⑤gsol bar gnang bar mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyi0lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te song ngo / /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras de nyid kyi mtshan mo nas zhes bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba 'debs pa la zhugs pa / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis klu gdug⑧pa dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa de dang de rnams ni btul lags na/ btsun pa klu'i7rgyal po sog ma med 'di yun ring po kyi zhig nas bdag cag la sha khon yim mchis par ni sha khonasnyebagyid/ 'gran zla ma mchis par ni 'gran zlar gyur/ gnod pa ma mchis par ni gnod par bgyid par gyur te/ lo tog gang dag skyes shing skyes pa rnams chud gzon par bgyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste klu'i rgyal po sog ma med legs par gdul bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la cang 2—44

mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis7lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la yon bsngo ②ba mdzad nas gshegs te/gtsug lag khang du byon nas dge slong gi dge ③'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs soX/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis0tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang phyogs su klu'i rgyal po sog ma med 'dul0du 'dong ngo / /byang phyogs na ni phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ me tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa dang / bsod snyoms med pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs drang po yod do zhes gsungs nas bcom ldan ⑦'das nang du yang dag 'jog gisaphyir gtsug lag khang du zhugs7so/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras rgyal po'i khab nas chu bo gang gā'i5)bar gyi lam dang grong khyer dag che thang du stor du bcug7ste lam rdo ba dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo thams cad bsalanenas tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab dri zhim po sna tshogs kyi pog phor dag bshams/ dar gyi chun 'phyang mang po dpyangasarlu/bar bar du me tog gi gzhal med khang dag byas so/ /yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī rnams kyis ni chu bo gang gā nas yangs pa can gyi bar du de bas lhag par khyad par du 'phags par lam dang grong khyer dag stor du bcug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgongs ka nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs te tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo na lan da gang na ba der 'dong ngo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dang yul ma ga 2—45

d+ma'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ na lan dar byon nas na lan da na a mra'itutshal dgag dbye can zhes bya ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe nakhulan da na kun dusargyu 'dam0bu'i tshong pa zhes bya ba rgas pa/ 'khogs pa/ gtugs pa btsas nas lo brgya nyi shu lon pa zhig gnas pa la/ na lan da'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams bkur sti byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed de/dgra bcom par bkur ro/ /de nas kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa'i sngon gyi grogs po dang / blon po dang / gnyen dang / snag0gi gnyen mtshams su gyur pa'i lha gang yin pa de 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te bdag gis kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa la 'di skad ces/ drang srong khyod tshur shog /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyad0pa spyod cig ces smrasalgen/ gang yang bdag gisatshig mi nyan7pa de srid pas/ ma la bdag de'i drung du song ste yid kyi dri ba 'dzin du gzhug go snyam nas/ de nas lha de kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /drang srong tshur shog /kho bo las yid kyi dri ba long la kun chub par gyis shig /ji ltar mdza' bo ma yin pa la mdza' bo ltar bcos pa yin par blta bar bya/ ji ltar bdag dang 'dra ba'i mdza' bo yin par rig par bya/ ci'i phyir spong / ji ltar nad med pa 'thob/ drang srong gang zhig khyod kyi yid kyi dri ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa 'di dag tshig gis lung bstan pas sems rangs par byed pa de'i thad du khyod tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig ces smras nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pas lha de las yid kyi dri ba bzung ste kun chub par 2—46

byas nas 'od srung rdzogs byed gang na ba der song ste phyin nas 'od srung rdzogs byed kyi drung du yid kyi7dri ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa/ ji ltar mdza' bo ma yin pa la mdza' bo ltar bcos pa yin par blta bar bya zhes bya ba nas ji ltar nad med pa 'thob par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /'od srung rdzogs byed kyis de'i yid kyi dri bkuyid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa rnams kyang mi shes rnam par mi shes na lan glan ③pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/de nas kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa 'di snyam du sems te/ 'od srung rdzogs byed kyisasrebadag gi yid kyi dri ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa rnams kyang mi shes rnam par mi shes na lan glanasapa lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam nas/ de kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu dang / smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can dang / mi pham 0skra'i la ba can dang / ka t+ya'i ⑦bu nog can dang /gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu gang na ba der song ste phyin nas gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu'i mdun du yid kyi dri ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa/ ji ltar mdza' bo ma yin pa la mdza' bo ltar bcos pa yin par blta ⑧bar bya zhes bya ba nas gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu'i bar gyis kyang bdag gi7yid kyi dri ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa rnams kyang mi shes/ rnam par mi shes na lan glan pa lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam mo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa 'di snyam du sems te/ gang la yid kyi dri ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa'i ⑩tshig gis lung bstan 8pa mi thob pa de 'dra ba'i rab tu byung bas bdag la ci zhig bya/ bdag gi nye du rnams la longs spyod rgya cher yod pas/ ma la bdag 'dug la 'dod pa yang longs spyad cing sbyin pa 2—47

yang btangatu/ bsod nams kyang bya'o snyam mo/ /yang de'i blo skyes pa/ ma la bdag dge sbyong gi ta ma gang na ba der 'gro bar bya'o snyam nas de chas pa na ②yang bsams pa/ re zhig dge sbyong dang bram ze rgan rabs gang dag⑧yin pa 'di lta ste/ 'od srung rdzogs byed nas gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu'i bar gong ma bzhin te/ de rnams kyis re zhig yid kyi dri ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa rnams kyang mi shes rnam par mi shes dun dge sbyong gi ta ma nas dugazhin pa gsar dusherab tu byung bas7lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam du bsams te slar ldog par 'dod pa las/ yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ sngon gyi kun du rgyu rnyingashepa rgan po 'khogs pa spyod pa'i slob dpon dag las bdag gis7 dge slong gzhon nu la brnyas par mi bya/ dge slong gzhon nu la zil gyis mnan7par mi bya ste/dge slong gzhon nu7yang de ni dbang che ba mthu che bar gyur pa yin no zhes thos so snyam du bsams nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar yid kyi zhu ba yid kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa/ji ltar mdza' bo ma yin pa la mdza' bo ltar bcos pa yin par blta bar bya zhes bya ba nas ji ltar nad med pa 'thob ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ mdza' bo gzhan la rnam par smod byed cing / /de ni bdag tu zad do zhes smra la/ /las kyang sla dgu0'dam zhing byed pa de/ /bdag gi bshes ma yin par shes par bya/ /gang zhig bden pa ma yin tshig /mdza' bo dag la smra byed cing / /smra la las su mi byed pa'ang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs shes te/ /de lta bu ni mdza' bo ma yin 2—48

patul mdza' bo ltar bcos pa yin par shes par bya'o②/ /ji ltar bdag dang 'dra ba'i mdza' bo yin par rig parashebya zhe na/ gang zhig rtag tu bag med dbye ba yi/ /bsam pas glags lta de ni mdza' min gyi/ /gang zhig 'dir ni snying dang 'drar gyur paraX/ /gzhan gyis mi phyed de ni mdza' bo yin/ /de lta bu ni bdag dang 'dra ba'i mdza' bo yin par rig par bya'o/ /ci'i phyir spong zhe na/ skyes bu gcesalgepa mthar 'byin cing / /'bras bu lta7bar byed pa ni/ /rab tu dga' ba skyed pa'i gnas/ /rab bsngags 'dren pa'i zhi ba sgomatsho/ /de don du gnyer bar bsgom mo/ /ji ltar nad med pa7'thob ce na/ rab tu dben pa'i ro dang ni/ /nye bar zhi ba'i ro shes nas/ /chos la dga' ba'i ro 'thung ba/ ri/nad med sdig pa med par 'gyur/ /de ltar na nad med pa 'thob bo / /de nas kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'i thugs kyis ni bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen no snyam du rig nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gau ta ma bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thobalgepa lta na/ bcom ldan 'das dge sbyong7gi ta ma'i spyan sngar bdag gis tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /kun du rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob ste/ de ltar rab tu byung nas tshe dang ldan pa des zhes bya ba nas de7sems shin tu rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom par gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/2—49

kun dga' bo dmar bu can gyi grong dunye'adong ngo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu dmar bu can gyi grong khyer dang rgyal po'i khab kyi bar gyi dbus na rgyal po'i gnas 'od ma'i dbyug pa can dukhunub mo nye bar rtenasacing bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga dang khyed cag kho nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag ma shes/ ma mthong / khong du ma chud / so sor ma rtogs pas lam ring po 'dir rgyug cing 'khor bar gyur to/ /bzhi po de dag gang zhe na/ nga dang khyed cag kho nas zhes bya ba nas/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa ma shes ma mthong zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /nga dang khyed cag kho nas zhes pa nas/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba dang / ༷sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam ma shes ma mthong zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ngas sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa rjes su rtogs shing so sor rtogs pas srid pa'i sred pa bcad pas 'khor ba'i skye ba zad del/da ni srid pa gzhan med dol/ /ngas sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba dang7/ 0sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa rjes su rtogs shing so sor rtogs pas srid pa'i sred pa bcad pas 'khor ba'i skye ba zad deyi/ da ni srid pa gzhan med do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal te7/bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nga dang khyed cag kho na yis/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag /ji lta ba bzhin ma mthong bas/ /lam ni7ring du 'khor bar gyur8/ /2—50

bden pa de dag mthong nas ni/ /srid tha'i sred pa bcad nas su/ /'khor ba'i skye ba zad pas na/ /da ni srid pa gzhan med do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te①/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo rgyadamar bu can gyi grong gang na ba der ③'dong ngo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang yul ma ga d+ma'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na dmar bu can gyi grong du byon to0/ /dmar bu can gyi grong gi dmar bu can gyi mchod rten na bzhugs so/ /dmar bu can gyi grong gi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga d+ma'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs nas dmar bu can gyi grong du byon te/ dmar bu can gyi mchod rten na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang tshogs nas tshogs dang / khyu nas khyur phradasacing 'dugaphunas dmar bu can gyi grong nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogasashegacig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dmar bu can gyi grong gi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dag lnga po 'di dag ni bag med pa'i nyes dmigs dag yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dag 'di la bag med pa bag med pa la gnas pa'i rgyus longs spyod chen po las nyams par 'gyur te/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dag bag med pa bag med 2—51
