ta ma la blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyinyeltar mnyanasate/ bzhon pa bzang po bstadasnyenas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bcibs pa bzang po bstadakyilags te/ lha da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de'i tshe sring mo mdzes ldan dang / nyi ldan gnyis0rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bkad sar 'ongs par gyur te/ sring mo mdzes ldan dang / nyi ldan gnyis kyis lha deng nyid bcom ldan 'das la bltakhuba'i phyir bzhud do zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha gal te deng nyid bcom ldan 'das gzigs pa'i phyir gshegs na/ lha 'di ltar bdag cag gi tshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la dbus phyag mdzod la gnod pa chungashengam/nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ 'tsho'am/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par spyod dam zhes snyun7gsol bar gsol/ de bzhin du bya'o zhes ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis mnyan nas/ de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bzhon7pa bzang po la zhon te 'chag khang nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste/ des ji tsam bzhon pa'i sa'i bar du bzhon pas song nas bzhin7pa las babs te/ rkang pa kho nas kun dga' ra bar zhugs7so/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas ko sa la'i rgyal po 2—200

gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gau ta ma sring mo mdzes ldan dang nyi ldan gnyis bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma'i zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ 'tsho'am/①bskyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par spyod dam zhes snyan gsol lags so/ /sring mo mdzes ldan dang nyilaldan gnyis kyis pho nya gzhan ma rnyed dam/ ci na rgyal po chen po nyid las gzhanasam yin/ kye gau ta ma sring mokyimadzes ldan dang / nyisaldan gnyis bdag gi bkad sarakhumachis pa na/ deng nyid lha bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir mchi 'tshal lo zhes thos so thos nas kyang bdag la 'di skad ces mchis teni/ lha gal te deng nyid bcom ldan 'das gzigs pa'i phyir bzhud par bzhed na/ bdag cag gi tshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la dbus phyag mdzod la zhes bya ba nas reg par spyod dam zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal po chen po khyod dang sring mo mdzes ldan dang nyi ldan gnyis bde bar gyur cig /re zhig gal te zhu btulung bstan pa'i slad du skabs phye na shes ldan gau ta ma la bdag phyogs gzhan 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /rgyal po chen po ci dang ci 'dod pa zhus shig /kye gi ta ma bdag gis khyod 'di skad ces dge sbyong ngam bram ze gzhan gyis thams cad shes pa'am / mthong ba gang yin pa de ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de gnas med do zhes gsung ngo zhes thos na/ gi ta ma khyod kyis de skad du bka' stsal par dgongs lags sam/ rgyal po chen po de skad du smras par mi dran no/ /de'i tshe sde dpon 'phags skyes po zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sde dpon 'phags skyes 2—201

po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sde dpon nyi ma snga ma dang tshes snga ma'i7nyi ma dag la rgyal po'i pho7brang du rgyal po dang / blon po dang / rgyal po'i 'khor rnams 'dus te 'khod pa na gtamasade lta bu sus glengs pa0dran nam/ lha dran te/'di lta ste/ bkra shis ldan gyi bu bram ze'i khye'u yang dag rgyal bakhulags so/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis mi zhig la smras pa/ kwa'i nang rje7khyod bkra shis ldan gyi bu bram ze'i khye'unyeyang dag rgyal ba gang na ba der song la phyin nas / bkra shis ldan gyi bu bram ze'i khye'u yang dag rgyal ba la 'di skad ces ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal khyod 'bod do zhes thos shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi7ltar mnyan nas/ bkra shis ldan gyi bu bram ze'i khye'u yang dag rgyal ba gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bkra shis ldan gyi bu bram ze'i khye'u yang dag rgyal ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal khyod 'bod do/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis mi de song nas ring po ma lon par rig nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gau ta ma 'di la kha cig don dang tshig ngan par bzung ba 'dzin pa lta mchis lags sam/ rgyal po chen po yod de/ don de gzhan kho na yin pa las de gzhan kho nar gzhan dag la smra'o/ r+sha/shes ldan gi ta mas ji lta bu zhig tu bka' stsal par dgongs lags/ rgyal po chen po ngas ni 'di skad du dge sbyong ngam bram ze gzhan gyis thams cad shes pa'am/ mthong ba gang yin pa de ni gnas ma yin go skabs med de gnas med do zhes bka' stsal par dran nol/ /shes ldan gi ta ma de skad du gsungs pa ni rigs pa'i tshul lags so/ / shes ldan go ta mas de skad du gsungs pa ni shin tu rigs pa'i tshul lags so/ /2—202

re zhig gal te zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du7skabs phyesan shes ldanakhul bdag zhu ba gzhan yang phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /rgyal po chen po ci dang ci 'dod pa zhus shig /kye gau ta mas0rigs ni bzhi po 'di dag ste/ bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs lags na de dag la khyad par ra4/ bsam pa'am/ tha dad du bgyi ba cung0zad mchis sam/ rgyal po chen po yod de/ de la bram ze'i rigs gang dag yin pa dang /rgyal rigs gang dag yin pa de dag ni 'jig rten gyis mthon por bkur ba yin no / /rje'u rigs gang dag yin pa dang / dmangs rigs gang dag yin pa de dag ni 'jig rten gyis dma' bar brtsis pa yin no/ /shes ldan gau ta ma la bdag cag mthong ba'i chos kyi donasalas brtsams te zhu ba ni mi zhu lags so/ /'on kyang tshe slad ma'i don las brtsams te zhu ba zhu7lags so/ /kye gi ta ma rigs ni bzhi po 'di dag ste/ bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs lags na de dag la khyad par ramanya bsam pa'am/tha dad du bgyi ba 'ga' mchis sam/ rgyal po chen po rigs ni bzhi po 'di dag ste/ rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs yin la/ de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos gdams ngag sbyin pa dang / rjes su ston pa dang / chos ston pa rnyed na/de dag la 'di lta ste/ ma 'ongs pa tshe phyi ma la khyad par ramanya bsam pa'am/tha dad du bya ba 'ga' yod dam/ kye gi ta ma rigs ni bzhi po 'di dag ste/rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs lags la/ de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos 2—203

gdams ngag stsol ba'am/ rjes su ston pa'am/ chos ston pa rnyed na/ de dag la 'di lta ste spangs pa la khyad par ramanyu/ bsam pa'am/ tha dadarnyudu bgyi ba 'ga' mchis sam/ rgyal po chen po rigasaphubazhi po 'di dag ste/ rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs yin la/de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos gdams ngag sbyin pa'am/ rjes su ston pa'am/ chos ston pa rnyed na/ de dag la 'di lta ste/ spangs pa la khyad par ramanya/ bsam pa'am/ tha dad du bya ba ⑤'ga' yod dam/ de'i phyir rgyal po chen po khyod nyid dul dri yisame/khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan thob shig /rgyal po chen po dper na 'di la gdulasnyob bzhi po glang po che gdul7ba'am/ rta gdul ba'am/ glang gdularwanyeba'am/ skyes pa gdul5)ba zhig yod la/ de las gdul ba gnyis ni ma dul ba rnam par ma dul bar gyur la/ gnyis ni shin tu dul ba shin tu rnam par dul bar gyur na/ rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ gdul ba gnyis po ma dul ④ba rnam par ma 8dul ba dag ci ga re zhig ma dul ba bzhin dul ba'i sar 'gro ba'am/ rnam par ma dul ba bzhin rnam par dul ba'i cha sta len par 'gyur ra4)/ kye gi ta ma ma lags so/ /gang yang gdul ba gnyis po shin tu dul ba dang / shin tu rnam par dul ba de dag shin tu dul bas dul ba'i gnas su 'gro ba'am/ shin tu rnam par dul bas dul ba'i cha sta len par 'gyur ram/ kye gau ta ma de lta lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du sa gang zhig dad pa can gyis thob par bya ba de ma dad pas 'thob par 'gyur ba de ni gnas med la/ g.yo med pa dang / skyon med pa dang / brtson 'grus 2—204

brtsams pa dang / shes rab can gyis thob par bya ba de shes rab 'chal pas thob pa ①de ni gnas med kyi sa gang zhig dad pa can gyis thob par bya ba de ②dad pa can gyis 'thob par 'gyur ba 'disnyeni gnas yod la/ g.yo med pa dang / skyon med pa dang / brtson0'grus brtsams pa dang / shes rab can gyis thob par bya ba de shes rab can gyis 'thob par 'gyur ba'i gnasasnyede ni yod do/ /kye gi ta ma rigs ni bzhi po 'di dag ste/ rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs lags la/ de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos gdams ngag rgyu75 ba'am / rjes su ston pa'am/ chos ston pa rnyed par gyur cing de dag gtso bo'i yan lag lnga dang ldan par gyur la/ de dag gis kyang mnyam mtshungs par spangs par gyur na de dag gis7rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba la khyad par ram/ bsam pa'am/ tha dad du bya ba 'ga' mchis sam/ de'i phyir rgyal po chen po khyod nyid la dri yisayi/ khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan thob shig /rgyal po chen po dper na shar phyogs nas bram ze gzhon nu zhig 'ongs pa dang rka/ de la 'ga' zhig gis 'di skad du gzhon nu tshur/ shing sātshwa)la skam po las gtsub stan byos la steng du gtsub shing zhog5)ste me dbyung ba'i phyir gtsubs la me phyung shig ces smras pa dang / des7shing sā la skam po las gtsub stan byas nas steng du gtsubaneshing bzhag ste/ me delodabyung ba'i phyir gtsubs nas me phyung / lho0 phyogs nas rgyal〈 )rigs gzhon nu zhig 'ongs pa dang / de la 'ga' zhig gis 'di skad du rgyal rigs gzhon nu tshur/ sbas skam po las gtsub stan byos stel steng du gtsub shing zhog nyeste/ me dbyung ba'i phyir gtsubs 2—205

la me phyung shig ces smras pa dang / des 57skam po las gtsub stan⑧byas nas steng du gtsub shing bzhag ste/ me dbyung ba'i phyir gtsubs rgyanas me phyung /nub phyogs nas rje'u rigs gzhon nu zhig 'ongs pa dang / de la 'ga' zhig gis 'di skad du rje'u durigs gzhon nu tshur/ shug pa ⑦skam po las gtsub stan byosasnyel steng du gtsub7shing zhog ste/ me dbyung ba'i phyir gtsubs la me phyung shig ces smras pa dang / sgodes shug pa skam po las gtsub stan byas nas steng du gtsub shing bzhag ste/ me dbyung ba'i phyir gtsubs nas me phyung /byang phyogs nas dmangs rigs gzhon nu zhig 'ongs pa dang / de la 'ga' zhig gis 'di skad du kye dmangs rigs gzhon nu tshur/ tsan dan skam po las gtsub stan byos la steng du gtsub shing zhig7ste/ me dbyung ba'i phyir gtsubs la me phyung shig ces smras pa dang /za8 des tsan dan skam po las gtsub stan byas nas steng du gtsub shing bzhag ste/ me dbyung ba'i phyir gtsubs nas me phyung ba dang / de dag 'ga' zhig gis gcig tu bsdus nas 'dam bu bcer ba'am/sog ma'i phung por bcugatson rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ mi rigs tha dad pas shing sna tshogs las phyung ba'i me de las ji ga me 'di ni 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ gsal ba'o// //'dul ba gzhis/ bam po sum bcu rtsa gsum pa/ me 'di ni de lta ma yin no / /me 'dis ni me'i⑧bya ba byed nus so/ /me 'dis ni mi nus so zhes bya ba'i khyad par ram/ bsam (spepa'am/ tha dad du bya ba 'ga' yod dam/'on te me de thams cad 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ gsal5)ba yin zhing me de thams cad kyis me'i bya ba byed nus/ kye gau ta ma zhugs de thams 2—206

cad 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ gsal ba lags shing zhugs detuthams cad kyis zhugs kyi bgyi ba bgyid rngo thogasnyelags so/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du bag yod pas ③thob pa gtso bos gtsubs ④pa'i me de la ni 'di lta ste/rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba la khyad par dang / bsam pa dang /tha dad du bya ba 'ga' yang med do/ /shes ldan gi ta mas de skad gsungs pa ni rigs pa'i tshul lags so/ /re zhig zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du skabs phye na shes ldan khyod la bdag gzhan yang phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags sonya/ /rgyal po chen po ci dang ci 'dod pa zhus shig /kye gi ta ma lha rnams mchis sam/ rgyal po chen po lha gang dag yin par shes/ lha gang dag sha khon dang bcas/'gran7zla dang bcas/ gnod pa dang bcas shing 'di lta bur 'ong zhingakhu'ong bar 'gyur ba'am/ lha gang dag sha khon med/ 'gran zla med/ gnod pa med cing 'di lta bur mi 'ong zhing 'ong bar mi 'gyur ba yin9 lha de dag ni re zhig der7bas/ lha gang dag sha khon dang bcas/ 'gran zla dang bcas/gnod pa dang bcas shing / 'di lta bur mchi zhing tsomachi bar 'gyur ba'i lha de dag tshe bas/ sug las bas/ bsod nams bas nas gnas/ de nas 'chi 'pho bar 'gyur ba de na lha'am lha'i bus/ lha'am lha'i bu gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar bgyi ba'am/ spyug par rngo thog lags sam/ rgyal po chen po lha gang dag sha khon7dang bcas/ 'gran0 zla dang bcas/ gnod pa dang bcas shing 'di lta bur 'ong zhing〈 )'ong bar 'gyur ba de dag las zas / tshe zad bsod nams zad nas gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar 'gyur ba de na lha'am lha'i bus/ lha'am lha'i bu gnas de nas 'chi nye'apho bar bya ba'amatsho/ sgyug 2—207

par mi nus so/ /kye gau ta ma de na lha gang dganyesha khonasridang bcas/ 'granasazla dang bcas/ gnod pa dang bcas shing 'di lta bur mchi zhing mchi dubar 'gyur ba de dag gis lha gnod pa ma mchis pasnyide dag gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar bgyi ba'am/ sgyug pa'i rngo thogakhulags sam/ de nas sde7dpon 'phags skyes pos ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge sbyong gi ta ma ni 'di skad ces lha rnams ni tshe lhag par ring bdu/ lhag par yun ring du gnas pa yin no zhes gsung bar7'gyur ba gang lags pa'i gnas de mchis so//de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi snam7 logs na rdul yab thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'di snyam du sems te/ sde dpon lus 'phags po 'di ni ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu yin la/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi chos nyid kyi sras yin pas sras dang bu ni lhan cig gtam byar rung ngo snyam du rig nas sde dpon lus 'phags po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sde dpon ji snyam du sems/ ko sa la'i rgyal po'i rang gi yul yin la/ de na yang de'i tshig gis khrims su bca' ba la debang sgyur na sems can dbang chung ngu kha cig gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar bya ba'agonye/ spyug par nus sam/ dge sbyong nus so/ /sde dpon ji snyam du sems/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi rang gi yul ma yin la/ de na yang de'i tshig gis khrims su bca' ba la dbang mi sgyur na/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sems can dbang chung ba kha cig gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar bya ba'am tsho/ sgyug par nus sam/ dge sbyong ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rang gi yul ma yin 0la/ de na yang de'i tshig gis 2—208

khrims su bca' ba la dbang mi7sgyur na/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sems can dbang chung ngu kha cig gnas de nas 'chi 'phoshebar bya ba'am/ sgyug par mi nus so/ /sde dpon khyod kyis sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams yod skad thos sam/ dge sbyong ko sa la'i bdag po rgyal po 'di nyid las thos so sde dpon ji snyam du sems/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar bya ba'am/ spyug par nus sam/dge sbyong re zhig ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams mthong ba yang nyams su mi myong na gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar bya ba'am/sgyug pa lta smosasakyang ci dgos/ sde dpon de bzhin du gnod pa dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis gnod pa med pa'i lha rnams mthong ba yang nyams su mi myong na gnas de nas 'chi 'pho bar bya ba'am/ spyug pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te⑤/de ni gnas med do/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gau ta ma dge sbyong 'di'i ming ci lags/rgyal po chen po kun dga' bo yin no/ /shes ldan kun dga' bos de skad du smras pa ni rigs pa'i tshul yin no/ /shes ldan kun dga' bos de skad du smras pa ni shin tu rigs pa'i tshul yin no/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /re zhig gal te zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/ shes ldan gau ta ma la bdag zhu ba gzhan yang phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /rgyal po chen po gang dang gang 'dod pa zhus shig /kye gi ta ma ci lags/ tshangs pa de mchis lags sam/ rgyal po chen po tshangs pa gang yin par shes tshangs pa gang zhig gnod pa dang bcas pas 'di lta bur 'ong bar 2—209

'gyur ba'am/ tshangs pa gang zhig gnod pa med pas 'di lta bur mi 'ong zhing 'ong bar mi 'gyur ba yin/ kye gi ta ma bdag ni de la tshangs pa gang zhig gnod pa ma mchis pas 'di lta bur mi mchinyezhing mchi bar mi 'gyur ba'i tshangs pa de lags par 'tshal lo/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyisakhubacom ldan 'das dang lhan cig skabs kyi gtam desalta bu glengs soX/ /de nas mi des bkra shis ldan gyi bu bram ze'i khye'u yang dag rgyal ba khrid nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha de 'di lags so/ /de nas bkra shis ldan gyikhubu bram ze'i khye'u7yang dag rgyal bas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la rgyal ba dang tshe spel ba dag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bkra shis ldan gyi7bu bram ze'i khye'u yang dag rgyal ba can la ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u nyi ma snga ma dang / byutshes snga ma la rgyal po'i pho brang du rgyal po dang blon po dang 'khor rnams 'dus shing 'dug pa na/ dge sbyong gi ta ma 'di skad ces dge sbyong dang bram ze gzhan gyis thams cad shes pa'am/ mthong ba gang yin pa7ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de de ni gnas med do zhes gsung ngo zhes pa'i gtam de lta bu sus smras dran nam/lha dran lags te 'di lta ste/ sde dpon 'phags skyes po de skad mchi'oci/ /'di lta ste/ bkra shis ldan gyi bu bram ze'i khye'u yang dag rgyal ba'o zhes de dag phan tshun de ltar gtam khungs 'byin par byed do/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi rim gro pa'i mis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha gshegs pa'i dus la bab lags so/ /lha dus la bab lags so/ /2—210

de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to①/ /shes ldan gi ta ma bdag gis thams cadasamakhyen pa nyid las brtsams te zhu ba zhus pa yang shes ldan go ta masasabadag la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zhu ba zhus pa lung bstanakyilags/ 'dir rigs rnam par dag pa dang /lhag pa'i lha dang / lhag pa'i tshangs pa las brtsams te/ shes ldan gi ta ma la bdag gis zhu ba zhus pa yang shes ldan gi ta mas bdag la lhag pa'i tshangs pa zhu ba zhus pa lung bstan lags te/ shes ldan gau ta ma la bdag gis zhu ba gang dang gang zhus pa de dang de kho na shes ldan gi ta mas bdag la zhu ba lung bstan lags pas / shes ldan gi ta ma la bdag gis gzhan gsol du ci mchis/ shes ldan gi ta ma bdag ni bgyi ba dang bsgrubalgepa mang lags pas da mchi lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de'i dus la bab par shes par gyis shig /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste yi rangasalgenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyisazhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi7spyan snga nas song ngo //de nas bcom ldan 'das ko sa la nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs ⑩pa dang mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das ko sa la nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod na bdag kho na'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der songarwa〉ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /2—211

phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyimanyebadag mgon med zas sbyin la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug② /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin stanakhulas langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas/stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos nyan pa'i phyir 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad deni/rnam grangs du mar7chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug⑩ /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad〈spenas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa skabs skabs su gdugs tshod gsol bar byed pa na/ dge slong rnams kyis 2—212

thog mar sprang po rnams la kha zas chung7zad byin pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya bar byed pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang gis longs spyadakunas lhung bzed kyi lhag ma lasasbyin par bya'o/ /de na sprang po gnyis po bram ze'i khye'u zhig dang / rgyal rigs kyi khye'u zhig yod pa las/ bram ze'i khye'us dus ma shes nas de dang por slong0bar brtsams pa las/ de la dge slong 'gas kyang chungasazad kyang ma byin no/ /rgyal rigs kyi khye'us7phyi nas slong ba dang / des phal cher rnyed nas des bram ze'i khye'u la smras pa/ khyod kyis cung zad rnyed dam/ des khros nas smras pa/ gal te kho bo la dbang zhig yod na shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong thams cad mgo drung tsonas bcad de sa la dor (nyeb zhig /rgyal rigs kyi khye'us smras pa/ gal te kho bo la 'byor pa zhig yod na kho bos nyi ma re re〈nyesangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la zhal zas ro brgyacadang ldan pas bstabs pa zhig /de gnyis de ltar gcig la gcig sngalgezhing mnyan yod nas byung nas shing drung zhig tu nyal ba dang / shing rtas 'khyam pa zhig phyogs der 'ongs te/ des bram ze'i khye'u de'i mgo bcad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba de la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro yid gtso yin/ /yid mgyogasalge rab tu snang ba'i yid kyis ni( nye/ /smras sam byas na de nas sdug bsngal de/ /'thob 'gyur 'khor lo 'phyan pas mgo bo bcad/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa stebaka' stsal pa de'i don ci lags/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis (nyebram ze'i khye'u sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge 2—213

slong gi dge 'dun la sems gdug ①pas tshig rtsub po phyung ②ba gang yin pa de mthong ngam/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /de sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la sems gdug pas tshig rtsubasnyepo phyung nas mnyan yod nas byung ste shing drung zhig tu nyal ba dang / shing rtas 'khyam0pas de'i mgo bcad par gyur to/ /ngas de las dgongs nas/ chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro yid gtso yin/ /zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du/ 'thob 'gyur 'khor lo 'phyan pas mgo bo bcad/ /ces bya ba'i bar gsungs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan yod na tshong dpon zhig bu med par shi'o/ /mnyan yod kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'dus nas smras pa/ su zhig tshong dpon du gzhug /kha cig gis smras pa/ su bsod nams kyi mthu chen po dang ldan pa'o/ /ji ltar shes par bya/brtag0mod ces de nas de rnams brtagashepar brtsams pa las/ de rnams kyis7rgyal rigs kyi khye'u de shing gi grib ma la nyal ba na shingayigazhan rnams kyi grib ma yol bar gzhol/ yol bar 'bab/ yol bar bab na/ shing de'i grib ma ni khye'u yide'i lus las ma yol bar mthong nas/ de rnams kyis de bslang ste tshong dpon du dbang bskur ba dang de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag la dpal gyi 'byor pa'i skal ba ci yod pa de dag 'thams cad ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la brten te yin gyisatso/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu gdugs tshod la spyan drang ngo snyam nas/de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong dpon de la chos dang ldan pa'i 2—214

gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' tshobar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtamanyegyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug② /yang dag par gzengs bstod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas tshong dpon de stanasalas langs te0bla gos phrag pa0gcig tu gzararnyunas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas stan duches dma' ba zhig blangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang /bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas/ de dang mthun pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de zhes bya ba nas/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsagasalgepa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo 0rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so zhes bya ba dang / bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis8/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chadasaji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi 0bar mngon par dad lags so zhes bya ba'i 2—215

bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u tshong dpon de la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug①/ yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs7te gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang du gshegs ③nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung dul gdan bshams pa la bzhugs te tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro yid gtso yin/ /yid mgyogs durab tu dang ba'i yid kyis ni/ /smras sam byas na de nas bde ba de/ /'thob 'gyur gribatum yol bar mi 'gyur bzhin / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pas bka' stsal pa de'i don ci lags/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis rgyal rigs kyi khye'u sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la sems dang ba bskyed pa gang yin pa de mthong ngam/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /de sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la sems dang bshebaskyed nas mnyan yod nas byung ste shing drung zhig tu nyal ba las mnyan yod kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gisashetshong dpon du dbang bskur nas/ de mthong ba'i chos kho na la7longs spyod mngon par 'phel bar gyur to/ /ngas de las dgongs nas/ chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro yid gtso yin/ /zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du 'thob 'gyur grib ma yol bar mi 'gyur bzhin/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gsungs so//gdu〈nyebu can du byon nas gdu〈nyebu can du sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya ba rgyas par gong ma bzhin du'o/ /sa can du byon nas sa can du sangs rgyas 2—216

bzhi'i gdan zhes bya ba gong ma bzhin du'o/ / seng ge can gyi grong du byon nasatuseng ge can gyi grong du sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya ba rgyas par gong ma bzhin du'o / /grong gsar du byon nas grong gsar du sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya bshegong ma bzhin du'o/ /grong khyer can du byon nas grong khyer can du sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya bsnyegong ma bzhin du'o//rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas de'i tshe kun du rgyu khri'u brtsegs zhes bya ba ma ga dhā bzang mo'i rdzing gi 'gram na gnas te/ de0mtshan mo mchil pas nyasabashor cing za bar byed do/ /de nam langs nas ni khri'u'i steng du khri'u bzhag pa la 'dug nas tshigs su bcad pas smra ste5nye/ chos kyi chos mchog gis 'tsho7)srog chags dag /'ga' la yang 'tshe mi byed dge slongasa'agyur/ /zhi ba'i yid kyis7sgong dang brtul zhugs spyad/ /dul ba de ni zhi ba'i rjes su mthun/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i gdul7ba'i dus mkhyen nas de'i drung du gshegs te bka' stsal pa/ tshigs bcad de ni ji lta bar/ /gal te khyod kyang de 'dra na/ /khyod kyang dam par brtsir rung na/ /spong ba khyod ni de mi 'dra/ /re zhig nye bar zhi zhing dul ba dang / /srog chags 'ga' la'ang 'tshe bar mnyebyed par/ /zhi ba'i yid kyis spong dang brtul zhugs spyod/ /dul ba de ni zhi ba'i rjes su mthun/ /gangasnyel lus dang ngag dang yid kyis ( tre ni/ /nyes par byas pa yod pa ma yin la/ /gang zhig gnas gsum dag gis bsdams gyur pa / /dul ba de ni zhi ba'i rjes su mthun/ /de nas kun du rgyu khri'u brtsegs kyis bsams pa/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'i thugs kyis ni bdag gi sems mkhyen to snyam du rig nas mngon par dad par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 2—217

kyis de'i bsamanyepa dang / bag la nyalakhudang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so ①sor rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ thos pas kun du rgyu khri'u brtsegs zhes bya ba nas thog ma dumed pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ⑦ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag gis de khri'u'i steng du khri'u bzhag pa la 'dug pa mthong nas/ dge slong zhig gis khri'u'i steng du khri'u bzhag ste chos mnyanasnyen de bden pa'i snod du gyur kyang bden pa ma mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ ci'i phyir dge slong 'dis bden pa ma mthong snyam na ma gus pas yin par gzigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nyes dmigs gang ci byung ba de ni dge slong dag khri'u'i steng du khri'u bzhag nas 'dug pa yin no snyam nas de lta bas na dge slong gis khri'u'i steng du khri'u bzhag pa la7'dug par mi bya'o/ /'dug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab nas n+ya gro dhar byon nas de nas snga dro sham thabs mnabs/ na bza' chos gos dang lhung bzed bsnams te n+ya gro dhar bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / ser skya'i gzhi'i7bram ze'i bu mo zhig n+ya gro dhar bag mar btang ba dang / bram ze'i bu mos bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes pa/ sku 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pas/ 'od zer nyi ma stong bas lhag pa/ gshegs na rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu de 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom 2—218

ldan 'das 'di ni shākya'i rigs dga' ba las 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs kyi rgyal srid kyang spangs/ btsun mo mang po dang / mdzod dang / bang mdzod kyi 'byor pa rnams kyang spangs nas rab tu byung ba de yin te/ de da ltar bsod snyoms la rgyus/ gal te bdag las7bsod snyoms kyi zan bzhes na ni de la bdag gis dbul lo snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis de'i sems mkhyen nas lhung bzed bzed ②de/ sring mo gal te khyod kyis yongs su btang nasalhung bzed 'dir phul cig /de nas de lhag par dad pa skyes te/bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis bdag gi sems mkhyen to snyam du rig nas dad pa drag pos bcom ldan 'das la bsod snyoms kyi zan phul ba dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe zhes bya ba nas/ mdzod spurakhunub par gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par ni zhes bya ba nas/ 'dzum pa mdzad ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bram ze'i bu mo gang zhig dad pa skyes nas nga la bsod snyoms kyi zan phul ba de mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo bram ze'i bu mo de dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bskal pa bcu gsum du log par 'gro bar mi 'gyur zhing lha dang mi rnams su nying mtshams sbyar cing 'khor nas srid pa phyi ma dang / skye gnas phyi ma dang / lus phyi ma dang /bdag gis ngo bosathob pa phyi ma la rang sangs rgyas shin tu legs smon7zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /kun du bram ze'i bu mo che ge mo zhig dad pa skyes nas bcom 2—219

ldan 'das la bsod snyoms zan zhig phul bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyisatude rang byang chub tu lung bstan to zhes〈sgra grags so/ /de'i khyo mesatog dang yam sreg shing gi phyir dgon par song ba des bdag gi chung mas dge sbyong gi ta ma la bsod snyoms zan zhig phul bas/ dge sbyong gi ta mas de rang byang chub tu lung bstan to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang mi bzod pa skyes te/ bcom lden 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /shes ldan gau ta ma bdag gi sdum par7byon tam/ bram ze son to/ /shes ldan gi ta ma bdag gi⑧mchis 'brangaphrogis bsod snyoms bshos7 shig phul nas khyod kyis de rang byang chub tu lung bstan skad na mad dam/bram ze bden no/ /kye gi ta ma khyod 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu byung na/ da bsod snyoms bshos tsam gyi slad du ji ltar shes bzhin gyi brdzunatswagyi tshig gsung / sa bon 'di tsam gyi7'bras bu 'di'o zhes bgyi ba khyod la su zhig yid ches par 'gyur/ bram ze de'i phyir khyod nyid la dri yis④/khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan thob shig /bram ze ji snyam du sems/khyod kyis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos mthong ba 'ga' yod dam/ kye gau ta ma re zhig ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos gzhan lta zhog /n+ya gro dharmya'adi nyid du ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos shig mthong ba de re zhig gson cig /kye gi ta ma n+ya gro dha 'di'i shar phyogs na n+ya gro dha'i shing chen po zhig mchis te/ de'i ming gis grong 'di n+ya gro dhatshwa)zhes bgyi'o/ /de'i 'og na shing rta lnga brgya0 ma regatucing phan tshun ma thug par mchis nyelags so/ /bram ze n+ya gro dha de'i sa bon tshad ji tsam zhig yod/ ci re stezhig zhing rnang tsam mas / kye gi ta ma ma 2—220

lags so/ /re lde tsam mamanya/ til 'dru ba'i 'khor lo tsam mamanya/ shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam mamanya/ ba'i ko ba tsam mamakha/ bil ba tsam mamatsho/ ka pid tha'i 'bras bu tsam mamanya/ kye gi ta ma ma lags so/ /kye gau ta ma yesheyungs kur gyi bzhi cha tsam mchis lags so/ /bram ze sa bon de tsam gyisa'abras bu shing chen po ⑨de tsam zhig skyes so zhes bya ba khyod la su zhig yid ches par 'gyur/shes ldan gi ta ma yid ches kyang rung ma ches kyang rung bdag gi mngon sum du gyur lags so/ /kye gi ta ma re zhig zhing snag che ba ser sme5)ba dog sa tshwa sgo ma mchis 8pa'i phyogs su sa bon sar 8pa grung po ma nyams par mchis pa la dus dus su lhas char phabalgen des na shing n+ya gro n+ta7chen po 'dir 'khrungs lags so//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba de la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/bram ze khyod7kyis ji lta bur/ /zhing dang sa bon mngon sum ltar/ /de bzhin las kyi rnam smin yang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon sum mo/ /ji ltar bram ze khyod kyi sa bon ni/ /chung dang shin tu shing chen de mthong ba/ /bram ze ngas kyang sa bon chung ngu dang / /phun sum chen po de yang de bzhin mthong / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis7zhal nas ljags brkyang bas7dbu skra la thug pa'i bar zhal gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad g.yogs nas bram ze de la bka' stsal pa/bram ze de ji snyam du sems/ gang gi zhal nas ljags byung bas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad yog ③par byed pa de ci ga 'khor los sgyur ba'i 0rgyal srid stong gi phyir yang shes bzhin du brdzun 0gyi tshig gsung ngam/ kye gi ta ma ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ nga yi ljags ni sgyu med bden pas bskyed pa dag /ci ga mi bden pa ni gsung bar ⑪2—221

'gyur srid dam/ /bram ze nga yis ji skad bshad pa de bzhin pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yin zhes rtogs par bya ba'i rigs/ /de nas bram ze de mngon par dad nas de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang /khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas zhes bya ba nas/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te①/ btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchikhulags kyisakhubadag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchisabar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas bram ze de bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' nas yi rangs te⑦/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas bcom zhen 'das7kyi spyan snga nas song ngo// //sdom la/ skamashepi la dang sbrul gduga~X dang / /ma thu lagyedang yul 'khor skyong / /glang chen grong dang grong khyer che/ /srug na dang ni bram ze'i grong / /grong khyer nag po ro hi ta/ /gsinganem can dang de bzhin du/ /dga' ba 'phel bas tshogs su ni/ /byas te yang dag brjod pa yin//bcom ldan 'das skam pi lar byon nas skam pi la'i nags khrod na bzhugs sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa skam pi la la bka' stsal pa/kim pi la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la brtsams te bsgom pa khyod la bshad 2—222

kyis①/ de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungasashig dang bshad do zhes de skad bka' stsal pa na/ tshe dang ldan pa skam pi lasnyecang mi smra'o/ /lan gnyis su yang de bzhin/ lan gsum du yang de bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos tshe dang ldan pa kim pi la la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa skam pi la khyod la ston pa gsung ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'tshal to/ /tshe dang ldan pa gau ta ma rab tu 'tshal to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i dus la bab lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de'i dus la bab lags teyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi las brtsams te bsgom ⑦pa bshad na/ de'i slad du dge slong rnams kyis thos nas 'dzin parashe'agyur lags so/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir legs par nyon la yid la zung7shig dang bshad do/ /'di la dge slong gang yang grong dang grong rdal zhes bya ba dang / dran bzhin du dbugs brngubs na dbugs brngubs so zhes slob ste zhes bya ba nas/ 'gog pa'i rjes su lta zhing dbugs phyung ba slob ste zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gang gi tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos dran bzhin du dbugs brngubs na/ dran bzhin du dbugs brngubs so zhes slob pa zhes bya ba nas/ lus kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs te lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing dbugs phyung ngo zhes slob ste zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas so/ /de'i tshelo'aphags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes so/ /kun dga' bo dper na lam po che'i bzhi7mdor 2—223

rdul gyi mchod rten zhig brtsigs7par 'gyurashel de nas shar phyogs nas bzhonasapa can nam/ khyogs sam/ shing rtas 'khyam ༷pa zhig 'ongs nadu/ kun dga' bo ji snyam du sems/ rdul gyi mchod rten 'jig par 'gyur ram/ btsun pa 'gyur lags so/ /de bzhin du gang gi tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos dran bzhin du dbugs brngubs son/ /zhes bya ba nas nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes pa zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gang gi tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos dga' ba so sor myong ba zhes bya ba nas/ sems kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangasasate tshor ba rnams la tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing dbugs phyung ngo zhes slob bo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes so/ /dper na kun dga' bo lam po che'i bzhi7mdor rdul gyi mchod rten zhig brtsigs par gyur la/ de nas lho phyogs nas bzhon pa can nam/ khyogs sam/ shing rtas 'khyam5)pa zhig 'ongs na zhes bya ba nas/ tshor ba rnams la tshor ba'i rjes su lta'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes so/ /gang gi tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos sems so sor myong ba dang / sems rab tu dga' ba dang / sems mnyam par 'jog pa dang sems rnam par grol bar byed cing dbugs brngubs na sems rnam par grol bar byed cing dbugs brngubs so zhes slob bo sems rnam par grol bar byed cing dbugs phyung na sems rnam par grol bar byed cing dbugs phyung ngo zhes slobasnyiste/ sems la sems kyi7rjes su lta'o⑩/ /gang gi tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes te mchod rten de nyid 2—224

la nub phyogs nas zhes dper bya'o/ /de lus de dang tshor ba de dang sems de la brnab semasatuyid mi bde ba gnyis ka nub pas chos rnams la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing btang snyoms〈su gnas so/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes te/ dper na lam po che'i bzhisamador rdul gyi ༷mchod rten brtsigs ①par gyur la/ de nas byang phyogs nas bzhon dupa can nam khyogs sam/ shing rtas 'khyam pa zhig 'ongs na/ kun dga' bo ji snyam du sems/ rdul gyi mchodaXrten 'jig par 'gyur ram/ btsun pa de ltar 'gyur lags so/ /zhes bya ba nas de ltar chos la chos kyi rjes su lta bshezhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi0yid la byed pa yod par shes te/ kun dga' bo de ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i dbang du byas te/ bsgoms pa yin no//de nas bcom ldan 'das ri 'or7zhig tu byon to/ /ri 'or〈rtede na tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i zhang po drang srong rnams5)kyi nang ducharab tu byung ba de7tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'dul bar 'gyur bas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/mod gal gyi bu zhang po la soms shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan te/ de'i gdul ba'i dus shes nas drang srong rnams kyi bsti gnas su 'jug par brtsams sol/ /de nas drang srong des smras pa/ dge sbyong 'dug shig /bram ze rnams kyi bsti gnas 'dir ma 'jug shig /des smras pa/ nga yang bram ze yin no/ /drang srong des tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bram ze khyod la bsang5)byed med/ /2—225

blugs gzaranyeyang ni yod ma yin/ /khyod ni mgo reg mesamachod min/ /bram ze bdagasheces ci ste smra/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos kyang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bram ze nga yi0ngo tsha shes/ /bsangasabyed blugasakyigazar shes rab nyid/ /chu rgyun rtag 'bab dad pa ni/ /nga yi ril ba spyi blugs yin/ /nang du legs par mnyam bzhag pa'i/ /bden pa kho bo7me mchod de'-i//yang dag sdom dang dul ba yis/ /nyin mtshan du ni sbyin sreg byed/ /gal te de ltar gyur na yang dge sbyong mgo reg la ni 'dir skabs mi 'byed7do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos rlung dang char drag btang nas mtsho bran dang nye ba zhig tu song nas shing zhig gi drung du rten cing 'dug go/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo'i 'khor zhig gnas pa des bsams pa/ 'di ni 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po yin te/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo gnyis kyis bla mar bya ba yin gyisayi/ ma la bdag gis 'di'i mchod pa bya ba la brtson par bya'o snyam ste/ klu de gnas nas byung nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i lus la lan bdun du dkris ④te steng nas mgo'i gdengs ka chen po byas nas 'dug go/ /drang srong rnams kyi chos nyid kyis ⑩gal te sdug bsngale ⑩la ma bsams na drang srong gi chos las nyams par 'gyur bas de nas 'drang srong de 'di snyam du sems teyi/ rab tu byung ba de rlung dang char drag gis nyen nas shi bar gyur te0/ bdag drang srong gi chos las nyams par gyur na mi rung ngo snyam nas/ de nas bste gnas de nas phyir byung ste/ blta bar brtsams pa na/ des de mthong nas smras pa/ kye rab tu byung ba kho bo cag gi bsti gnas su zhugs shig /des smras pa/ drang srong chen 2—226

po khyod drang srong ginyechos de las nyams par gyur tam/ drang srong des de'i nga ro las ngosashes nas smras pa/ 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po lags sam/drang srong bdag skye bos de ltar shes so/ /'phags pa don ci zhig la byon/khyod nyid kyi gdulasaba'i dus shes nas 'ongs so tshur spyon bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du bzhud do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos zhang po khrid nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gi zhang po drang srong gi nang du rab tu byung ba 'di lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di la chos bshad pa'i rigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong de'i bsam0pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i chos bshad pa⑥mdzad de/ de thos pas drang srong des7phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas nas de nas stanashelas langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skadagye ces gsol to//btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung yib dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thobalgepa lta na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rludage slong tshur shog zhes bya bas rab tu phyung ngo zhes bya ba nas/de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /spa byi snam sbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhirachaganas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas 2—227

dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur/ /ces7bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'ol/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po song ba dang / klu gzhon nu de gnas de na gcig tu7mi dga' bar gyur nas/ de nas ri 'orasnyeder yams kyi nad dag btang ste/ bdag nyid drang srong gi cha byad du mngon par sprul nas bste gnas der song ste gnas so/ /de nas ri 'oraphun gnas pa'i skye dubo'i tshogs de bste gnas der lhags nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ drang srong chen po bdag cag la yams kyi nad byung na bdag cag gis ji ltar bgyi/ drang srong gis smras pa/ phyogs 'di nyid du shog la 'dug shig dang / zhi bar 'gyur rol/ /de nas ri 'orakun gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs de phyogs der lhags nas gnas so/ /phyogs der dusbrul gyis gdugs ⑨byas pas sbrul gdugs ⑩sprul gdugasatshwa)zhes bya bar grags te/ dad pa can rnams kyis gtsug lag khang yo byad thams cad yod pa zhig brtsigs so//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma thu la na 'bab chu rab tu bzangasaldan zhes bya ba'i 'gram slob pa rnams kyi a mra'i tshal na bzhugs7so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bdag nyid gling dang / bdag nyid skyabs dang / chos kyi gling dang / chos kyi skyabs la gnas par bya'i/ gling gzhan ma yin/ skyabs gzhan ma yin no/ /dge slong dag khyed kyis7bdag nyid gling dang / bdag nyid skyabs dang / chos kyi gling dang / chos kyi skyabs kyis gnas par bya'i(3/ gling gzhan ma yin zhing skyabs gzhan ma yin pa 'di la so sor yang dag par bslab par bya'o/ /mya ngan dang ske/ smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang /2—228

'khruganyepa rnams ni ji lta bu zhig yin/ gang zhig yod na ci la brten nas ci la mngon par zhen te/ bdag ni ci yin zhes rjes su ltakhub rnams la mya ngan dang /spre'usngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang /'khrug pa gang dag ma skyes pa ni skye zhing skyes pa rnams ni phyir zhing 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ni chos rnams kyi rtsa ba lags/bcom ldan 'das ni 'dren pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ni ston pa lags pas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di nyid dge slong rnams la bshad na/ bcom ldan 'das las dge slong rnams kyis thos nas 'dzin par 'gyur lags so/ /dge slong dag de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung ④shig dang bshad do / /dge slong dag gzugs yodakyin gzugs la brten0nas gzugs la mngon par zhen te/ gzugs ni bdag yin no zhes rjes su lta ba rnams la mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa gang dag ma skyesalgepa ni skye zhing skyes pa rnams ni phyir zhing 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ dge slong dag tshor ⑨ba dang / 'du shes dang ske/ 'du7 byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yod na/ rnam par shes pa la brten spenas rnam par shes pa la mngon par zhen te rnam par shes pa ni bdag yin no zhes rjes su lta7ba rnams la mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa gang dag ma skyes pa ni skye zhing skyes pa rnams ni phyir zhing 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag khyed kyis ltos shig ces bya ba nas/ dran bzhin du dbugs brngubs na brngubs so zhes slob ste/ tshor ba la tshor ba'i rjes su lta'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong 2—229

ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos tshor ba la tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing gnas so/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes te/ dper na kun dga' bo lam po che'i bzhi mdor rdul gyi mchod rten zhig brtsigs ①par gyur la lho phyogs nas bzhon ②pa can nam/ khyogs samanya/ shing rtas 'khyam0pa 'ongs na zhes bya ba nas/ tshor ba la tshor ba'i rjes su lta'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nangaXgi yid la byed pa yod par shes so/ /gang gi tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos sems so sor myong ba dang sems rab tu dga' ba dang /sems mnyam par 'jog pa dang sems rnam par grol bar byed cing dbugs brngubs so0zhes slob pa dang / sems rnam par grol bar byed cing dbugs phyung na sems rnam par grol bar byed cing dbugs phyung ngo zhes slob ste/ sems la sems kyi rjes su lta ba de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos sems la sems kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas sonya/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes so/ / dpe niphunub phyogs nas khyogs 'ong ba7de nyid bya'o / /de lus de dang tshor ba de dang sems de la brnab sems dang / yid mi bde ba de dag nub pas chos la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing btang snyoms su gnas so / /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos chos la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas so/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pa yod par shes te/ 'di lta ste lam po che'i bzhi mdor rdul gyi mchod rten zhig brtsigasalgepar gyur la/ de nas byang phyogs nas ni bzhin pa can nam/ khyogs sam/shing rtas 'khyam pa 'ongs na/ kun dga' bo ji snyam du sems/ rdul gyi 2—230

mchod rten 'jig par 'gyur ram/ btsun pa de ltar 'gyur lags so0zhes bya ba nas de ltar chos rnams la chos kyi rjes su lta'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa'i nyan thos gnas pa na nang gi yid la byed pakhuyod par shes te/ kun dga' bo de ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la brten ③nas bsgoms pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das yul sgra ngan nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ bang mdzod stug po can du byon nas/⑤ bang mdzod stug po can na bang mdzod stug po can gyi tshal na bzhugs sos/ /bang mdzod stug po can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das yul sgra ngan nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na bang mdzod stug po can du byon nas/ bang mdzod stug po can na bang mdzod stug po'i tshal na bzhugs so zhes thos so thos nas kyang tshogs nas tshogs dang / khyu nas khyur 'dus shing phradasnyenas bang mdzod stug po can nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi7zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bang mdzod stug po can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po sum bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ de'i tshe khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong 'khor de nyid du7'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong 'di snyam du sems te/ ji ltar bcom ldan 2—231

'das7kyis gsungs pa'i don bdag gis shes pa ltar na khyim pa khyim na gnas pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa gcig tu salasagyis dag pa/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ rnam par byang ba spyad pa 'di ni sla ba ma yin pas ma la bdag skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ngosasnyam mo / /de nas bcom ldan0'das kyis rnam grangs du mar bang mdzod stug po can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas bang mdzod stug po can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste yi rangasakyinas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo / /khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gis bang mdzod stug po can gyi ⑦gram ze dang khyim bdag rnams dong nas ring po ma lon par rig nas stan ⑧las langs te bla gos7phyag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung tsob dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob pa lta na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /khyim bdag gi bu pha dang ma gnyis kyis gnang ngam/ btsun pa ma gnang ngo / /khyim bdag gi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams 2—232

ni pha dang ma gnyis kyis ma gnang ba rab tu 'byin pa dang / bsnyen par rdzogs par mi byed do/ /btsun pa bdag gis ci nas pha dang mas gnang ba de ltar bgyi lags so/ /de nas khyim bdag gi ①bu yul 'khor skyong bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pasal mngon par dga' ste yi rangasalgenas/ rang gi khyim gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / pha dang ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum mkhyen par mdzod cig /bdag dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim ma mchis par rab tu 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /bu yul 'khor skyong shes par gyis shig /khyod nged kyi bu gcig pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba bzod pa mi mthun pa med pa yin pas khyod shi bar gyur na nged mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral grang / gson bzhin du ga la gtangakhu/ yab yum gal te re zhigasheganang na legs/ gal te ma gnang na deng slan cad 'tshalasnyim yang mi 'tshal/ phyag yang7mi 'tshal lo/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gis nyi ma gcig kyang zan bcad pa byas so/ /gnyis dang gsum nas bdun gyi bar du zan bcad pa byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi7pha dang mas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu yul 'khor skyong shes par gyis shig /khyod ni shin tu gzhon pa bde ba 'dod pa yin pas khyod kyi 8sdug bsngal mi shes te / tshangs par spyod pa spyad dka'o/ /rab tu dben pa bya dka'o/ /gcig pulgenyid la mngon par dga' ba dka'o/ /gnas mal dgon pa dang / nags khrod dang / bas mthar gnas pa ni mnagasanyedaka'o/ /bu yul 'khor skyong tshur 'dug la 'dod pa dag la yang0spyod cig /sbyin pa dag kyang byin cig /bsod nams dag kyang gyis shig /de skad smras na nyekhyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor 2—233

skyong cang mi smra'o/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi pha dang mas nye du rnams la bcol ba/ kye nye du dag re zhig bu yul 'khor skyong slong7shig /de nas khyim bdagakhugi bu yul 'khor skyong gi nye du rnams khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /busayul 'khor skyong mkhyen par mdzod cig /khyod ni shin tu gzhon pas bde bsnyebazhed pa lags zhes bya ba nas bsod nams dag gyis shig ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de skad smras na khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong cang mi smra'o/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi0pha dang mas yul 'khor skyong gi ne'u ldangs rnams la bcol ba/ kye gzhon nu dag re zhig bu yul 'khor skyong slongakhushig /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi ne'u ldangs7rnams kyis yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye sras des pa yul 'khor skyong mkhyen par mdzod cig /khyod ni shin tu gzhon pas bde ba bzhed pa lags la zhes bya ba nas/ bsod nams dag mdzod cig ces bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin du'o/ /des de skad smras na khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong cang mi smra'o/ /de nas gzhon nu dag gis yul 'khor skyong gi pha dang ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum sras yul 'khor skyong 'di gum pas ci zhig bgyi/ rab tu 'byung du gnong dang7/ gal te dga' bar gyur na 'di gson po nyid du gzigs par 'gyur la/ gal te mngon par mi dga' bar gyur na yang bu'i gnas pha ma gnyis ma lags pa gzhan su zhig mchis/ gzhon nu dag bdag cag la gal te rab tu byung nas lta bar byed na de bzhin du gnang bar bya'o/ /de nas yul 'khor skyong gi ne'u ldangs dag gis khyim bdag gi bu 2—234

yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ / des pa7yul 'khor skyong mkhyen par mdzod cig /pha dang mas gnang ste 'di skad ces gal tekhurab tu byung nas lta bar byed na'o zhes kyang zer ro/ /shes ldan dag bltasabar bya'o/ /de nas khyim bdag gi0bu yul 'khor skyong rim gyis lus kyi mthu dang stobs bskyed nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gis 'di skad ces gsol toX/ /btsun pa bdag ni pha dang mas gnang lags kyisaX/btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par〈rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thobalgepa lta na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung7ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gitsodangos po thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong rab tu phyung bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas bang mdzod stug po can du ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong bsnyen par rdzogs te lo bcu lon nas dgra bcom pa thob ste rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong nas 'di snyam du sems te/sngon bdag khyim par gyur pa na pha dang ma la rab tu byung nas blta bar bya'o zhes 2—235

khas blangs pa7yod kyis②/ ma la bdag gis khas blangs pa de mthar dbyung ngo snyam nas/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa sngon bdagakhukhyim par gyur pa na pha dang ma la blta bar bgyi'o zhes g.yar gyis blangs pas bdag g.yar gyis blangs pa de mthar 'byin du mchi'oX/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi0thugs kyis tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi sems khyab par mdzad cing khyab par mdzad nas thugs la mdzad cing / thugs la mdzad nas 'di snyam du dgongs te/ rigs kyi bu yul 'khor skyong ni slar yang khyim na gnas pa'am/ sogs ⑧'jog spyod pas 'dod pa dag la longs spyod pa'i 'os ma yin no snyam du mkhyen nas/ tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yul 'khor skyong khyod7song la sems can ma rgal ba rnams ni sgrol cig /ma grol ba rnams ni7grol bar gyis shig /dbugs ma phyin pa rnams ni dbugs phyung shig /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams ni7yongs su mya ngan las zlos shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste yi rangasalgenas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs te/ mnyan yod du bsod snyoms spyad nas zas kyi 2—236

bya ba byas te zas phyi ma'i bsod snyoms las slar log nas gnas mal ji ltar spyad pa mkhos su phab ste ①lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs nas bang mdzod stug po can⑧gang na ba der song ste/ rim gyis spyad pa spyod cing rgyu ba na bang mdzod stug po can du phyin nas/ bang mdzod stug po can gyi bang mdzod stug po'i tshal du 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te bang mdzod stug po can du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas/ de rim gyis bang mdzod stug po can nas bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na rang gi khyim gang na ba der song nas/ de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi pha bar sgo'i khyams na skyes ga⑧spa mkhan gyis spa dang kha spu 'chos pa na/ tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi phas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong sgo drung na 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang kha zer bar byed de/ dge sbyong0mgo reg 'o ni dag gis kho bo'i rigs kyi rgyun bcad de/'o ni dag gis kho bo'i bu gcig pasasdug pa yid du 'ong ba bzod pa mi mthun pa med pa yul 'khor skyong rab tu phyung bsnyen par rdzogs par byas na/ dge sbyong mgo reg 'o ni rnams la su zhig bsod snyoms sbyin par bya bar sems/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis rang gi ༅khyim nas rgya gag ma gtogs pa ⑦sbyin pa yang ma thob/ bskrad kyang ma bskrad pa dang myur ba myur bar phyir byung ngo / /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi sngon gyi bran mo rgan mo zhig zanasadron rul pa zhag lon pa zhig dor7ba'i phyir thogs te sgor byung ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis sngon gyi bran mo rgan mo de mthong ngo mthong nas kyang bran mo rgan mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sring mo gal te zan dron 2—237

rul pa zhag7lon pasa'ador ba yin na kho bos bzas7lhung bzed 'dir chug shig /'phags pa gsol cig /de nas sngon gyi bran mo rgan mo des zan dron rul pa zhag lon pa lhung bzed du 'jug pa na tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / bzhin dang / sna dngas/ smra dngags dag gi⑧mtshan ma shin tu legs par bzung nas 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /rje'i sras yul 'khor skyong lags sam/ sring mo kho bo skye bo dag gis de ltar shes so / /de nas sngon gyi bran mo rgan mo de rings pa rings par tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi pha gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi pha la 'di skad ces smras so/ /josnyibo mkhyen par mdzod cig /sras yul 'khor skyong bang mdzod stug po can du7byon nas ring mo zhig lags na nyid kyi khab tu ni byon mi bzhed do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi pas lag pa g.yon pas spa bsdus nas ras yug gcig gi smad g.yogs bgos bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor7skyong gang na ba der song ba dang / de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong 8rtsig drung zhig tu 'dug nas zan dron rul pa zhag lon pa za bar byed pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi phas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yul 'khor skyong khyod bang mdzod stug po can du phyin nas ring mo zhig lon 8na ci'i phyir rang gi khyim du 'jug par mi 'dod/ zan dron rul pa zhag lon pa khyod kyi grecabar yang ji ltar 'gror btub/ khyim bdag khyod kyi khyim du 'ongs na rgya gag ma gtogs pa sbyin pa yang ma thob/ bskrad kyang ma bskrad pa dang myur ba myur bar byung ngo / /bu yul 'khor skyong yin par kho bos mi shes mod/ gal te kho bos 2—238

shes na de skad mi smra ba zhig /bu yul 'khor skyong bzod par gsol lo/ /khyim bdag bzod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi phas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la yan lag thams cad kyis 'khyud pa byas nas rang gi khyim du stan bshams pa nyidatul 'dug tu bcug go /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi pas yul 'khor skyong gi ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu yul 'khor skyong ②yun ring zhig lon nas khyim du 'ongs kyis②/ kye re zhig khyod bdag nyid kyis snod du tshos la sta gon gyis shig dang de la bu yul 'khor skyong longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi masakhurang nyid kyis snod du btsos0nas sta gon byas so/ /de nas mi zhig gis tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi mdun du gser gyi phung po chen po gal te mi gcig pha rol na 'greng na mi gcig tshu rol na 'dug pa mi mthong la/ mi gcig tshu rol na 'dug na gcig pha rol na 'greng ba mi mthong ba spungs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi mas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu yul 'khor skyong khyod kyi ma la bud med rnams kyi bud med kyi nor dang / bud med kyi bag rdzongs dang / bud med kyi khud pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa yang 'di snyed cig yod do/ /gzhan yang khyod kyi pa'i ni mtshan mas thebs pa'i gser dang sa le sbram yang brgya phrag du ma dang / stong phrag du ma dang / brgya stong phrag du ma yod na phal gzhan lta smosashekyang ci dgos/ bu yul 'khor skyong tshur khyod 'dug la 'dod pa dag la yang yongs su spyod cig /sbyin pa dag kyang thong shig /bsod nams dag kyang gyis shig /khyim bdag gi chung ma khyod gal te kho bo'i tshig la dad pas mnyan par bya bar sems pa lta na/ bdag gisalgegadams 2—239

shing rjes su bstan to/ /bu yul 'khor skyong gdamasarkyungag stsol cig /bu yul 'khor skyongasarjes su ston cig dang / khyod kyi tshig la bdag dad pasalgemanyan par bgyi'o snyam du sems so/ /khyim bdag gi chung ma tshur khyod kyis sha na'i ras skye sar par0byos la/ gser dang sa le sbram gyis khong ste shing rta'i nang du chug la chu bo gang gā'i rgyun shugs drag cing gtingashezab pa gang na yod pa der 'or cig /gzhi de las khyod kyi mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams skye bar gyur ta re/de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi⑧ma 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis de lta bu'i bya bas kyang bu yul 'khor skyong bzlog par bya ba ma nus so snyam mo//de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi mas mna' ma la bcol ba/ kye bag sar7re zhig ji lta bu'i mnye ba rnams kyis mnyes pa dang / khrus rnams kyis bkrus pa dang / dri rnams kyis byugs pa dang / gos rnams bskon pa dang /rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / bdug pa rnams kyis bdugs pa dang /phye ma rnams kyis gtor bas8/ bu yul 'khor skyong de sngon khyimachapar gyur pa na dga' ba dang yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i mnye ba rnams kyis mnyes pa dang / khrus rnams kyis khrus dang / dri rnams kyis byugs pa dang / gos rnams〈nyebaskon pa dang / rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / bdug patshwanyernams kyis bdugs pa dang / phye ma rnams kyis gtor ba gyis la bu yul 'khor skyong gi rkang pa gnyis la gtugs la 'di skad ces/ gang gi slad du rje'i sras bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa lha'i bu mo ji lta bu zhig ces kyang smos shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi sngon gyi ()chung mas ji lta bu'i ⑫2—240

mnye ba rnams kyis mnyes pa dang / khrus rnams kyis bkrus pa dang / dri rnams kyis byugs pa dang / gos rnams bskon pa dang / rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / bdug pa rnams kyis bdugs7pa dang / phye ma rnams kyis gtor bas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong sngon khyim par gyur pa na dga' ba dang yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i mnye ba rnams kyis mnyes pa dang / tshos rnams kyis khrusasnyedang / dri rnams kyis byugasalgepa dang / gos rnams bskon pa dang / rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / bdug pa rnams kyis bdugasakyipa dang / phye ma rnams kyis gtor ba byas nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te 'di skad ces smras so/ /rje'i sras gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na tshangs par〈spyad pa spyod pa lha'i bu7mo de ji lta bu zhig lags/ sring mo kho bo bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa ni lha'i bu mo'i ched5)du ma yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis sngon gyi chung ma la sring mo zhes tshig tu smras pas brgyal nas sa la 'gyel to4)/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis pha dang ma la smras pa/ de7yab yum gal te kha zas btang ba lags na ci mi stsal tam/ btang snyoms su bzhag ste ci mtho 'tsham lags sam/ bu yul 'khor skyong longs spyod cig /ces de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi pha dang mas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de/ rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas7bstabs shing tshim par byas so)/ /tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis zos nas lag pa bkrus te lhung bzed gyu bar rig 2—241

nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ltos shig lus ni nor bu dang / /rna rgyan gyis ni bkra byas pa'angatu/ /nad dang slu ba'i chos can te②/ /brtan par gnas pa yod ma yin/ /skra yi lan bu brgyad lhasasashing / /mig ni mig sman gyis bskus pa'ang / /byis pa rmongs par byed nus kyi/ /pha rol tshol ba ma yin no/ /dri rnams kyis ni lus bskus la/ /rkang pa btsag gis byugs pa yang / /byis pa rmongs par byed nus kyicha/ /pha rol tshol ba ma yin no/ /mig sman gser gyis bkra byas shing / /dul rjoba'i lus ni brgyan pa yang / /byis pa rmongs par byed nus kyi/ /pha rol tshol ba ma yin no/ /ri dgas 'chor ⑥bas rnyi ⑦btsugs nas/ /ri dwags gzung bar ⑧ma nus ltar/ /rngon pa 'o dod 'bod bcug la/ /zos nas gnas su 'gro bar bya//de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis pha dang ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byas nas de nyid nas steng gi nam mkha' la song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong bang mdzod stug po can gang na ba der7song ste phyin nas ba ru ra'i shing zhig gi drung du nyin par gnas par bya ba'i phyir 'dug go/ /de'i tshe rgyal po kau rab bya tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gi snyan pa yang sgrogs shingacaganas te/ nam zhig na bdag shes ldan yul 'khor skyong mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur/ nam zhig na gal te zhu ba lung bstan pa'i phyir skabs phye na bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu bar 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po kau rab byas tshal srung ba'i mi la bsgonyeb/2—242

kwa'inyenang rje khyod song la myur du bang mdzod stug posnyecan gyi tshal phyag dar byos shig /sang nga der skyed mos tshal gyishesar 'gro'o/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes skyes pa des rgyal po kau rab bya'i ltar mnyan nas bang mdzod stug po can gyi0tshal thams cad phyag dar byed pa na/ mi des tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong ba ru ra'i shing zhig gi drung na nyin par gnas par ༷bya ba'i phyir 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyal po kau rab bya gang gi snyan pa yang dang yang du sgrogs shing gnas te/ nam zhig na bdag shes ldan yul 'khor skyong mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur/ nam zhig na gal te'uzhu ba lung bstan pa'i phyir skabs phye na bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu bar 'gyur snyam pa'i shes ldan yul 'khor skyong de ni 'di yin te/ bang mdzod stug po can gyi 'di lta bu zhig tu phyin gyisal/ ma la bdag gis rgyal po kau rab bya la sbran par bya'o snyam nas/ de nas skyes pa des rgyal po kau rab bya gang na ba der song ste phyin nas rgyal po kau rab bya la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha gang gi snyan pa yang dang yang du sgrogs shing ⑩bzhugs la nam zhig na bdag shes ldan yul 'khor skyong mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur/ nam zhig na gal te zhu ba lung bstan pa'i phyir skabs phye na bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu bar 'gyur snyam pa'i shes ldan yul 'khor skyong de ni de lags te/ bang mdzod stug po can gyi 'di lta bu zhig tu mchis lags te/ lha da de'i dus la babalgepar dgongs su gsol/de nas rgyal po kau rab byas mi gzhan zhig la bsgo ba/ kwa'isnyunang rje tshur bzhon pa bzang po myur du sdogs shig /de la nga zhon nas deng kho na5)shes ldan yul 'khor skyong blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /lha bka'adza )bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des 2—243

rgyal po kau rab bya'i ltar mnyan nas bzhin ①pa bzang po myur du bsdogs te/rgyal po kau rab bya gang na ba der song nas7phyin pa dang / rgyal po kau rab byashel 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bcibasalgepa bzang po bsdogs lags te/ lha da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas rgyal po kau rab bya bzhon pa bzang po la zhon0nas bang mdzod stug po can nas byung ste༅/ tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir song nas/ de ji tsam bzhonashepa'isnyibar du bzhon7pas song ste/ bzhin pa las babs nas rkang pa kho nas kun dga' ra bar zhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis rgyal po kau rab bya rgyang ring po kho na nas 'ongs parwaskremathong ngo mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces smras so/ / rgyal po chen pos rgyal po chen po byon pa legs so tshur spyon/ rgyal po chen po khyod nyid kyi yul lags pas bzhed na bdag kyang stan tshul g.yar drongs shig /kye yul 'khor skyong bdag gi yul lags mod kyi/ 'on kyang yul 'khor skyong gis bdag stan la g.yar drang bar 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po chen po gdan mchis kyisalgegal te bzhed na bzhugs shig /de nas rgyal po kau rab bya tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas rgyal po kau rab byas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gal te rigs dman pa'am/ longs spyod rnams yongs su zad pa'am/ gtugs par gyur na skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa5)kho nas khyim nas5) khyim med par rab tu 'byung 2—244

ba yod na/ bdag cag rigs ni kau rab bya yin la/ longs spyod ni rgya che ba yin gyis①/ 'di ltar kho bos shes ldan yul 'khor skyong la longs spyod kyi skal ba dag lasasnyibago bsha' byas / shes ldan yul 'khor skyong tshur khyod 'dug la 'dod pa dag la yang yongs su spyod cig /sbyin pa dag thong shig /bsod nams dag gyis shig /rgyal po chen po cha ma lags pa'i mgron rjodu 'bod pas bdag mgron7du 'bod kyi 'tshamasapas ni ma lags so/ /khyod lta bus bdag 'dra ba'i skyes 0bu mkhas pa 'di lta 0bu'i mgron du 'bod pas mgron ⑪du yang ma 'bod cig /bdag gis shes ldan yul 'khor skyong dang 'tsham pa'i mgron du 'bod pas mgron du 'bod pa ji lta bu zhig lags/ rgyal po chen po tshur spyon/ khyod kyis 'di skad ces kye yul 'khor skyong kho bo'i yul 'byor cing gnod pa med pa/ sdo ba med cing7'tshe ba med la slong ba po'i bsod snyoms rnyed sla ba yin gyis0/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong bang mdzod stug po can 'dir gnos〈 )shig dang / bdag gis shes ldan yul 'khor skyong chos bzhin gyis bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba bya'o zhes bgyi ba lags na/ rgyal po chen po sems mngon par dad pa gang la gang lags pa de tsam gyis bgyis lags te 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang gal te zhus pa lung bstan pa'i phyir skabs phye na shes ldan yul 'khor skyong la bdag zhu lags so/ /rgyal po chen po gsungs shig /thos nas khyod la rig par bgyi'o/ /kye yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni yongs su nyams pa lags te/ de dag gis yongs su nyams pa'i rigs kyi bu dag skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /2—245

bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rga bas yongs su nyams pa dang / nad kyis yongs su nyams pa dang / nye dus yongs su nyams pa dang / longs spyod kyis yongs su nyams pa'o/ /kye yul 'khor skyong rga bas yongs su nyams pa gang zhe na/'di la rigs kyi bu rgas 'khogs gtugs par gyur nas de 'di snyam du sems te/da ni bdag rgas 'khogs gtugs pas bdag gis re zhig 'dod pa dag bdoganyekyang longs spyadasapar slasab ma yin na mi bdog na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ ma la bdag skra dang kha spu bregs la gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa khosnyinas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ngo snyam nas/ de rga ba'i yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams pas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ste/ 'di ni rga ba'i〈yongs su nyams pa zhes bya'o/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong rga ba'i yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams pa ma yin na skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong ni gzhon nu thor bu lang tsho la bab pa/ skra gnaganyepa/ na tshod dar la bab pa dang ldan pa yin te/gang gi tshe rtsed mo dang / dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / cha ba dang /brgyan ④pa'i gnas la brtson pa dang ldan pas gnas par bya ba de'i tshe nye du rnams mchi mas brnangs shing ngu bzhin dang bcas pas ma rangs bzhin skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med7par rab tu byung na/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis ci zhig shes mthong thos rtogs nas skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos7te dad pa 2—246

yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med paraturab tu byung / de la ni kho bosasherangs pa ma yin te mi bzod do/ /kye shes ldan yul 'khor skyong nad kyis yongs su nyams pa gang zhe na/ 'di la rigs kyi bu na ba sdug bsngal ba nad tshabs chesabar gyur nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag ni na ba sdug bsngal ba nad tshabs che bas bdag gis re zhig 'dod pa dag bdog kyang longs spyad par slasab ma yin na mi bdogashen lta smos kyang ci dgos/ ma la bdag skra dang kha spu bregs nas nigos ngur smrig bgos nas zhes bya ba nas rab tu 'byung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nad kyis yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams pas7skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas zhes bya ba nas rab tu 'byung zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /'di ni nad kyis yongs su nyams pa zhes bya'o/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong ni nad kyis yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams pa ma yin no0/ /spa dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas zhes bya ba nas rab tu byung ⑩zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gnod pa med cing nad med pa'i rang bzhin can dang / ran par 'jug pa'i drod dnge ldan pa ste/ ha cang bsil balgem yin pa dang / ha cang tsha ba ma yin pa dang / khams snyoms pas gnod pa med pa dang ldan pas khyod kyis zos pa dang / 'thungs pa dang / 'chos pa dang / myangs pa rnams legs par bde bar 'ju bar 'gyur na/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong de la ci zhig shes mthong zhes bya ba nas rab tu 'byung zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de la ni kho bo rangs pa ma yin te mi bzod do/ /kye yul 'khor skyong nye dus yongs su 2—247

nyams pa gang zhe na/ 'di la rigs kyi bu'i nye du rnams rabs chad nye du rnams kha dganyenas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye du rnams rabs chad nye du rnams kha dag ②pas ma la bdag skra dang kha spu bregs nas zhes bya ba nas rab tu 'byung b.rasabya'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nye du'i0yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams pas7skra dang kha spu bregs te zhes bya ba nas rab tu 'byung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /'di ni nye dus yongs su nyams pa zhes bya'o/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong ni nye dus yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams pa ma yin na/ spa dang kha spu bregs nasashegos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngos/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yul 'khor skyong gi nye du ni kau rab bya'i rigs nas bzung ste brgyud pa bang mdzod stug po can 'di nyid na rgyas par yod na/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis ci zhig shes mthong zhes7bya ba nas rab tu byung zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de la ni kho bos rangs pa ma yin te mi bzod do/ /kye yul 'khor skyong longs spyod kyis yongs su nyams pa gang zhe na/ 'di la rigs kyi bu'i longs spyod srabs pa dang / yongs su zad pa dang / gtugs par gyur nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi longs spyod ni srabs pa dang /yongs su zad pa dang / gtugs par gyur gyis8/ ma la bdag skra dang kha spu bregs nas zhes bya ba nas rab tu 'byung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de longs spyod yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams pas7skra dang kha spu bregs nas7zhes bya ba nas rab tu 'byung ngo / /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /'di ni longs spyod kyis yongs su nyams pa zhes bya'o/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong ni 2—248 ca

longs spyod yongs su nyams pas yongs su nyams patum yin na②/ zhes bya ba nas rab tu byungasazhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong ni bang mdzod stug po can 'di na rigs mchog dang rigs bzang po yin pas 'di lta ste/ longs spyod chen po dang ldan pa yin na/ 'di la shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis ci zhig shes mthong thos rtogs nas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas0khyim med par rab tu byung0/ de la ni kho bo rangasalgepa ma yin te mi bzod do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po 'di dag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des yid 'byung ba'i lam du gsungs te/ yid 'byung ba de dag gis yid byung nas rigs kyi bu rnams skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rgyal po chen po 'jig rten 'di thams cad ni rga bas nye bar khrid pa yin/ 'jig rten 'di ni rjekhro su 'gro ba med pas skyabs med pa yin/ 'jig rten 'di ni thams cad bor te 'gro bar 'gyur bas bdog⑧pa med pa yin/ 'jig rten 'di ni ngoms mi shes te sred pas 'khol bas chog mi shes pa yin par bdag gis shes mthong thos rtogs nas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa khoshenas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /bdag gis mdor bsdus te gsungs shing rnam par ma phye ba 'di'i don rgyas par 'tshal bar mi 'gyur bas/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis don de nyid ci nas bdag gi ⑩shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis mdor bsdus 7te gsungs shing rnam par ma phye ba 'di'i 'don 2—249
