rgyas par 'tshal bar 'gyur bar rgyas par bshad du gsol/ shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis 'di skad ces 'jig rten 'di thams cad ni rga bas nye bar khrid pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa gang lags7pa de shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis ci las dgongs te gsungs/ de'i phyir rgyal po chen po khyod nyid la dris7khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa desnyebazhin dukhulan thob shig /rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ gang gi tshe khyod lo nyi shu'am lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon par gyur pa na na tshod kyis gzhon nu thor bu lang tshokhul bab pa/ skra gnagashepa/ nyamasartsal7bdo ba dang ldan pa de dang da ltar gyi lus su 'di lta ste tshe'am/ kha dog gam/stobs sam/ shugs sam9 smra dngags sam/ srid du 'am/ sboms su mnyam zhing mtshungs par mthong ngam/ kye yul 'khor skyong gang gi tshe bdag lo nyi shu 'am lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon par gyur pa na na tshod kyis gzhon nu thor bu lang tshonyel bab pa/ skra gnagacapa/ nyam rtsal bdo ba dang ldan pa de dang da ltar gyi lus su 'di lta ste tshe'am/ kha dog gam/ stobs sam/ shugs sam/ srid du'am/ sboms su 'am9 smra dngags su mnyam zhing mtshungs par ma mthong ste / da ni bdag na tshod kyis lo brgyad bcu lon pas rgas 'khogs gtugs te bar 'ga' bdag 'dug pa dang langs pa yang gzhan gyis bya dgos so/ /rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des 'di las dgongs nas 'jig rten 'di thams cad ni rga bas nye bar khrid pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de bdag gis shes mthong thos rtogs nas skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste de la 2—250

ni bdag rangs te bzod do/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gang la rangs te bzod pa de la bdag kyang rangs te bzod do/ /gang yang shes ldan yul 'khor skyong 'di skad ces 'jig rten 'di ni rjes su 'gro ba med pas skyabs med pa yin no zhes gsungs pa7bdag la ni bu dang / chung ma dang / bran dang / las bgyid pa dang / bzhad gad pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan dang /'dul ②sbyong mkhan dang / glang po che la zhon pa dang / rta rkya dang / shing rta pa dang / bshan thogs dang / gzhu 'dzin pa dang / 'drol bu dang / go re longasabagyid pa dang / bro garaphulen pa rnams dang / rgyal po'i bu dpa' ba rtul phod pa/ rab tu gnon tshan po che chen po dang ldan pa gang dag bdag gi gshed ma phyir rgol ba mi mdza' ba dag mchis pa slar 'joms par bgyid pa mchis na/ 'on kyang shes ldan yul 'khor skyong 'di skad ces 'jig rten 'di ni rjes su 'gro ba med pas skyabs med pa yin no zhes gsungs pa de shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis ci las0dgongs te gsungs rgyal po chen po de'i phyir khyod nyid la dris khyodashekyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan thob shig /rgyal po chen po dasaltar khyod la lus kyisarkyuganod pa 'ga' mchis sam/ kye yul 'khor skyong bdag la mchis te da ltar rlung gis rgyab tu gnod do/ /rgyal po chen po gang girwarnyatshe rlung gis rgyab tu gnod par gyur pa de'i tshe bdag gi bu dang / chung ma dang / bran dang / las byed pa dang / bzhad gad pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan dang / 'dul sbyong mkhan dang / glang po che la zhon pa dang / rta rkya dang / shing rta pa dang / bshan thogs7dang / gzhu 'dzin dang ske/ 'drol bu dang / go re long byed pa dang / bro gar len pa dang /2—251

rgyal po'i bu dpa' ba rtul phod pa/ rab tu gnon tshan po che chen po dang ldan pa gang dag yin pa tshur/ bdag la skyes shing byung ba'i sdug bsngal drag po rtsub pa tsha ba mi bzod pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba rnams choms7shig ces bgyis na 'grubashebam/ kye yul 'khor skyong ma lags so/ /gang gi tshe rlung gis bdag gi rgyab tu gnod par gyur pa de'i tshe bdag gi bu dang / chung ma dang / bran dang / las bgyid pa dang / bzhadasnyegad pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrusakyimakhan dang / 'dul sbyong mkhan dang / glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa dang / rta rkya dang / shing rta dang /⑤ bshan thogs dang / gzhu 'dzin dang / 'drol bu dang / go re long bgyid pa dang / bro gar len pa dang / rgyal po'i bu dpa' ba rtul phod pa/ rab tu gnon tshan po che chen po dang ldan pa gang dag yin pa tshur/ bdag la byung zhing skyes pa'i sdug bsngal drag po rtsub pa〈tsha ba mi bzad7pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba rnams choms shig ces bgyis kyang mi 'grub kyi/ de'i tshe bdag 'ba' zhig sdug bsngal drag po rtsub pa tsha ba mi bzod pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba rnams myong ngo / /rgyal po chen po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des 0'di las dgongs nas 'jig rten 'di ni rjes su 'gro ba med de skyabs med pa yin no zhes gsungs pa de bdag tigis shes mthong thos rtogs nas skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung7ste/ de la ni bdag rangs te bzod do/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gang la rangs te bzod pa de la bdag cag kyang rangs te bzod do/ /gang yang shes ldan yul 'khor skyong 'di skad ces 'jig rten 2—252

'di ni thams cad bor nas 'gro bar 'gyur bas bdog pa med pa yin no zhes gsungs pa/ kye yul 'khor skyong bdag cag la bu dang / chung ma dang / bran dang / las bgyid pa dang / zhes bya ba nas rgyal po'i bu rnams mchis te zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gang dag bdag mchi na rjes ①bzhin 'brangasal / 'greng na 'grengasab dang / nyal na zhugs tshe bgyid pa dag mchis na/'on kyang shes ldan yul 'khor skyong 'di skad ces 'jig rten 'di ni thams cad bor te 'gro bar 'gyur bas bdog pa med pa yin no/ /zhes gsung bsrede shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis cisalas dgongs te gsungs/ rgyal po chen po de'i phyir khyod nyid la dris7khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa7de bzhin du lan thob shig /rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ gang gikhutshe skye bo mang po la mi sdug pa/ skye bo mang po mi 'dod pa/ skye bo mang po mi dga' ba/ skye bo mang po'i yid du mi 'ong ba 'jig rten thams cad kyi thun mong 'di lta ste/ 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i chos de 'ongs par gyur pa de'i tshe bdag gi7bu dang / chung ma dang / bran dang /las byed pa zhes bya ba nas rgyal po'i bu dag tshur zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /gang dag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro ba'i phyi bzhin shog ⑩shig ces bgyis na 'grub bam/ kye yul 'khor skyong ma lags so/ /kye yul 'khor skyong gang gi tshe skye bo mang po la mi sdug pa/ skye bo mang po mi 'dod pa/ skye bo mang po mi dga' ba/ skye bo mang po'i yid du mi 'ong brwa)'jig rten thams cad kyi thun mong 'di lta ste / 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i chos de 'ongs par gyur pa de'i tshe bdag gi bu dang / chung ma dang / bran dang / las bgyid pa rnams dang zhes bya ba nas/ rgyal po'i bu'i bar gang dag yin pa7tsar zhes bya ba'i7bar 2—253

du'o/ /bdag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du mchi7ba'i phyi bzhin shog⑧shig ces bgyis kyang mi 'grub ste/ bdag 'ba' zhig 'jig rten 'disanas 'jig rten pha rol du mchikhubar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des 'di las dgongs nas 'jig rten 'di ni thams cad bor te 'gro bar 'gyur bas bdog pa med pa yin no zhes gsungs pa de bdag gis shes mthong thos rtogs nas/ skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ de lasani bdag rangs te bzod do/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gang la rangs te bzod pa de la bdag kyang rangs te bzod do/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gang yang 'di skad ces 'jig rten 'di ni ngoms mi shes shing sred pas bkol bas chog mi shes pa yin no zhes gsungs pa/ kye yul 'khor skyong bdag sgra ngan rgyas pa 'di nyid la yongs su spyod cing btsun mo mang po dang / mdzod dang / bang mdzod rgyas pa la yongs su longs spyod na/ 'on kyang shes ldan yul 'khor skyong 'di skad ces 'jig rten 'di ni ngoms mi shes shing sred pas bkol bas chog mi shes pa yin no zhes gsungs pa de shes ldan yul 'khor skyong gis ci las dgongs te gsungs/ rgyal po chen po de'i phyir khyod nyid la dris khyod kyis ji ltar〈bzod pa de bzhin du lan thob shig /rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/khyod 'di na sgra ngan rgyas pa la ⑨yongs su spyod cing btsun mo mang po dang /mdzod dang / bang mdzod rgyas pa la yongs su spyod pa las shar phyogs nas mi yid gcugs pa/ yid ches pa/ brtan po/ 'jig rten la mi slu ba zhig 2—254

'ongs nas de ①'di skad ces lha bdag shar phyogs nas 'dir mchi ba na de na bdag gis ljongs 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos rab tu gang ba dag cig mthong ste/ lha ljongs de dag 'di lta bu'i dpung dang 'di lta bu'i dbyig dang / 'di lta bu'i bzhon pas dra ma drangs te gzhomakhupa dang / coms nas rnal du dgod par rung ngo / /zhes smra na/ rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ khyod yul der dra ma drang zhingashedrangs nas bcom ste/ rnal du 'godasadam/ khyod ljongs de dag 'dod dam/kye yul 'khor skyong gal te bdag gis ljongs de dag 'di lta bu'i dbyig dang /'di lta bu'i dpung dang / 'di lta bu'i bzhon pas dra ma drang bshedang / dra ma drangs nas choms pa dang bcom nas rnal du dgod rjodu rung bar shes na/ljongs de dag tu dra ma drang zhing dra ma drangs nas bcom la/ bcom nas rnal du dgodasado/ /bdag ljongs de dag kyang 'tshal lo/ //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po sum bcu rtsa lnga pa/ rgyal po chen po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mkhyen cing gzigs pa des de las dgongs nas 'jig rten 'di ni ngoms mi shes shing sred pas bkol bas chog mi shes pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de bdag gis shes mthong thos rtogs nas skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos 8te dad pa yang dag pa kho yinas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/de la ni bdag rangs te bzod do/ /shes ldan yul 'khor skyong khyod gang la rangs te bzod pa de la bdag kyang rangs te bzod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis de skad ces smras nas gnas brtan dgra bcom pas gzhan yang 2—255

'di skad ces smras so/ /'jig rten dag na nor dang ldan pa'i mi/ /de dag chags dang bcas pas sogs7byed cing / /nor rnams rnyed nas gtong bar mi byed la/ /phyir zhing 'dod pa don du gnyer ba mthong / /mi dbang rgya mtsho mtha' yis gtugs pa'i sa/ /thag bcug bcom ste cham du phab nas ni/ /rgya mtsho tshun cadasakyis kyang mi chog stob/ /chags pas pha rol don du gnyer bar 'bad/ /mi dbang de bzhin mi gzhan mang po dag /yongs su bzungakyil ngoms pa yod min pas/ /chog mi shes pas rang gi lus bor te/ /sred dang ma bral bar ni0'chi bar 'gyur/ /srog ni ther zug ma yin tshe thung ste/ /rga bas gzir ba la ni skyabs yod min/ /'chi ba la ni nor rjes 'brang mi 'gyur//nye du ma yin grogs min bu ma yin/ /spun dang sringashemo de bzhin grogs kun dang / /snying du sdug pa'i tshogs ni7'dus nas ni/ /kye ma kyi hud 'di ni lhar57gyur ces/ /skra bshig mchi ma can gyicagadong gis5)ngu / /de ni ras kyis dkris te phyung nas ni/ /me sbar nas ni de nas sreg par byed/ /rang gi las kyis sems can de khrid nas/ /de yi nor rnams bgo skal spyod pas phrogs8/ /'di ni skye ba na yang gcig pu skyedzo/ /'chi ba na yang gcig pu 'chi 'gyur zhing / /gcig pus sdug bsngal nyams su 'dir myong 'gyur/ /skye bo 'khor bar grogs yod ma yin no/ /phyug po'am yang na bkresalgepa'am brtan po'am / /bus pa de bzhin gnyis kus yireg myong na⑥/ /brtan po de yis nams kyang g.yos〈 nyemi 'gyur/ /bus pa bus pa yin phyir rtag tu g.yo/ /blo chung mi mkhas5)rjes su slob byed cing / /de nas las rnamasalgegasum po byed 'gyur zhing / /mngal dang 'jig rten pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur/ /khon dang 2—256

rjes 'brel sdug bsngal las mi 'grol/ /shes rab nor rnams kun gyi mchog tu gsungs / /de yis bdag nyid shes pas bdag nyid rig /srid dang srid min bdag nyid ma rtogs7pas/ /blun po sdig pa'i las rnams byed pa yin/ /phran tshegs7thabs sam yang na chos min pa'am/ /mthu yis gzhan dag lasasheni gang 'phrog pa/ /nyes byas las byed 'khor ba la brten nasabya/ /nying tor brgyud pas grol bar 'gyur ma yin/ /ji ltar rkun po khyim 'bigs bzungasakyinas ni/ /sdig pa'i las can rang gi las kyis bcom/ /de bzhin skye dgu nyes byed 'di dang ni/ /'jig rten pha rol rang gi las kyis bcom/ /shing las shing tog0bzhin du mi rnams ni/ /gzhon dang bar ma rgan po rnams kyang ltung / /'dod pa sna tshogs sdugasacing yid 'ong ba/ /rang bzhin de lta bu yis sems rab 'joms/ /'dod pa rnams kyis 'di 'ching chags par 'gyur/ /'dod pa yod na khonanyedang 'jigs pa skye/ /de ltas rgyal po 'di nas rab byung ste / /dge sbyong nyid ni nyams pa med mchog yin/ /de nas rgyal po kau rab yibya tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis smras pa la mngon par dga' ste yi rangs〈nyenas rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te stan las langs nas song ngo /bcom ldan 'das glang po che'i grong rdal du byon pa dang / bram ze zhig gis bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ 'od zer nyi ma stong bas lhag pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas bzang ba de rgyang ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyitshwanyespyan sngar song nas tshigs su bcad pas bstod par 2—257

brtsams pa/ gser gyi mdog can mig tu sdug pa dang / /dga' ba'i 'byung gnas yon tan kun dang ldan/ /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur ba lha yi lha/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol byon pa lags/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa na zhes bya ba nas/ mdzod spur nub par gyur to/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar ba byas nas zhus pa/ kha dog sna tshogs stong gis bkra ba yinya/ zhes bya ba nas kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/ de de bzhin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bram zes ②de bzhin gshegs pa la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa gang yin pa mthong ngam/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /'di dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bskal pa nyi shur log par ltung bar 'gro bar mi 'gyur te/ 'on kyang lha dang mi rnams su nyingakhumatshams sbyar cing du'akhor nas srid pa phyi ma 0skye gnas phyi ma dang / lus phyi ma dang /bdag gi ngo bo thob pa phyi ma la rang sangs rgyas bstod 'os zhes bya bar 'gyur ro//dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/ the tshomakhuthams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bram ze 'dis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rang byang chub tu lungaphubastan pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus 2—258

na yang nga la tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pas/ ngas grong mchog lnga byin pa de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung7shig dang bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā ②'o ṇa sī ④grong khyer du rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba rjo'abyor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa skye bo dang mi mang pos rab tu gang ba la rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ de lhag par snyan dngags la dga' bar gyur to/ /bā rā ṇa sī na bram ze snyan dngags mkhan gzhan zhig yod pa de la bram ze mos smras pa/ bram ze grang ba'i dus la bab kyisakyirgyal po de'i spyan sngar song la rjes su mthun pa'i legs par smra ba 'ga' byos ⑦dang / gal te na grang ba'i skyabs cungasazad 'thobashepar 'gyur ro/ /de song ba las ji tsam na rgyal po glang po che la zhon nas byung ngo / /bram ze des bsams pa/ ci bdag gis rgyal po la bstod dam/ 'on te glang po che dam pa la snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ glang po che dam pa 'di ni 'jig rten thams cad kyis sdug cing yid du 'ong ba yin la rgyal po la ni 4)khyad par du yin pas/re zhig glang po che dam pa〈nyemangon par bstod par bya'o snyam nas des tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sa srung bu yi lus kyi sha tshugs ltar/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa'i gzugs ni phun sum tshogs/ /mdog dang tshad kyis lus kyi gzugs ⑩legs pa/ /glang chen dbang po bkra shis rab tu bsngags/ /de nas rgyal po mngon par dga' nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kho bo'i glang chen sdug cing yid 'ong ba/ /mi rnams mig 'phrog dga' ba skyed pa gang / /de la khyod kyis bstod pa'i tshig smras kyisaX/ /khyod la grong5)gi mchog ni lnga sbyin0 no/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus kyi ( nyeglang po che dam pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid 2—259

yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bram ze gang yin pa de ni bram ze 'di nyid yin te/de na yang nga la 'dis tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pas ngas 'di la grong mchog lnga byin no/ /da ltar yang nga la 'dis tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pas ngas yang 'dinyerang byang chub tu lung bstan to//grong khyer chen por gshegs nas grong khyer chen por sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya ba'i bar rgyas par gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yul srug nar gshegs pa dang yul srug na nasabram ze dbang po zhes bya ba gzugs dang lang tshoshedang / thos pas rgyags par gyur nas bdag dang 'dra dub ni 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no zhes sgrogs shing rnam par sgrogs sel/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang 0phyogs gzhan zhig na dge slong ⑦gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs te chos 'chad do/ /bram ze dbang po zhes bya bas dge sbyong go ta ma yul srug nar byon to7zhes thos nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong gi ta ma gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa blta na sdug pa zhes thos kyisal/ ci bdag las lhag par gzugs bzang ba yin nam/ 'on te ma yin ltar 'gro'o snyam nas de byung ba dang7/ ji tsam na bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa 'od zer nyi ma stong bas lhag pa/rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas bzang balgemathong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong gi ta ma ni bdag bas gzugs lhag par bzang mod kyi/ tshad ni lhag par ring ba ni ma yin no snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i gtsug tor blta bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na ma mthong nas de 2—260

phyogs shin tu mtho ba zhig la 'dzegs na 'on kyang ma mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze dbang po la bka' stsal pa/ bram ze nyon mongs kyis ①thong shig /gal te ri rab kyi rtse la 'dzegs te bltas kyang 'onasakyang ches nyon mongs su zad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor ni mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i ②'gro bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gtsug tor mi mthong ngo / /zhes ma thos sam/'on kyang gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad mthong bar 'dod na khyod kyi ⑤khyim na me'i sbyin sreg byed pa'i 'og na tsan dan sa mchog las byas pa'i mchod sdong nyid yod kyis de phyung la gzhol cig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'isheyab dang / yum las 'khrungs pa'i sku'i tshad ni de yin no/ /bram ze dbang pos bsams pa/ de yang ngo mtshar zhig ste bdag gis lan 'ga' yang ma thos na song ste blta'o snyam nas de rings bsnyerings par song nas me'i sbyin sregashebyed pa'i thab kyi 'og tu brko bar brtsams pa las de thams cad du de bzhin du gyur to / /de mngon par dad par gyur nas bsamanyepa/ dge sbyong gi ta ma ni gdon mi za bar thams cad mkhyen pa yin gyis7song la bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam nas de dad pa skyes te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang /bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas zhes bya ba nas thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi 2—261

shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dang /chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis①/ bdag dge bsnyen⑧du gzung du gsol/ deng slan cadasaji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas bram ze dbang po stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis tsan dan sa mchog gi mchod sdong gi dus mchod bshams lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bram ze gnang gis dusong la shoms shig /de nas des sa phyogs dben pa skabs yod pa zhig tu rim gro chen pos mchod sdong de bsgrengs dunas dus mchod chen po bshams ⑦so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag gzhan ⑧dag gis kyang rten dge bar gyur cig ces bya bar rig nas/ rtswa ⑨thu sha5)btags7te bram ze dbang pos mchod sdong gi dus mchod bshams pas na dbang po'i dus mchod ces bya bar grags so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis mnyan yod du cho 'phrul chen po bstan pas mu stegs 8can rnams ni spa bkong / lha dang mi rnams ni dga' bar mdzad/ skye bo dam pa rnams ni yi rangs byapar mdzad pa 0de'i tshe mu stegs can rnams bros nas mtha' 'khob tu gnas shing kha cig ni bram ze'i grong zhes bya bar dong nas gnas so//de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das ko sa la'i 7ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na 'bram 2—262

ze'i grong du gshegs so/ /mu stegs can rnams kyis ni7dge sbyong gau ta ma 'ong ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rings pa rings par bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyi khyim du dong ste lhagasalgenas smras pa/ chos thosalgepar gyur cigaX /chos thob par gyur cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag de ci zhig kho bo cag gis khyed kyi phun sum tshogs pa ni mthong gisaX/ ji srid rgyad pa mkhumathong ba de'i bar du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gi rgyad pa gang lags/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong gi ta ma 'khor stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang spu gri'i ser ba 'bebs shing 'ong ste/ bu dang bcas pa dum bu med par byed par〈'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gang gi tshe kho na ⑨bzhugs shing grogs bgyi ba la thug pa de kho na'i tshe bzhud pa ni bzang po ma lags te/ bdag cag rnam pa thams cad du ma rung ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te dge sbyong gi ta ma gsod na ni 'khod par bya'o/ /bzhugs shig gsad par bgyi'o zhes de rnams lag na dbyug pa dang gzhu thogs/ khu tshur bcangs/ go bgos te byung ba dang / lam gyi dbus na shākya rgan po zhig 'dug pas mthong nas smras pa/shes ldan dag gang du 'dong / de rnams kyis smras pa/ dgra bsad pa'i phyir rol/ /khyed cag gi dgra su yin/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'o/ /shes ldan dag gal te bcom ldan 'das dgra yin na byams pa gzhan ci 'dra ba zhig yin/ shes ldan dag slar log shig /de rnams ldog tu ma btub pa dang / des bsams pa/ 'di dag ni chos bshad pa'i 'os su 'gyur ba ma yin gyis8/ rnam pa thams cad du pha rol gnon pa zhig bya'o snyam nas/ des ri brags su zhugs 2—263

nas me btang ba dang / ri brags kun tshig pas ①ca co dang ku ②co'i sgra chen po byung ba de rnams kyis thos nas sngangs te smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag dang dge sbyong gi ta ma ni thag ring po kho na yin gyini/ ri brags 'dir ni phung ba chen po gzhan 'di byung ste ri brags bsregs kyis me bsad kyis0slar ldog go zhes de rnams kyis bsad par brtsams pa dang / bsad par ma nus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyang de nyid du byon nas bka' stsal pa/ gnas 'jog dag 'di ci byed/ bcom ldan 'das ri brags rnams zhugs kyis tshig na dgum par rngo ma thogashelags so/ /ngas bsad dam/ bcom ldan 'das dgumanyedu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung phyung ma thag kho nar 'di ltar yang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus me de zhi bar gyur to/ /de rnams mngon par dad par gyur nas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ci zhig gi slad du gshegs lags/ khyed cag kho na rjes su gzung ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang /bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang 'dra ba'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de zhes bya ba nas/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun nyepa shākya rgan po 'dis nye du la chags pas bsod nams ma lags pa mang du bsags te ri brags bsregs pa la gzigs/ bcom 2—264

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da⑥ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de / ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus na yang gnyen la chags pas bsod nams ma yin pa mang du bsags te ri brags bsregs pa de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungasashig dang bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri brags zhig na spre'u lnga brgya'i tshogs gnas pas lo thogasnyeskyes shing skyes pa rnams chud gsan to/ /ri brags na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'dus nas phan tshun du gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag spre'u rnams kyis lo thog la gnod pa byed na de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ gzhan dag gis smras pa spre'u rnams gsad mod/ de rnams ji ltar gsadakyipar bya/ ri brags kyi nyenasakor gyi shing thams cad bcad de shing tin tu ka gcig pu zhig bzhag la nyen kor ⑨rnams tsher mas bskor tang de la bza' ba'i phyir spre'u rnams 'dzeg par 'gyur7te/ de ltar gyur tang der de rnams gsad7par bya'o/ /de nas de rnams kyis brags kyi nyen kor gyi shing thams cad bcad de shing tin tu ka gcig pu bzhag nas nyen kor rnams tsher ma'i ra bas bskor te srung ma tho)pa'i mi bzhag nas bsgo ba/khyod 8kyis gang gi tshe spre'u rnams tshogs par gyur pa de'i tshe kho bo cag la sgron cig /de nas dus gzhan zhig na shing tin tu ku'i me tog dang 'bras bu chags te smine pa dang / spre'u rnams kyis sde7dpon la smras pa/ sde dpon shing tin tu ka smin cing mchis kyis0gsol du gshegs so/ /de nas sde dpon 'khor lnga brgya dang shing tin tu ka la 'dzegs te nyeshing tin tu ka de la 'baza' bar brtsams so/ /de nas srung buma'i mis ri brags na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la smras pa/ shes ldan dag shing tin tu ka la spre'u thams cad 'dzegs nas za bar 2—265

byed kyisarkyukhyed cag gi bya ba'am byed pa gang yin pa de gyis shig /de nas ri brags na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs lag na mda' gzhu dang dgra sta thogs/ khu tshur ②bcangs te rings par song nas shing tin tu ka bcad ③par brtsams pa dang / de nas spre'u de rnams bredakyide mchong rgal zhing0shing ka phan tshun rgyu bar byed do/ /sde dpon ni sems las chung ngus za bar byed pa dang / spre'u de rnams kyis de la smras pa/ sde dpon bdag cag ni sdug bsngal mi bzad pa nyam nga ba thob cing mchis te phan tshun du rgyu lags na/ khyod ci'i slad du thugs khral chung ngus bzhugs des tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bya ba mang po'i mi rnams la/ /bya ba min pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /shing gi 'phro ni mang yod pasal/ /sems las bskyungs te bza' bar gyis/ /de nas yang sde dpon gyi phru gu zhig ri brags de na bcings te 'dug pa de lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa dang / ji tsam na spre'u bzang po zhig phyogs der 'ongs pa dngarkyu/ de sems khong du chud pa mthong nas smras pa/ grogs po ci'i phyir lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du chud/ des smras pa/ da ltar ri brags na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kho bo'i nye du gsod du dong na ci'i phyir sems khong du chud par mi 'gyur/ ci'i phyir khyod kyis pha rol gnon pa ma byas/ bcings na ji ltar pha rol gnon pa bya/ kho bos khyod dgrol lo zhes des de bkrol ba dang / de nas des ri brags der me btang ste/ ri brags kun tshig pas ca co dang ku co'i sgra chen po byung ba de rnams kyis thos nas sngangs te smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag dang spre'u rnams ni thag ring po kho na yin gyibya/ phung ba chen po gzhan 'di byung ste ri brags bsregs kyis me gsad 2—266

kyis ⑦slar ldog ②go zhes de rnams me gsad ③pa'i phyir brgyugs ༷pa dang /spre'u rnams kyang shing tin tu ka las babs nas bros so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ spre'u'i0phru gu gang yin pa de ni shākya rgan po 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'dis nye du la chags pas ri brags bsregs la da ltar yang 'dis nye du la chags pas ri brags bsregs so//nag po'i grong khyer 0du gshegs nas nag po'i grong khyer ⑦du sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya ba rgyas par gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ro hi ta kur byon nas ro hi ta ka na gnod sbyin glang chen stobs kyi gnas na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin glang chen stobs gnod sbyin rnams kyi gnod sbyin gyi 'dun gyesar song ba dang / gnod sbyin glang chen stobs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das bskyed par byon nas ro hi ta ka na bdag gi gnas kho na na bzhugs so༅zhes thos so thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin glang chen stobs la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad ces bya ba nas/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhinarnyudu'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin glang chen stobs stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das do mod bdag gi gnas su bzhugs par gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 2—267

gnod sbyin glang chen stobs la cang mi gsung bsatuganang ngo / /de nas gnod sbyin glang chen stobs kyis ②bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang lnga brgya sprul te/ stan nang tshangs can dang / sngas nang tshangs can dang / gor bu lnga brgya dang / zhugs ling lnga brgya bshams so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar ②mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin glang chen stobs la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas gnod sbyin glang chen stobs kyis bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas stan las langs te song nas de'i ne'u zla kha che0yul gyi gnod sbyin sgra sgrogs zhesasnyebya ba de la des bsgo ba/ kho bos sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod la spyan drangs kyis byang laphyogs kyi 'bras bu rnams skur ③cig ces des de la 0pho nya btang nas de nyid kyi mtshan mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' 0ba dag sta gon byas nas/ nang par sngar langs te gtsug lag khang chag chag dang phyag dar byas nasalgegadan bshams te nor bu'i chu snod bzhag nas/ khang skyong gis gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa dang / gnod sbyin sgra sgrogs kyis rgyan 'brum gyis skon pa bkang ste gnod sbyin rnams kyi lag tu bskur te/ de dag gis gtsug lag khang gi dbus su phung por spungs te bzhag go/ /dge slong rnams kyis 'bras bu 'di dag ci'i yin pa dang6/ ji ltar brtag par bya ba mi shes nas/ de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag byang phyogs kyi nags kyi7'bras bu rgyan 'brum zhes bya 2—268

ste / mes brtag pa byos la rim7shig /dge slong rnams 'brum bu re re nas byed pa na ②shin tu yun ring du thogs ②par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phung po gnyis sam gsum du byos la mes reg par byos shig /de nas gnod sbyin glang chen stobs kyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas/ gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' babadang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas zhes bya bkunas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin glang chen stobs la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs pa dang rgyan ⑦'brum mang du lhag ⑧par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal7pa/ rgyan 'brum rnams mnyes la khu ba brim par bya'o/ /'on kyang lhag nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dro 'jar byas te7bzhag pa〈nyedang dge 'dun gyi7dus ma yin pa'i btung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du zhabs gnyis bkrus nas gtsugakhelag khang du nang du yang dag 'jog nyegi phyir zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga ni tshe thung ngu'i dus la byung bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus la bab na gdul ba'i don bya batshwanyeni rab tu mang bas gal te nga dge slong kun dga' bo dang thabs cig tu byang phyogs su gshegs na ni gdul ba rnams kyi don bya dka' bar 'gyur gyisayi/ ma la nga gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje dang lhan cig gshegasakyi par bya'o snyam 2—269

nas / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gtsug lag khang7gi phyi rol du tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje bos pa/ dran dang ldan rnamasashebazang por shog /dran dang ldan rnams rtagasatu bzang / /zhi ba thob0pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dran dang ldan pa bde bar nyal/ /dran dang ldan rnams bzang por shog /dran dang ldan rnams rtag tu bzang / /rgyal dang pha rol rgyal spangs nas/ /dran dang ldan pa bde bar nyal// //bar sdom la/ spungs pa can na sangs rgyas stobs/ /re tu ka na chos stobs te/ / sin dukhun ni por chen zhabs/ /mgo reg spyi blugs sog ma med/ /hu lu klu dang de bzhin nags/ /gnyid 'grogs7drang srong7nyams pa dang / /kun tha 'bras kyi grong khyer du/ /mchog gi ma btul dbang ldan dzo/ /gsing ma'i gnod sbyin chen po dang / /de bzhin brtsegs skyong dga' 'phel dang / /srid pa'i lha dang gtum byed kyi/ /bu bdun rnams ni btul ba dang / /gnod sbyin phyugs skyong 'gro mgyogs dang / /nab so'i klu la gzugs brnyan btang / /sbu bu can dang sbubs can btul/ /mdung can gyi ④ni grong khyer na/ /mdung can zhes bya'i gdon7sbyin mo/ /'bra go can dang rdul mchod rten/ ci /sog med tshogs su bsdus te brjod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje7la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje tshur byang phyogs su klu sog ma med 'dul du 'dong ngo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje dudang thabs cig tu de nyid nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyang ring po 2—270

kho na zhig na tshal sngo zhing sngo ba bsgrengs7pa dag gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje khyod kyis tshal sngo zhingasasngo ba bsgrengs pasadag mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /de ni u shi ra'i ri yin te/ nga0yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na zhi gnas dang rjes su mthun pa rnams kyi gnas mal gyi mchog ta ma sa'ishetshal zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das spungs pa can du gshegs so/ /de'i tshe spungs pa can na gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs zhes bya ba 'dug pa sdig pa'i bsam pa can zhig gnas pas spungs pa7can na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis ⑨mgu bar byas kyang de dus dus su gnod pa byed do/ /spungs pa can na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das spungs pa can du gshegs nas phyogs che ge mo na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang spungs pa can na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad ces bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas spungs pa can na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs 'di bdag cag 2—271

la yun ring mo zhig nas sha khonatum mchis par ni sha khon bgyid/ 'gran7zla ma lags par ni 'granasazla bgyidadu/ glags ma btsal bar ni glags tshol bar bgyid lags na/ kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs gdul bar gsol/ de'i tshe gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs 'khor de nyid dusnyi'adus shing 'dug par gyur nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs la bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas stobs khyod kyis thos sam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis thos lags so/ /sangs rgyas stobs khyod kyis thos sam/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag gis thos lags so/ /dam pa ma yin pa'i chos sdig pa de las log shig /bcom ldan 'das bdag ldog lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams la bzhag go/ /de nas des spungs pa can zhes bya ba'i gnas mal brtsigs7so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa ⑧can rnams kyis kyang yo byad thams cad dang 0ldan pa'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa dang gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs zhabs ⑩'bring du chas pa las bcom ldan 'das kyis slar bzlog nas bka' stsal pa/ skye bo'i tshogs 'di srungs shig /ngas kyang nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nasanyekyang ci nas spyan ldings te 'bab par 'gyur ba de ltar byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gzhan dag gis kyang phyogs der mchod rten brtsigs pas mchod rten spungs pa can zhes bya bar grags so/ /re tu kur byon nas/ re tu kur gnod sbyin chos stobs zhes bya ba btul te/des re tu ka zhes bya ba'i gnas mal brtsigs so/ / sin dur gshegs pa dang /2—272

sin dushen mnyan pa gzhan zhig yod pa de bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis dad pasabaskyed de/ de nas dad pasaskyes nas bden pa rnams la bzhag go/ /gnod sbyin phor chen btul nas zhabs7kyis bcags pas phor chen zhabs kyis bcags pa zhes bya bar grags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das drang srong rnams kyi bsti gnas su gshegs nas der drang srong mgo reg dang ril ba spyi blugs can btul nas bram ze dang (nyakhyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis gnas mal ril ba spyi blugs can zhes bya ba brtsigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje klu'i rgyal po sog ma med kyi ⑦gnas gang na ba der 'dong ngo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyisaltar mnyan7to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang / klu'i rgyal po sog ma med (3 kyi gnas su gshegs so/ /klu'i rgyal po sog ma med kyis bcom ldan 'das kyichaganas su gshegs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang khros 'khrugs rngam yi ma rangasalgenas steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te ser ba dang rdul gyi char dbab par brtsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu 'khrugs so zhes byams pa la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / char pa de dag a ga ru'i phye ma dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i 'phye mar gyur nas 'bab par brtsams so/ /de nas 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mda' bo che dang / mdung thung la sogs te mtshon cha rnams dbab par brtsams pa desnyedag kyang lha'i ut+pa la dang / pad ma dang /ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dra ra bar gyur nas 'bab par brtsams so/ /de nas sog ma med kyis khro ba'i mes du ba dbyung0 bar brtsams 2—273

pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis dud pa dbyung bar brtsams so / /de nas de spungs dang / rgyags pa dang / nga rgyal bcom par gyur nas gnas su zhugs te 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ klu gdug pa rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ba ni rgyu rnam pa gnyis kyis te/ 'jigs pa dang /'khrugasalgepas yin gyisargya/ ma la ngas 'di 'jigs su gzhug go snyam du thugs su chud nas gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje klu'i rgyal po sog ma med 'jigs par gyis shig /de nas gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan te/ rdo rje ri'i 7la 'phangs nas ri'i rtse mo bshig ste lhung ba des klu'i rgyal po sog ma med kyi gnas non par gyur to/ /de nas sog ma med sngangs skrag phongasalgenas 'bros par brtsams pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis7me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs nas phyogs thams cad 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun dusarab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi drung na zhi zhing bsil bar gyur pa ma gtogs par de gang dang gang du song ba de dang de na mi⑥mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci bdag la tho btsam lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rga ba'i chos can ci ngas tho btsams samadzo/ gal te ngas yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bu dag ma thob na/khyod kyis nga7ming lus par byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag 'khor lo dang / bkra shis dang / g.yung drung 'khyil pa dang / dra bas 'brel ba/ bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bsgrubs pa/ 'jigs pa rnams 2—274

dbugs ①'byin par mdzad pas spyi bo la ②reg par mdzad nas bka' stsal pa/bzhin bzangs khyod kyis bum pa bzang ①po lta bu'i nyan thos chen po bzhi la zan0byin te/ sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lhasagya nom pa dag gi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba las khyod kyis smon lam log par btab pas dud 'gro rnams su skyes te/ rdegashepa dang gsod pa la zhen cing pha rol gyi srog 'phrog pa dang / pha rol gyi srog la gnod pa7byed pas 'tsho bar byed na/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas sems can dmyal ba ma gtogs par khyod kyi 'gro ba ni gang zhig yin/ skye ba ni gang zhig yin/ tshe phyi ma ni gang zhig yin/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gisasheci zhig bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ bzhin bzangs tshur nga las skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams zung la/ yul ma ga d+marwar+shan gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la mi 'jigs 8pa byin cig /btsun pa bdag deng slan cad ⑫bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar skyabs su mchi ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams mnos nas yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la yang mi 'jigs pa stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas de'i chung ma dang / bu mo dang mna' ma rnams kyisalgegasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la bdag cag kyang skyabs su mchi zhing bslab pa'i gzhi7rnams nod lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams byin no/ /de'i bu ri bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang skyabs su mchi ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams nod nyelags so/ /sog ma med kyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bdag cag klu rnams ni mi mdza' ba mang ba sngo)lags kyis(spre/ri bo la skyabs su mchi ba stsal cing bslab pa'i gzhi rnams ni ⑥mi dpog par 2—275

gsol/ 'dis7bdag cag bsrungs paraku'agyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la skyabs su 'gro ba byin no/ /de nas gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes sog ma med grogs po dang / gnyen 'dab ③dang / mdza' bshes rnams btul bar gyur pa mthong nas yid rab tu dga' bas gar byas te smras pa/ khros pas lce bskyod mgo mang bsgul dunas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'bebasaX rang gnas skyes bu rang la phyogs pa ri mtho rtse lta bu/ /du ma'i tshogs lhags ngal chad dbugs brdzogasarkyubazur cing lta byed pa/ /sbrul bdag sog ma med de drang srong bka' btsan rnams kyis btul/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sog ma med 'khor drug khri dang bcas pa7btul nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshal sngo zhing sngo ba bsgrengs5)pa dag gzigs sol/ /gzigs nas kyang gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje khyod kyis7tshal sngo zhing sngo ba bsgrengs pa dag mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /lag na rdo rje de ni kha che'i yul yin te/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon nas dge slong kun dga' bo'i lhan cig gnas pa dge slong nyi ma'i gung zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ des klu gdug pa hu lu ducabatul nas thabs bshams te de las skyil mo krung 8shong ba'i sa blangs nas kha che'i yul kun du bstan pa 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /nga'i lhag mthong dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas mal rnams kyi nang na 'di lta ste/ kha che'i yul mchog tu 'gyur te/ grong khyer dang grong rdal drug khri dang / grong rdal drug stong dang ske/ grong rdal drug bcu rtsa gsum po 'di rnams ni kha che'i0 yul yin no/ /yul gnyidake 'grogs5)su drang srong dang gnod sbyin nyams pa 'khor dang bcas 2—276

pa btul lo/ /yul gan7thar gnod sbyin mo 'khor dang bcas pa btul lo9/ /'bras kyi grong khyer du byon nas 'bras kyi grong khyer du rgyal po sde mchog gi ma bden pa rnams la rab tu bzhag go/ /yul dbang ldan du byon te/ dbang ldan na rdza mkhan gzhan zhig yod pa de bzos shin tu rgyags te snod rnams skamasashenas 'khor lo las 'gogs par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de gdulakyiba'i dus mkhyen nas rdza mkhan gyi cha byad du nyidakyimangon par sprul te de dang lhan cig gtam bya bar brtsams pa/ khyod kyis snod ci 'dra ba dag cig 'khor lo las 'bebs par byed/ des gsol pa/ bskams nas 'bebs so ngakyiyang bskams nas 'bebs so/ /khyodashedang bdag mnyam lags so/ /'di kho nar zad dam ci/ nga ni so btang nas kyang 'bebs so/ /khyodakulhag go/ /so gtong ba7'ba' zhig tu yang ma zad do/ /'o na ci zhe na/ gser dang /dngul dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / shel gyi rang bzhin du yang byed do/ /de mngon par dad par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyisanyerdza mkhan gyi cha byad mi snang bar mdzad de rang bzhin gyi cha byad du bzhugs〈nyenas de 'khor gyi skye bo dang bcas te bden pa rnams la rab tu bkod do/ /gsing ma can du gshegs nas gsing ma can du gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas pa skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams la rab tu bzhag go/ /brtsegs skyong du klu ba lang skyong dang / dgar ba gnyis so/ /dga' 'phel du gshegs nas dga' 'phel du rgyal po srid pa'i lha 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gtum byed kyi bu bdun dang /gnod sbyin sa 'tsho bden pa dag la rab tu bkod do/ /de nasnyimatsho chen po yod pa gang yin pa de na 'gro mgyogs dang / nab so gnyis klu'i skyesnyiganas su 2—277

skyes te lo bcu gnyis 'das shing steng du byung ste 'khrugs ①pas 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la chos ma bshad pas〈des na bdag cag rnam par ltungakhub klu'i skye gnas su skyes kyisakhuci nasarkyubadag cag gis de'i bstan pa gzhig par bya'o zhes smra'o⑦/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te / klu 'gro mgyogasasnyedang nab so ni 'di ltar mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che ba yin pas nga ⑨yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas nga'i bstan pa thal bar rlag ⑩par 'gyur ba gang yin pa'i gnas 'di yod do snyam du mkhyen nas/ bcom ldan 'das klu 'gro mgyogs7dang / nabanyeso gnyis gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas 'gro mgyogs dang / nab so gnyis la bka' stsal pa/ 'gro mgyogs dang / nab so tshig bzhi pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs zhes bya ba yod pa bshad kyis shes par byos shig /btsun pa bdag cag dam pa'i chos 'tshal bar bgyid pa su zhig mchis snyam du rig nas/ de nyid du slar zhugs te/ de gnyis 'di snyam du sems so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ni bdag cag la chos bshad na bdag cag gis rnam par ma shes so snyam pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs der sku'i gzugs brnyan btang nas 'gro mgyogs7dang / dab so gnyis kyis de la bltas shing bltas shing bcom ldan 'das da dung bzhugs pa lta zhes slar yang dang yang du zhugs so/ /phyogs de nyid du bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin mo sbru bu can dang / sbubs can gnyis btul to/ /mdung can gyi grong khyer du gshegs so/ /mdung can gyi grong khyer na gnod sbyin mo mdung can zhes bya ba khro zhing gtum la gzu lums can zhig gnas pas mdung can gyi grong khyer gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyi bu btsas shing btsas pa dag za bar byed do//2—278

mdung can gyi gong khyer gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das mdung can gyi grong khyer du gshegs nas phyogs che ge mo na bzhugs so zhes thos solta/ /thos nas kyang tshogs nas tshogs dang khyu nas khyur phradakhucing 'dus nas mdung can gyi grong khyer nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dongakhuste lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis mdung can gyi grong khyer gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis zhes bya ba nas/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas mdung can gyikhugrong khyer gyi0bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po sum bcu rtsa drug pa/ bcom ldan 'dasashedage slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu lasang bdag cag gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal zas gsol zin nas phyagashebacabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir 'khod nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis klu gdug pa dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa de dang de rnams ni btul lags na/ btsun pa gnod sbyin mo mdung can zhes bgyi ba 'di bdag cag la yun yiring mo zhig nas sha khon 8ma mchis par ni ⑩sha khon tsodu 2—279

bgyid①/ 'gran zla ma lags par ni 'gran7zla bgyid/ glags ma btsal bar ni glags tshol bar bgyid de/ byis pa btsas shing btsas pa rnams 'phrog par bgyid lags na/ kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse bakhunye bar bzung ste/gnod sbyin mo mdung can gdul bar gsol/ de'i tshe gnod sbyin mo mdung can 'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin mo mdung can la bka' stsal pa/ mdung can khyod kyis thos sam/bcom ldan 'das bdag gis thos lags so/ /mdung can khyod kyis thos sam/bde bar gshegs pa bdag gis thos lags so/ /dam pa ma yin pa'i chos sdig pa de las log shig /btsun pa dam zhig bca' lko/ gal te 'di dag bdag0gi slad du gtsug lag khang rtsig⑧par bgyid na bdag ldog par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdung can gyi grong khyer gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la bka' stsal pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag khyed ②kyis thos sam/bcom ldan 'das thos lags so/ /khyed cag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bya/bcom ldan 'das brtsigashelags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa brtsig lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin mo mdung can 'khor dang bcas te btul nas gshegs so/ /'bra go can du gshegs pa dang 'bra go can na byis pa chung ngu dag ciganyertul gyi mchod rten la rtse bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byis pa chung ngu dag rdul gyi mchod rten la rtse ba gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang yang gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje khyod kyis byis pa chung ngu rdul gyi mchod rten la rtse ba dag mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /lag na rdo rje nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya lon 2—280

pa natu'adir ku sha na'i rigs kyi rgyal po ka nis ka zhes bya ba 'byung b.rakhu'agyur ba des phyogs 'dir mchod rten rtsig⑧par 'gyur te/ de'i ming ka nis ma'i mchod rten zhes bya bar 'gyur zhing nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das na yang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ro hi ta ka nas klu'i rgyal po sog ma med kyi gnas kyi bar du srog chags sa ya phrag bdun dang 'bum phrag bdun btul nas ro hi ta kur gshegs te gtsug lag khang du zhugs nas nang du yang dag bzhag go/ /bcom ldan 'das dgongs ka nang du yang dag 'jogatsolas bzhengasakyinas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dang po'i rgyal srid gang na ba deratu'adong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis sngar ni 'di skad ces kun dga' bo byang phyogs su klu'i rgyal po sog ma med 'dul du 'dong ngos/ /byang phyogs na ni phan yon rnam pa lnga yod do zhes gsungs la/ daltebacom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad du kun dga' bo dang po'i rgyal srid gang na ba der 'dong ngo zhes gsungs na de ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo nga gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje dang thabs cig tu byang phyogs su gshegs nas ta thotem sa'i tshal rnams lung bstan to zhes bya ba nas rdul gyi tsomachod rten lung bstan 8to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /kun dga' bo ro nyi ta ka nas klu'i rgyal po sog ma med kyi gnas kyi bar du de bzhin gshegs pas srog chags sa ya phrag bdun dang 'bum phrag bdun btul te0/ byang phyogs na ni nyes dmigs lnga yod de8/mthon dman can dang / sdong dum dang / tsher mas gang ba dang / rdo ba 2—281

dang / gsogatum dang / gyo mo mang ba dang / khyi za ba dang / bud med gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa'o// //sdom la/ dang po'i rgyal srid rta bzangs dang / /bcom brlag dang ni o ta la'i⑧/ /kun dga' ra ba dgra mtha' dang / /tshugs par dka' dang gang gā'i chu/ /yi dgas dus dpog phyi ma yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul dpa' sde nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na dang po'i rgyal srid du gshegs nas/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ①tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo phyogs 'dir rgyal po mang pos bkur ba dang po ༷rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ba de ni dang po'i rgyal po yin no/ /de'i phyir 'di dang po'i rgyal srid ces bya bar grags so/ /rta bzangs su0gshegs nas/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo phyogs 'dir rgyal po mang pos bkur 0ba'i rta bzang po ①rin po che byung ste/ de'i phyir 'di rta bzangs zhes bya bar grags so//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo bcom brlag gang na ba der 'dong ⑧ngo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das bcom brlag tu gshegs pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyang ring po kho na zhig na tshal sngo zhing sngo ba bsgrengs pa dag gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis tshal sngo zhing sngo ba bsgrengs7pa pha bisnyemathong 2—282

ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo de ni ri bo rtse mthon zhes bya ste / nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa dang / bcom brlag nas gar mkhanatudang dpa' bo zhes bya ba spun gnyis kyis de la gtsug lag khang rtsig⑧par 'gyur te/ de'i ming gar mkhan dpa' bo zhes bya bar 'gyur zhing lhag mthong dang zhi gnas kyi rjes su mthun⑧pa'i gnas mal rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo bcom brlag 'dir spos 'tshongasregi khye'u sbas pa zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de'i bu nye sbas zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi mtshan med pa zhig 'byung ⑤ba de nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa dang bstan pa la rab tu byung nas sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong kun dga' bo'i lhan cig gnas pa nyi ma'i gung zhes bya bas nye sbas de rab tu 'byin par 'gyur te/ gdams ngag ston pa rnams kyi phyi ma ni nye sbas yin par 'gyur ro/ /gar mkhan dpa' bo de la phug srid du khru bcwa0brgyad pa/ zheng du khru bcu gnyis pa/ 'phang du khru bdun pa zhig yod par 'gyur te/ desashegang dang gang dag la gdams ngag bstan nas dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas pa de dang de rnams kyis thur ma sor bzhi tsam pa re re phug de'i nang du 'dor bar 'gyur phro/ /gang gi tshe phug dekyi dgra bcom pa'i thur mas gang bar gyur pa7de'i tshe nye sbas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur te/ de yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas dgra bcom pa'i thur ma de dag nyid spungs nas de rnams kyis sreg par byed do/ /dge slong rnams the tsom skyes nas the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ma 'ongs pa na skye bo mang po la snying brtse ba dang tshe dang ldan pa nye 2—283

sbas lung bstan pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de'i tsher ma zad ji ltar 'di 'das pa'i dus na skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung7shig dang bshad do//dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri bo lartse mthon 'di gnyid kyi ngos ④gsum la rang sangs rgyas dang drang srong dang / spre'u rnams gnas te/ ngos gcig na ni rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya'o/ /gnyis pa la ni drang srong lnga brgya'o/ /gsum pa la ni spre'u lnga brgya'o/ /spre'u'i sde dpon gyi kun du spyod pa ni spre'u'i phru gu btsas shingasnyebatsas pa dag gsod par byed pa yin no/ /de nas spra mo de dag phru gu'i mya ngan gyis non pas phan tshun gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan sprakhumo dag nyon cig /bdag cag nigi phru gu btsas shing btsas pa dag sde dpon 'dis gsod par byed kyis7de la thabs shig bsham par bya ste/ bdag cag las spra mo gang zhig sbrum par gyur na des sde dpon la brjod par mi bya'o/ /ji tsam dus gzhan tho)zhig na spra 8mo zhig sbrum par gyur nas de de rnams kyis dben pa'i phyogs shig tu sbas nas rtsa ba dang 'bras bus bstod de spre'u'i phru gu byung nas de yang de rnams kyis dben pa'i phyogs shig tu bsnun gsos bskyed de/ de gang gi tshe chen por gyur pa de'i tshesades sde dpon de rang gi khyu nas bskrad nas ri bo rtse mthon na phan tshun du 'khyam7par brtsams so/ /de 'khyam7pa na rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgra thos nas de de rnams kyi drung du song ste/ gang gi tshe bag phebs par gnas par gyur pa de'i tshe de rnams la rtsa ba dang / lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu dang so shing dag 'bul bar byed do/ /de rnams kyis kyang de la lhung bzod kyi lhag ma dag 'dor bar byed do/ /rang sangs rgyas de rnams kyi7kun 2—284

du spyod pa ni zos shing zos nas skyil mo krungatubacas te 'dugashego/ /spre'u des kyang de rnams kyi spyod lam mthong nas skyil mo krungasnyebacas shing 'dug go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rang sangs rgyas de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag gi lus rnag can 'dis thob par bya ba gang yin pa ni thob zin gyis④/bdag cag zhi ba 0mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 'jug go snyam nas/ de nas0de rnams kyis 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog⑧'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byas nas phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de rnams ldang ba'i dus gang yin pa de'i tshe mi ldang nas spre'u des7de rnams ma mthong bas mi dga' bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na spre'u de phug tu zhugs nas rang sangs rgyas de rnams kyi chos gos rnams nas gsig par7brtsams so/ /de nas phug de na gnas pa'i lha gang yin pa de 'di snyam du sems te/ spre'u 'dis rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi (7sku bshig na 7mi rung ngo snyam nas rdo leb chen pos sgo 8bcad nas 'dug tsogo/ /de nas spre'u de mya ngan dang sdug bsngal ba hudang / smre sngags bton te song nas ri bo rtse mthon la kun nas 'khyam ⑩pa na mi rnams 'dod pas mi dga' bar gyur te/ rna ba gtod cing mi'i sgra thos par 'dod pa las/ des drang srong de rnams smra ba'i sgra dag thos nas/ de 'gron pa skyalam stor ba bzhin du rings pa rings par de rnams kyi drung du song ngo / /drang srong de dag kyang dka' thub drag pos gdung bar byed deyi/ kha cig ni lag pa bsgreng nas 'dug go/ /kha cig ni rkang pa ya gcig gis so/ /kha cig ni gdung ba lngas gdung bar byed do/ /gang gi tshe spre'u de de rnams dang lhan cig 2—285

bag phebs par gnas par gyur pa de'i tshe drang srong de rnams la rtsa ba dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / so shing dag sbyin par byed do/ /de rnams kyang de la zas kyi lhag ma dag 'dor bar7byed do/ /des de rnams kyi spyod lam dkrugs7shing rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod lam ston par byed de③/ de nasagang dag lag pa sgreng 0ba de rnams kyi lag pa dag phab nas se gol gyi sgra phyung r+sā)/ sbran nas mdun du skyil mo krungarkyubacas te 'dug go/ /gang dag rkang pa ya gcig pa de rnams kyi nirkang pa phab nas mdun du skyil mo krung ⑨bcas te 'dug go/ /gang dag gdung ba lngas gdung bar byed pa de rnams kyi me gsad nas se gol gyi sgra phyung ste mdun du skyil mo krung bcas nas7'dug go/ /de nas drang srong de rnams kyis gdams ngag 'bogs pa la smras pa/ mkhan po spre'u 'di bdag cag gi dka' thub la bar chad bgyid do zhes de rnams kyis de la rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa shes ldan dag spre'u de dag ni dran pa dang ldan pa yin te/ gdon mi za bar 'dis drang srong kha cig gi spyod lam de lta bu mthong gis khyed cag gis kyang skyil mo krung chos la 'dug shigatso /de rnams kyis skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug pa dang / de rnams kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams mngon du gyur nas de rnams kyis mkhan po dang slob dpon med pa'i shes pas byang chub kyi phyogs7sum bcu rtsa bdun dang mthun pa'i chos bskyed nas rang byang chub mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas de rnams spre'u de la chos las byung ba'i dad pa skyes nas/ de rnams kyis ljongs nas bsod snyoms0lo tog sar pa dang 'bras bu sar pa dang / dus gsar gyi rnyed pa gang yin pa de rnams las de la thog mar byin nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed do/ /ji 2—286

tsam dusashegazhan zhig na spre'u de dus las 'das so/ /de nasakhurang byang chub de rnams kyis yul khams dang phyogs sna tshogs na yod pa'i shing dri zhim po rnams blangs te/ shing dri zhim po thams cad kyis phung por spungs nas bsregs so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ rang byang chub rnams dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'i spre'u gang yin pa de ni nye sbas 'di nyid yin te/ 'di de'i tshe yang skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir zhugs so/ /da ltar na yang ngas 'di skye bo mang po la phan pa dang snying rje ③bar lung bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpa' sde nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa dun bcom brlag tu gshegs pa dang / bcom brlag gi bram ze rnams kyis dge sbyong gi ta ma bcom brlag tu phyin nas de shin tu rigs bzhi po rnam tshar dag par 'dod de 'chad par byed 'dogs par byed/ rab tu 'jog par byed/ rnam par 'byed par byed/bye brag tu 'byed par byed/ gsal bar byed/ ston par byed/ yang dag par rab tu ston par byed do zhes thos nas/ gal te de bcom brlag tu 'dug na bdag cag ⑧shi rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i bar chad du ⑨'gyur la de ni bkur ste ma yin pas skrag go zhes grag gis(7/ gal te de la 'ga' zhig gis bkur ste ma yin pa byas nas de lta na de bcom brlag tu 'dug par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te de la mi smad rigs kyis bkur ste ma yin pa byas na ngo mtshar du mi 'dzin gyi gal te de la skyes bu gtso bo 'ga' zhig gis bkur ste ma yin pa byas na des ni legs par 'gyur na/ bdag cag gi nang na skyes bu gtso bo su zhig yod snyam mo/ /de'i tshe〈nyebacom brlag na bram ze sngor gyur5)ces bya ba rig byed dang rig byed kyi yan lag gi pha rol tu phyin pa rang gi smra ba gsal bar byed 2—287

pa / pha rol gyi rgol ba tshar gcod par nus pa de'i tshig bden pa'i rjes su 'brang ba zhig yod do/ /de nas bcom brlag gi bram ze rnamasatu'adus shing tshogs te/ sngor gyur gyi drung du song nas mkhan po 'dir dge sbyong gi ta ma mchis nas/ derasashin tu rigs bzhi posnyernam par dag pa zhes bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu ston par byed do zhes thos zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de ni bkur ste ma yin pas skrag go zhes gda' na/ gal te de la0'ga' zhig gis bkur sti ma lags pa bgyis na/ de lta na de bcom brlag tu mchis par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te de la mi smad rigs kyis bkur ste ma lags pa bgyis na ngo mtshar du mi 'dzin gyi gal te de la skyes bu gtso bo 'ga' zhig gis bkur ste ma lags pa bgyis na legs par 'gyur na/ bdag cag gi skyes bu gtso bo mkhan po ma lags pa su zhig mchis/ khyod kyis de la bkur ste ma lags pa'i tshig gi⑧rgya lcag gis spyo bar7gsol/ sngor gyur gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag gi lce 'di ni bden pa'i rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ gel te spyo bar 'os pa zhig na spyo'o/ /'on te bstod par 'os pa zhig na bstod do/ /de nas bram ze sngor gyur bcom brlag naphonyaganas pa'i bram ze rgan rabs rgan rabs rnams kyis mdun du bdar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ba na/ bram ze sngor gyur gyis rgyang ring po kho na nas bcom ldan 'das ()sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ 'od zer nyi ma stong bas lhag pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas bzang ba shing drung zhig na rten cing zhi ba'i spyod lam gyis bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas 2—288

kyang ya mtshan skyes te mig bgrad de bltas nas bstod par brtsams pa lus dang ngag dang dbang por bcas pa yi/ /yid kyis tshul bzhin rtse gcig bgyis nas ni/ /yon tan rang bzhin yon tan rgya mtsho che/ /khyod kyi yon tan phyogs gcig brjod par bgyi/ /smra ba rnams kyi dam pa rab mchog lags/ /skyon med dbang po shin tu mnyam par bzhag /pha rol rgol btubartson pa thams cad kyis/ /don dam thugs su chud la bskyod mi nus/ /khyod kyikhuspyod pa shin tu rdzogs pa nyid/ /brtul zhugs bsgrubasalgepas brtul zhugs shin tu rdzogs/ /stobs ldan khyod kyi ting 'dzin zad med pas/ /sred med bu dang ri yi rgyal po bzhin / /skyes bu khyu mchog khyod la gnod mi mnga'/ /mi zhum bsnyengs pa mi mnga' dub mi mnga'/ /'byung po rnams la'ang mi bzod 'ga' mi mnga'/ /khyod ni ma chags 'thab pa ga la mnga'/ /brtabs pa med cing ha cang zhum mi mnga' / /gdung ba med cing dgyes pa'ang yong mi mnga'/ /ri yi bdag po lhun po rab brtan ltar/ /khyod kyi thugs ni rtagakhutu dge ba nyid/ /thub pa skyes mchog khams rnams thams cad nas/ /khyod kyi ye shes yangs pa sgrib mi mnga'/ /skye mched rnamasapa sna tshogs dag la ni/ /mashethogs nyams shing zad pa med par 'jug /thub pa khyod la gang la'ang som nyi med/ /yid gnyis yod min the tshom yod ma yin/ /khyod nyid kyis ni mchog dang mchog min pa/ /rig pas thugs su chud nas thams cad mkhyen/ /mthong na dga' bar 'gyur la mthong na legs/ /mthong na legs pas mthong na mkhas pa dga'/ /khyod la dga' dang mi dga' mnyam pas na/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i spyod lam de bzhin mdzad⑩/ /khyod ni snyan5)pa'i spobs par ldan pa lags/ /'dzum pa'i gsung 2—289

dang dran ldan bsnyengasalgepa med/ /mkhas rnams 'dod pa rabakutu 'chad pas na/ /'jig rten gsum du khyod kyi grags pa 'byung / /mi dang lha dang lha min gnod sbyin dang / /srin po mang dang 'jig rten 'dir mkhas dag /thub pa'i drung du yang dang yang lhags nas/ /khyod la yang dang yang zhu mi bzod med/ /khyod ni snyan pa'i gsung gis dga' mdzad pas/ /mi dang lha dang lha min gnod sbyin dang / /srin po yid gnyis bsal rnams thub pa che/ /khyod kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal slar mchi'o/ /bzhengs dang bzhugs dang gshegs dang bzhud pa dang / /mnal dang mi gsung yang na gsung ba 'am/ /'on te lhung bzed chos gos bsnams pa dag /gi tam khyod kyi thams cad mdzes pa nyid/ /thogs pa med mnga'akhumi myur mnyam pas na/ /gsung ni snyan pa'i yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /mi yi mchog ni dus su gsung bas na/ /gsung gi zlos pa rnam par spangs pa lags/ /'jig rten na ni stobs dang ldan par grags/ /skyes bu mkhyen pa skyes bu khyu mchog gtso/ /'jig rten lhar bcas 'di ni mtha' dag la//nga rgyal mi mnga' khyad du gsod mi mdzad/ /mdza' ba dang ni mdza' bakhum lags dang / /mthun pa dang ni mthun pa ma lags dang / /g.yo0dang mi g.yo rang bzhin gnas pa la/ /ngo mtshar 'dzin pa nam yang mi mnga'o the sngagasaX'adon cing snying brtser smra ba dang / /kha chu 'dzags7pas nyam thag skad 'byin dang / /yongs su gdungs dang rnam par gdungs ldan dang / /'jigs dang rims nad mya ngan gyis nyen pa/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa brgya yis gtses pa dang ske/ /yun ring nas ni mgon med bde ba med/ /srid pa'i sred par zhugs shing mun bsgribs pa'i/ /'gro ba 'khrugs pa la ni rab gzigs nas/ /2—290

bdag nyid rnam pa sna tshogs mthu dag gis/ /thub pa thugs rje chen po 'jug mdzad cing / /shākya skyes kyi mchog ni khyod nyid kyis/ /phongs par gyur rnams dgrol phyir brtson paratumadzad/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas 'di dang / /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad pasnyegang yin dang / /srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba yi/ /lam nisnyematshungs pa med pa khyod kyis bshad/ /rnam par 'dren pa chen po brtson 'grus che/ /rab mchog pha rol smra ba rnams kyi mchog /'jig rten gsum na khyod mtshungs ma mchis na/ /khyod las lhag pa0lta zhig ga la mchis/ /khyod la khong khro rjes su chags mi mnga'/ /thub pa khyod la yongs su zag0mi mnga'/ /sdug dang 'gal dang rtsod pa brtul zhugasashebazang / /khyod la mi mnga' rtag tu mi mnga' lags/ /thub pa sdug dang mi sdug bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal mnyam dang de bzhin mi mnyam spangs/ /dga' dang mi dga' ba dag bzod mdzad de/ /yang dag bsdams shing 'di na nyer zhi spyod/sgyu /smad pa byas kyang gnod pa mi mnga' la/ /rab tu bsngags pas khengs par mi 'gyur bas/ /grags pa grags pa ma yin khyod la mnyam/ /glang chen mche bar ldan pa g.yul ngo ru/ /'dor ba drag tu 'phangs pa'i mda' dag ltar//skyesabo sdig can rnams kyis smras pa yi/ /tshig ngan tshig rtsub dag kyang bzod par mdzad/ /drang srong khyod snyan gsung zhing tshig kyang bzod/ /shin tu ngan du smras pa'ang7mi bzod med/ /smad par smras sam dge bar smras kyang rung / /thub pa mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa lags/ /mchod 'os rtag par mi dang lha dag dang / /lha min gnod sbyin srin po rnams dang ni/ /drang srong bdag nyid chen pos rtag mchod na/ /khyod ni thugs brtan gzhan du 'gyur mi mnga' /2—291

'di bas bdag mchog ces kyang0rlom mi mnga'/ /'di bas bdag chung zhes kyang rlom mi mnga'/ /bdag ni 'di dngasamanyam zhes mi rlom pas/ /khyod la nga rgyal rnam pa gsum mi mnga'/ /brtan dang ldan la bong ba gser dang mtshungs / /be+e ḍūr+ya7dang gsog ma gyo mor mtshungs/ /thub pa chen po lha dang bcas pa yi/ /'gro ba 'di ni rtswa shing 'dra bar spyod/ /zla ba nyi ma'i 'od zer dang phrad nas/ /grang dang tsha ba'i rlung dag langs na yang / /ri yi dbang po lta bur bzod mdzad de/ /thugs brtan khyod la rab tu gnod mi mnga'/ /gzims cha dang ni stsang nas bshos dang ni/ /bla gos sham thabs rnam pa sna tshogs dag /thub pa zag med so sor brtags nas ni/ / de yi0don du bsten0par mdzad pa lags/ /mgon po bdag la med ces thugs ngan med/ /ma bcingarme legs gsung bdag gir 'dzin0mi mnga'/ /gnod pa sna tshogs dag las yongs su grol/ /rnyedashepa brnyes na'ang dgyes par mi 'gyur la/ /de ma brnyesalgepas kyang ni zhum mi 'gyur/ /khyadasnyedu gsod pa bzod7pa mdzad cing 'diratso/ /bkur ste dag la'ang chags pa mi mnga' lags/ /lha gnas ri yi ngos las 'khrungs pa yi/ /khrag ltar dmar ba'i tsan dan mchog dag dang / /mda'achadang ral gri rnon pos khyod kyi thugs/ /lan 'ga' yang ni 'gyur ba mi mnga' lags/ /don med gtam ni gsung bar mi mdzad gang / /skye bo ngan pas bsten pa'i gtam ma lags/ /rnyed pa'i gtam min zang zing bcas gtam min/ /bdag nyid che rnams mi 'dod ma lags kyi'/ /gtam gang rab dben bde ba skyed byed cing / /rab tu zhi ba 'ba'ashe zhig rab brjod pa/ /lha las 'das pa'i gtam ni gang dag cig / gsungs nas sdig pa rnam par 2—292

'dul ba gsungs①/ /snyan pa rnams dang 'brel pa rnams dang ni/ /legs par bshad dang snying por ldan pa yi/ /rnam par nges pa'i gtam rdeg thub pa che//'gro ba'i don slad rab tu gsung bar mdzad/ /mi mkhas dag dang log par lta rnams dang / /gzu lums can dang dga' bar ldan rnams dang / /phra ma can dang tshig rtsub sgyusnyecan gang / /de dang lhan cig bcom ldan khyod mi rkyen/ /mi ni gang dag drang zhing sgyu med lge/ /bden la dga' zhing dbang po thul ba dang / /rtag tu legs par brtags nas byed pa ni/ /de dang lhan cig bcom ldan khyod mi rkyen/ /chos mkhyen lugs mkhyen gang zag mkhyen pa dang / /drug po mngon mkhyen khyodakyil rtag phyag 'tshal/ /thub pa zhing0mkhyen mchog dang mchog min mkhyen/ /tshul dang tshul min mkhyen khyod mgos phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho rgya chen legs mthong nas/ /bdag gis yon tan phyogs gcig yongs su brjod par bas/ /'phags pa khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol ni/ /rtogs par rngo thogashe'agro ba'i nang na mishem mchis de lta bu la sogs pa bstod pa lnga brgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod tenas de ltar mngon par dad par gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis sngor gyur ji ltar stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bram ze sngor gyur gyis bcom ldan 'das la bstod nas song ste de lam du zhugs pa na/ bcom brlag gi bram ze rnams kyis tshig gi rgya lcag gis pagasalgepa las thal ba tsam du brgyad de8/ mkhan po khyod la kho bo cag gis dge sbyong gi ta ma la bkur sti ma yin pa byos shig ces smras na/ khyod da gzod slar 8bstod de 'ong ngam/ shes ldan dag kho bos sngar kho bo'i lce ⑩ni 2—293

bden pa'i rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ gal te smad par 'os pa zhig na smod la/ bstod par 'os pa zhig na bstod do zhes sngar mnyesmras sam/ dge sbyong gi ta ma ni bstod par 'os pas kho bos bstod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs ②lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams ②nas bcom brlag tu bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / de'i tshe bcom brlag na rgyu skar gyi nub mo la bab boX/ /de nas bcom brlag na gnas pa'i lha mo gang yin pa de 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te dge sbyong gau ta ma bcom brlag tu 'ongs na bdag gisargyu skar gyi nub mo la bar chad byed par 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar sgren mor byedakyinas 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo re zhig bud med ni shin tu bkab kyang bzang ba ma yin na sgron mo lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas lha mo de skyengs nas phyogs gcig tu song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lam las bzur tekhudage slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bcom brlag na ni nyes dmigs lnga po 'di dag yod de①/ lnga gang zhe na mthon dman dang sdong dum dang tsher mas gang ba dang / rdo ba dang gsog ma dang gyo mo mang ba dang / dgongs ka za ba dang bud med mang ba yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma gshegs par bcom brlag gi gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas gang na ba de logs su gshegs te byon nas/ gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas byul te shing drung zhig tu rten cing nyin mo'i gnas pa'i phyir bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin bong bu yibong bu'i gzugs su byas nas 'phyan pa dang de la 2—294

khye'u dang bu mo dag zhon pa dang / des de dag rtseratubacug /dga' bar byed du bcug nas nags thibasasnyepor song nas za bar byed pas/ de'i ming gnod sbyin bong bu gnod sbyin bong bu zhes bya bar grags so/ /bcom brlag gi bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das bsod snyoms la gshegs pa las lha mo zhig gis tho btsamasalgepas/ bcom brlag tu ma gshegs par gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas su gshegs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag so so nas snod du btsos ⑦shing bsdogs te shing rtarasnyibacug nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bcom brlag gi bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis zhes bya ba nas/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzarashenas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du 'dir gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza'akhub dang bca'asheb dag gis shing rta bkang ste 'tshal te mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste de bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten 0cing gnas pa de dag thams 2—295

cad rim gro'inyeganas su sdus7shig /bsod snyoms yongs su longs spyod du gzhugashego/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas na/ dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten0cing gnas pa de dag thams cadabya/ rim gro'ikhuganas su bsogasashenas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te7phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten 0cing mchis pa de dag thams cad rim gro'i gnas su bsogs lags te/ bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rim gro'i gnas ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom brlag gi bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas zhes bya ba nas/ phyag gnyis bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir 'khod nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis klu gdug pa dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa de dang de rnams ni btul lags na/ btsun pa gnod sbyin bong bu 'di bdag cag la yun ring po7zhig nas sha khonatsom mchis par ni sha khon bgyid/ 'gran zla ma lags par ni 'gran7zla bgyid/ glags ma btsal bar5)ni glags tshol bar 2—296

bgyid de/ bus patubatsas shingakhubatsas pa rnams 'phrog par bgyid lags na/kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste gnod sbyin bong bu gdul ③bar gsol/ de'i tshe gnod sbyin bong bu 'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin bong bu la bka' stsal pa/ bong bu khyod kyis thos sam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis thos lags so/ /bong bu khyod kyis thos sam/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag gis thos lags so/ /dam pa ma yin pa'i chos sdig pa las log shig /bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gi slad du phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang rtsig par dam 'cha' bar bgyid na bdag ldog go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bcom brlag gi bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams la bka' stsal pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag khyed cag gis thos sam/ bcom ldan 'das thos lags te brtsigabago/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin bong bu 'khor lnga brgya dang btul to/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis7de'i ched du gtsugashelag khang lnga brgya brtsigs so/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin mda' can dang gnod sbyin nags ldan dang gnod sbyin mo bslang ⑩rnyed ma dang mchu rnams btul to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyis〈nyebacom brlag tu zhugs so/ /zhugs nas gnod sbyin mo 'gran zla ma 'khor lnga brgya dang btul nas de'i don du gtsug lag khang lnga brgya brtsigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bcom brlag gi nang dang phyi rol du gnod sbyin nyis stong lnga brgya btul nas de'i ched du bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis gtsug lag khang nyis stong lnga brgya brtsigs so//2—297

de nas bcom ldan 'das o ta lar gshegs te/ o ta lar7o ta la'i nags khrod na bzhugs so/ /de nakhubram ze shing snasal chen po lta bu o ta la'i bu zhes bya ba phyug pa nor mang ba longs spyod che ba zhig gnas so zhes bya ba rgyas par sbyar ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' shamasathabs mnabasalgelhung bzed dang chos ༷gos bsnams te o ta lar bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig na zhing pa lnga brgya tsam mgo bo rdul gyis yog cing sha na'i ras kyis〈smad g.yogs bgosalgenas zhing med pa las zhing pa de rnams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsaloganyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ gzi brjid kyis mdzes par mthong ngo zhes bya ba rgyas par sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams la chos bshad pas zhes bya ba nas mchod par bya ba dang rjed par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar 8bya bar gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas rmon pa stong po de dag gnya' shing dang ru thag bcad nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das yongs su bskor te 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams la tshig gsum gyi chos bshad pa dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams su skyes nas zhes bya ba nas bden pa mthong nas rang gi gnas su dong ngo zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshomanyethams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa zhing pa lnga brgya po 'di rnams kyis las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas zhing pa rnams su gyur nas dbul po'i khyim rnams su skyes shing 'di rnams ni rmon par ⑩gyur lags/ dge slong dag 'di rnams kyis las byas shing bsags pa zhes bya ba 2—298

rgyas par sbyar te/ 'di rnams yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba yin te/ 'di rnams kyis de na le los dus 'das par byas pas las de'i rnam par smin pas zhing pa rnams su gyur to/ /rmon7pa 'di rnams kyis kyang de nyid la rab tu byung nas bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo phra mo rnams la gus par ma byas pas las de'i rnam par smin pas dud 'gro rnams su skyes so/ /'di rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba gang yin pa de'i las kyisarnam par smin pas ngakhulas bden pa mthong bar byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na dugacig tu gnag ⑤pa rnams kyi zhes bya ba rgyas par sbyar ro/ /bram ze shing sā0la chen po lta bu o ta la'i bus dge sbyong shākya'i srasasheshākya'i rigs las skra dang kha spu bregs te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas dpa' sde nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang o ta lar byon nas/ o ta la na7o ta la'i nags khrod na bzhugs te/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong gi ta ma de'i dge ba dang / grags pa dang / sgra dang / tshigs su bcad pa rgyalochen po 'di lta bu 'di dag phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su grags par gyur te/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de 'jig rten lha dang bcas bdud dang bcas/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa skye dgu dge sbyong dang bram zer 2—299
