pa ni gcig tu gnagatupa yin la zhes bya ba nas brtson par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes de skad ces bka' stsal to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das chu bo gang gā rgalasab dang / de na ngang pa dang / nya dang rusasbal lnga brgyas bskor te bskor bkyibyas so/ /de rnams la bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigashegasum gyi chos bshad pa mdzad de/ bzhin bzangs dag 'di ltar 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba yin pas nga la sems mngon par dad par gyis la/ ci nas kyang dud 'gro'i skye gnas la 'dod chags dang bral bar gyis shig /de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ gang bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das las tshigashegasum gyi chos thos nas kha zas za bar byed pa ni bdag cag gi cha ma yin no snyam nas/ de rnams kyis7kha zas bcad pa dang / dud 'gro'i skyesnyiganas su song ba rnams ni me'i shas che bas dus las 'das te shi 'phos pa dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams su skyes so / /chos nyid kyis lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon par sems gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang /las gang gis yin pa'o/ /de rnams kyis bltas na dud 'gro dag las shi 'phos nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams su skyes pa dang zhes bya ba nas0/ me tog man dā ra bas7thu ba bkang ste bcom ldan 'das kyi nye 'khor dang chu bo gang hā snang bas gsal bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te6)/bcom ldan 'das la kun nas bskor te 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang rang bzhin mkhyen 2—350

nas de dang 'dra ba'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad pas zhes bya ba nas/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ de rnams kyisatubaden pa mthong ba dang / des lan gsum du ched dukhubarjod pas ched du brjod do③/ /btsun pa 'di lta bu ni bdag cag la phas ma bgyis te/ mas ma lags/ rang gi skye bo dang / gnyen gyi tshogs dang sdug pas ma lags/ rgyal pos ma lags/lha rnams kyis ma lags/ sngon gyi 'das pas ma lags/ dge sbyong dang bram zes ma lags pa gang lags pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la mdzad de/sems can dmyal ba dngasayi dgas rnams nas ni rkang pa drangs/ lha dang mi rnams su ni rab tu bkod/ 'khor ba las ni ring du mdzad/ khrag dang ma chi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams⑥/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo rnams ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i7rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bgyis te/btsun pa bdag cag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag cag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyisal/ bdag cag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i ⑩bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas sngon nya dang / ngang pa dang / runesbal byed byed pa'i lha'i bu de rnams tshong pa khe spogs rnyed pa lta bu dang zhes bya ba 2—351

nas rang gi gnas su dong ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa nya dang / ngang pa dang / ru0sbal 'di rnams kyis las ci zhig bgyis na des na ngang pa dang / nya dang / rusasbal rnams su skyes lags/ las ci zhig bgyis na des na lha rnams su skyes nas bden pa mthong bar bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngang pa dang / nya dang / rusasbal 'di dag nyid kyisakyilas rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal ①pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na duston pa 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste zhes bya ba nas/ de bā rā ṇa sri'i grong khyer nashedrang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar rten cingasabazhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i bstan pa la de rnams rab tu byung bar gyur te / de na dge slong de rnams kyis bslab pa'i gzhi༅phra mo phra mo rnams dral bas〈spelas de'i rnam par smin pas nya dang / ngang pa dang / ru sbal rnams su skyes par gyur to/ /gang yang nga la sems mngon par dad par byas pa des na lha rnams su skyes par gyur to/ /gang yang yang〈nyedag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung las tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa des na bden pa mthong bar byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na/ gcig tu gnag pa'i las rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnagasnyepa yin la zhes bya ba nas brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed cag gis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes de skad ces bka' 2—352

stsal to/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das chu bo gang gā rgal7ba dang yi dgas sdong dum tshig pa lta bu/ keng rus sgrengasab lta bu/ rang gi spas lus yog⑧pa/ lto ri sul ltar 'dug pa/ kha khab kyi mig tsam yod pa 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur pa lnga brgya tsam gyis yongs su bskor nas/de rnams kyis thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag cag yi dgas rnams ni rnam par ltung ba'i lus can rnams lags te/sngon gyi las kyi nongs pas chab kyang mi rnyed lags na 'tshalakhum mthong ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ khyod ni thugs rje chen po mnga' ba lags na bdag cag la chab stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams la chu bo gang gāshebastan nas/chu bsil skye bo kun gyis nye bar spyad bya ba/ /skal ldan shing rta klung chen 'di ni grong dgashedang / /yul 'khor dag dang grong khyer tshim par byed cing 'bab/ /zhing rnang sā lu ku mu da dang ut+pal skrun(te/ /yi dgas rnams kyis gsol pa/chu bo skye bo kun gyis nye bar spyad bgyi ba/ /skal ldan shing rta 'bab 'di bdag cag rnams la skams5)/ /'di ni khrag gi dri mas gang zhing lag pa〈nyen/ /dbyug pa dgra star bcas pa thogs pas 'di bsrungasalgemathong / /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gā'i lha la bka' stsal pa/ khyod ni grong dang yul 'khor grong khyer tshim byed cing / ci /zhing rnang sā lu ku mu da dang ut+pal skrun/ /ci phyir yi dgas skom pas rab nyen tshim mi byed/ /khyod la byis pa'i skye bo7sdug bsngal snying rje med/ /gang gā'i lhas gsol pa/ byis pa'i skye bo la bdag 'jigs pas ma lags shing / /tshig rtsub sgyus7kyang mi mthun chab gtong mi bgyid de/ /2—353

nongs bgyis sgrib pa chen pos bsgribs pa 'di dag la/ /chu bo skams7gyur 'di la bdag gis ci zhig nongs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu chen posayi dgas rnams la chu ludakhucig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas yi dgas rnams la chu blud0par brtsams pa dang / yi dgas de rnams kyi kha khab kyi0mig tsam pokyidag bskyed par ma nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis de rnams kyi kha bskyed nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos chu blud pa dang /de rnams skomasapas nyen pas mang du 'thungs pas lto rgyas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la sems dang ba ⑨bskyed nas shi'o zhes bya ba nas/bden pa mthong nas rang gi gnas su song ngo / /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa ⑪sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa yi dgas 'di rnams kyis las ci zhig bgyis na des na yi dgas rnams su skyes lags/ las ci zhig bgyis na des na lha rnams su skyes nas bden pa mthong bar bgyis lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid kyis las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ zhes bya ba nas/ de bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na 'drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar rten cing 2—354

bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i nyan thos rnams kyis dad pa las bslangs nasanyesangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la bya ba byed do/ /gang gi tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi bstan pa rgyas par ma gyur pa de'i tshe dad pa ②'dri ba'i dge slong yang nyung bar gyur to/ /gang gi tshe rgyas par gyur pa de'i tshe dad pashe'adri ba'i dge slong yang mang bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na 'dun khang zhig na dge bsnyen lnga brgya bya bsnye'aga' zhig gi phyir lhags shing 'dus par gyur pa dang / dad pakyi'adri ba'i dge slong rab tu mang po ⑦dag de rnams kyi drung du song ⑧nas sbyin du gzhug7par 'dod pa na/ de rnams kyis kun nas dkris pa drag pos ngag rtsub pa'i las phyung ba/ 'od srung gi dge sbyong 'di rnams ni yi dgas rnams su skyes pa bzhin rtag tu lag pa zedarwa)par byed do zhes smras so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ dge bsnyen lnga brgya po gang dag yin pa de dag ni yi dgas lnga brgya po 'di dag nyid yin te/ gang yang 'di rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi nyan thos rnams la yi dgas kyi tshig smras pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas tshe rabs lnga brgyar yi dgas rnams su skyes par gyur te/da lta'i bar du yang yi dgas rnams su skyes pa yin no/ /gang yang nga la sems mngon par dad par byas pa des na lha rnams su skyes so/ /gang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi blangs pa des na bden pa mthong bar byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la zhes bya ba nas brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed cag gis de lta bu la bslab 2—355

par bya'o/ /zhes de skad ces bka' stsal to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das chu bo gang gā ①las rgal ba na glang po che'i lta ②stongs kyis g.yas phyogs nas chu bo gang gā la ⑧gzigs pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du g.yas phyogs nas chu bo gang gā0la gzigs par mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed cag chu bo gang gā'i gleng gzhi 0nyan par 'dod dam/ bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa da de'i dus la bab lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chu bo gang gā'i gleng gzhi ⑦gang lags pa bshad nin dge slong rnams nyan ⑨par 'gyur lags so// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po sum bcu rtsa dgu pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba rgyal po smyug sbams 47zhes bya ba chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/de'i yul 'byor pa dang7/ rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba/ shing me tog dang 'bras bu rtag pa/lha rnams dus dus su char 'bebs pas sa gzhi lo thogatsodang ldan zhing 'thab pa dang / thabatsomo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'khrug long dang / chom rkun dang /mu ge dang / nad rnams rab tu zhi bar gyur la/ mi rnams rtag tu chos la gzhol ba na chos kyis rgyal srid byed du 'jug go/ /ji tsam na rgyal po de so ga'i7dus la bab nas shing rnams kyi me tog kha 'bus shing ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug5)dang /shang shang te'u rnams skad 'byin pa'i nags khrod du btsun mo'i 'khor gyis yongs 2—356

su bskor nas skyed mos tshal gyi gnas su song ba dang / ji tsam na mi lus gnyer mas gang ba/ mgo skya ba/ lus kyi yan lag rnyis pa/ dbang po rgyad pa①/sha skemasapa/ zho sha chung ba zhig khararnyub la brten nas gom pa dal bu dal bus 'gro ba zhig mthong ngo / /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag mi lus gnyer mas gang ba mgo skya ba zhes bya ba nas/ kharasreb la brten nas 'gro ba 'di ci zhig yin zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha de ni 'du byed rnams dengs pas rgas 'khogs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga la yang 'di lta bu'i chos 'byung bar 'gyur ram / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha chos de⑥ni thun mong lags so/ /de nas rgyal po yid mi bde zhing chas pa dang yang mi skya bo rbab rbab po/ lus gas shing hrud hrudasapo/ lto ri sul ltar 'dug pa/ rma rnag gis gang ba/ yan lag dang nying lag rnams las 'dzag pa/ lhan pa rnams kyis dkris pa zhig shugs ring po5)ring por 'byin cing khar7ba la brten nas 'theng zhing 'gro bar chas pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag mi skya bo bseng bseng7po zhes bya ba nas/ 'theng zhing 'gro bar chas pa 'di ci zhig yin zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha 'di ni nad kyis thebs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga la yang 'di lta bu'i chos 'byung chibar 'gyur ram/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha chos 'di ni thun mong lags te/ nyes par spyod pa'i las bgyis pa rnams la sngon gyi las kyi nyes pas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/rnam7pa thams cad du sdig pa mi bya'o snyam du bsams nas chas pa dang / yang 2—357

des ras sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnamasatukyis khyogasaltebargyan nas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan dang /dung dang / rnga pa ṭasaha dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang /bu mo dag bun long zhing / mi bzhis bteg0nas mgyogs0mis ni sna drangs/skyes bu lag na shing thogs pa ni phyi bzhin 'brang zhing kyi hud pha/ kyi hud sdug pa/ kyi hud spun/ kyi hud jo bo zhes kun du ngud mo'i sgra 'don pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag ras sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams kyis khyogs brgyan cing zhes bya ba nas/ ngud mo'i sgra 'don pa 'di ci zhig yin zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga la yang 'di lta bu'i chos 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha chos 'di ni thun mong lags so/ /de nas rgyal pos rgas pa dang / nad pa dang / shi ba yang dag par mthong nas yid byung ste/ bdag gis kyang 'di lta bu'i longs spyod rnams spang dgos so snyam nas slar log ste/ mya ngan gyi khang par zhugs nas 'dug go/ /de'i yul na bram ze dus dpog ces bya ba phyug pa nor mang ba longs spyod che ba zhig yod de/ des ji ltar rgyal pos rgas pa dang / nad pa dang / shi ba mthong ste yid byung nas mya ngan gyi khang par zhugs nas 'dug pa thos so/ /thos nas kyang bram ze brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing shing rta rta rgod ma dang ldan pa thams cad nas dkarasnyeba'i nang du zhugs te/ gser gyi khar7ba dang ril ba spyi blugs thogs nas rgyal po sgyug sbams gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / rgyal po la 2—358

blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bram ze dus dpog chab sgo na mchis so de nas rgyal po phyir byung nas dkor khangarkyudu 'dug pa dang / bram ze dus dpog gis rgyal ba rgyadang tshe spel ba dag byas te 'dug nas smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du thugs ngan gyi khang par zhugs te bzhugs/ rgyal pos ji ltar gyur pa thams cad bram ze dus dpog la rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa lha 'jig rten ni rang gi las kyi 'bras bu la spyod pa lags pas 'di la thugs ngan bgyir ma mchis so/ /sems can legs pa'i las bgyid pa rnams kyang mchis/ nyes pa'i las bgyid pa rnams kyang mchis/ gnyi ga'i las bgyid pa yang mchis te/ 'khor los7sgyur ba rnams ni rtag tu las legs pa bgyid de/ gum na yang lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha yang 'khor los sgyur ba lags te/ mi'i bde ba khyad par du 'phags pa bstar nas lha'i bde ba yang nyams su bstar bar 'gyur mod kyi/ lha 'on kyang mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa mchod sbyin la brtson par mdzod cig /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag yul thams cad du dril sgrogs su chug ste/ rgyal po gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byed kyisarkyukhyed shogashel longs spyod cig ces sgo shig /de nas rgyal pos sbyin pa'i khang pa rtsig 0tu bcug nas zas 'dod pa rnams la ni 8zas/ btung ba 'dod pa rnams la ni btung ba byin no/ /der 'bras khu dpo ba'i dong byas nas/ der dron po dag blugs pa dang bsil bar gyur pas ma dros pa ma dros pa zhes bya bar grags so/ /de'i 'bras khu dang 'bras bkrus pa'i khu bas lo bcu gnyis tshang bar bkang bas lud par gyur pa'i kha de nas 'bab chur bab pas 'bras khu'i chu 'bras khu'i chu7zhes bya bar grags so// //2—359

bu can/ /sasnyel stobs dang sasnyela'i stobs/ /gser bre dang ni gnas bcas dang / /thug0pa dang ni mnyan yod dang / /ma dros grong khyer bin du dang / /yangs pasacan ni tha ma yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul gzhon nu bskyed par gshegs nas gzhon nu bskyed par tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo phyogs 'dir rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags zhes bya ba btsas nas 'di nyid du chen por gyur to/ /desalgen grong khyer yang gzhon nu bskyed pa zhes bya bar7grags so/ /krung krung sgra can du gshegs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo krung krung sgra ⑨'dir rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi glang po che dam pas krung krung zhes bya ba'i skad phyung bas/ krung krung can krung krung can7zhes bya bar grags sol/ /dpung rgyan ldan du gshegs nas dpung rgyan ldan gyi phyogs zhig tu 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya ba rgyas par gong ma bzhin du'o/ /nor bu can du gshegs nas nor bu can du tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo nor bu can 'dir byang chub sems dpas nor bu mang po'i mchod sbyin byas pas nor bu can zhes bya bar grags so/ /sa la'i stobs su gshegs nas/ sa la'i stobs kyi phyogs zhig tu 'dzum pa mdzad nas zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan zhes bya ba rgyas par gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gser gyi brer gshegs nas kun dga' bo gser gyi bresnyi'adir byang chub sems dpas gser mang po mchod sbyin byas pas da dung yang 2—360

bram ze rnams gser bres 'jal zhing 'gedanyepas gser gyi bre gser gyi bre zhes bya bar grags so/ /gnas bcas su gshegs nas gnas bcas su tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gnas bcas 'dir rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags zhes bya ba 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /lo legs pa dngasnye/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba na rgyal srid byed du 'jug go / /de dus gzhan zhig na5)spyi bor sha then 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa zhig skyesasrete/ dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'amasaras bal gyi 'da' ba bzhin du cung zad kyang gnod pa skyed par mi byed dzo/ /de yongs su smin nas brtol ⑧ba las gzhon nu zhig byung na⑨/ gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa blta na sdug pa/ pags pa'i mdog gser 'dra ba zhes bya ba nas yan lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du stornya/ spyi bo skyes spyi bo skyes zhes bya bar grags so/ /rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyis gzhon nu byung ma thag tu btsun mo'i 'khor drug khri'i nang du bkril)ba dang / mthong ma thag tu btsun mo de thams cad kyi nu ma las 'o ma zags nas so so nas smras 0pa/ nga las nu/nga las nu zhes smras pas8/ nga las nu nga las nu zhes bya bar grags so/ /de la kha cig gis ni spyi bo7skyes/ kha cig gis ni nga las nu zhes bya bar shes so/ /gzhon nu nga las nu yul zhig tu song ba dang / rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags na bar gyur nas/ de rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bu'i sman gyis bkur ste byas kyang / de slar thu bar gyur nas/ des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag myur du gzhon nu la rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur bas dbang skur5nyecig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes0 blon po rnams 2—361

kyis pho nya ①btang nas rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags pa snyung ②bar gyur nas des bka' stsal pa/ gzhon nu spyan drongs la rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur7ba nyams su myong bar gyis shig ces byung gisaX/ de bas na gzhon nu myur du gshegs pa'i rigs so zhes spring ngo / /de chas pa na rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags shi'o/ /de nas yang blon po rnams kyis yang de la pho nya btang ste/ gzhon nu khyedakyikyi yab nongs kyisashegashegs te rgyal srid bzhes su gsol zhes spring ba dang / gzhon nu nga lasakunus bsams pa/ bdag gi yab ni nongs na bdag der ji ste 'gro snyam du bsams nas de nyid na 'dug pa dang / yang blon po rnams 'dus nasasheblon po'i gtso bo pho nyar btang nas de song ste smras pa/ gzhon nu gshegs la rgyal srid bzhes su gsol/ des smras pa/ gal te bdag gis chos bzhin gyis rgyal srid 'thob na 'di nyid du rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur ba 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /blon po rnams kyis spring ba/ lha rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur ba la ni mang du 'tshal7te/ rin po che'i gcal dang / seng ge'i khri dang / gdugs dang /cod pan dang / dpung rgyan gyis pho brang gi nang du rgyal srid dbang bskur 'tshal lo/ /de bas na gzhon nu 'di nyid du gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /des smras pa/ gal te bdag gis chos bzhin gyis rgyal srid 'thob par 'gyur na thams cad 'di nyid du 'ong grang / gzhon nu nga las nu'i mdun nas 'gro ba gnod sbyin lha gnas zhes bya ba des rin po che'i gcal dang / seng ge'i khri de nyid du blangs so/ /pho brang na gnas pa rnams kyis kyang gdugs dang / cod pan dang / dpung rgyan khyer te rang lhags te pho brang na gnas pa rang lhags shing rang lhags pas gnas bcas gnas bcas zhes bya bar grags so//2—362

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo mnyan yod gang na ba der 'dongatungo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar ②mnyan nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod nas7rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang /ji tsam nas phyogs shig na bram ze zhig zan ma zos par zhing med0pa na/ de'i ched du bu mo zhig thug pa khyer te 'ongs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs de nyid du gshegs so/ /de nas bram zesakyisangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/'od zer nyi ma stong bas7lhag pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu yang de bcom ldan 'das la dad pa skyes te/ ji ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba bsagasalgepa'i sems can la thog mar sangs rgyas mthong ba de ltar ni lo bcu gnyis su zhi gnas goms par byas pa la sems las su rung ba skye ba dang / bu med pa bu rnyed pa dang / dbul pos nor gyi gter mthong ba dang / rgyal srid la dga' ba rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur ba ni de lta ma yin no/ /des thug pa de khyer te myur ba myur bar bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gau ta ma 'di ni thug pa lags te/ gal te shes ldan gau ta ma bdag la thugs brtse na 'jamasalgegasol cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze de la khron pa rnying pa zhig bstan nas/ bram ze khyod kyis gal te yongs su btang na khron pa rnying pa 'dir lugs ⑩shig /des khron pa rnying pa der blugs sdo des khron pa 2—363

rnying pa7der blugs pa dang / 'di ltar yangasasangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus khron pa rnying pa de thug⑧pas gang nas rlangs pa 'thul zhing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze de bos nas bram ze thug pa brimasakyishig /des brim par brtsams pa na bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar dge 'dun thams cad kyis 'thungs kyang khron pa rnying pa de de dubazhin du thug pas gang nas rlangs pa 'thul zhing 'dug par 'gyur ba de ltar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas bram ze de lhag par yang mngon par dad par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi7zhabs la phyag byas te chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan snga na⑧'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyalashedang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang 'dra bar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa tsomadzad pas zhes bya ba nas thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bgyis te/ btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ / mngon par 'phags so/ 9zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /brdeg ni bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis8/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas bram ze de tshong pa khe spogs rnyed pa lta bu dang / zhing pa lo thoganyelegs pa lta bu dang / dpa' bo g.yul ngor rgyal ba lta bu dang / nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba lta bur gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon 2—364

par dga' ste rjes su yi rangasatunas bcom ldan 'das kyisazhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /ji tsam na zhing drung du phyin pa dang / zhing de la gser gyi nas she dgasnyeskyes par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ya mtshan skyes nas mig bgrad 0de tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/kye ma yon tan rang bzhin zhing / /nyes kun rnam par spangs pa la/ /bdag gis de ring sa bon btab/ /de ring nyid du 'bras bu thob/ /de nas bram ze de rings pa rings par rgyal po'i drung du song nas son pa dang / rgyal ba dang tshe spel ba dag byas nas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha bdag gis stsangashenas stsal ba de rnamasalgegaser she dgashetu gyur gyis de la spyan zhig bsko7tebar gsol/ rgyal pos spyan7bskos te btang ba dang / bram zes phung por byas te/ bgos pa las rgyal po'i skal ba nas tha mal par gyur nas(nye/ spyan gyis rgyal po la rig par byas pa dang / rgyal pos bsgo ba/ yang bgos shig /yang bgos pa dang /de bzhin du rgyal po'i skal ba ni nas tha mal par gyur nas/ de ltar lan bdun gyi bar du bgos na de kho na bzhin du nas su gyur pa dang / rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas de bdag nyid song ste bltas na de bzhin du gyur nas des bram ze de la smras pa/ bram ze 'di ni khyod kyi bsod nams las skyes pa yin gyisabya/ rgyal po'i skal ba thong la khyod kyis ci dpags pa de kho bo la byin cig /de nas bram ze de shin tu mgu bas ci byin pa de dag gser gyi nas she dag tu gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa dang / ji tsam na phyogs gzhan zhig na zhing pa skya bo rbab rbab po rkang pa dang lag pa7 ser ga byung ba/ sha na'i ras kyi smad g.yogs ligyon pa lnga brgya zhing rmed do / /smon pa de dag kyang lcag gzer bu 2—365

can gyis gzhus7pas/ lus smas shing rma byung bas rnag 'dzag la sngam pa 'don bzhin dusazhing rmodasado/ /zhing pa de rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/'od zer nyi ma stong bas lhag pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo zhes bya ba nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa'i sems can rnams la thog mar sangs rgyas mthong ba ni zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyang ring po kho na nas zhing pa rnams 'ong ba gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang gdul ba'i don du lam la0bzur nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas zhing pa de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zhing pa de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de zhes bya ba nas/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas teni/ de rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad cesalgegasol to/ /btsun pa legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la bdag cag rab tu 'byung ba dang / bsnyen par 2—366

rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob pa lta na/ bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs paranyespyod pa spyad par bgyi'o②/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams dge slong tshur shog ces bya bas rab tu phyungasango zhes bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams la gdams ngag byin nas de rnams kyis 'bad pa dang / brtsal ba drag po zhes bya ba nas mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to / /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /glang de dag kyang gnya' shing dang /ru thag bcad nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong7ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das la kun nas bskor tekhu'adug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams la tshig gsum gyi chos bshad pas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ ldadaper na chu bo gang gā rgal te gshegs pa na ngang pa dang / nya dang / ru sbal rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas rang gi gnas su song ba bzhin no/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa sngon zhing pa bgyid bgyid7pa'i dge slong 'di dag gis las ci zhig bgyis na/ las des7zhing par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan7pa la rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa mngon sum du bgyis lags/ sngon glang bgyid bgyid pa'i lha'i bu 'di dag gis kyang las ci zhig bgyis na/ des na glang rnams su skyes shing bden pa mthong bar bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid kyis las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /2—367

dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ ston pa 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung stenyu/ zhes bya ba nas / desa'i rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar rten cing bzhugs so/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i bstan pa la zhing pa lnga brgya po 'di rnams rab tu byung bar gyur te/ de na 'di dag gis ma bklagasalgem bton/ yid la bya ba goms par ma byas so/ /'on kyang dad pas byin pa zos shing zos nas 'du 'dzikyil chags te le los dus 'das par byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ dge slong lnga brgya po gang yin pa de ni zhing pa lnga brgya po 'di dag nyid yin no/ /gtsug lag khang gi bdag po gang yin pa de ni zhing pa 'di dag gang gi yin pa'i khyim bdag 'di nyid yin te/ gang yang 'di dag gis gtsug lag khang gi bdag po'i〈 )dad pas byin pa zos nas ma bklagasalgem bton/ yid la bya ba goms par ma byas la / 'du 'dzi la chags te/ le los dus7'das par byas pa'i las des na tshe rabs lnga brgyar gtsug lag khang gi bdag po de'i zhing pa rnams su gyur te/ da lta'i bar du yang zhing par skyes pa yin no/ /'di dag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa des na da ltar nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /sngon glang byed byed pa'i lha'i bu 'di rnams kyang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung bar gyur te/ 'di dag gis de na bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo phra mo rnams dral bas las des na glang rnams su skyes so/ /gang yang nga la sems 2—368

mngon par dad par byas pa des na lha rnams su skyes so/ /gang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung lasanyetshangs par spyod pa spyad cing bsrungs pasalged ltar lha'i bur gyur nas bden pa mthong bar byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas nasregacig tu gnag pa rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la zhes bya ba nas brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed cag gis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o zhes de skad ces bka' stsal ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo chu mangs gang na ba der 'dong ngo / /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal 0zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das chu mangs susnyigashegs pa dang /phyogs gzhan zhig na bram ze zhig zhing med do/ /de nas bram ze des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus brgyan pa zhes bya ba nas kun nasalgebazang ba mthong ngo / /zhes bya ba'i bar gong masabazhin du'o/ /des bsams pa / gal te shes ldan gi ta ma'i drung du phyag 'tshal du song na ni bdag gi las 'chor lanya/ 'on te phyag 'tshal du ma song na ni bsod nams yongs su nyams par 'gyur na/ de la gang gis na las kyang mi 'chor la bsod nams kyang yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i thabs bzang po ci yod snyam pa las de blo skyes pa/ 'di nyid na 'dug bzhin du phyag byas na de lta na las kyang mi 'chor la/bsod nams kyang yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur ro snyam nas/ des ji ltar lcag gzer bu can nyid thogs shing gnas de nyid du ⑩'dug bzhin du sangs rgyas 2—369

bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo zhes phyag byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo bram ze 'dis nyes te/ gal tetupha bi las phyogs 'di na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel gyi tshogs ma zhig par bzhugs so snyam pa de lta bu'i so so rang gis rigs ②pa'i ye shes shig yod par gyur na nga'i spyan sngar 'ongs te phyag byas pa zhig /de lta na pha bis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis la phyag byas par 'gyur ba zhig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo phyogs 'di na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrelakhugyi tshogs ma zhig pa bzhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos myur ba myur bar bla gos bzhi ltab0tu byas te bting nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs su gsol/ des nakhus phyogs 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis kyis longs spyad par 'gyur lagasashete/ gang yang yangasnyedag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang / gang yang da ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyishegadan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel gyi 0tshogs ma zhig pa rnams lta (7bar 'dod dam/ bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa da de'i dus la bab lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel gyi tshogs ma zhig pa gang dge slong rnams la bstan pa mthong lags na/ dge slong rnams sems mngon par dad 2—370

par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed panyemadzad de/ chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyisakhu 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe srog chags grog sbur rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa sems kyis shes par 'gyur bas klu rnams kyis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci zhig gi phyir 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad snyam na / bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel gyi tshogs ma zhig pa gzigs par bzhed par mthong nas / de nas de rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel gyi tshogs ma zhig par phyung ba dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rtags zung0shig nub par 'gyur ro zhes pa dang nub bo/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das kyiso yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel gyi tshogs ma zhig pa/ nyan thos rnams la bstan to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang yang ngo mtshar skyes nas btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / khrom gyi ru pa dang / grong mi dang / yul mi rnams dang / lhan cig chas so/ /de bzhin du lus 'phags po dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang / drang srong7sbyin dang / so phag mkhan rnying pa dag dang / ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga dang / srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma ngo mtshar skyes te chas so/ /kha cig sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas yang dag par bskul ba dang / ji tsam na de mi snang bar gyur to/ /de rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gisaring bsrel gyi tshogs ma zhig pa nub par gyur to zhes thos so//2—371

thos nas kyang yang de rnams kyis bdag cag 'dir lhags pa dgatuni don med par gyur to zhes sdug bsngalasnyedang / yid mi bde ba skyes so/ /dge bsnyen zhig gis sa phyogs der bskor ba byas nas sems la sems kyis 'di snyam du mngon par 'dus byas te/ bdag gis 'di la gom pasabor bas bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo'i tshogs chen po de'i 'gyod pa skyes pa bsal ba'i phyir dang / dge bsnyen de'i bsam pa yang thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni0gom 'dor na/ / 'dzam bu'i ༅chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya g.yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /dge bsnyen gzhan zhig gis yang7phyogs der 'jim pa'i gong bu gcig bzhag nas sems kyis 'di snyam du mngon par 'dus byas te/ re zhig gom pa bor ba'i bsod nams kyang de snyed du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs na/'di la 'jim pa'i gong bu bzhag pa'i bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge bsnyen de'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ gang zhig rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi / /mchod rten la ni 'jim gong 'jog byed na/ / 'dzam bu'i7chu bo'i gser gyi gong bu ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /de thos nas srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma dag gis kyang 'jim pa'i gong bu bcerarwateto/ /gzhan dag gis de la me tog sil mas gtor nas/ sems kyis 'di snyam du mngon par 'dus byas pa/ re zhiganyegom pa bor ba dang / 'jim pa'i gong bu'i bsod nams kyang de snyed du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs na/ bdag 2—372

cag gi me tog sil ma rnams la bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyam pa dang /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ gang zhig rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ /mchod rten me tog sil ma spungs pas 'thor/ / 'dzam bu'i7chu bo'i gser gyi bre bo ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /gzhan dag gis de la me tog gi phreng bas bskor ba byas nas sems kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa/ me tog sil ma rnams kyi bsod nams de snyed du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs na②/ bdag cag gis ③me tog ༷phreng bas bskor ba la bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas / /sangs rgyas mchod rten me tog phreng bskor ba/ / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi sgrom dag ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /gzhan dag gis de la mar me'i phreng ba phul nas/ sems kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa/ me tog phreng bas bskor ba'i bsod nams de snyed du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs na/ bdag cag gis me mar phul ba'i bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi bsam pa thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bsal/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten mar me 'bul byed na/ / 'dzam bu'ishechu bo'i gser srang bye ba ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /gzhan dag gis de la dri'i7chus chag chag btab nas/ sems kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa/ mar me phul〈nyeba'i bsod nams de snyed du/ bcom ldan 2—373

'das kyis gsungs na/ bdag cag gis dri'i chus chag chag btab pa'i bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyamanyepa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten dri chus 'thor byed na/ / 'dzam bu'ikhuchu bo'i gser gyi phung po ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /gzhan dag gis de la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /'phan btags nas sems kyis mngon par 'dus byas pa gom pa bor ba dang /'jim gong bzhag pa dang / me tog sil mas gtor ba dang / me tog phreng bas bskor ba dang / me mar phul ba dang / dri'ikhuchus gtor ba'i bsod nams de snyed du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs na/ bdag cag gis gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan btags pa'i bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan0'phan ni 'dogs byed na/ /gser ni ri bo lhun po dang mnyam pa/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa minaX/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i rdzogs sangs rgyasaX/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa/ /ded dpon bla na med pa la/ /yon du bshad pa de yin no/ /de rnams 'di snyam du de la re zhig bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la bya ba byas pa'i bsod nams de snyed du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs na/bzhugs pa la bsod nams ji snyed cig tu 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa rgyathugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de 2—374

gsungs pa/ 'di natusems rab dang byas nas/ /gang zhig bzhugs dang gang zhig ni/ /mya ngan 'das la mchod byed pa/ /bsod nams mnyam ste khyad par med/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad rnams kyi/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo thogs ②pa med pa skorasab bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag gi yon tan ni rtogs par mi nus so//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis duskye bo'i tshogs chen po de la gang thos na srog chags brgya dustong phrag du mas khyad par chen po thob ste0/ kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tunyesems bskyed/ kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu/ kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed/ kha cig gis ni dro bar gyur pa thob/ kha cig gis ni rtse mo/ kha cig gis ni bden pa dang mthun pa'i bzod pa dag /kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas sol/ /kha cig gis ni lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas/ 'khor de las phal cher ni sangs rgyas la gzho'akho/ chos la 'bab/ dge 'dun la bab par bkod pa de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad do/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis phyogs de nyid du dus ston btsugasalgepa dang / de nas chu mangs dus ston can chu mangs dus ston can zhes bya bar grags so//de nas bcom ldan 'das yul ko byas la nas ༷ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med 2—375

zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das ko sa la nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang mnyan yod du byon nas/ mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi bdag gi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der songatuste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad ces bya ba nas/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i⑧bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin stan las langs te zhes bya ba nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud dephubacom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas/ gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta gon byas nas/ nang par sngar langs te gdanashebating nas nor bu'i chu snod sta gon byas nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin te/ bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis dus7tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa gdugs tshod lags shing mchis na bcom ldan 'das de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/sgo srungs kyi7mi la bsgo ba/ kye nang rje re zhig sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod ma gsol gyi bar du gzhan mu stegs pa dag nang du ma 2—376

btang7zhig /de'i 'og tu mu stegs pa rnamasakhul sbyin no/ /jo bo bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes sgo srungs kyisamis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin las mnyan to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs mnabs lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun gyis bltas menas zhes bya ba nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu0bar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dgon pa'i gnas mal zhig nas skra dang kha spu ring zhing chos gos ngan pa zhig gyon te rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'ongs te/ des bltas na rgyal byed kyi tshal stong par 'dug nas des dge skosaphul dris pa/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gang du bzhud/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis spyan drangs so/ /des bsams pa/ de nyid du bsod snyoms bza' zhing sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam nas/de khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du song ba dang / sgo srungs kyis7smras pa/ 'phags pa nang du ma bzhud par gzhes shig /ci'i phyir khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi mchid nas re zhig sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod ma gsol gyi bar du gzhan mu stegs pa dag nang du ma btang zhig /de'i 'og tu mu stegs pa rnams la sbyin no zhes bsgo lags sol/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos bsams pa/ (nyebram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis bdag la dge sbyong shākya'i sras kyi yin no zhes bya bar ma shes pa de ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed kyis song la skye bo bkren pa rnams la snying 2—377

rje bya'o snyam du bsams te skyed ①mos tshal du song nas des bsams pa/ deng bdag gis su zhig rjes su gzungasnyibar bya snyam pa dang / re zhig cigasnyen grong phyi nyug ma mdzes thebs0pa lus zhigs shing lus las rnag khrag 'dzag pa zhig slong mo la rgyu zhing 'dug nas de'i drung du de song ba dang des kyang bslangs na 'bras khu zhig rnyed nas/ des tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po lus mdzes pa dang sems dang zhing spyod lam zhi bar mthong nas des bsams pa nges par bdag gis yon gnas 'di lta bu la bya ba ma byas pas des na bdag 'di lta bu'i gnas su gyur gyisabya/ gal te 'phags pa 'od srung chen pos bdag la thugs brtse ba'i phyir 'bras khu bzhes na bdag gis 'di dbul lo snyam pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos de'i bsam pa sems kyis shes nas lhung bzed bzed de0/ sring mo gal te khyod kyis btang ba yin na lhung bzed 'dir lugs shig /de nas des sems mngon par dad par byas nas lhung bzed der blugs pa dang sbrang ma zhig lhung ngo / /des de dbyung bar brtsams pa dang /'bras khu7de'i nang du sor mo gcig chad de lhung ngo / /des bsams pa/'phags pas bdag gi sems bsrung ba'i phyir ma phor zad kyi 'on kyang gsol ni mi gsol lo snyam pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos de'i bsam pa sems kyis shes nas de'i mngon sum kho nar 'bab pa'i rtsig drung zhig tu 'dug nas 'thungs pa dang / des bsams pa/ cung zad du na bdag gi⑥sems bsrung ba'i phyir gsol gyi/ 'on kyang 'dis zas kyi go chod par ni ma byas so snyam pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos de'i bsam pa sems kyis shes nas grong phyi nyug ma de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sring mo rab tu 2—378

dga' ba skyed cig dang khyod kyis byin pa'i zas 'dis kho bo nyin zhag gcig 'da' bar bya'o/ /de lhag par dga' ba skyes nas bdag gis 'phags pa 'od srung chen po la bsod snyoms bstabs na7bzhes so snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po la sems dang bsnyebaskyed nas shi bsasridaga' ldan gyi lha'i risakyisu skyes so/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis des 'bras khu zhig phul nas sems mngon par dad par byas nas shi ba ni mthong na gang du skyes pa mkhumathong nas/ des sems can dmyal bar brtag par ⑨brtsams na yang ma mthong / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang / mi dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum pa rnams su yang ma mthong ste/ 'di ltar lha rnams kyi shes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug gi gong du mi 'jug go// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bzhi bcu pa/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ 'od srung bdag nyid chen po can/ /bsod snyoms phyir ni rgyu ba nayi/ /'od srung 'bras khu phul ba yi/ /bud med de ni gar dga' lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dga' ldan zhes bya'i lha de rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad 'byor pa ste/ /'od cisang 'bras khu phul5)ba yi/ /bud med de ni de na dga'/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du cisems te/ re zhig mi 'di dag ni bsod nams mngon sum du ma mthong na yang sbyin pa dag gtong / bsod nams dag byed nas/ bdag bsod nams dag mngon sum du mthong zhing rang gi bsod nams kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa go ci'i phyir sbyin pa dag mi gtang bsod nams dag 2—379

mi bya snyam nas/ 'phags pa 'od srung chen po 'di0sdug pa dang / mgon med pa dngas/ bkren pa dang / phongs pa la thugs brtse ba yin gyisal/ ma la bdag gis 'di la bsod snyoms bstab 0par bya'o snyam du bsams nasaX/bkren pa'i srang du khyim shag0shig tu 'dug pa⑦/ lhang lhong rdol ba shin tu mi bzad pa zhig sprul nas/ bdag nyidakutha ga pa skra legs7pa/ sha na'i ras kyi smad g.yogs gyon pa/ rkang lag ser ga byung ba zhig tu sprul nas ras 'thag par brtsams so/ /lha mo bde sogs kyang tha ga pa'i chung ma'i cha byad du byas nas ras skud 'ju bar7brtsams so/ /de'i phyogs gcig tu ni lha'i zhal zas zhigatsos gon byas te bzhag pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po bkren pa dang / mgon med pa dang / phongs pa'i skye bo rnams la rjes su brtse ba'i phyir rim gyis khang pa der phyin nas 'di ni sdug bsngal ba zhig go zhes lhung bzed bzed nas sgor bsdad pa dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i zhal zas kyis bkang ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 'di snyam du 'di'i zas lha'ichabadud rtsi la khyim gyi spungs ni7'di tsam pas shin tu 'gal lo zhes bsams te⑩/ bdag gi snying la the tshom skyes payi/ 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ dgra bcom pa rnams ni ma bsams par ye shes mthong ba mi 'jug pas bsam pa la zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin yin par mthong nas des smras pa/ kau shi ka 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis khyod kyi yun ring po nas rjes su 'brel pa'i the tshom dang som nyi'i zug ju rtsa nas phyung zin na ci'i phyir skye bo sdug bsngal ba'i bar chad byed/ 'phags pa 'od srung chen po skye bo sdug 2—380

bsngal ba'i bar chadanyeci ste bgyid/ re zhig mi 'di rnams ni bsod nams dag mngon sum du ma mthong na yang sbyin pa dag gtongs/ bsod nams dag bgyid na/ bdag bsod nams dag mngon sum du mthong zhing rang gi bsod nams kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa gosaci'i phyir sbyin pa dag mi gtang / bsod nams0dag mi bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis7kyang / bsod nams dag ni bya dgos te/ /bsod nams ma byas sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /bsod nams dag ni byas pa yis/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol dga'/ /zhes ma gsungs sam/de ⑦phyin chad tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po nibasams nas khyim rnams su bsod snyoms la 'gro bar brtsams so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin nam mkha' la 'dug bzhin du lha'i zhal zas kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung gi lhung bzed 'gengs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos7lhung bzed khas bub ⑩pas bza' ba dang btung ba por yibar gyur pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir rjes su gnang gis lhung bzed kyi kha g.yogs bcang bar bya'o/ /grong phyi nyug ma che ge mo zhes bya bas 'phags pa 'od srung chen po la 'bras khu gsol nas de dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi ris su skyes so zhes kun du sgra grags so/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis grong phyi zhug ma che ge mo zhes bya bas 'phags pa 'od srung chen nyo la 'bras khu gsol nas dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris su skyes so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 2—381

'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad ces bya ba nas/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i b.ratugong ma bzhin no/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'od srung chen po'i slad du dgung bdun du bdag gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas kokhus la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis de nyid kyi nub mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag stakhugon byas nas nang par sngar langs te gdan bting nas nor bu'i chu snod bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis dus tshod gsol pa0zhes bya ba nas/ rang gi lag nas stobs shing0tshim par byed de zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /mu lto ba zhig rgan gral logs na 'dug pa rgyal po 'di bsod nams dgakhumangon sum du mthong zhing rang gi⑧bsod nams kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa yin pas bsod nams dag gis ngoms mi shes par sbyin pa dag gtong bsod nams dag byed do zhes sems mngon par dad par gyur to/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 2—382

sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la rnam ①grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' bsherang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rgyal po chen po su'i ming nas brjod de yon bsngo bsnyebya/ ci0khyod kyi'am/'on te khyod bas bsod nams ches mang du bskyed pa gang yin pa zhig gi/ rgyal pos bsams pa bdag gi bsod snyoms bcom ldan 'das kyis yongs su longs spyad pas bdag bas bsod nams ches mang du bskyed pa gzhan lta su yod snyam du bsams nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag bas bsod nams ches mang du bskyed pa gang lags pa de'i ming nas brjod cing bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bsngo ba mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mu lto ba de'i ming nas brjod cing yon bsngo ba mdzad do/ /de bzhin du nyi ma drug gi bar du mdzad pa dang / nyi ma drug pa la rgyal po lag pa la 'gram pa gtadakyinas/ bcom ldan 'das ni bdag gi bsod snyoms longs spyad cing yon bsngo ba ni mu lto ba'i ming nas brjod nas mdzad do snyam ste sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa de blon po rnams kyis mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du phyag la zhal gtad de thugs mi dgyes shing bzhugs/ rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag da niltar bcom ldan 'das ni nga'i bsod snyoms yongs su longs spyad ⑨na yon bshad pa ni mu lto ba'i ming nas brjod cing mdzad na/ ci ste sems khong du chud cing mi 'dug /de nas blon po7rgan po zhig gis smras pa/ lha thugs khral chung 2—383

ngur bzhugs shig dang bdag gis sang ci nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis lha kho na'i mtshan nas brjod de yon bsngo ba mdzad pa ①de ltar bgyi'o/ /des zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la bsgosab/ khyedasakyis sang kha zas ches bsod pa dang rab tu mang po sta gon gyis la brim pa yang 'di ltar ci nas kyang phyed ni dge slong rnams kyi lhung bzed kyi nang du 'gro la/ phyed ni sa la 'bosabar gyis shig /de dag gis phyi de nyin kha zas ches bsod pa dang / ches rab tu mang ba bshams te/de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun legs par ༷bzhugs par rig nas brim par brtsams te/ phyed ni dge slong rnams kyi7lhung bzed du blugs / phyed ni sa la pho'o/ /de nas mu lto bas sa la pho ba rnams bsdu ba'i ⑧phyir brgyugs7pa dang de phyag tshang 'brim pa dag gis slar bskrad do/ /de nas mu lto ba des smras pa/ gal te rgyal po 'di la nor rdzas rab tu mang po yod na bdag cag lta bu sdug bsngal ba slong ba gang yin pa de dag la ci'i phyir mi sbyin / kha zas 'di bor ba ci phan zhes mu lto ba de sems 'khrugs pas sngon gyi ji lta ba de ltar sems dad par bya ma nus so/ /de nas rgyal pos sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun de rnams gdugs tshod gsol zin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi ming nas smos te yon bsngo ba ni mi mdzad do snyam du bsamasalgenas yon bsngo balgem mnyan pa kho nar khyim du song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ko tsos la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi ming nas smos te yon bsngos pasnyi'adi skad du mdzad de/ glang po rta dang shing rta dpung bu chung / /zhon nas grong khyer yul bcas 'khol byed pa/ /zan dron lan tshwa dag gis ma btab cing / /snum bag med pa'i mthu ni yin par ltos/ /de nas bcom ldan 2—384

'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi pho brang du gdugs tshod lan mang du gsol nas ming nas brjod de yon bsngo ba mdzad na/ 'di lta bu'i yon bsngo0ba mdzad pa ni bdag gis sngon chad ni lan 'ga' yang ma thos lags so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi nas kyisadar thug lan tshwas ma btab pa laltebartsams te las kyi rgyu ba khyod nyan par 'dod dam/ bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa da de'i dus la bab lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi nas kyi dar thugakyilan tshwas ma stsal ba las brtsams te las kyi rgyu ba bshad pa bcom ldan 'das las dgi⑧slong rnams kyis thos nasakyi'adzin par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'orashezhig na khyim bdag cig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa blta na sdug pa zhes bya ba nas bskyed bsrings te de chen por gyur cito zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin noni/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo bdag cag gi bu lon ded7pa dang / nor 'phrog pa skyes kyis bdag zong thogs te yul gzhan du 'gro'o/ /desarwanyesmras pa/ rje'i sras de bzhin mdzod cig /des zong thogs te yul gzhan zhig tu song ba las de de nyid du ma stes te7shi bar gyur to/ /de ched0po mi bdog pa zhig pas de'i 2—385

khyim gyi nor rnams zad pas de'i bu yang sdug bsngalatubar gyur pa dang / khyim bdag de'i sten⑧grogs shig yod pa des de la smras pa/ khye'usakho bo'i zhing las dag byos shig dang ngas khyod kyi zan sbyar bar bya'o/ /des de'i zhing las dag bya bar brtsams nas des kyang de'i zan sbyar to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na dus ston la babakyinas khye'u de'i mas bsams pa/ deng ni khyim bdag gi chung ma mdza' bshes dang gnyen dang nye du dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze'i skye bo rnams zan sbyin pas brel bar 'gyur gyis/ snga 'tshogs su song la khye'u de'i zan bskyal lo snyam nas/ de snga 'tshogs su song nas khyim bdag gi chung ma la don de dag go bar byas pa dang de khros nas smras pa/ re zhig dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang / nye du rnams kyang da dung ma byin par mngag gzhugashepa khye'u lasasbyin nam/ re zhig de ring ni sdod cig /sang nyis 'gyur du sbyin no/ /de nas khye'u de'i mas bsams pa/ khye'u bkres par ma gyur grang snyam nas bdag nyid kyi nas kyi zan dron lan tshwas ma btab pa 'di bskyal7lo snyam rmatsho/ /des de khyer nas zhing thog tu song ba dang khye'u des de (7rgyang mi ring ba zhig nas mthong nas des smras pa/ yum zhim po cung zad ma mchis sam/ des smras pa/bu de ring ni zan nar ma gang yin pa7nyid kyang med do/ /yum ci ste lags/des bu la khyim bdag gi chung ma ji skad du zer ba de dag thams cad rgyas par bsnyad nas zan dron lan tshwas ma btab pa 'di yang kho mo nyid kyis khyer te 'ongs kyis8/ bu 'di zo shig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa/ zhog la bzhud cig/des bzhag ste song ngo / /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman zhing ngan pa la snying brtse ba can/ bas mtha'i gnas mal 2—386

la dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu dag 'byung bar 'gyur bsarkyuji tsam na rang sangs rgyas shig phyogs der phyin pa dang / des de lus mdzes pa dang / sems dang ba dang / spyod lam zhi bar mthong nas des bsams pa/gdon mi za bar bdag gis yon gnas yang dag pa 'di lta bu la bya ba ma byas pa des na bdag 'di 'dra ba'i⑧gnas skabs su gyur gyis③/ gal te bdag las zan dron lan tshwas ma btab pa 'di bzhes na bdag gis de la dbul bar bya'o snyam pa dang / de nas rang sangs rgyas des skyes bu bkren pa de'i bsam pa sems kyis shes nas lhung bzed bzed de/ bzhin bzangasalgegal te khyod kyis btang ba yin na lhung bzed 'dir chug shig /de nas des dad pa7drag pos zan dron lan tshwas ma btab pa rang sangs rgyas de la phul lo/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khye'u bkren pa gang yin pa de ni ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di nyid yin te/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'dis rang sangs rgyas la zan dron lan tshwas ma btab pa phul ba gang yin pa'i las des na lan drugashesum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byas so/ /mnyan yod 'di nyid du yang lan drug rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur to/ /las kyi lhag ma de nyid kyis da ltar yang rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur te/ ngas 'di'i zan dron gyi rnam par smin pa rdzogs pa de la dgongs nas/ glang po rta dang shing rta dpung bu chung / /zhon nas grong khyer yul bcas 'khol byed pa/ /zan dron lan 'o⑧dag gis ma btabashecing / /snum bag med pa'i mthu ni yin par ltos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi zan dron lan tshwas ma btab pa las 2—387

brtsams nas las kyi rgyu ba bshad do zhes kun du sgra grags pa ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis thos nas/ de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der songanyeste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gsal rgyal la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis zhes bya ba nas/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ⑧logs su thal mo sbyar ba bcud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la bdag dgung zla ba dugasum du na bza' 0chos gos dang bsod snyoms dang / snyun gsos kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams 'bul zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis zla ba gsum du zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa gsol nas dge slong re re la yang 'bum ri ba'i gos re re bskon te/'bru mar gyi bum pa bye ba bsogasakyinas mar me'i phreng ba bltam par brtsams so//de na gdugs tshod kyi kha dang / mchod pa'i tshe ca co'i sgra chen po gragashepa dang /ci tsam na grong nyug ma shin tu sdug bsngal ⑧ba zhig rdza'i chag dum zhig thogs te slong ba la zhugs pa des sgra chen po dang sgra mthon po thos so/ /thos nas kyang dris pa/ shes ldan dag sgra mthon po dang sgra chen po 'di ci zhig yin/ gzhan 2—388

dag gis smras pa/ ko7sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la zla ba gsum du gdugs tshod gsol nas dge slong re re la yang 'bum ri ba'i gos re re bskon te/ 'bru mar gyi bum pa bye ba bsogasalgete mar me'i phreng ba gtong bar rtsomasapa yin no/ /de nas grong zhug ma de 'di snyam du sems te/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di bsod nams kyisakyingoms mi shes nas da dung yang sbyin pa dag gtong bsod nams dag byed na/ ma la bdag gis kyang 'ga' zhig las bslangs la bcom ldan 'das la me mar zhig bltam mo snyam nas/ des bslangs pa'i 'bru mar nyung zad snod gyo ral gyi nang du blugs te bcom ldan 'das kyi 'chag sa'i slad du mar me bltam nas/ zhabs gnyis la gtugs te smon lam btab0pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis ji ltar ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'di skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na 'jig rten du byung ba de bzhin du bdag kyang skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na ston pa shākya thub pa zhes bya ba kho nar 'gyur zhing / yang ji ltar 'di'i zung mchog dang zung bzang po shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang / nye gnas dge slong kun dga' bo dang / yab zas gtsang dang / yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang /sras gzhon nu sgra can zin bzang po dang / grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi lags pa de bzhin du bdag gi yang ③zung mchog dang zung bzang po shā ri'i bu dang /mod gal gyi bu dang / nye gnas dge slong kun dga' bo dang / yab zas gtsang dang / yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang / sras gzhon nu sgra can7rin bzang po dang / grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir 'gyur zhing ji ltar yang bcom ldan 'das 'di sku gdung gses nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de bzhin du 2—389

bdag kyang sku gdung gses nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /ji tsam na mar me de dag thams cad ni shi'o/ /des btang ba'i mar me ni 'bar zhing 'dug go/ /chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ji srid nang du yang dag ma bzhag pa de srid du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi nye gnas rnams nang du yang dag mi 'jog pas ①tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bsams pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'od la mnal bar mdzad pa de niphuganas ma yin zhing go skabs med pas ma la bdag gis mar me de gsad par bya'o snyam nas des lag pas gsad ⑧par brtsams pa las ma nus so/ /de nas chos gos kyi gasridang / de nas bsil yab kyis g.yabs na 'on kyang gsad par ma nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di ci byed/ des gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bdag gi glo ba la bsams pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'od la mnal bar mdzad pa ni gnas ma mchis shing go skabs ma mchis kyis⑥/ ma la bdag gis zhugs mar dgum mo snyam nas bdag gis de sug pas dgum par brtsams na rngo ma thog gos/ /de nas chos gos kyi grwa dang / de nas bsil yabashekyis g.yabs na 'on kyang rngo ma thog lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dub par ma byed cig /gal te rnam par 'thor 6)rlung langs na des kyang gsad par mi nus na lag pa dang /chos gos kyi grwa dang / bsil yab 8kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'di ltar mar me 'di ni bu mo 'dis sems kyis mngon par 'du byed pa chen pos bus pa yin no/ /gzhan yang kun dga' bo bu mo 'di ni skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya 2—390

thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur zhing de'i zung mchog dang zung bzang po shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang / nye gnas dge slong kun dga' bo dang /yab zas gtsang dang / yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang / sras gzhon nu sgra canatuzin bzang po dang grong khyer ser skya'i gzhisazhes bya bar 'gyur la/ de sku gdung gses nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /grong nyug ma che ge mo zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das kyisa'achag sa'i slad du mar me btang bas de bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to zhes kun du sgra grags pa bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis thos nas/ de'i ma 'ongs pa'i yon tan la bsams nas yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs so/ /de nas kosas la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis thos nas de nas ngo mtshar skyes te/ 'bru mar bum pa stong bsdogs nas mar me sna tshogs su zangs te rin po che sna bzhi'i mar me 'chag sa'i slad du bus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gis 'phags pa 'od srung chen po mchod pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das dgung bdun gyi bar du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ༷bdag gi sngon gyi 'tshal ⑦ma dron po lan nitshwas ma stsal ba las brtsams te las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan nas/ yang bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi7dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu bdag gis dgung zla gsum du gdugs tshod gsol nas dge slong re re la yang 'bum ri ba'i gos phrugs re bskon te/ 'bru mar bum pa bye ba bsdogs te phreng bar sbrengs nas zhugs mar bltam lags na/2—391

bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ma bstan lags na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi gtso bo 'dren par 'gyur bar⑥lta na/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan na legs lags7so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni zab pa/ zab par snang ba/ mthong bar dka' ba/ rtagasalgepar dka' ba/brtag par bya ba ma yin pa/ rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa/ zhib mo brtagasasrepa'i rtogs pa dang / mkhas pa dang mdzangs pas ༷rig par bya ba yin te/de ni khyed kyi sbyin pa lan gcig byas pas thob par sla ba ma yin te/ sbyin pa lan brgyas ma yin/ sbyin pa lan stong gis ma yin/ sbyin pa lan brgya phrag stong gis ma yin no/ /'on kyang rgyal po chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod na sbyin pa dag kyang sbyin/ bsod nams dag kyang bya zhing dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par bya/ bsnyen par bya/ bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po khyodasakyis de bzhin du sbyin pa dag ni btang /bsod nams dag ni byas shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten⑨/ bsnyen bsnyen bkur byas na de lta na khyod nam zhig na 'jig rten gyi gtso bo 'dren par 'gyur grang / de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal mchi ma blags te ngus so/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis gos kyi mtha' mas mchi ma phyis nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba na sbyin pa ni ⑩ci snyed cig stsal/ bsod nams ni ji snyed 2—392

cig bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po re zhig 'das pa'i bskalanyepa gzhan rnams lta zhog gi/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid rgyal nga bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer bas rnam grangs du mar sbyin pa btang ba dang / bsod nams byas pa de dag legs par rab tu nyon la zungasashig dang bshad do// //bar sdom la/ nga las nu dang legs mthong che/ /dus dpog ku sha gdol pa dang / /lha chen po dang mu khyud rgyal/ /me long gdong dang nor bzangs dang / /thams cad sgrol dang 'dum byed do/ /rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo dpag tu med pa na rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags zhes bya ba byung bar gyur te/ de'i spyi bor sha rmen 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa zhig skyes pa dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ ras bal gyi 'da' ba lta bur gnod pa cung zad kyang mi skyed do/ /de yongs su smin nas rdol ba las gzhon nu gzugs bzang po mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ pags pa'i mdog gser 'dra ba/mgo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ lag pa ring ba/ dpral0ba'i dbyis che ba/smin ma 'jar ba/ sna'i gzangs mtho ba/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa'i lus dang ldan pa zhig byung ngo / /byung ma thag tu btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du bkri ba dang / rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi btsun mo brgyad khris gzhon nu mthong nas nu ma rnams las 'o mnyezags pa dang / bud med re res kyang nga las nu nga las nu zhes smras pas de'i ming nga las nu nga las nu zhes bya bar gyur 2—393

to / /gzhan dag na re 'di spyi7bo las skyes pas de'i phyir gzhon nu'i ming spyi bo skyes zhes bya'o zhes zer to/ /de na kha cig gis ni nga las nu zhes bya bar shes so//kha cig gis ni spyi bo skyes zhes bya bar shes so/ /gzhon nu nga las nu gzhon nu'i rtsed mos rtse ba la brgya byin drug shi 'phos pa lon no/ /rgyal tshabasnyel gnas pa la brgyasabyin drug shi 'phos pa lon no/ /gzhon nu nga las nu yul zhig tu song ste / de yul du phyin pa dang rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags na bar gyur nas de rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman gyis snyen bkur byas na yang phyir thu ba kho nar gyur nas des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/shes ldan dag myur du gzhon nu la rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur bas dbang bskurakyicig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes blon po rnams kyis pho nya bkug ste rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags bsnyungakunas/ des gzhon nu spyan drongs la rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur ba nyams su myong bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal gyisaX/ gzhon nu myur du byon pa'i rigs so zhes spring ngo / /de chas pa dang rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags shi'o/ /de nas blon po dag gis yang pho nya gzhan zhig gtong〈ba la gzhon nu khyod kyi yab ni nongs kyisal/ tshur spyon rgyal srid bzhes shig ces spring ngo ske/ /gzhon nu nga las nus bsams pa/ gal te bdag gi yab nongs na/der song yang ci phan snyam du bsams nas de nyid na 'dug go/ /blon po rnams yang 'dus nas blon po zhig pho nyar btang ba dang der ()song nas smras pa/gzhon nu rgyal srid bzhes shig /des smras pazha gal te kho bos chos dang mthun pas7rgyal srid 'thob par 'gyur na rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur5)ba 'di nyid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /blon po rnams kyis spring ba/ lha rgyal srid kyi 2—394

dbang bskur ba la ni mang du 'tshal te/ rin po che'i gcal dang / seng ge'i khri dang / gdugs dang / cod pan dang / dpung rgyananyegyis pho brang gi nang du rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur bar bgyi 'tshal bas de lta bas na gzhon nu 'di nyid du byon pa'i rigs so/ /des smras pa/ ngas chos dang mthun par rgyal srid 'thob pa lta na thams cad 'di nyid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu nga las nu'i mdun nas 'gro ba gnod sbyin lha gnas zhes bya ba des rin po che'i gcal dang / seng ge'i khri de nyid du blangs so/ /pho brang na⑧gnas pa rnams kyis kyang gdugs dang / cod pan dang / dpungasargyan khyer nas rang de nyid du lhags te/ pho brang 'khor ba rang lhags pas gnas de'i ming gnas bcas gnas bcas zhes bya bar grags so/ /phyis blon po de rnams dang /khrom gyi ru pa dang / grong mi dang / yul mi rnams kyis ni dbang bskur ba khyer te dong sgronas de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha dbang bskur ba bzhes su gsol/des smras pa/ nga mi rnams kyis cod pan bcing ngam/ gal te chos kyi rgyal srid 'thobashen mi ma yin pa rnams kyis cod pan 'ching grang / ji tsam na de mi ma yin pa rnams kyis cod pan bcings pa dang / de'i rin po che sna bdun byung ba 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa blon po rin po che nyid do/ /de la bu dpa' ba rtulasaphod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms par byed pa stong yang tshang bar byung ngo / /yangs pa can gyi nyenashekor na nags tshal stug7 po dganyedaga' dga' ltar 'dug pa zhig yod pa de na drang 2—395

srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa lnga brgya bsam gtan byed do/ /nags tshal stug po de na yang bya garaturab tu mang po dag cig kyang gnas so/ /bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra yin pas bya garasarnams lding zhing skad 'byin par byed pa dang / de nas〈drang srong rang0bzhin ngan zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de 'khrugs nas des bya gar0rnams la 'dab gshogashernams lhags par shog shigasheces dmod pa bor ro/ /de rnams drang srong 'khrugs pas 'dab gshog ⑨rnams lhags par gyur to/ /de nas de rnams rkang pas 'gro bar brtsams pa dang /rgyal po de yang ljongs rgyuranyesong bas bya gar7rnams rkang pas 'gro ba mthong ngo //de nas des blon po rnams la dris pa ci'i phyir bya gar 'di rnams rkang pas 'gro bar gyuratso/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra lags pas drang srong 'khrugs pa dag gis 'di rnams la dmod pa bor ba dang /de nas drang srong 'khrugs pas 'di rnams kyi 'dabasnyigashog rnams lhagasalgepar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal pos smras pa/ gang dag sems can rnams la snying brtse ba med pa'i drang srong 'di lta bu yang yod pa lta zhes smras nas/ shes ldan dag deng tsol drang srong rnams la khyed cag nga'i yul na ma 'dug shig ces sgo yishig ces smras so/ /de nas blon po rnams0drang srong gi thad du dong nas bsgo ba/rgyal po'i zhal nas khyed cag nga'i yul na ma 'dug shig ces bka' stsal to/ /drang srong rnams kyis bsams pa/ rgyal po 'di ni gling bzhi la dbang ba yin pas ri rab kyi bang nyerim du 'gro'o snyam nas/ de rnams der dong ste gnas so/ /rgyal po nga las nu'i mi rnams ni sems par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / nye bar rtog par byed pa yin te/ de dag gis bsams shing nye bar 2—396

brtags nas bzo'i gnas dang las kyi7gnas thashedad pa rnams bya bar brtson pas de rnams7sems par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / nye bar rtog ①par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ming shed las skyes shed las skyes zhes bya bar grags so/ /de rnams kyis zhingakyilas dag bya bar brtsams pa dang / rgyal po ljongs rgyur song bas mi de rnams zhing las dag byed par mthong nas des blon po rnams la smras pa/ mi 'di rnams ci zhig byed/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha sman du 'gyur bar bgyi ba'i slad du lo thog la sogs pa skrun pa lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ ci bdag gi0rgyal srid kyi mi rnams zhing las byed dam/ de nas des smras pa/ lhas sa bon gyi rigs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi char phob shig ces byas pa dang / rgyal po nga las nus sems bskyed ma thag tu lhas sa bon gyi rigs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi char phab bo/ /rgyal po nga las nus yul mi rnams la dris pa/'di dag su'i bsod nams kyis byung / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'i yang lags/ bdag cag gi yang lags so/ /yang mi de rnams ras bal gyisnyizhing rmo bar brtsams pa dang / yang rgyal po nga las nu ljongs rgyur song bas mthong nas/des7blon po rnams la smras pa/ mi 'di rnams ci zhig byed/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mi 'di rnams ni ras bal gyi zhing med lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ ci zhig tu dgos/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gos bgyi ba'i slad du'o/ /de nas rgyal po nga cilas nus smras pa/ ci nga'i rgyal srid kyi mi rnams ras bal gyi zhing med dam/ lhas ras bal kho na'i char phob cig ces byas pa dang / rgyal po nga las nus sems bskyed ma thag tu lhas ras bal kho na'i char phab bo/ /rgyal pos yul mi rnams la dris pa/ 'di dag su'i bsod nams 2—397

kyis byung / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'i yang lags/ bdag cag gi yang lags so/ /yang mi de rnams ras bal de rnams 'khal bar brtsams pa dngatu/rgyal pos smras pa/ mi 'di dag ci zhig byed/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha skud pa 'tshal ba'i slad du ras bal de 'khal lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ci nga'i rgyal srid kyi mi rnams ras skud 'khalashelam/ lhas ras skud kyi char khosan phobasashig ces byas pa dang / rgyal po nga las nus sems bskyed ma thag tu lhas ras skud kho na'i char phab bo/ /rgyal po des smras pa/ 'di dag su'i bsod nam sa kyis byung / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'i yang lags/ bdag cag gi yang lags so/ /de nas rim gyis ras 'thag par brtsams pa dang /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'di dag ci zhig byed/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gos su bgyi ba'i slad du ras 'thag lags so/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ da7ci nga'i rgyal srid kyi mi rnams ras 'thag gam snyam nas/ lhas ras nyid kyi char phob shig ces byas pa dang / rgyal po nga lasashenus sems bskyed ma thag tu lhas ras nyid kyi char phabashebo/ /rgyal pos dris pa 'di dag su'i bsod nams kyis byung /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'i yang lags/ bdag cag gi yang lags so/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ mi 'di rnams ni bdag gi bsod nams dag gi mthu rab tu mi shes te/ bdag la 'dzam bu'i gling 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang /bde ba dang / lo legs pa(7/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba yang yod/bdag la rin po che sna bdun 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / btsun mo rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa blon po rin po che 2—398

yang yod/ bdag la bu dpa' ba rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms par byed pa stong yang tshang bar yod kyis①te/ kye ma bdag gi⑧lo brang gi nang du rin po che'i char 'bab cing de las phyi rol du ni kār ṣā pa ṇa ge'aga' yang mi 'bab par gyur cig snyam pa dang rjo/rgyal po nga las nus sems bskyed ma thag tu pho brang gi nang du zhag bdun du rin po che'i char bab laX/ phyi rol du ni kār ṣā pa ṇa0'ga' yang ma bab ste/ ji ltar mthu chen po/ rdzu 'phrul chen po bsod nams byas pa/ dge ba byas pa rang gi bsod nams kyi 'bras bu so sor nyams su myong ba bzhin no/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'di dag su'i bsod nams kyis byung / de rnams kyis smras pa/lha'i lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed kyis nyes te/ gal te khyed kyis lha'i bsod nams kyis lags so zhes smras4 pa dang / ngas 'dzam bu'i gling mtha' dag tu rin po che'i char phabasnyepar 'gyur ba zhig /'on kyang khyedashelas rin po che su 'dod pa des rin po che ci 'dod pa dag long shig /de nas rgyal po nga las nu de rgyal srid chen po'i dbang byed du 'jug pa la brgya byin drug shi 'phos pa lon no/ /nga las nu'i mdun nas 'gro ba gnod sbyin lha gnas zhes bya ba de la rgyal pos smras pa/ gang ngas bka' stsal dgos pa bka' 'og tu ma chud pa'i gling gzhan 'ga' lta yod dam/ lha gnas kyis smras pa/ lha shar gyi lus 'phags zhes bgyi ba'i gling 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba mchis kyis(te/ lha der gshegs te bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas rgyal po nga las nu 'di snyam du sems te/bdag la 'dzam bu'i gling 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo — 2—399
