nu nor bzangs skyes ri 'or ①de phab nas skyes khyer te glang po'i grong khyer du 'ongs so zhes rgyal pos thos nas mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /de nas gzhon nu ngal sos nas pa'i drung du song ste phyag byas nas mdun du 'dug pa dang / rgyal pos mchog tu dga' bar 'gyur ba'i gtam byas nas smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod bde bar 'ongasarkyusam/ lha khyod kyi bka' drin gyis ri 'orasnyeb phab ste gte'u bzung / sna bo bskos lags te/ dpya dang skyes kyang 'di dag lags kyisakyiphyag mdzod du gzhug tu gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu legs par byas kyisakyibazhes so/ /de nas gzhon nus pha la phyag byas nas chas pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu skyes la lhan cig kho nar longs spyad kyis 'dug shig /lha bdag gis yid 'phrog ma ma mthong nas yun ring zhig lags pas mchikhulags sol/ /gzhon nu deng 'gro ba sholasal sang song shig /de gal gyis 'chu zhing 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab nges par deng nyid bdag mchi lags so/ /rgyal po cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas gzhon nu rang gi khyim du song na btsun mo'i pho brang gi sgo dpal gyis stong par mthong nas de sems khong du chud bzhin du zhugs na⑩/ yid 'phrog ma ma mthong nas snying stor te phan tshun du rgyu zhing yid 'phrog ma yid 'phrog ma zhes sgra phyung ngo / /ji tsamanyen btsun mo rnams tshogs nas btsun mo de rnams kyisalgegatam rlung la bskur ba dang / de'i snying la zug rngus zug pas yang nas yang du dris pa lasatso/ de rnams kyis ji ltare gyur pa smras so/ /de mya ngan gyis yid blong bar gyur to/ /bud med de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha btsun mo'i 'khor 'di na de bas bud med shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa dag mchis na ci'i slad du thugs ngan mdzad/ des pha snying rje med 2—498

cing byas pa chud gson ①pa thos nas ma'i drung du song ste rkang pakhul gtugasasnyenas smras pa/ yum/ yid bzhin yon tan ldan gyur cing / /gzugs mdzes phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /yid 'phrog ma ni mi gda' na/ /bdag gi0yid 'phrogasnyigang du mchis/ /yid kyis rab tu brgyuganyesnyam na'ang / /bdag gi yid ni kun tu rmongs/ /de dang bral bar gyur pa yis/ /snying ni shin tu gdungs pa nyid/ /bdag gi yid du mchi7zhing yid 'phrog la/ /yid du 'thad cing yid la dga' ba yi/ /yid 'phrog dang bral bdag lus gdungs pa yi/ /bdag gi sdug bsngal7'di ni gang nas mchis/ /des smras pa/ bu yid 'phrog ma sdug bsngal mi bzad pa nyam nga bar gyur nas kho mosatshwa) btang ngo / /yum ji ltar gyur/ des ji ltar gyur pa thams cad rgyas par smras pa dang / des pha snying rje med cing byas pa mi gzo ba yin no zhes smras nas yang smras pa/ yum gang du mchis/ shul ni gang nas/ des smras pa/ gang du yid 'phrog song ba yi/ /lam de ri dang drang srong dang / /seng ge dag gis rtag bstenanecing / /chos kyi rgyal po gnas pa yin/ /de yid 'phrog ma dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal 8gyis mi bzad ⑩par nyam thag cing snying rje rje skad du bla yizhing smre sngags 'don pa/ yid bzhin yon tan ldan gyur pa'i/ /yid 'phrog ma ni mi gda'5nyen/ /zhes bya ba nas bdag gi sdug bsngal 'di ni gang nas 'ongs zhes bya ba'i sprebar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas mas smras pa/ bu btsun mo'i 'khor 'di na de bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i bud med dag yod na ci'i phyir mya ngan byed/gzhon nus smras pa/ yum de ma rnyed par bdag dga' bar ga la 'gyur/des de ()dbugs phyung yang 'on kyang mya ngan gyis gdungs nas de'i khungs tshol 2—499

zhing phan tshun du btsal bar brtsams te de'i blo skyes pa/ gang kho na las thob pa de nyid la re zhig dri'o snyam nas/ des rngon pa spang leb can gyi drung du song ste dris pa/ khyod kyis yid 'phrog ma gang nas rnyed/ des smras pa/ ri bo che ge mo'i ngos la drang srong zhig gnas te/ de'i bste gnas na tshangs pa 'du ba zhes bgyi ba'i rdzing mchis te/ der khrus la zhugs pa las drang srong gis bstan nas rnyed do/ /des bsams pa/ da7ni drang srong gi drung du song dang de las khungs phyin par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /rgyal pos gzhon nu yid 'phrog ma dang bral bas shin tu yid blong ba'i gtam de thos so/ /de nas rgyal pos smras pa/gzhon nu khyod yid blong du ci yod/ da ni de bas khyad paraku'aphags pa'i chung ma sbyin no/ /des smras pa/ yab bdag ni de ma lags pa'i mchis 'brang7gi 'khor dang mchis par rngo mi thog lags so/ /rgyal pos de la lan du ma smras kyang ma zlogs sonya/ /de nas rgyal pos grong khyer gyi sgo dang ra ba'i khar ci nas kyang gzhon nu phyir mi 'chor bar bya ba'i phyir skyes bu srung ma dag bkod do/ /de nas gzhon nu ni mtshan thog thag mi nyal bar gyur to/ /lnga po 'di dag ni mtshan mo cung zad nyal gyi pal cher mi nyal te/ lnga gang zhe na/ skyes pa budakyimed la chags pas sems bcings pa dang / bud med skyes pa la chags pa dang /srog chags ngur pa dang / chom rkun⑧pa'i ra bgo7dang / dge slong brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gzhon nu 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te bdag sgo nas song na rgyal po'i sgo srungs kyi srung ma gtum po dag yod de/ de rnams kyis bdag chad pasalgegacod pa'am/ srog dang bral bar byed par 'gyur gyis(nye/ ci nas kyang ma la bdag srung ma med 2—500

pa'i lam nas 'gro'o snyam nas/ de mtshan mo langs te ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng bas mgo bo bcings pa'i phreng ba rgyal mtshan la btagasatunas gang na srungakhuma'i mi med pa de nas babasalgepa na zla ba shar to/ /de nas des zla ba la bltasakyinas yid 'phrog ma dang bral ba'i smre sngags 'di lta 0bu dag 'don par byed de/zla nya0rgyu skar rgyal po mtshan mo gsal byed kyi⑦/ /khyod ni snar ma'i mig tu sdug pa ded dpon bzang / / ci gasnyebadag gi sdug pa ut+pal lta bu'i mig /yid 'phrog ces bgyi khyod kyis sa stengasalgegazigs lags sam/ /zhes smras nas/sngon gyi dga' ba nyams su myong ba dran zhing song ba las ri dgas mo zhig mthong nas de la yang smras pa/ kye ma ri dgas mo khyod rtswa chu lo ma za/ /khyod ni legs gyur bder spyod bdag ni rngon pa min/ /ri dwags5)mo ltar mig dkyusanyering bas gzugs bzang ba/ /bdag gi yid 'phrog ces bya khyod kyis mthong gyur tam / /de⑥de nas song ste phyogs gzhan zhig tu phyin pa dang / tshal me tog dang 'bras bus byamadzes par byas pa'i snying po la bung ba dag longs spyod pa mthong nas de nas bung ba zhig la smras pa/ sbrang rtsi'i bung ba ri bo mthon ting lta bu'i mchog /sgyug ma'i sbubs dang pad ma dag la gnas 'cha' ba/ /skra yi tshogs ring kha dog gung ba ltar gnag pa/ /bdag gi yid 'phrog ces bya khyod kyis mthong gyur tamanya/ /phyogs de nas kyang song ba dang sbrul zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang smras pa/ kye ma'o sbrul gnaganyeshing lo lta bur lce g.yo zhing / /mig dang kha yi nang nas dud pa'i tshogs 'byin pa/ /khyod kyi gdug pa'i me dang 'dod chags mer mi mtshungs/ /bdag gi yid 'phrog ces bya khyod kyis mthong gyur tam/ /de nas kyang phyogs gzhan zhig tu son pa dang / tshal gzhan zhig 2—501

na khu byug sgra 'byin pa zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khu byug de la yang smras pa/ kye ma khu byug tshal mchog ljon shing la gnas pa/ /'dabanyechags tshogs kyisargyal po bud med yid 'phrog pa②/ /ut+pal sngon po lta bur dri med mdzes pa'i mig /bdag gi yid 'phrog ces bya khyod kyis mthong gyur tam/ /phyogs de nas kyang song ba dang / shing mya ngan 'tshang zhes bya ba me tog thams cad rgyas pa zhig mthong nas/ ming0gi rnam grangs bkra shis zhes brjod pa/ /ljon pa rnams kyi rgyal po cher gyur las/ /yid 'phrog mya ngan gyis ni blong ba dag⑨ /thal mo sbyor na khyod kyis mya ngan songasayi/ /de de ltar yid blong bzhin rim gyis drang srong de'i bste gnas su phyin tsonas des drang srong de la dul 8ba dang bcas pas phyag byas nas smras pa/ bzod 'phags gos su shing shun dang ni g.yang gzhi 8mnabs/ /rtsa ⑩ba myu gu skyu ru thal ba ka pid gsol/ /drang srong mgos btud ⑩phyag 'tshal bdag gi yid 'phrog ma/ /khyod kyis gzigs sam khyod ni bdag la myur du gsungs/ /de nas drang srong des gzhon nu nor bzangs la byon pa legs so 8zhes byas pa yidang / stan bting ba 0bya ba la sogs pa sngar bya ba'i 0yang dag par dga' ba byas nas smras pa/ smin ma 'jam dupa'i smin mtshungs 0mthon mthing chabazhin legs mthong na dga' ba'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /bzhin ras zla ba nya 'dra ut+pal sngon po lta bu'i mig de bdag gis mthong / /dpon khyod bag rkyang byabazhugs te rtsa ba 'bras bu sna tshogs gsol bar mdzod cig dang / /slad kyis bde blag byon 'gyur 'di la bdag gi yid la the tshom yod ma mchis/ /smin ma bzang mos 'di skad tshig smras te/ /gzhon nu khyod la sred pas bdag mi bde/ /nags khrod gnas 2—502

pa'ang sdug bsngal7chen po ste/ /gshegs par gyur na nges par bdag mthong ngo / /des sor gdub rgyan 'di byin nas smras pa/ lam yang la bgrodasnyedaka' bas nyon mongs par 'gyur gyisasaslar log shig /gal te bzlog kyang 'dug tu ma btub na de la lam bstan pa'i rigs so/ /des yang 'di skad ces bstanakhute / byang phyogs logasalgen ri nag po gsum yod do/ /de dag rgalakhuba'i pha rol na yang gsum/ de dag rgalasaba'i pha rol7na yang gsum yod de/ de dag rgal ba dang ri'i rgyal po gangs can zhes bya ba yod de/ phyogs de nas sman 'di dag blang bar bya ste/ 'di lta ste shin tu 'o ma 'dzag ces bya ba'i sman yod de/ de mar las7)btsos nas btung bar bya'o/ /des na skom pa dang bkres pa med cing dran pa dang mthu stobs 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /spre'u zhig kyang bkri bar bya/ gsang sngags dganyekyang bslab par bya/ gzhu mda' dang chas pa dang / nor bu 'od dang ldan pa dang / dug gsod pa sman dug sel dang / lcags kyi phur pa gsum dang / pi bang7yang bcang bar bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po gangs can gyi byang phyogs na ri bo phur pa'i rtse yod do/ /de nas lam chu sgracacan dang / seng ldeng can dang / rgyud gcig pa dang / rdo rje can dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can dang / phur pa'i dbyibs dang / sa srung bu'i dbyibs dang / mi g.yo ba dang / rab grol lo/ /khyod kyis ri de dag rgal dgos te/ de la ri bo seng ldeng can la ni phug nas 'jug /rgyud gcig pa dang / phur pa'i dbyibs la yang phug nas 'jug /rdo rje can la ni bya'i rgyal pos 'jug ste/ thabs 'di dag gis ri bo de rnams rgal bar bya'o/ /'khrul 'khor ra gdong can dang / lug lta bu dang / skyes 2—503

bu srin po ser skya'i gzugs can dag gzhom par bya'o/ /phug na sbrul kha chu'i rgyun chen po'i shugs kyis rgyug pa zhig mchis te/ de ni zho shas gzhom par bya'o//gang na sbrul ni nag po zhig /phug na phyed 'dug mthong nas ni/ /bdag gi slad du gzhu bdungasatul/ /mda' yis bsnun te gsad7par gyis/ /gang la lugasheganyis phan tshun nas/ /rdung bar byed⑥pa mthong na ni/ /de gnyis rwa re bcag mdzod dang / /lam ni rnyed par 'gyur lags so/ /'jigs pa che skyed mtshon thogs pa'i/ /lcags kyi skyes pa gnyis mthong na/ /de gnyis las ni gcig brdegs dang / /lam ni rnyed par 'gyur lags so/ /srin mo lcags kyi mchu can zhig /kha 'dzums gdangs par〈bgyid gzigs na/ /de tshe de yi 'phralasheb la/ /phur pa dag gis gdab par mdzod/ /de bzhin khron pa klong dragarwate'akhyil/ /drug bcu'i khru0)can la khyod mchongs/ /skra mig seng ge'i ltar ser zhing / /mi bzad bsnyenatshwanyepar dka' ba gyi/ /gnod sbyin dang ni srin po dag /gzhu bkang ste ni gsangasamadzod la/ /chu srin 'dzin khris gang ba yon / /chu bo mang po rgal mdzod cig /nang ga phye ma labalgegadungs dang / /sna tshogs ngud mosri dgod pa dang / /sbrul can 'od ma can gyi klung / /nang ga na ni srin mo khro/ /phye ma lab spen mi ma yin/ /gdungs pa na ni 'dzin khri mang //sna tshogs can na 'dod sgyur gzugs/ /dud mor mi 'am ci yi bran/ /dgod pa na ni mi 'am ci'i/ /mna' ma sbrul can sbrul mang na/ /'od ma can klung shal ma li/ /nang ga na duni brtan par bya/ /phye ma leb la rtul tsomod bya/ / gdungs parasnyi'adzin khri kha bcing ngo / /sna tshogs can du klu sna tshogs/ /ngud mo can du yid bde bas/ /dgod byed du ni mi smra ba'i/ /sbyor bas kun 2wa 504

du rgal bar mdzod/ /sbrul can du ni sbrul dug gi/ /sngags kyi sbyor dang 'od ma can/ /klung du mtshon rnonatugadab pa yi/ /sbyor bsakhukun tu rgal bar mdzod//chu bo rnams rgalasanas gcan pa'i gnas na gnod sbyin lnga brgya yod pa de rnams la sran tshugs te gzhom par mdzod cig /de nas ni mi'am ci'i rgyal po'i pho brang mchis so zhes gsungs shig /de nas gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis ji skad bstan pa'i sman dang / gsang sngags dang / sman dug sel gyi sbyor ba rnams btsal ba'i phyir drang srong de'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag byas nas song ngo de nas des spre'u ma gtogs ⑦par ji skadakhubastan pa thams cad sta gon byas nas/de nas de rnams khyer te yang drang srong de'i drung du song ba dang / des de la spre'u byin nas smras pa/ gzhon nu 'bad pa 'dis ci bya/ yid 'phrog ma 'disalgeci zhig7dgos/ khyod gcig purwa)grogs med pa7lus gdon misngo)za bar 'gyur gyis thong / gzhon nus smras pa/ drang srong chen po bdag ni gdon mi za bar mchi'o/ zhaci'i slad du zhe na/ mkha' la zla ba rgyu ba grogs shig ga las mchis/ /mche ba'i mthu stobs ldan pa'i ri dgas gtso bo dang / /me yis nags sreg pa na grogs shig ga las mchis/ /bdag lta bu la grogs po mthu ldan ci zhig 'tshal//kye ci rgya mtsho che chur 'jug par mi bgyi 'am/ /ci lags sbrul gyis zin ces gso bar mi bgyi 'am/ /sems can spungs can gyis bstenatshwa)brtson 'grus cher brtsams te/ /gal te 'bad de ma rung5)'di la nyes pa med/ /de nas gzhon nu nor bzangs yid 'phrog mas bstan pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs dang chas te rim gyis ri dang / chu bo dang / phug dang g.yang sa la sogs par sman dang /gsang sngags dang / sman dug sel gyi sbyor bas rgyal bar byas nas mi'am ci'i 2wa 505

rgyal po ljon pa'i grong khyer dang nye ba zhig tu son pa dang / gzhon nus grong khyer dpal dang ldan pa skyed mos tshal gyi tshal me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang ldan pas mdzes par byas pa/ bya sna tshogs kyis bsten pa/ rdzing bu dang /mtshe'unyering po dang / gru bzhi dang / mi'am ci mo rnams kyis bskorakhub de la mi'am ci mo rnams chu len du 'ongs pasamathong nas/ des0gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis de rnams la smras pa/ chu mang po 'dis ci zhig bya/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa'i sras mo yid 'phrog ma zhes bgyi ba zhig mchis/ de mi'i lag tu son par gyur pas de'i mi'i dri bshal ba lags so//gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis dris pa/ ci bum pa 'di dag thams cad kyis dus gcig tu de'i steng nas sdugs sam/ 'on te rim gyis/ de rnams kyis smras pa/rim gyis so/ /des bsams pa thabs 'di bzang ste/ sor gdub kyi rgya 'di bum pa gcig gishenang du gzhug go snyam nas/ des mi'am ci mo gcig gi bum par ma tshor bar bcug nas mi 'am ci mo de la smras pa/ khyod kyi〈bum pa 'dis thog mar yid 'phrog ma la khrus byos shig /des bsams pa/ gdon mi za bar 'di la dgos pa zhig yod par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de nas des bum pa de thog mar yid 'phrog ma'i spyi ⑨bor blugs pa las ji tsam na sor gdub kyi rgya pang du lhung ba dang yid 'phrog mas de 'phrigs so/ /de nas mi 'am ci mo la dris pa/'dir mi 'ga'armyazhig ma 'ongs sam/ des smras pa/ mchis so/ /song la de dben pa zhig tu zhoganyeshig /des de nang du khrid nas dben pa zhig tu bzhag gol/ /de nas yid 'phrog mas pa'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ yab gal te bdag 8gi khyim thab bgyid pa gzhon nu nor bzangs de mchis na de la 2—506

khyod kyis ci zhig bgyi/ des smras pa/ de mi yin tenyecir yang mi mkho bas ngas de dum bu brgyar byas lasaphyogs bzhir gtor te gtangasango / /yid 'phrog mas smras pa/ yab mir gyur pas 'dir ga la mchici/ bdag nyid de skad mchi bar bas so/ /de nas mi'am ci'i rgyal po0ljon pa kun nas dkris pa dang bral te / de nas kun nas dkrisalgepa dang bral nas smras pa/ gal te gzhon nu de 'ongs na ngas khyod rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan lasanor dang yo byad mang po dang /mi'am ci mo stong gis yongs su bskor te de la chung ma'i don du sbyin no/ /de nas yid 'phrog ma dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' bas gzhon nu nor bzangs lha'i rgyan gyis brgyan nas mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa la bstanasheto / /de nas mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas gzhon nu nor bzangs gzugs bzang po mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur te/ de nas de bgam par 'dod nas gser gyi sdong po bdun dang / shing ta la bdun dang / rnga bo che bdun dang /phag bdun btsugs so/ /gzhon nu nor bzangs ni byang chub sems dpa' yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bzo'i gnas dang las kyi gnas de dang de dag la mkhas pa yin no/ /lha rnams kyang de dag la bgegs med par bya ba'i phyir brtson par byed do/ /desanas byang chub sems dpa' gar dang / glu dang pi bangacadang / kharasnying dang / shin tu sgra snyan dang / pi bang7rgyud gsum pa dang / rdza rnga la sogs pa lha rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i sil snyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgra'i khyad par ni kun nas 'bud cing mi'am ci stong phrag du mas ni yongs su bskor nas/ ral gri ut+pa la sngon po'i 'dabatshwanyem 'dra ba thogs te/2—507

mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa mthong bar gser gyi sdong po'i drung du song ①nas chu shing la gcod pa bzhin du sdong po de dum bu dum bur gcad ②par brtsams te/de nas desatil gyi 'bru tsam du brlagasakyiso/ /mdas ni shing rtakyil bdun dang ske/ rnga bdun dang / phag bdun gtsang mar phyung ste/ ri rab bzhin du mi g.yo bar gnas so/ /de nas nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha dang / mi'am cikhubargya stong phrag du mas a la la zhes ca co dang ga zha'i ③sgra chen po phyung ngo / /mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas mthong zhing thos nas shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /de nas mi'am ci mo yid 'phrog ma 'dra ba sha stagashestong gi dbus su yid 'phrog ma bzhag ste/ gzhon nu nor bzangs la smras pa/ gzhon nu tshur yid 'phrog ma ngo shes par gyis shig /de nas gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smras pa/ ji ltar khyod ni ljon pa'i bu yin la/ /kho bo'i sdug pa yid 'phrog yin zherwanyen/ /bden pa 'di yis myur ba kho nar ni/ /yid 'phrog gom pas myur du 'gro bar shog /de nas de7ma thag tu gom pas song ba dang / mi'am ci7rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gzhon nu nor bzangs 'dirnyastobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon pa shin tu tshogs pa lags te/ yid 'phrog ma dang thab rir bab lags na/ ci'i slad du 'di la tho7btsam/ 'di la yid 'phrog ma stsolasngo)cig /de nas mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa mi'am ci'i tshogs rnams kyis dzo)rjes su bsngags pa dang /mi'am ci rnams kyi 'dun pas gzhon nu nor bzangs la rje chabakur sti chen po byas nas yid 'phrog ma 0 lha'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan (7te lag pa g.yon pas bzung / gser gyi0 bya ma bum lag pa g.yas pas bzung nas gzhon nu nor 2—508

bzangs kyi7drung du song ste smras pa/ gzhon nu yid 'phrog ma 'di mi'am ci mo stong gis yongs su bskor te/ kho bos khyod kyi chung ma'i phyir byin gyisal/ mi rnams ni ngosami rtag pa yin gyisaX/ ji ltar yang 'di ma dor cig /yab bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa las mnyan nas mi'am ci'i gnas kyi khang pa na yid 'phrog ma dang lhan cig skyes pa med par sil snyan rnams kyis rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de dus gzhan zhig na rang gi yul dran nas pha ma dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi mya ngan gyis gdungs par dugyur nas yid 'phrog ma la smras pa pha ma dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis non par gyur to/ /de nas yid 'phrog mas de ltar gyur pa dag pha la rgyas par smras so/ /des smras pa/ gzhon nu dang lhan cig song la mi rnams ni slu bar byed pa yin gyis/ khyod kyis bag yod par gyis shig de nas mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas nor bu dang / mu tig dang / gser la sogs pa mang du brdzangs te btang nas de yid 'phrog ma dang lhan cig tu steng gi nam mkha'i lam la mi'am ci'i shugs kyis chas pa na rim gyis glang po'i khyim gyi grong khyer du phyin noni/ /de nas glang po'i khyim gyi grong khyer rdo ba dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo rnams bsal nas tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab/ dar gyi chun 'phyang dpyangs7rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs/ shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por dag bshams/me tog rnam pa sna tshogs bkram ste/ dga' dga' ltar byas so/ /de nas gzhon nu mi'ilogatso bo stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing yid 'phrog ma dang lhan cig tu glang po'i khyim gyi grong khyer du zhugs so/ /de nas7lam gyis 2—509

dub pa'i ngal bsos7nas rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs pashedag khyer te pa'i drung du song nas rgyal po'i stan gyi glo zhig tu 'dug ste/ mi'am ci'i grong khyer du song ba dang 'ongs bsnyernams rgyas par smras so/ /de nas rgyal po nor can gyis 'di ni shin tu stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon pa can no zhes bya bar rigasanas rgyal po'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur to①/ /gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis0bsams pa/ gang bdag yid 'phrog ma dang lhan cig tshogs pa dang / rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur ba thob par gyur pa 'di ni sngon byas pa'i rgyu'i khyad par yin gyisasti/ ma la da yang bdag gis ⑧sbyin pa dag ni btang ⑨/ bsod nams ⑩dag ni bya'o snyam nas/ des glang po'i khyim gyi grong khyer du lo bcu gnyis su gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byas so/ /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus na gzhon nu nor bzangs zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin snyam na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ nga nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na rgyal po nor bzangs zhes bya bar gyur to/ /ngas gang yid 'phrog ma'i phyir stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon pa〈nyebastan nas/ lo bcu gnyis su gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byas pa des ngas bla na medashipa'i byang chub ma thob mod kyi/ 'on kyang sbyin pa de dang /brtson 'grus de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu tsam dang7/ rkyen tsam dang / tshogs tsam yin no//rgyal po chen po gzhan yang ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i phyir sbyin pa dag btangahū/ bsod nams dag byas pa 2—510

gang yin pa de nyon cig /rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba thams cad ces bya ba'i grong rdal gyitugrong khyer na rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen zhes bya ba zhig rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa②/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos rab tu gang ba dngas/ 'thab pa dang / thabasremo dang / khrag khrug dang / 'gyed pa rnams rab tu zhi ba zhes bya ba nas/ chos bzhin gyis rgyal srid byed du 'jug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ zhadus gzhan zhig na btsun mo dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse〈pebar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sems can dang ldan par gyur te/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas khye'u gzugs bzang po/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ pags pa'i⑧mdog gser7'dra ba/ mgo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ dpung pa ring ba 'phral7ba'i dbyes che ba/ smin ma 'jar〈skreb/ sna'i gzangs〈nyematho ba zhes〈nyebya ba nas/gnas lnga la byang bar gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /gzhon nu thams cad sgrol dad pa bzang ba/ dge ba'i bsam pa can/ bdag la phan pa dang / gzhan la phan par zhugs pa/ snying rje can bdag nyid chen po chos 'dod pa/ skye dgu rnams la byams pa/ thams cad sbyin pa/ thams cad gtong ba/ chags pa med par gtong ba/ gtong ba chen po la zhugs pa yin no / /de'i gtong ba rgya chen po thos nas dpag tshad brgya nas kyang don du gnyer ba'i skye bo 'ongs ④te thams cad kyang yid la re ba rdzogs par byas nas gtong ngo / /de nas re zhig cig na byang chub sems dpas7shing rta nor bu dang gser 2—511

dang dngul dang / rdo rje dang / be+e ḍūr+ya7dang / spug dang / pad ma rākhug dang / in+d+ra grikhulas 'bar bar byas pa/ tsan dan0mchog gi snying po las bsgrubs pa/ seng ge dang stag dang gung gi pagasalgepas g.yogs pa/ rta rlung gi shugs ltar mgyogs pa/ gser dang dngul gyi dril bu g.yer ku'i sgra 'khrol ba bzhi dang ldan pa mchog gi nang du zhugs nas grong khyer rjodam pa nas skyed mos tshal du mngon du song ngo / /de nas bram ze rig byed dang rig byed kyi yan lag shes pa kha cig gis thams cad sgrol mngon du bsu nas smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /yang smras pa/ khyod ni 'jig rten thams cad du/ /thams cad gtong zhes rnam par grags/ /bram ze rnams la shing rta 'di / /khyod kyis sbyin pa gtang ba'i⑧migs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol shing rta de las myur ba myur bar babs te snying dga' ba dang mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' bas bram ze de dag la shing rta7byin nas smras pa/ bdag gis ji ltar bram ze la/ /mchog tu dga' bas shing rta btang ⑫/ /de bzhin bdag gis srid pa gsum/ /btang yinas byang chub mchog reg shog/ //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bzhi bcu 07drug pa/ de dus gzhan zhig na glang po che'i mchog rgyal srid 'phel zhes bya ba me tog kun da dang / ku mu da dang / kha ba dang / dngul dang / sprin dkar po lta bu'i mdog can bdun legs par gnas shing rkang lag legs par gnas pa/ glang po che sa srung gi bu ltar 'gying zhing 'gro ba/ rang bzhin gyi mtshan mchog gis brgyan pa/mthong na bkra shis pa la zhon nas shin tu sdug pa'i bran dang / mdza' bshes 2—512

dang / g.yog rnams phyi bzhin 'brang zhing zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ①ba bzhin du sos ku'i ②dus la bab pas shing rnams me tog kha 'bus shing / ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / ri skegasashedang / khu byug dang / shang shang te'u sgra 'byin0pa'i nags tshal gyi skyed mos tshal gyi sar song ba dang / de nas phyir rgol bas sbad 0pa'i bram ze kha cig gzhon nu thams cad sgrol gyi drung du rings pa rings par 'ongs nas/rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig ces smras nas yang smras pa/ lha min lhar bcas 'jig rten du/ /khyod ni thams cad gtong zhes grags/ /khyod kyi glang po'ikhumachog 'di ni/ /bdag cag rnams la stsal ba'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' glang po'i mchog de las myur ba myur bar babs nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'ikhuyid kyis de dag la glang po'ishemachog de byin nas smras pa/ bdag gis ji ltar bram ze la/ /mchog tu dga' bas glang chen btang / /de bzhin bdag gis srid pa gsum/ /btang nas byang chub mchog reg shog /rgyal po thams cad bshes gnyen gyis khyod kyi sras thams cad sgrol gyis glang po che'i tsomachog rgyal srid 'phel zhes bya ba phyir rgol bas sbad (nyepa'i bram ze rnams la byin no zhes ⑫thos so/ /thos nas rgyal po thams cad bshes gnyen shin tu khros 'khrugs nas gzhon nu thams cad sgrol bkug ste smras pa'/ gzhon nu khyod nga'i yul na ma 'dug par song shig /de nas gzhon nu thams cad sgrol phas spangs pa dang /bsams pa(7/ bdag gis byang chub kyi phyir 'bad par byas pa dang / 'jig rten ()thams cad rjes su gzung duba'i phyir brtson 'grus kyi go cha 0bgos pas 2—513

glang po che de⑥yang btang ste/ de bas khyim na gnas pas ni/ /ci nus par ni sbyin pa btangs/ /dka' thub nags7su brten nas ni/ /nges par mchog dag bya ba yin④/ /bslangs na mi⑧sbyin zhes bya bzhu/ /tshig ni smra bar mi phod kyisal/ /de bas bdag ni khyim spangs te/ /dka' thub nags〈kyesu rab tu 'gro//byang chub sems dpas7de ltar snying la mna' mtho bcad nas chung ma rgyags sbyin ma'i drung du song ste de dag rgyas par smras so/ /de nas rgyags sbyin mas thos ma thag tu sdug pa dang bral bar dogs pa'i snying gis thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ rje'i sras gal te de lta na bdag kyang dka' thub kyi nags gnas7)su mchi ste/ bdag ni rje'i sras dang bral na skad cig tsamanyang 'tsho bar rngo mi thog5)lags so/ /de〈nyeci'i slad du zhe na/ nam mkha' zla bas stongs par gyur pa dang / /ji ltar sa ni lo tog gis stongs dang / /pad ma chu yis stongs par gyur pa dgatso /bud med khyim thab kyis stongs de bzhirno no/ /byang chub sems dpas7smras pa/ bdag cag mthar gdon mi za bar 'bral bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni 'jig rten gyi rang bzhin yin no/ /khyod ni bza' ba dang ske/ btung ba dang / mal cha dang / bgo ba mchog la goms pas lus shin tu skyid pa 0yin dka' thub kyi nags (nyen ni rtswa dang lo ma bting (nyebar ni nyal rtsa bsngo)dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu ni za/ rtswa drur0 ba dang / zug rngo dang / rtswa dang / tsher mas gang ba'i sa la ni rgyu/ yang dang yang du za gcig pa la ni brten( nye/ bdag nyid skye bo thams cad la ni bstenake dgos/glo〈 zhebur du 'ongs pa thams cad mchod pa nyel ni 'bad nyedagos la/ de na yang nga5)gdon mi za bar ci nus kyi57sbyin pa gtong ste/ de la khyod kyis cung 2—514

zad kyang mi 'gyod7par bya dgos so/ /de bas na re zhig da dung yang legs par soms shig /rgyags sbyin mas smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag rngo ci thog gisalgerje'i sras kyi rjes su sgrubasnyelags so/ /byang chub sems dpas〈gesmras pa/ gal te de lta na dam bcas pa de khyod kyis dran par byos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' pha'i drung du song nas mgo bos phyag byas te/ yab cig bdag gis sbyin parasaglang chen stsal/ /nongs pa gang lags sa bdag bzod par gsol/ /bdag ni grong nas dgon par mchi lags kyis⑥/ /mi yi dbang po'i7phyag mdzod stongs mi 'gyural/ /de nas rgyal po bu dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis dbugs kyis brnangasalge te skad 'dar 'dar bor smras pa/ bulate/sbyin pa'i blo 'orasnyil 'dug shig /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ sa ni ri dang bcas par yang / /gal te ldog par 'gyur gda' yangasnyi/ /sa bdag bdag ni sbyin pa las/ /sems ni ldog par mi bgyid do/ /zhes smras nas song ngo / /de nas bu dang / bu mo〈nyedang / chung ma dang lhan cig shing rta'i nang du zhugs te/grong khyer dam pa de nas byung nas pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang yul mi mya ngan byed pa brgya stong rjes su 'brang bzhin song ngo / /de nas mi zhig gis ngu zhing smre sngags 'don pa'i sgra de yang thos/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po grong khyer gyi sgor byung ba yang mthong nas mi zhig la dris pa/ kye nang rje skye bo'i tshogs chen po cho nges 'debs pa 'di ci las gyur/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci mi shes sam/'di ltar mi yi dbang pos nyid kyi sras po mche5)ba bzang / /brtan pa'i ngang tshul rab tu sbyin la dga' ba 'di ni sgyugs()/ /de ni bu dang chung mar bcas te nags mthar chas pa yonya/ /pho brang 'khor ba rnams 'dus ( 1shin tu snying rjes 2—515

cho nges 'debs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpasanyegrong khyer dam pa de nas byung ba'i pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams la ci rigs par mngon du song nas smras pa/shes ldan dag slar deng shiganyeslar dengasashig /'di ltar shin tu yun ring po nas sdug pa dang 'grogs pa yang mjug tu gdon mi⑧za bar 'bral ba'i mtha' can du 'gyur te/ gnyen pa'i7skye bo dang 'grogs pa ni lam ku'isnyingal bso ba'i bste gnas kyi shing dang 'dra bas gdon mi za bar sdug pa dang 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten kun na skye bo dbang med de/ /mdza' ba rnams dang 'bral bar 'gyur bsams nas/ /khyod kyis sa stengasalge'abad pa thams cad kyis/ /zhi phyir blo gros mi g.yo brtan par7gyis/ /de nas dpag tshad sum brgya 'das pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthong nas bram ze zhig mngon du 'ongs te smras pa/ kye rgyal rigs gzhon nu bdag ni khyod kyi yon tan thos nas 'di nas dpag tshad sum brgya tsam gyi 0yul nas 'dir mchis lags kyis8/ khyod kyis shing rta mchog 'di bdag ngal ba 'bras bu mchis par bgyi ba'i rigs so/ /de nas rgyags sbyin ma mi bzod pa skyes nas tshig brlangs pos bram ze de la smras pa/ e ma'o nags na'ang mi dbang sras la slong ba gang / /bram ze 'di ni shin tu brtsechab med pa'i blo/ /mi dbang sras po mi dbang dpal las nyams gyur pa/ /'di la 'dir ni snying rje ci ga mi skye 'am/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ khyod kyis bram ze ma spyo shigatso /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyags sbyin0gal te nor 'dod len pa 'di dag med gyur na/ /kun sbyin med par mi gang zhig gis sa stengs0 byang chub 'thob/ /sbyin sogs0pha rol phyin drug tshul gyis yon tan mchog can gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' 2—516

rnams kyis kun mkhyen nyid mchog rtag tu 'thob/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' bas yang rta dang ldan pa'i shing rta de bram ze de la byin nas smras pa/ bram ze ser sna'itudri ma sel byed pa/ /shing rta rab tu byin⑧pa 'di yis 'dir/ /bdag ni drang srong che mchog gis bskor ba'i/ /zag med chos kyi shing rta che skorasashog /de nas thams cad sgrol gyis snying rab tu dga' bas shing rta'i mchog de yang bram ze la byin nas gzhon nu nag po phrag pa la khyer/rgyags sbyin mas ①ni gzhon nu ma dra ba can khyer nas dka' thub kyi nags logs su chas pa dang rim gyis dka' thub kyi nags su phyin to/ /de nas thams cad sgrol dka' thub tshal der rang gi snying mgu bar byed pa'i brtul zhugs blangs te gnas so/ /ji tsam na rgyags sbyin ma rtsa ba dang 'bras bu'i phyir dka' thub kyi nags nas song ba dang / bram ze zhig thams cad sgrol gyi drung du 'ongs nas smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /bdag cag bkol bsnyem mchis pas/ /spa shug lhan cig 'khyam bgyid na/ /de yi don du bus pa gnyis/ /khyod kyisakhubadag la sbyin pa'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol bu sdug pa gtong ba la cung zhig sems shing 'dug pa dang / de nas bram ze des byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ kye rgyal rigs gzhon nu bdag gis khyod thams cad ster7ba'o zhes thos na 'di ltar khyod la bdag gis bslangs pa de la ci zhig dpyad du yod/ khyed ni kun ster snying rje yi/ /bdag nyid can du sa stengs grags/ /ji ltar grags pa de bzhin du/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bya ba'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol 2—517

gyis bram ze de la smras pa/ kye bram ze chen po/ rang gi srog ni gtongatub la'ang / /lan 'ga' dpyod pa masamyong na/ /rang gi bu ni btang ba la/ /bdag blo gzhan du gyur ci smos/ /bram ze chen po de lta mod kyi/ bdag gis nags su bskyed bskyed pa'i⑧/ /bus pa 'di gnyis yongs spangs nasabya/ /ma dang bral ba'i nyon mongs pa/ /'di dag ji ltar gnas snyam modabya/ /gzhon nu shin tu brtse med pas/ /bus pa btang0la bdag min zhes/ /kha cig bdag la phyar 'ong gis༅/ /bram ze bdag ni khrid na legs/ /de nas bram ze des thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ kye rgyal rigs gzhon nu rgyal po chen po'i rigs su skyes pa/ sa 'di thams cad du yon tan grags pa/ srog chags thams cad la snying brtse bsarnyubyams par zhugs pa/ sbyin pa dang / mchod pa7dang /bkur stis spos kyi glang po che lta bu/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / glo bur ba'i skye bo la mchod pa57byed pa/ skye bo bkrenarwa)pa dang / phongs pa dang /mgon med pa dang / ltogs pa yongs su sdud pa/ thams cad kyi re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ mthong na don yod pa khyod kyis bdag 'ongs pa nom pa med pa'am/ lam gyis dub pa 'bras bu med pa'amathu/ mthong ba don med pa'am / re ba dang yun ring po nas brnagasnyibarnag pa'i 'dod pa 'bras bu med par bya ba gang yin pa de ni cha ma yin te/ khyod kyi7med do5)zhes bya ba'i tshig gis kho bo'i yid la re bsnye kun tu rtog pa'i rta btab na myur du )ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na khyod kyis bdag gi5)yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byas nas gtang5 nyeba'i rigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chu gter gos su gyon zhing gza' mig mtshungs med pa/ / ri bo mchog rgyas nu mar ldan pa'i ro 2—518

stod can/ /grong khyer grong rdal bcas pa'i sa la btsal7byas kyang / / mche bzangs khyodasadang mtshungs parashegatong phod yod ma yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol gyis bram ze'i tshig de thos nas bu la chags pa'i blong bas 'di dag sems par byed de/ gal te re zhig bu gnyis po/ /bram zerasabyin na bu dang ni/ /bral ba las byung sdug bsngalasadag /bdag dang rgyags byin0gyis thob 'gyur/ /'on kyang 'di la masabyin na/ /brtul zhugs las kyang nyams 'gyur zhing / /bram ze 'di ni tshi chad7de/ /ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin du 'gro/ /nyis na bu bral nyam thag pa'i/ /mya ngan sa stengs bdag gis blang / /de bzhin ma byas dam bcas pa/ /zhig cing brtul7zhugs nyams par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol gyis sdug pa'i bu gnyis nges par gtong5)bar chad nas smras pa/ kye kho bos dka'achaspyad brgya yis 'jig rten sdug bsngal gyis/ /rgya mtsho chen po so sor 'jigs byed pa/ /gting mi dpogs par rab tu bying ba dag /pha rol rgal〈nyephyir lam gyi zam stegs bca'/ /zla ba dri med nya ba'i bzhin ras can/ /ma zhum kha nas de skad tshig smras nas/ /mchi ma rlan chus mig ni gang gyur pa'i/ /byis pa gnyis po5) bram ze de la byin/ /yang smras pa/ bu 'di byin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /rgya chen bdag gis thob gyur nas/ /des ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ 'jig rten rnams ni bsgral bar bya/ /bus pa gzhon〈 tenu dag byin ma thag tu sa 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas sa g.yos pa des nyetshal de na gnas pa'i dka' thub can rnams sngangs nas phan tshun smras pa/ sa ni mi bzad g.yos gyur pa/ /'di ni su yi mthu ltas yin/ /gang gi mthu ni 'di 'dra ba/ /shin 2—519

tu gsal bar shes par bya/ /de natuganas 'jog dang rus gcig pa rgan po dka' thub can ltas shes pa la mkhas pa gzhan zhig yod pa des drang srong de rnams la don de go bar byas pa/ gdon mi za bar dka' thub kyi nags na 'dug pa'i bu byis pa 'bras bu dang chu 'thungaphub yid du 'ong ba/ mig tu sdug par byed pa gnyis thams cad sgrol gyis skye bo ③sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir spangs te/ des na sa g.yos par gyur to/ /de nas bus pa gzhon nu de gnyis kyis pas snying nas yongs su btang ba'i blo rig nas snying rje rje skad du ngu zhing thal mo gnyis sbyar nas thams cad sgrol gyi rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ yab cig yum ni ma mchis par④/ /khyod ni bdag cag stsol bzhed pa/ /re zhig de ni mthong gyur nas/ /de nas bdag cag stsal du gsol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yid la gcagasalgepa'i sdug bsngal0gyis ngo thum gnag cing mchi ma 'dzag bzhin de gnyis la 'khyudakunas smras pa/ bu dag / nga yi7snying du mi sdug min/ /snying brtse snying rje med min te / /'jig rten kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /yon tan mthong nas btang ba yin/ /ci nas nga yis byang chub mchog /zhi ba rang gis thob nas ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la gnas pa'i/ /rten med 'jig rten rnams bsgral lo/ /de nas bus pa gzhon nu de dag gis phas snying nas yongs su btang ba'i blo rig nas pa'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te thal mo sbyar nas snying rje rje skad dang / sma babalgepa'i tshig gis dal gyis7smras pa/ gal te khyod kyis thag bkum na/ /ma la bdag cag gnyis kyi phrin8/ /khyod kyis bzod pa mdzod cig ces/ /yab cig khyod kyis gsung du gsol/ /yab gzhan yang / byis par gyur pas bla ma khyod la 2—520

nongs pa bgyis pa gang / /gal te la lar thugasatul mi 'bab tshig 'ga' smras pa 'am/ /gus par mnyan nasasnyeyongs su mnyes pa nyid du ma bgyis pa/ /de ni byis pa'i nongs pa lags zhes bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ /de skad ces smras nas pha la phyag 'tshal te lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas mig mchi mas gang bzhin du bla ma la smra bar yid la chags pas yang dang yang phyir lta ②zhing bste gnas de nas byung ste song ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byis pa gzhon nu'i tshig ④shin tu snying rjer rung ba de dag gis snying blong nas duyid kyis byang chub tu smon lam btab ste dka' thub kyi tshal gyi lo ma'i spyil0bur zhugs so/ /byis pa gzhon nu dag dong ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /lha stong phrag du ma yang bar snangashel ca co dang / ga zha'i 0sgra 'byin cing / e ma'o rab sbyin bdag nyid che/ /bus pa 'di gnyis btang nas kyang / /gang gi yid ni 'gyur med pa/ /de yi nges pa rmad cig go/ /de nas rgyags sbyin ma rtsa ba dang 'bras bu rnams khyer te bste gnas logs su chas pa las sa che thang du g.yos pa des myur ba kho nar bste gnas de nyid du song ba dang / lha gzhan zhig gis rgyags sbyin ma byang chub sems dpa' sems can 〉thams cad thar bar bya bar brtson pa byas pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar chad byed par 'gyur du 'ong ngo snyam nas seng ge mo zhig gi gzugs su bsgyur te lam bkag nas 'dug pa dang / rgyags sbyin mas ri dgas kyi rgyal po'i chung ma de la smras pa/ ri dgas rgyal po'i chung ma sgeg sgegatsom/ /kho mo'i 'di bkag nas ni ci ste 'dug /ji ltar bdag ni mi 'phyo nges shecan/ /lam las bzur ste myur du 'gro bar gyis/ /gzhan yang /2—521

khyod kyang ri dgas rgyal po'i chung ma la/ /bdag kyang mi yi dbang po seng ge yi/ /btsun mo yin pas chos kyi spun gyur gyis①/ /ri dgas rgyal mos bdag gi⑧lam phye shig /de skad ces smras pa dang / lha seng ge'i gzugs su bsgyur ba de yang lam de nas logs shig tu song ngo / /de nas rgyags sbyin mas bkra mi shis pa'i ltas dag mthong nas yud tsam zhig bsams pa/ ji ltar bar snang la ngud mo'i sgra grag⑧pa dang / ji ltar yang tshal na gnas pa'i lha rnams mya ngan byed pa'i sgra gragakhupa las na gdon mi za bar bste gnas su ma legs pa zhig byung bar gyur to snyam nas smras pa/ ji ltar bdag mig 'gul ba dang / /ji ltar bya skad 'byin pa dang / /ji ltar bdag ni dogs pa las/ /bus pa de gnyis btang bar nges / /ji ltar sa 'di g.yos pa las/ /bdag gi snying ni 'dar ba dang / /ji ltar lus kyang rmya7ba las/ /bus pa de gnyis btang bar nges/ /zhes de lta bu'i mi legs pa brgya stong dag sems shing bsti gnas su song nas bste gnas su zhugs te mi dga' bzhin bltas na burnyuganyis ma mthong nas/ de nas rmongs shing snying 'dar nas bsti gnas kyi gzhi de'i rjes bzhin du sems te/ phyogs 'di na ni gzhon nu nag po5) sring mo dang lhan cig ri dgas kyi phru gu dang rtag tu rtse rtse/ 'di ni de gnyis kyi sa rdul las byas pa'i khyim yin/ 'di ni de gnyis kyi rtsed mo'i cha spyad nyeyin na de gnyis5)mi snang na/ gal te zhig na bdag gis ma mthong gi/ lo ma'i spyil bur zhugs nas nyal lta srid dam snyam du de ltar snying la re zhing / bu mthong bar 'dod pas rtsa ba dang 'bras bu phyogs gcig tu bzhag nas mig mchi mas gang bzhin du khyim thab ⑩kyi rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ rje'i sras khye'u dang bu mo gnyis gang du mchis/2—522

thams cad sgrol gyis smras pa/ kho bo'i drung du bram ze zhig /re bas yang dag 'ongs gyur nas/ /bus pa de gnyis de la byin/ /de dganyerjes su yi rang rigs / /de skad ces smras pa dang / rgyags sbyin ma ri dgas mo mda' dug can gyis phog⑧pa bzhin du sa la sgyel〈nyenas nya chu'i gnas nas phyung ba bzhin du ni 'gre ldog par byed/ krung krung bu stor ba bzhin du ni snying rje rje skad du ngu ske/ ba be'u shi ba bzhin du ni 'ba' sgra sna〈tshogs 'don cing smras pa/ pad mashegazhon nu lta bu'i byad bzhin can/ /lag pa pad ma'i 'dab ltar gzhon sha can / /bdag gi bu gnyis sdug bsngal ma myong bci/ /'gro ba gang du song nas sdug bsngal 'gyura3nye/ /ri dgas bu ltar drang zhing ri dgas mig /ri dgas lhan cig bsti gnas dga' dga' na/ /de ring bdag (nyegi bu gnyis ji lta bur(nye/ /gzhan gyi dbang gis dong zhing sdug bsngalasagyur/ /mig ni mchi mas gang ba'i mig gis ni/ /snying rjes ngu ba shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ /de ring bdag gis legs par ma mthong bas/ /skye5)bo bkren pa'i nang na sdug pas 'tshom/ /de gnyis bdag gisalgepang nas bskyed bskyed pa/ /zas su rtsa ba me tog 'bras bu za/ /bzod dang gnam pas bla ma brtag dka'aphanyeb/ /bdag gi bu gnyis shin tu sdug bsngal〈 )lo/ /de gnyis ma dang nye du bral ba dang / /rtsa lag rnams kyis gzu lums57spangs pa las/ /skye bo sdig can ngan dang phrad gyur nas/ /bdag gi bu gnyis shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /skom zhing bkres pas bdag nyid rtag gdungs nas( nye/ /de gnyis su yi dbang gis 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bran du gyur pas gdon mi za bar ni/ /de gnyis nyam thag sdug bsngal yongs su gzir/ /bdag gis nges par tshe rabs gzhan dag tu/ /srog chags sdug 2—523

pa brgya dang bral ba yi/ /sdig las shin tu mi bzad 'dir byasalgepa/ /des na ba be'u med bzhin cho nges 'debs/ /bden tshig gang gis bdag ni rtag tu yang / /sems can kun la yid ni mnyam gyur pa/ /bden tshig des ni bdag gi bu gnyis po/ /bran du gyur pa mes ni thar bar shog /rgyags sbyin mas bus pa gzhon nu de dag gis bskyed cing bsrungasalgepa'i shing gang yin pa de dag lo ma thib be 'dug par mthong nas snying du sdug nas 'khyud de smras pa/ bus pas ril ba chung ngus7chu bcus paX/ /lo ma rnams las chu thigs 'dzag pa yi/ /ljon shing rnams ni sems dang bcas pa bzhin/ /bus pa nu zho ma blud lta bur ngu / /yang bus pa gzhon nu de gnyis dang rtse rtse ba'i ri dgas kyi phrug gu bsti gnas na 'dug pa rnams mthong nas mi dga' ste snying rje rje skad kyi tshig gis dal bus smras pa/ de yi ne'u zla mthong bar 'dod pa gang / /nags su sashetshugs mtshon cing tshol byed pa/ /ri dgas phru gu rgyu ba 'di dag kyang / /bdag gi sdug bsngal mi chung gzhan yin no/ /de nas bus pa gzhon nu de dag lam gang nas dong ba'i lam der rjes bcad pashedang / bus pa gzhon nu de gnyis kyi rjes drang por ma byung gi gya gyus gang bar mthong nas lhag par yang sdug bsngal gyis gdungs nas smras pa/ ji ltar 'then7pa'i rjes byung dang / /la lar myur du song ba las/ /brdegs te khrid par gdon mi za/ /kye ma bram ze brtse med mchog /mgul ni dbugs kyis brdzangs shing skad kyang 'dzer/ /ma mchu mdzes pa 'dar7zhing bdag gi bu/ /ri dgas bzhin du mig kyang rig rig ste/ /rkang pa 'jam pos ji ltar song zhig gu/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑩de de ⑩ltar smre sngags 'don pa'i bdag nyid de mthong nas mi rtag pa 8nyid dang 2—524

ldan pa'i tshig de dang de dag gis rnam grangs mang por go bar byas nas smras pa/kho bos bu gnyis grags7pa yis/ /btang bsnyem yin snang bas min/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ / gtang bar dka'asnyeba'i bu de btang / /mchog tu gtang dga'akhubadag nyid dang / /bu nor chung ma rnams btang nas/ /sems dpa' chen pos tshul bzhin du/ /byang chub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /rgyags sbyin bdag gis gtong ba la brten gtang dka' ba'i/ /bus pa de gnyis 'jig rten thar pa'i don du btang / /bdag dang chung ma bzhon dang nor yangashebatang byas te/ /kun la thams cad gtang ba'i blo gros nga la yod/ /de nas rgyags sbyin mas sems brtan ②te byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/khyod la bar chad mi bgyid kyisal/ /khyod blo gzhan du ma gyur7cig /gal te bdag kyang stsol bzhed nayi/ /dogs pa med par bdag stsol cig /gzhan yang ske/ dpa' bo gang phyir nyid kyi phyir8/ /sdug pas chags pa btang ba yi/ /don de myur du thob nas ni/ /srid las 'gro ba bsgral bar mdzod/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' dang / rgyags sbyin ma brtson 'grus shin tu rmad du byung ba dang / shin tu bya dka' bar rigacanas sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te steng gi nam mkha' las bsti gnas der lhags nas (stesnang ba rgya chen pos nags de gsal bar byas te/nam mkha' la 'dug bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ 'di ltar 'jig rten rmongs pa blo ngan gzhung gis bcings pa'i blo gros can/ /longs spyod la chags snying gi zhags pa bu yis bcings pa'i nang na yang / /khyab bdag khyod gcig chags pa med pas dga' ba bskyed pa'i bu gtong bas/ /nges par 2—525

go 'phang bde dang zhi ba dri med dka'apheb med par 'thob②/ /de skad ces byang chub sems dpa' spro ba bskyed nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bsamasapa/ 'di gcig pu g.yog dang bral na nyon mongs par 'gyur gyis④/ma la bdag gis rgyags sbyin ma bslang ngo snyam nas/ de nas7bram ze'i cha byad du bsgyur te byang chub sems dpa'i drung du song nas yang byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ yan lag kun bzang khyim thab las/ /'phyo ba med cing snying nye ba//rigs na bsngags pa'i sring mo 'di/ /bdag la bran mo'i don du stsol/ /de nas rgyags sbyin ma mi bzod pa skyes nas bram ze la smras pa/ ngo tsha0med cing brkam pa khyod/ /'di na bram ze tha shal te/ /khyod lta 'phyon ma mi byed cing / /dam chos dga' ba nga 'dod dam/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol snying rje dang ldan pa'i snying gis rgyags sbyin ma la brtag ⑧par brtsams pa dang ske/ de nas rgyags sbyin mas byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ bdag ni bdag la g.yar ngan med/ /de bzhin bdag la lta ma lags/ /gcig pu ji ltar bzhugs 'gyur zhes/ /de ltar khyod slad g.yar ngan bgyid/ /de nas byang chub sems dpasakyirgyags sbyin ma la smras pa/ go 'phang mi zad mya ngan med pa tshol bdag la/ /sa stengs〈nye'adir ni rgyags sbyin mya ngan bya mi dgos/ /khyod ni mya ngan med par bram ze 'di rjes 'brongs8/ /bdag ni ri dgas 'chi ba bzhin du bste gnas 'thengs/ /de skad ces smras pa dngasnyi/ dga' ba dang /mgu ba dang / yid rab tu dga' bas bsams pa dang / sbyin pa 'di ni nags tshal 'dir/ /bdag gi sbyin pa tha ma yin/ /rgyags sbyin 'di yang yongs btang nas/ /yongs su gzung ba med par 'gyur/ /snyam du rig 2—526

nas rgyags sbyin ma lag pa nas bzung ste/ bram ze de la smras pa/ bdag gi mchis 'brang7sdug pa 'di/ /snying nas snying nye bsgo ba nyan/ /ya rabs tshul can snyan par smra/ /bram ze'isnyomachog khyod bzhesasasu gsol/ /de nas mche ba bzang po yis/ /chung ma byang chub 'dod phyir btang / /chu la gru ni ji lta bar / /sa ni mtha' dag rnam drug g.yos/ /de nas rgyags sbyin ma bramasaze'i dbang du gyur te/ khyo dang bu dang bu mo dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag nas dbugs brdzangs pas sgra ngar ngar por 'gags bzhin 'di skad ces smras so / /bdag gis7tshe rabs snga ma la/ /ci 'dra ba yishelas nganatshwa) byas/ /de nas ba be'u shi ba bzhin/ /skye bo med pa'i nags na5)ngu / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bram ze'i cha byad mi snang bar byas te/ rang bzhin gyi cha byad du gnas nas rgyags sbyin ma la smras pa/ skal bzangs7bdag ni bram ze ma yin mi yang ma yin gyi/ /bdag ni lha yi dbang po brgya byin lha min 'joms byed de/ /khyod kyi 'dul ba mchog tu gyur pa 'di yis bdag mgu yis(nye/ /bdag las dam pa gang zhig 'dod pa de 'dir smra bar gyis/ /de nas de'i tshig gis rgyags sbyin ma yid bde ba skyes nas brgya byin la phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ sbyan stong ldan pa bdag gi bu/ /bran gyur pa las thar mdzad cing / /mes po'i drung du phyin par yang / /sum bcu rtsa gsum bdag pos mdzod/ /de skad ces smras nas yang5nyedabang po chen po bste gnas su zhugs nas byang chub sems dpa'i drung du song ste7rgyags sbyin ma lag pa g.yon pa nas bzung nas byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ bdag gis khyod la rgyags sbyin 'di / /g.yog gi phyir ni sbyin par byas(nye/ /khyod kyis〈nyesu la'ang ma sbyin cig /2—527

bzhag pa byin na smad par 'gyur①/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bram ze khye'u dang bu mo khyer ba de ji ltar grong khyer gzhan zhig⑧yin no snyam nas grong khyer de nyid du song stesabus pa gzhon nu de dag btsong bar brtsams pa de lta bur rmongs par byas so/ /ji tsam na blon po rnams kyis mthong nas rgyal posrel smras pa/ lha/ khyod kyi dpon po nag po dang / /dra ba can dang de gnyis ni / /bram ze shin tu ma rungs pasakyi/ /grong khyer mchog 'dir 'tshong zhing mchis / /de skad thos nas rgyal po de sems mi dga' nas smras pa/ gzhon nu gnyis myur du ston cig /blon po rnams kyis skad phyung ba dang grong khyer pa rnams myur du rgyal po'i mdun du nye bar lhags so/ /ji tsam na blon po gzhan zhig gis rgyal po'i drung du khrid pa dang / mi'i⑧dbang po mngon7phyogs khrid pa'i tsha bo gos med cing / /lus rbeg7dri ma can gyi lus de de yis mthong nas ni / /med la seng ge'i7khri las sa yi steng7du lhung gyur te④/ /pho brang 'khor mi blon tshogs bud med dag kyang ngu bar gyur/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ gang zhig nags na gnas na yang / /sbyin la mngon par dga' ba'i yid/ /mig bzangs de ni myur du 'dir/ /chung ma dang bcas dgug par gyis/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' la phyag byas nas rang gi gnas su song ngo / /phyi zhig na rgyal po thams cad bshes gnyen shi ba dang / bram ze dang / blon po dang / grong mi dang /yul mi rnams lhan cig tu bsti gnas der song nas byang chub sems dpa' la gsol ba btab ste rang gi grong khyer du bos nas rgyal por bcug go/ /de nas rgyal po thams cad sgrol thams cad gtong zhes bya bar gyur to/ /des dge sbyong 2—628

dang / bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / phongs pa dang / mdza' bo dang /nye du dang / gnyen bshesanyedang / zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la sbyin pa rnamakhupa du ma dag byin nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ byang chub don du gnyer ba yis//rgyal rigs bram ze rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs rigs gdol pa g.yung po la'ang / /'jigs pa med par sbyin pa gtangadu/ /gser dang dngul dang ba lang dang / /rta dang nor bu'i rna rgyan dang / /de bzhin las dag byed pa'i bran/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs la sbyin/ /chags pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bu dang bu mo yongs btang bas④/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /mi yis0dag pa thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus kyi0rgyal po thams cad sgrol zhes bya bar gyur pa gang gis dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang /bkren pa dang/ phongs pa dang / mdza' bo dang / nye du dang / gnyen bshes dang / zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la sbyin pa rnam pa du ma dag byin nasalgebasod nams dag byas pa de gzhan7zhig yin snyam na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta ste/nga nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po thams cad sgrol zhes bya ba der gyur te/ nga nyid kyis de na dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / phongs pa dang / mdza' bo dang / nye du dang / gnyen bshes dang / zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la sbyin pa rnam pa du ma dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas so/ /rgyal po chen po nga'i sbyin pa'am sbyin pa'i bgo bsha' des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo snyam na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ 'on kyang nga'i sbyin pa de ni thonyebla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu tsam dang /rkyen tsam dang / tshogs tsam yin no//2—529

rgyal po chen po gzhan yang ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i phyir sbyin pa dag btang / bsod nams dag byas pa gang yin pa de nyon cig /rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba thams cad ces bya'i ①gong rdal gyi grong khyer du ②rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen zhes bya ba zhig byung bar gyur te/ de 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa / skye bo dang mi mang pos rab tu gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / thabashemo dang /khrag khrug dang / 'gyed pa dang / chom rkun dang / nad rab tu zhi ba/'bras sā7lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang phun sum tshogs pa⑥/ bu gcig pa la byams pa bzhin du rgyal srid byed du bcugasheste/ chos bzhin gyis rgyal srid byed du 'jug go/ /des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas desadang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/de7rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ pags nyepa'i mdog gser 'dra ba / mgo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ dpung pa ring pa/ 'phral57ba'i dbyis che ba zhig btsas te/ de'i nye du rnams 'dus nas khye'u'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed do8/ /shes ldan dag gzhon nu 'di ni rgyal po thams cad bshes gnyen gyi bu yin pas gzhon nu thams cad sgrol zhes bya bar gdags sol/ /zhes gzhon nu thams cad sgrol du ming7btags nas/ ma ma brgyad la gtad de zhes bya ba nas/ gnas lnga rnams la byang bar gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /de gang ci slong ba desathams cad slong ba po dag la sbyin par byed pas de'i ming thams cad gtong ba thams cad gtong ba zhes bya bar 2—530

grags so/ /khams kyi rgyal phran gyi bu mo rgyags sbyin ma zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de de'i ched7du bslangs nas dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos bag mar blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las ji tsam na khye'u zhig btsas pa dang / de'i ming nag po zhes bya bar btags li/ /yang de dang rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu mo zhig btsas te/ de'i ming dra ba can zhes bya bar btags so/ /rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen la glang po'i⑧mchog bkra shis ldan zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i mthus khams kyi rgyal phran rnams spa 'gong bar byed do/ /des thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ bu bdag cagashegis gang cung zad khams kyi rgyal phran rnams spa 'gong bar byed pa de dag thams cad kyang glang po'ikhumachog 'di'i mthu yin gyis gakhyod thams cad gtong na yang glang po'i mchog bkra shis ldan ni zhog shig /khams kyi rgyal phran rnams kyis smras pa/ gang gi mthus na bdag cag thams cad rgyal po thams cad kyisabashes gnyen 'dis zil gyis mnan/ kha cig gis smras pa/ rgyal po thams cad bshes gnyen la glang po'i mchog bkra shis ldan zhes bya ba zhig yod dokyi/ /de'i mthus bdag cag 'dis zil gyis mnan to/ /de dag gis smras pa/ gang gis na glang po'i mchog de dgug pa'i thabs bzang po lta ci yod/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha rgyal po thams cad kyi (trebashes gnyen gyi bu thams cad sgrol zhes bgyi ba de mi sbyin pa'am mi gtong ba ci yang ma mchis te/ de ci slong ba de thams cad sbyin pas de'i ming thams cad yigatong ba thams cad gtong ba zhes bya bar grags kyis8/ bram ze dag cig mngags dang de rnams kyis bslangs na khugs par 2—531

'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis bram ze dag bkug nas smras pa/ bram ze dag dengatul thams cad ces bya ba'i grong rdal na/ thams cad sgrol zhes bya ba las glang po'i mchog slongs shig /de dag mngags nas thams cad kyi grong rdal du dong ngo / /gzhon nu thams cad sgrol glang po'i mchog me tog kun da dang / ku mu dasadang / kha ba dang / dngul dang / sprin dkar po'i mdog lta bu mche ba drug pa/ bdun legs par gnas pa/ glang po che sa srung gi bu ltar 'gyingasazhing 'gro ba/ rang bzhin gyi mtshan mchog gis brgyan pa/ mthong na bkra shis pa la zhon nas shin tu sdug pa'i bran dang / grogs po dang g.yog rnams phyi bzhin 'brang zhing zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba bzhin du0grong khyer nas byung nas skyed mos tshal logs su song ngo / /de nas mngags pa de dag gis gzhon nu thams cad sgrol mngon du bsusnyenas smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /yang smras pa/ lha0min lhar bcas 'jig rten du/ /khyod ni thams cad gtong zhes grags/ /khyod kyis glang po mchog 'di ni/ /bdag cag rnams la stsal ba'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' glang po'i mchog de las babs nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis bram ze de dag la glang po'i mchog de bstan nas smras pa/ ji ltar bdag rab dga' bas dengashe/ /bram ze rnams lasheglang chen btang / /de bzhin bdag gis srid pa gsum/ /btang nas byang chub mchog reg shog /blon po rnams kyis rgyal po thams cad bshes gnyen la smras pa/ lha khyod kyi sras thams cad sgrol gyis glang po'i mchog bkra shis ldan zhes bgyi ba phyir rgol bas mngags pa la stsal to/ /rgyal pos thos nas shin tu 2—532

khros 'khrugs te bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag dengatul thams cad sgrol khrid de shog shig /de rnams kyis desakhrid de 'ongs pa dang / rgyal po thams cad kyisabashes gnyen gyis thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ gzhon nu kho bos khyodakyil gang cung zad khams kyi rgyal phran rnams spa 'gong bar byed pa de thams cad ni glang po'i mchog 'di'i mthu yin gyis / khyod thams cad gtong na yang glang po'i mchog 'di ni〈zhog shig /ces snga mo zhig tu ma bsgo'am/ ci'i phyir khyod kyis glang po'i mchog yongs su btang / des mnyan nas smras pa/ yab bslangs na ji ltar mi stsal/ ci ji snyed bslangs pa de thams cad7sbyin nam/ tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ khyim na gnas pa'i skyes bu yis/ /ci rigasalgepar ni sbyin pa gtang / /'on te nags su song na ni/ /nges pa yi ni mchog bya'o/ /yab gal te sbyin pa dag btang / bsod nams dag bgyir ma mchis na dka' thub kyi nags su brten par bgyi'o/ /gzhon nu de bzhin du gyis shig /byang chub sems dpas rgyags sbyin ma'i drung du song ste smras pa/4 rgyags sbyin ma bdag ni dka' thub kyi nags su gnas kyis8/ khyod khyim na bag yod par gnos shig /des smras pa/ rje'i sras dang thabs cig dka' thub kyi nags su gnas par bgyi'o / /rgyags sbyin ma byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sbyin pa la dga' bas gal te khyod 'ga' zhig slong na byin par 'gyur ro/ /rje'i sras gal te khyod kyis btang na stsal du gsol/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ khyod kyis dam bcas pa 'di dran par byos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' pa'i drung du song nas mgo bos phyag byas te smras pa/ yab gcig bdag gis sbyin slad glang chen btang / /nongs pa gang lags sa bdag bzod par gsol/ /bdag ni 2—533

grong nas dgon par mchis lags kyis①/ /mi dbang khyod kyi phyag mdzod stongs ma gyur/ /de nas rgyal po bu dang bral ba'i blongaphubs mchi mas brnangs nas smras pa/ bu sbyin pa dang dka' thub kyi nags kyi blo gros 'di zlog shig /byang chub sems dpasashesmras pa/ sa ni ri dang bcas par yang / /gal te ldog par 'gyur gda' yi/ /sa bdag bdag ni sbyin pa las/ /sems ni ldog par mi bgyid do/ /zhes smras nas song ste/ byang chub sems dpa' bu dang bu mo dang / chung ma dang lhan cig shing rta mchog gi nang du zhugs nas dka' thub kyi nags su chas so/ /de nas bram ze rig byed dang rig byed kyi yan lag shes pa kha cig gis thams cad sgrol bsusnyenas smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /khyod ni 'jig rten thams cad du/ /thams cad gtong zhes rnam par grags/ /bram ze dag la shing rta 'di/ /khyod kyis sbyin par gtangakyiba'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol shing rta'i mchog de las babs nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i snying gis bram ze desnyedag la shing rta'i mchog de bstan nas smras pa/ji ltar bdag rab dga' bas deng / /bram ze rnams la shing rta btang / /de bzhin bdag gis srid pa gsum/ /btang nas byang chub mchog reg shog⑨ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rta la zhon nas rgyags sbyin ma dang lhan cig dong ba dang / de nas bram ze rig byed dang rig byed kyi yan lag shes pa kha cig gis thams cad sgrol bsutshwanyenas smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /khyod ni 'jig rten thams cad du/ /thams cad gtong zhes rnam par grags/ /bram ze rnams la rta 'di ni/ /khyod kyis sbyin par gtang7ba'i 2—534

rigs / /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol rta de las babs nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i snying gis bram ze de rnams la rta de bstan nas smras pa/ ji ltar bdag rab dga' bas deng / /bram ze rnams la rta btang ba/ /de bzhin bdag gis⑥srid pa gsum/ /btang nas byang chub mchog reg shog /de nas byang chub sems dpas ni nag po khrid/ rgyags sbyin mas ni dra ba can khrid de rkang pas dong nas byang chub sems dpas gangs ri'i sul me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chusaphun sum tshogs pasazhig tu song ste byang chub sems dpa' ni bsam gtanasabyed do / /rgyags sbyin masani 'bras bus bsnyen bkur byed do/ /ri 'orashegazhan zhig na bram ze zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de / de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u mtshan ngan pa bcwa ⑧brgyad dang ldan pa zhig btsas pa ngan 0to re zhes sgra 'byin pas de'i ming ngan to re ngan to re zhes bya bar yi gyur to/ /ri 'or ⑪gzhan zhig na bram ze rig 'byed bzhi shes pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las ji tsam na bu mo gzugs bzang mo mdzes 7)ske/ blta na sdug pa zhig btsas te bsrings bskyed nas chenatsomor gyur pa dang /bram ze des bdag gi bu mo 'di byad gzugs sam/ rigs sam/ bzo'am/nor gyi7phyir ni su la yang mi sbyin no/ /'on kyang su zhig bdag las rig byed bzhi klog pa zhiganyeyod na/ bdag gis de la 'di sbyin par bya'o zhes dam 2—535

bcas so/ /de nas ngan to re gsang tshig don du gnyer zhing gsang tshig tshol ba bram ze de'i gan du song ste phyin pa dang7smras pa/ mkhan po'i zhabs lasabakur sti bgyid par 'tshal lags so/ /ci'i phyir rig byed bklag⑧pa'i slad du'o / /de bzhin du gyis shig /de de las rig byed bklag par brtsams pa las de yid gzhungs pa'i rang bzhin can zhig yin pas des ring po ma lon par rig byed rnam pa bzhi la byang cibar gyur to/ /bram ze des bsams pa/ bdag gis dam bcas pa ni bdag gi bu mo 'di rigs sam zhes bya babargyas par sbyar te/bram ze'i khye'u 'dis bdag las rig byed bzhi byang bar byas pa yin na mtshan mkhungan pa bcwatubargyad dang ldan pa dze+e/ gal te 'dis bu mo ma 'dod na ni legs so snyam nas des de la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u bdag gis bu mo 'di byad gzugs sam/ rigs sam/ bzo'am/ nor gyi phyir su la yang mi sbyin te/'on kyang su zhig bdag las rig byed bzhi klog7pa zhig yod na/ bdag gis de la 'di sbyin par bya'o zhes dam bcas pa las bdag las khyod kyis rig byed bzhi byang bar byas pa las khyod la bu mo 'di chung mar sbyin no/ /des smras pa/bkra shis par gyur cig /blang bar bgyi'o zhes des de la dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos bag mar btang nas smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u7chung ma khrid la rang gi khyim du song shig /des chung ma de khrid de rang gi khyim du song ba dang / des de la smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag ni shin tu gzhin pas las bgyid rngo mi thog gis bdag la bkol7ba stsol cig /des de la smras pa/ bzang mo kho bo la bkol ba ga la mchis/ des smras pa/ rje'i sras thams cad ces bgyi ba'i grong rdal na rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen zhes bgyi ba de'i sras thams cad sgrol zhes bgyi ba 2—536

de gang cung zad ci slong ba de thams cad stsol gyis①/ de la bdag gi bkol ba slongs shig /bzang mo gal te de lta na lhan cig tu 'dong ngo / /de nas ngan to re thams cad kyi grong rdal du phyin nas dris pa/ gzhon nu thams cad sgrol gang na/ de dag gis smras pa/ dka' thub kyi nags na gnas so// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bzhi bcu rtsa〈bdun pa/ de nas ngan to re chung ma dang lhan cig dka' thub kyi nags su song ba dang / de'i tshe rgyags sbyin ma me tog dang 'bras bu'i phyir song ngo / /de nas bram ze ngan to re rgyags sbyin ma me tog dang / 'bras bu'i phyir song ba dang / thams cad sgrol gyi drung du 'ongs nas smras pa/ chu gter gos su gyon zhing gza' mig mtshungs med pa/ /ri bo mchog rgyas nu mar ldan pa'i ro stod can/ /grong khyer grong rdal bcas pa'i sa la btsal byas kyang / /mche bzangs lakhyod dang mtshungs por gtong phod yod ma yin/ /bdag cag bkol ba ma mchis pas/ /spa shug0lhan cig 'khyam0bgyid na/ /khyod kyis rjes su brtse bgyis te/ /bdag la bkol ba stsal ba'i rigs/ /kho bo la bkolasab ga la yod/ de dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na nag po dang dra ba can rtse zhing 'dug pa dang / des smras pa/ bus pa gzhon nu 'o ni dag byin7cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' bu sdug pa yongs su gtong ba la yud tsam zhig sems par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze des thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ kye rgyal rigs gzhon nu kho bos khyod thams cad gtong ba'o/ /zhes thos nas de'i phyir kho bo khyod la slong na/'di la khyod kyis dpyad du ci zhig yod/ snying rje yi ni bdag nyid khyod/ /thams cad gtong bar sa stengs grags/ /ji ltar grags pa de bzhin du/ /2—537

khyod kyis sa stengasatubya ba'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpas7bram ze de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rang gi srog ni gtong ba la'angashe/ /bdag gis res 'ga'ang ma dpyad na/ /rang gi bu ni gtongasab la / /bdag blo gzhan 'gyur smos ci dgos/ /bram ze chen po de lta mod kyi/bdag gis nags su bskyed bskyed pa'i⑤/ /bus pa 'di gnyis yongs spangs na//ma dang bral ba'i nyon mongs pa/ /'di dag ji ltar gnas snyam mod/ /gzhon nu shin tu brtse med pas/ /bus pa btang la bdag min zhes/ /kha cig bdag la 'phyar 'ong gisaX/ /bram ze bdag ni khrid na legs/ /de nas bram ze des byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal rigs gzhon nu rgyal po chen po'i rigs su skyes pa/ sa 'di thams cad du yon tan grags pa/srog chags thams cad la snying brtse bas 'o byams par zhugs pa/ sbyin pa dang ske/ mchod pa dang / bkur stes spos kyi glang po7lta bu/ dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang / glo bur bshedang / skye bo bla ma la mchod pa0/ bkren pa dang /mgon med pa dang / phongs pa rnams yongs su 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyi re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ mthong na don yod pa khyod kyis bdag 'ongs pa nom pa med pa'am/ lam gyis dub pa 'bras bu med pa'am/ mthong ba tedon med pa'am/ re ba dang yun ring po nas brnag 8brnag pa'i 'dod pa 'bras bu med par bya ba gang yin pa de ni cha ma yin te/ khyod kyi 8med do zhes bya ba'i tshig gis kho bo yid la re ba kun du rtog pa'i rta btab na myur du ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na khyod kyis bdag gi re ba yongs su rdzogs par byas te/gtang ba'i rigs so/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ bram ze gal te de lta 2—538

na yongs su gtanganyengo / /bus pa gzhon nu dag gtangasnyem thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyisakhams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bsams pa/ rgyags sbyin ma byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa'i bar chad byed par 'gyur du 'ong ngo snyam nas/ seng ge mo zhig gi gzugs su bsgyur te lam bkag nas 'dug pa dang / de nas rgyags sbyin mas smras pa/ ri dgas rgyal po'i chung ma sgeg sgegasam/ /khyod ni ci ste lam bkag 'dug par byed/ /gal te bdag ni mi 'phyo bden zhe na/ /lam las bzur te myur du 'gro bar gyis/ /khyod kyang ri dgas rgyal po'i chung ma la//bdag kyang mi yi dbang po seng ge yi/ /btsun mo yin pas chos kyi spun gyur gyisasti/ /ri dgas rgyal po'i chung mas bdag lam phye/ /de skad ces smras pa dang ske/ ri dgas kyi rgyal mo de lam de nas logs shig tu song ngo / /de nas rgyags sbyin ma bste gnas gang na ba der song ba dang / nag po dang / dra ba can gang na yang ma mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i drung du song ste smras pa/rje'i sras bus pa gzhon nu gnyis gang na mchis/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/kho bo'i drung du bram ze zhig /re bas yang dag 'ongs gyur na⑧/ /bus pa de gnyis de la byin/ /de dag7rjes su yi rang rigs/ /de brgyal nas sa la 'gyel ba dang / de la chu mang pos btab nas brtas〈 )te smras pa/ rje'i sras bus pa gzhon nu dka' thub kyi nags nas bskrun pa bde ba'i bdag nyid can de dag khyod kyis ci'i slad du yongs su spang()/ de nas byang chub sems dpas rang gi lus las7bla gos phud de rgyags sbyin ma la smras pa/ ci nga5)de gnyis la byams pa med snyam mamanya/ nga'i ba spu'i khung thams cad nas gas te khrag byung 2—539

ba la ltos/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bsams pa/ bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa la dga' bas gal te 'ga' zhig gis rgyags sbyin ma blangasatute de la byin na g.yog byed pa med par 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas / bdag nyid bram ze'i khye'u zhig gi cha byad du sprul nas byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du 'dug ste smras pa/ grogs po g.yog byin cig /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ bdag la g.yog ga la yod/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/rgyags sbyin ma byin cig /byang chub sems dpas〈rgyags sbyin ma'i gdong du brtag⑧par brtsams pa dang / rgyags sbyin mas0byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa shes nas smras pa/ rje'i sras gal te khyod kyis bdag0btang na stsal du gsol / byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ bram ze khyod la byin no/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bram ze'i khye'u'ishecha byad mi snang bar byas tesherang gi cha byad du 'dug nas smras pa/ drang srong bdag gi rgyags sbyin ma 'di khyod la bcol gyisal/ khyod kyis su la yang ma sbyin cig /rgyags sbyin mas brgya byin gyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos gtugs te smras pa/ kau shi 17ci nas kyang bus pa gzhon nu de gnyis bran nyid du mi 'gyur ba de ltar mdzod cig /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis de bzhin du bya'o zhes smras nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bus pa gzhon nu khyer ba'i bram ze ji ltar thams cad kyi grong rdal du 'tshong 0bar brtsams pa de ltar rmongs par byas so/ /de gnyis rgyal po'i zho shas 'tsho ba rnams kyis mthong nas de rnams rgyal po'i drung du dong7ste smras pa/ bus pa nag po dang / dra ba can ni bram ze zhig tshong 'dus na 'tshong zhing mchis lags so/ /des bsgo ba/2—540

shes ldan dag dengatul khrid de shog shig /de gnyis khrid de 'ongs pa dang /rgyal pos srang la bcalasate mnyam du gser gyis blus so/ /rgyal po des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag gang zhig khye'u dang bu mo yang yongs su gtongashebar byed pa de0la gzhan yongs su gtong bar mi bya ba ci yod/ gzhon nu de khug shig dang rgyal sridakyikyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug go/ /blon po rnams kyis de dka' thub kyi nags nas bkug ste/ de rgyal po'i rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la bzhag nas des grong khyer gyi sgo bzhir ⑧mchod sbyin gyi gnas kyi khang pa brtsigs nas lo mang po dang / lo brgya phrag mang po dang / lo stong phrag mang po dang / lo brgya stong phrag mang por sbyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas te de ⑨bdag nyid kyi mchod sbyin gyi phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ byang chub bsod nams don gnyer bas/ /dge sbyong rnams dang bram ze dang / /dmangs rigs gdol pa g.yung po layi /'jigs pa med par sbyin pa byin/ /gser dang dngul dang ba lang dang / /rta dang nor bu rgyan rnams dang / /de bzhin las dag byed pa'i bran/ /tshul khrims ldan pa rnams la sbyin/ /chags pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bu dang bu mo yongs btang bas/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /mi yis dag pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po thams cad sgrol zhes bya bar gyur pa gang gis bu dang chung ma yongs su btang ba de gzhan zhig yin snyam na/ khyod kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ 'on kyang nga nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po thams cad sgrol zhes bya ba der7gyur te/ ngas de na bu dang chung ma yongs su btang ngo / /rgyal po chen po ngas bu dang chung ma yongs su btang ba 2—541

des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo snyam na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ 'on kyang7sbyin pa de ni bla na med pasayang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu tsam dang / rkyen tsam dang / tshogs tsam yin no//rgyal po chen po chagazhan yang ngas bla na med pa yang dag ①par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i phyir sbyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas pa gang yin pa de nyon cig /rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed de/ du'abyor pa dang /rgyas pa dang zhes bya ba nas chos bzhin gyis ⑦rgyal srid byed do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ji tsamanyen ltas mkhan dag gis bā rā ṇa sīr7lo bcu gnyis su char pa mi 'bab bo zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs sbyin gyis rang gi yul du dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ nga'i yul na gnas pa'i shes ldan grong khyer pa dag nyon cig /ltas mkhan dag gis lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bab par lung bstan gyis(nye/ khyodatshwanyecag las gang dag la lo bcu gnyis su bza' ba dang btung btsayod pa de rnams ni 'dug shig /gzhan rnams ni bza' ba dang btung ba mod pa'i yul du dengs7shig /lo legs par gyur pa dang slar yang shog shig /de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sri'i ⑩grong khyer na khyim bdag 'dum byed ces bya ba phyug pa nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzunganyeb yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig gnas so/ /des mngan bkug7ste smras pa/kye nang rje bang ba na bdag 'khor gyi skye bo dang bcas pa lo bcu gnyis kyi rgyags 2—542

thub panyeyod dam/ 'on te med des smras pa/ jo bo mchis so/ /de nas khyim bdag 'dum byed 'khor dang bcas pa ni 'dug go/ /skye bo'i tshogs gzhan ni bza' ba dang btung ba mod pa'i yul du dong ngo / /sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang ngan pa la snying brtse ba can/bas mtha'i gnas malasal dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu dag 'byung bar 'gyur bas ji tsam na bā rā ṇa sī'i7phyogs gcig tu rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya gnas so/ /phyogs gzhan zhig tu yang rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya'o/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya po dag snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ khyim bdag 'dum byed gang na ba der dong ste lhags pa dang /khyim bdag 'dum byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag khyod kyis rab tu byung ba lnga brgya la lo bcu gnyis su bsod snyoms 'bul nus sam/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag re zhig mnganakhul rmas te bgyi'o/ /des mngan⑧bkug ste smras pa/ kye nang rje bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rab tu byung ba lnga brgya po 'di rnams kyi lo bcu gnyis kyi rgyags thub pa yod dam/ des smras pa / jo bo mchis so/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya po de rnams la khas blangs so/ /ji tsam na phyi dro'i dus su rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya po gzhan yang lhags nas khyim bdag 'dum byed la khyim bdag rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya po 'di dag la khyod kyis yilo bcu gnyis su bsod snyoms dbul 8bar nus sam zhes bslangs5)pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag la g.yar gyis blangs lags na yang bslang ci 'tshal/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag de dag kyang gzhan la/ bdag cag kyang gzhan yin no/ /des smras pa/2—543

'phags pa dag gal te de lta na re zhig mnganatul rmas te bgyi'o/ /des mnganasabakug ste smras pa/ kye nang rje bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rab tu byung ba stong gi⑧lo bcu gnyis kyi rgyags thub pa0yod dam/ des smras pa/ jo bo mchis so/ /de nas khyim bdag des rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya po de rnams la khas blangs nas zhus0pa/ khyed cag gi dus gang lags/ de rnams kyisashesmras pa/ gung tshigs ma yol ba'o/ /de nas khyim bdag 'dum byed kyis7sbyin pa'i khang pa brtsigs nas sbyin pa'i zhal ta pa'i mi dag kyang bskosal/ dus tshod brjod pa dag kyang bskos te/ des nyi ma re re zhing rang sangs rgyas stong la bsod snyoms 'bul du bcug go/ /mu ge de yang lo bstud skyem kho nar bar ye ma chad nas/ de nas khyim bdag des rang sangs rgyas rnams la zhus pa/'phags pa dag lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ram/ char 'bebs par 'gyur ro / /bdag gisanyes bon stsal tamanya/ thob shig /de dag gis sa bon btab bol/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi shes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas7des bsams pa 'jig rten na yon gnas gang ji snyed pa de rnams kyi mchog ni rang sangs rgyas rnams yin la/ sbyin bdag gang ji snyed pa de rnams kyi mchog ni khyim bdag 'dum byed yin gyisatso/ bdag gis 'di dag gi grogs bya'o snyam nas/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis dbang po chen po'i char phabalgepa dang / lo tog de rnams ku bar skyes so/ /de nas skye bo'i tshogs de rnams kyis rang sangs rgyas rnams la zhus pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gi lo thog bskrun pa gang lags pa de dag ku5)bar skyes par gyur na de la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ ma bcad0 par skrun 2—544

cig /de rnams kyis bskrun pa las me tog dang 'bras bu rdza ma'i tshad tsam chags so/ /de nas de rnams kyis rang sangs rgyas de dag la rgyas par smras pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ ma bcadatucig dang / rang nyid smin nas gas par 'gyur ro/ /ji tsamasan de rnams smin nas gas pa dang / gang gis sa bon ji lta bu btab ba de'i desakho na lta bu sha stag gis gang bar gyur to/ /de nas mu ge rgyun chad de 0lo legs par gyur nas yul phyogs sna tshogs na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang / srog chags gang dag mu gis 'jigs skrag nas dong ba rnams kyang yul bā rā ṇa sīrakyi'ongs so/ /de nas mu ge rgyun chad de lo legs par gyur nas khyim bdag 'dum byed kyis de na rang sangs rgyas stong la gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba sna tshogs dang / tshod ma ro dang ldan pa rnams kyis tshim par byas te tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ blo ldan mkhas pas nor dang ni/ /dad pa shes rab rnyed nas ni/ /skyes bu de yis rtag par yang / /'dod chags bral la yon dbul lo/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan pa'i/ /brtan rnams gang gis bshos gsol ba/ de yisherigs ni bde bar 'phel/ /de ltasashetshul khrims phun7tshogs pa'i/ /yon gnas dag la yon phul na/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /bde ba dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag 'dum byed ces bya bar gyur pa gang gis mu ge lo bcu gnyis su byung ba na rang sangs rgyas stong la bsod snyoms sbyar cing de'i grogs lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byas pa de gzhan ()zhig yin snyam na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta ste/'on kyang nga nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag 'dum byed ces bya ba der gyur 2—545

te①la/ nga nyid kyis〈de na mu ge lo bcu gnyis su byung ba na rang sangs rgyas stong la bsod snyoms sbyar bas nga'i grogs lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byas sol/ /rgyal po chen po nga'i sbyin pa'am/ sbyin pa'i bgo bsha'7des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob po snyam na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta0ste/'on kyang nga'i sbyin pa de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu tsam dang / rkyen tsam dang / tshogs tsam yin no// //sdom la/ sprin shugs dbang po sbrul mgo gnyis/ /de bzhin chu sregashene tso dang ske/ / ston mo ru sbal sde bzangs dang / /ded dpon tshogs su bsdus pa yin / /rgyal po chen po gzhan yang ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i phyir sems can rnams rjes su gzungasab byas pa gang yin pa de nyon cig /rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba 'dzam bu'i gling gi don mthun nor tshol bsherab tu mang po dag cig rgya mtsho'i gru bo che bsgrubs te/ rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par 'dod nas de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag bdag cag rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa rnams 'di lta ste/ gcig la gcig phan thogs par mngon pa med kyis(nye/ ma la bdag cagatshwanyenor tshol ba rnams so so nas phongs pa na dgos pa rkyal〈nyegyi cha spyad dag khyer te rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par bya'o zhes de ltar chas bcad nas nor tshol ba rnams so so nas phongs pa na dgos pa rkyal7gyi cha spyad kha cig gis ni shing shal ma li'i spang leb/ kha cig gis ni ras sgye nang tshangs can/ kha cig gis ni ku ba brgyus(nyepa/ kha cig gis ni ra rkyal khyer te rgya mtsho chen por zhugs so/ /de rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i 2—546

dbus su phyin pa dang / chu srin nya'i rigs kyis rgya mtsho'i gru bo che bshig go/ /gru bo che bshig pa dang / de rnams rkyal pa re re la zhon te chu ji lta ba bzhin du khyer te dong ba las/ de rnams kyi las kyi rnam7par smin pa las byung ba'i rlung byang phyogs nas langs te/ des lho phyogs kyi 'gram du khyer ba dang / de na bud med gzugs bzangasamo/ mdzes ma blta na sdug pa dag yod de/ de dag gis 'di skad7ces smras so/ /jo bo dag tshur spyon bzhin bzangs dag tshurakyispyon / bdag cag jo bo ma mchis pa rnams kyi jo bo dang / khyim thab ma mchis pa rnams kyi khyim thab dang / gnas ma mchis pa rnams kyi gnas dang / gling ma mchis pa rnams kyi gling dang / mgon ma mchis pa rnams kyi mgon dang /skyabs ma mchis pa rnams kyi skyabs dang / rten ma mchis pa rnams kyi rten mdzod cig /'di dag ni khyodasakyi zas7kyi khang pa dang / skom gyi khang pa dang ske/ gos kyi khang pa dang / gnas mal gyi khang pa dang / dga' bar 'gyur ba'i kun dga' ra ba dang / dga' bar 'gyur ba'i tshal dang / dga' bar 'gyur ba'i rdzing dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi rin po che rab tusamang po 'di lta ste/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūr+ya7dang / dung dang /man shel dang / byi ru dang / dngul dang / gser dang / rdo'i snying po dang / spug dang / pad ma rā ga dang / dung dang / g.yas su 'khyil pa dag lags kyis〈nyekhyed tshur spyon/ bdag cag dang lhan ciganyertsed mo bgyi/dga' bar bgyi/ dga' mgur spyad par bgyi'o/ /khyed cag las su yang smyos kyang lho phyogs kyi lam du ma bzhud cig /de dag bud med de rnams dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/2—547
