rgyal mtshan gyis mchod do/ /rgyal por gyur nasatusangs rgyas ni/ /don dam gzigs pa grong mchog tu/ /'jug pa de la ta la yi/ /lo ma'i bsil yab mchod pa byas/ /nga ni tshong dpon gyur pa na/ /'jig rten gsal mdzad sangs rgyas ni/ /shākya thub lasame tog gi/ /sil ma sna tshogs dri sbyar mchod/ /grong khyer mchog tu mthor 'phags pa'i/ /mi mchog 'jug par mthong nas ni/ /rol mo rnams kyi sgra dag dang / /me tog rnams kyisalgemachod pa byas/ /rgyal por gyur tshe dad pa0yis/ /sangs rgyas dam pa zhes bya ba/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rgal ba la/ /thog mar shing rta dag gis bstabs/ /nga ni rgyal por gyur pa na/ /gtso bo'i ched du lam bstanarnyucing / /dpag tshad brgya ni gang bar yang / /me tog khang brtsegs mchod pa byas/ /sangs rgyas dgra zhi mdzad pa ni / /grong khyer gshegs zhes ngas thos nas/ /lam ni rgyal mtshan yongs bkangasaste / /rgyal po'i 'byor pas bsu ba byas/ /nga ni mnyan par gyur pa na/ /shing rta'i yan lag chu 'gram du/ /byon pa ngas ni mthong nas ni/ /thub pa chu yi rgyun las bsgral/ /ded dpon gyur tshe dad pa yisasti/ /shing rta skal ldan chen po ni/ /ngas ni gru zam btags nas kyang / /mtsho chen las ni bsgral ba byas/ /nga ni rgyal por gyur pa na/ /rkang gnyis dam pa sangs rgyas ni/ /tshangs la tsan dan sa mchog gi/ /ka bar ldan pa'i khang pas mchod/ /rgyal por gyur tshe sangs rgyas ni/ /bcom ldan tshangs pa'i tshe mchod cing / / snam sbyar〈nyergyal mtshan bsgreng nas ni/ /ngas ni yams kyi nad zhi byas/ /tsan dan ldan la char7med tshe/ /rgyal po lta bu'i sku khrus byas/ /de tshe lhas ni char phab pas/ /skye bo rnams ni skyabs su dong / /nga ni rgyal por gyur pa na/ /sangs rgyas 2—646

bcom ldan zla ba la/ /mchod nas ngas ni byams bsgoms pas/ /bdud kyis btang ba'i yams nad zhi/ /mi yi dbang por sngon gyur tshe/ /ngas ni byang chub 'dod pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas dbang po 'dul ba la/ /cho 'phrul phyir ni gsol ba btab/ /rgyal po dag tu gyur pa na/ /rin chen ri bo 'od chen ldan/ /'khor ni brgya stong phrag mang po/ /mthong nas lo lngar mchod pa byas/ /bram zer gyur tshe dad pa7yis②/ /sangs rgyas don kun sgrubasnyepa ni/ /mtshan dang ldan pa mthong nas kyang / /ngas༄ni bstodasnyipa lnga brgya byas/ /bram zer gyur tshe yid dga' bas/ /sangs rgyas dbang po rgyal mtshan mthong / /ngas ni thal mo legs sbyar te/ /dam pa 465 ba'i 'os zhes gsol/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad pa nas/ /thub pa dbang po'i57rgyal mtshan bar/ /bdun khri dang ni drug stong gi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni nga yis mchod/ /grangs med gnyis pa tshang bar ni/ /rgyal ba nga yis ⑧mchod byas te/ /byang chub phyir ni spyod pa na/ /de tshe nga la skyo sems med/ /grangs med pa gnyis pa'o//sangs rgyas bde mdzad dam pa la/ /rgyal por gyur tshe mchod byas te⑨/ /mya ngan 'das nas mchod rten brtsigs/ /rgyal srid rab tu zhi bar byas/ /rgyal por gyur tshe dad pas7 ni/ /sangs rgyas gang po re skong la/ /tshul dang 'dra bar mchod byas te/ /chos kyi rgyal po zhes bsgrags so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad zil gnon la/ /tshong dpon gyur tshe legs par ni/ /rim gro byas shing mi mchog la/ /de bzhin gser gyi me tog gtor/ /nga ni tshong dpon gyur pa na/ /sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can/ /thub chen grong mchog gshegs de la/ /gser gyi dra bas mchod pa byas/ /nga ni tshong dpon gyur pa na/ /2—647

pad ma dam pa dpa' chen po/ /rgyal por grags7pa'i grong mchog tu/ /dngul gyi me tog sil mas gtor/ /nga ni bram zer gyur pa na/ /sangs rgyas grags mchog slob masheyi/ /dge 'dun gyis ni mdun bltas pa/ /mthong nas mi mchog gnas kyis mchod/ /nga ni rgyal por gyur pa na/ /legs gsung byang chub shing drung du/ /bzhugs pa ngas mthong glang po rta/ /shing rta dpung bu chung gis bsrungs/ /sangs rgyas dri med thub chen la/ /tshong dpon gyur tshe bsro gangasnyedang / /mchod rten las dang mar mes ni/ /de yi tshe na rnam par mchod//sangs rgyas sad mdzad rdo leb stengakyi/ /snyoms par zhugasalgepa mthong nas ni/ /dad pas rol mo'i sgra kun dang / /rgyal po'i 'byor pas bzhengs gsol to/ /tshong dpon du ni gyur pa na/ /'jig rten dga' mdzad dgra thul lge/ /sangs rgyas spyod pas gshegs pa na/ /lam ni sna tshogs brgyan pas mchod/ /tshong dpon gyur7tshe yid dga' bas/ /gnas 'jogashegashegs pa thos nas ni/ /skyed mos tshal ni brgyan byas nas/ /ngas ni gtsug lag khang brtsigs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan skar 'od la/ /byang chub 'dod pas dad pas ngas0/ /rgyal po'i mdzod ni thams cad nas0/ /nor bu rin chen rnams kyis mchodahu/ /nga ni rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe/ /tog gis bdud7rnams bcom nas ni8/ /chos kyi rgyal srid bsgrags pa na/ /ngas ni rgyal mtshan kho na btsugs/ /bha ra dwasadza blo ldan pa/ /bram ze mya ngan 'das pa la/ /rgyal posnyings ni ril ba dang / /dbyug gu gtsug lag khang chen byas/ /nga ni ded dpon gyur pa na/ /sangs rgyas 'dren pa don gzigs pa/ /gser dang nor bu mu tig dang / /dri yi snying po rnams kyis mchod/ /sangs rgyas don kun sgrub pa ni/ /sangs rgyas 2—648

spyod pas gshegs pa na/ /rgyal por gyur tshe dpung dag gi①/ /tshogs kun gyis ni mchod pa byas/ /sangs rgyas don dam gzigs pa ni/ /grong khyer dam par gshegs pa na/ /rgyal por gyur tshe rol mo dang / /me tog kun gyis mchod pa byas/ /nga ni ded dpon gyur pa na/ /sangs rgyas skar7rgyal rkang gnyis mchog /dri yi snying po de bzhin du/ /rtsa ba'i dri rnams rab tu gtor/ /rin chen bkra ba'i phug na yang / /sangs rgyas skar rgyal lasani ngas/ /de tshe tshigs bcad gcig bstod pas/ /bskal pa dgu ni phyir bsnyil to/ /'bru 'tshong du ni gyur pa na/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnamasagazigs la/ /de tshe byang chub spyod pa'i phyir/ /mud ga spar gang phul bas mchod/ /tshong dpon gyur tshe ngas mchod pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog ni gtsug tor can/ /thub pa nyan thos tshogs bcas pa/ /zhal zas kyis ni zla gsum mchod/ /tshong dpon du ni gyur pa'i tshe//'jig rten 'dren pa thams cad skyob/ /skal chen nyan thos bcas pa 'khya/ /zhal zas kyis7ni gus par mchod/ /tshong dpon gyur tshe dad pa yis/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig pa ni/ /bdog pa kun la spyan drangs7nas/ / tshangs par spyod phyir blo gros bskyed/ /tshong dpon du ni gyur pa na/ /yang dag sangs rgyas gser thub la/ /gtsug lag khang brtsigs dad pa yis/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /bram ze'i khye'u bla ma'i tshe/ /dga' skyong gi ni tshig thos nas/ /'od srung7rkang gnyis mchog las ni/ /rab tu 'byung ba'i blo bskyed do / /byams pa drang srong gyur pa na/ /rgyal por gyur nas rim gro byas/ /byas pa gzo ba rjes dran nas/ / des ni nga la slar mchod do/ /gang yang sangs rgyas bde mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung bar du ni/ /ngas ni 2—649

bdun khri bdun stong gi/ /rgyal ba rnams ni mchod pa byas/ /grangs med gsum po tshang bar ni/ /rgyal ba ngas ni mchod byas te/ /sngon ni byang chub spyodatupa na/ /nga la skyo ba'i sems med do/ /nga ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas mchog ni de rnams mchod/ /nga ni de dag thams cad kyis/ /'jig rten mdun⑧du lung bstan to/ /ngas ni sngon bsamasalgegang yin pa/ /nga yi smon lam thams cad rdzogs/ /ngas ni sangs rgyas khur bor te/ /sems can rnams ni rjes su bzungakyi/ /shi bi'i rgyal por nga gyur tshe༅/ /sbyin pa dag ni thams cad btang / /nga ni dus dpog gyur pa'i tshe/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /rgya mtsho'ikhutshong par gyur pa na/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin don du/ /srog chags rnams ni ma btang zhing / /ngas ni rang gi srog btang ngo / /nga sngon drang srong gyur pa na/ /bzod pa'i pha rol rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /yan lag rnams ni gtubs pa yis/ /nga yi bzod pa yongs su rdzogs/ /mi ma yin mo'i skyes rabasalodang / /de bzhin rgya mtsho bskams5)pa dang / /de bzhin bdag ni bden dga' ba'i/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /sman chen blon por gyur pa dang / /gnag lhas skyes su nga gyur tshe/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs nas/ /de bzhin rnga bo che yang bsgrags/ /bram ze rab 'bar gyur pa na/ /ral par 'dabanyechags tshang bcas kyang / /bsam gtan las ni ma langs par/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin brtson byas/ /snying rje yongs su bsgoms byas shing / /pha rol phyin pa drug rdzogs pas/ /khur lci ba ni ngas bor te/ /dam bcas pa yang rdzogs par byas/ /nga dang sangs rgyas gang phrad tsonas/ /mchod pa byas pa'i mi mchog ni/ /de kun mya ngan 'das par 2—650

gshegs / /nga ni byang chub la bzhag go/ /rgyal po 'od ldan dbang po nas/ /thub pa dbang po'i ①rgyal mtshan bar/ /sems can bye ba phrag stong ni/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bsnyebyas/ / 'jig rtenashegatso bo rnam 'dren0pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas te lha mir bcas/ /'jig rten 'di ni bsgral ba dang / /sgrol dubar mdzad ⑥pa smos ci dgos/ /ngas ni 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /mya ngan 'das na'ang chos kyi gru / /brtan pa dag ni bca' byas te/ /brgya stong phrag ni bsgral bar bya/ /mi gang sangs rgyas skyabs song zhing / /mya ngan 'das kyang sangs rgyas la/ /bya ba byed pa'i skyes bu de/ /'jig rten dag ni skyid ⑦de ba/ /gang dag de bzhin gshegs rgyal la/ /bya ba cung zad byedakuna'ang de/ /mtho ris sna tshogs bgrod nas ni/ /bdud rtsi'i7go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur⑩/ /yang dag ji bzhin 'di thos nas/ /dge ba bungs ni bskyed de bya/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'khyams sa re/ /sangs rgyas mang po'i skabs rdzogs so// //sangs rgyas 'od ldan dang / shākya thub pa dang / kauṇ+ḍi7rgya dang / 'jig rten 'dren dang / gzhan gyis mi thub dang / rin chen gtsug tor dang /bde mdzad dang / sgra snyan dang / dpal 'byung dang / phan bzhed dang /kauṇ+ḍi7rgya dang / bltasnyin sdugatsodang / spyan mdzes7dang / yul 'khor skyong dang / mar me mdzad dang / dka' thub mdzad dang / mun sel dang /bde mdzad dang / dbang chen dang / gtsug tor can dang / ma 'gags pa dang / spyan mdzes dang / legs 'khrungs dang / yid bzangs dang /tsan dan dang / tshangs sbyin dang / 'od zer can dang / don dam 2—651

gzigs dang / shākya thub pa dang / mthoratu'aphags dang / dam pa dang /gtso bo dang / dag⑧ni mdzad dang / shing rta'i yan lag dang / skal ldan shing rtasadang / tshangs pa dang / tshangs pa'i tshe dang / tsan dan dang /dbang po dang / dbang po dul0dang / rin chen ri bo dang / don thams cad sgrubalgepa dang / tha mkhudabang po'i rgyal mtshan dang / bzod pa mdzad dang / rdzogs ldan dang / thams cad zil gnon dang / rin chen gtsug phud dang / pad mashedam pa dang / grags pa dam pa dang / gsungashesnyan dang / dri ma med dang / sadakumadzad dang / dgra thul dang / gnas 'jog dang / skar 'od dang / tog dang / drang srong dang / bha ra dwa dza dang / don gzigs dang / don dam gzigs dang / don thams cad gzigs dang / rgyalachadang / skar rgyal dang / rnam par gzigs dang /gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob dang / log par dad sel dang /gser thub dang / 'od srung dang / shākya thub pa dang / tha ma byams pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rnams7rdzogs sgotsho// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas zhes bya ba gong ma bzhin du ste/ de nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe gzhan mu stegs can kun tu rgyu rab tu mang po rtog khang ⑩du lhags shing 'dus par gyur nas skabs kyi gtam 'di ltasabu dag gleng bar byed de/ shes ldan dag shes par gyis ste shig /sngon ni bdag cag la rgyal po dang / blon po dang /2—652

bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / grong mi7dang / yul mi⑧dang / tshong pa dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon rnams kyis bkur steshebyas/ bla mar byas/ rjed par byas pas gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang /nad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyang rnyed pa las/ da ni dge sbyong go ta ma 'jig rten du byung ba laphubakur ste0byed/ bla mar byed/ rjed par byed/mchod par byed ces bya ba nas sman dang yo byad rnams zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /des na dbaltar bdag cag gi rnyed pa dang bkur sti thams cad kyi thams cad du chad na/ de la dkyibadag cag gis7ji ltar bya/ de nas kha cig gis smras pa/ tshangs par spyod pa la mi tshangs par spyod pa skyon yin pas de la skyon 'di gdags so/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ ji lta bu zhig bya/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag gi nang na kun du rgyu gzugs bzeng mo mdzes pa blta na sdug pa gang yin pa de la0sring mo dag tshur dge sbyong gi ta ma la skur pa thob cig ces spro bar bya'o/ /bdag cag gi nang na kun tu rgyu gzugs bzang mo mdzes pa blta na sdug pa gang yin/ bram ze'i bu mo rtswa mi7yin no/ /de la spro ba bskyed do zhes de rnams kyis de pho nyas bkug ste smras pa/ sring mo shes par gyis shig /sngon ni bdag cag gis bkur sti dang zhes bya ba nas nad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /da ni dge sbyong go ta ma 'jig rten du byung bas 'jig rten de la bkur ste byed pas bdag cag gi rnyed pa dang bkur ste thams cad kyi thams cad du chad par gyur na/ khyod kyis yal bar dor byaram/ bram ze'i bu mo kun tu rgyu rtswa mis ⑩smras pa/'phags pa dag bdag gis de la ji ltar bgyi lags/ sring mo khyod kyisanyenye 2—653

du rnams kyi ched du dge sbyong gi ta ma la kho mo dang lhan cig tu mi tshangs par spyadatudo zhes khyod skur pa 'debs par spro'am de lta na bdag cag ②gi rnyed pa dang bkur ste0sngon gyi bzhin0du 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / bram ze'i bu mo kun du rgyu rtswa misalgegazhan mu stegs can dang / kun du rgyu rab tu mang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa dag dge sbyong go ta ma la ni skur pa 'debs par bdag mi spro'o/ /sring mo khyod ji tsam du dge slong0gi ta ma la skur pa 'debs par ⑧mi spro ba de tsam du bdag cag dang ⑨gtam 'dre (sprebar mi bya/phebs par smra bar〈nyami bya/ blta bar mi bya/ rnam par blta bar mi bya zhing khyod gnas thams cad du 'dug tu mi gzhug ste/ 'gyod pa de nyid kyis dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa'i gnas de yod do/ /bud med ni shes rab chung ba yin pas de 8skrag nas smras pa/'phags pa bdag gis ji lta bu zhig bgyi/ sring mo tshuranyekhyod5)rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi (nye tshal du rgyun du song la dus tha (7gi tsam lon nas dge sbyong gau ta ma la skur pa thobasnyi shig /de nyi ma re re zhing langs te nyergyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /ji tsam na sto la snod cig bcings stenas bcom ldanake 'das gang na ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la chos 'chad cing bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze'i bu mo kun du rgyu rtswa mi ⑦rgyang ring po kho na nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga nyenyid kyis las rnams byas shing bsags pa/ tshogs rnyed pa/rkyen yongs su bsgyur khyab/ 'od pa bzhin tu )nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba rnams gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong nyebar 'gyur snyam 2—654

mo / /de nas bram ze'i bu mo kun tu rgyu rtswa mi7bcom ldan 'das kyisaspyan sngar 'dug nas gsol pa/ bdag ni 'di ru sbrum bgyis nas/ /chags par 'gyur zhing dga' 'gyur ba/ /snyan cing 'jebasalgepa'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /da lta chos ni gsung mdzad dam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyisasnyibaka' stsal pa/ yang dag min pa smra ba dmyal bar 'gro/ bram ze'i bu mo rtswa misalgegasol pa/ gang gis7byas nas ma byas zhes smra'amanya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dman pa'i chos can mi ni de gnyi ga⑨ /pha rol dag tu 'dra bar7'gro bar 'gyur / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma bram ze'i bu mo rtswa ⑩mi 'di ni bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la yun ring mo nas mtho 8'tsham par byed do snyam du bsams nas rdzu 'phrul gyis snod de sa la lhung bar byas so/ /de nas bram ze'i bu mo rtswa mi skyengs nas rings pa rings par slar song ngo / /de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la chos kyi dbang du bgyi ba'i bka' mchid kyang bka'algestsal/ gang du thog mar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa yang lung bstan/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa yang bka' stsal lags pas ci nas bdag cag mtsho chen po ma dros par mchis la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'tsho zhing gzhes (nyepa rnams kyi gdon mi za bar 2—655

mdzad patuni bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ ji srid sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa dang ske/ sems can 'gas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu phyir mi ldog pa'ishesems bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis gdulasabar bya ba thams cad btulasnyib dang / nyan thos kyi mchog zung gcig tu bstan pa dang / mtshams bcad pa dang / sku tshe'i⑧lnga cha btang ba dang / mnyan yod du cho 'phrul chen po rnam par bstan pa dang / grong khyer gsal bar lha las gshegs pa bstan pa dang yab dang yum gnyis bden pa dag la bkod pa dang /mtsho chen po ma dros par nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba bstan pa ma mdzad pa de srid du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /don 'di la ni bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig mtsho chen po ma dros par sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan par bzhed nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mtsho chen po ma dros pa gang na bar 'dong / der rang rang gi sngon gyi las kyi rgyusheb lung bstan par bya'o/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa lnga brgyar gcig gis ma tshang ba dang thabs cig tu mnyan yod nas mi snang bar gyur te mtsho chen po ma drosalgepar gshegs so/ /gnod sbyin gtum7po mi bzad gnas pa yid 'ong zhing / /me tog sna tshogs shing gis rnam par mdzes byas pa/ /de las rgya mtsho dug can dag tu 'gro ba yi/ /chu bo chen porwa)bzhi po 'di dag phyogs bzhir 'bab/ /gang gā sin 67de bzhin pa k+ṣa dang / /si ta de la rdzu 'phrul stobs thob pa/ /ma gtogs mi rnams kyis ni mi bgrod7pa/ /der 2—656

ni thub pa dge 'dun bcas par bzhugs/ /de nasatubacom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad de/ chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad pa de'i tshe srog chags grog sbur yan chad kyi semasasakyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa shes par 'gyur bas/ de nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nyesadaga' bo gnyis kyis bsams pa/ ci'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugaso bskyed pa mdzad snyam na/ mtsho chen po ma dros par las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan par bzhed par mthong ngo / /de nas de gnyis kyis mtsho chen po ma dros pa'i nang du pad ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa0shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam bzang po thams cad gser las byas pa/ sdong po ni rin po che/ ge sar ni rdo rje las byas pa/pad ma stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba zhig sprul pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la pad ma'i snying po de la bzhugs so/ /dge slong gnas brtan0gnas brtan rnams kyang pad ma gzhan rnams kyi snying po la 'khod do/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la snam sbyar 'drubalgebo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu song la rab tu byung ba'i zla bo khrid de shog shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu7chen po mtsho chen posam dros pa nas mi snang bar gyur cing bya rgordo kyi phung po'i ri la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ston pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgyar gcig gis ma tshang ba dang thabs cig tu mtsho chen po ma dros pa na sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan par 2—657

bzhed nas khyod la gzhes kyis ①tsar shog 'dong / des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po re zhig snam sbyar drubs la de nas phyis 'gro'o/ /des smras pa/ grogs bya'o/ /de bzhin du gyis shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa modakugal gyi bu chen pos rdzu 'phrul gyis sor mo lnga char gyis drub par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa modasnyegal gyi bu chen po 'o na lta drub zin du zad mod/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gal te khyod mi 'gro na mthus bkur bar bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ske rags rgya cang phrol nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po khyod bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin na④/ re zhig khyod kyis 'di khyer la7de nas phyis kho botswakhyer cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos de drangs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/ 'di ni mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che ba yin pas gal te 'di khyer7bar 'gyur ba'i gnas 'di yod do snyam nas des de bya rgod kyisaphung po'i ri'i spyil btags7so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos de drangs pa dang / bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri 'gul bar gyur to/ ṇa tshe dang ldan pa shāsnyiri'i bus7bsams pa/ 'dis bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri yang khyer bar 'gyur gyis7/ ma la bdag gis ri'i rgyal po ri rab la gdags so snyam nas/ des de ri'i rgyal po ri rab la btags pa las/ yang tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos de drangs pa dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo dag kyang g.yos par gyur/ ma dros pa yang kun nas 'khrugs shing dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyang ldeg par gyur nas pad ma'i snying 2—658

po la 'dug bzhin du de rnams kyisatubacom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa ci'i slad du klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo gnyis g.yos lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dga' bo dang nye dga' bo gnyis g.yos pa ma yin te/ 'on kyang nyan thos chen po gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par 'phrul par byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab 'di yang khyerakhubar 'gyur gyis③/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi pad ma'i sdong po la gdags so snyam nas/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi pad ma'i sdong po la btags pas ma 'gul bar0'dug go/ /gang gi tshe de'i rdzu 'phrul la rdzu 'phrul gyis rdugs pa de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu khyod kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse ba0byas zin gyisakyitshur shog 'dong / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po song shig dang kho bo 'ong ngo zhes byas nas ji srid tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ma phyin pa de'i bar du tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ⑦sngar phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas7te pad ma'i snying po la 'dug pa dang / de'i 'og tu tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po phyin pas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mthong nas des smras pa⑨/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i7 bu 'ongs sam/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bo7'ongs so/ /dge slong rnams the tshomanyeskyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ 'on kyang tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyisalgepam par bgyis pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/2—659

dge slong dag da lta7'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus na yang bzos pham par byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba yulakhudabus su ri mo mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig byung ngo / /de dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi⑧phyir yul dbus nas yul nas can zhes bya bar song ngo / /de de na 'khrul 'khor gyi sgyu༄rtsal gyi slob dpon zhig gi khyim du zhugs pa las/ desasnyide ngal0ba'i rim gro bar 'khrul 'khor las bu mo zhig byas nas btang ngo / /des de'i rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas 'dug go/ /de nas des songasashig ces smras na/ de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /des bsams pa/ gdon ma zos par7'di bdag dang dga' mgur spyad pa'i phyir btang ngo snyam nas/ des de'i lag pa nas bzung ste drangs pa las ji tsam natshwa)zhig nas shing brul gyi phung por gyur to/ /de skyengs nas bsams pa/ bdag gcig pu zhig tu skyengs par byas kyis(nye/ ma la bdag gis ni 'di rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang du skyengs par bya'o snyam nas / des sgo'i ngos logs la rang gi gzugs brnyan 'gegs pa zhig bris te/sgo phag tu yib nas 'dug go/ /de ldang ba'i dus gang7yin pa de las thalachab dang / de nas 'khrul 'khor gyi sgyu rtsal gyi slob dpon gyis bsams pa ring zhig lon na ci'i phyir de sgor ma byung snyam du bsams nas der song ba las ji tsam na 'gegs te shi ba mthong ngo / /des bsams pa/ ci'i phyir 'dis bdag nyid srog dang bral bar byas snyam pa las des 'khrul 'khor zhig nas shing brul gyi phung por 'dug pa mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag nyid skyengs pas 'gegs so snyam tso)/ /yul nas can gyi kun du spyod pa ni gang su'i khyim yang rung der mi glo bur ba shi na ji srid rgyal po la mi mthol ba de srid du 2—660

des de la rim gro mi byed do/ /de nas de rgyal po'i drung du song ste mthol ba/lha yul dbus nas ri mo mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig mchis te/ de bdag gitusdum par gnas pa las/ de la bkur ste bgyi ba'i slad du bdag gis 'khrul 'khor las bu mo zhig bgyis te btang ba dang / des de lag pa nas bzung ste drangs pas shing gi phung por mchis pa dang / de skyengs nas bdag nyid 'gegs lagasalgen/ lha de la g.yar snga 'brimasapa zhig gtang du gsol/ de nas bdag gis rim gro bgyisnyilags so/ /de nas rgyal pos zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng0lashegayar snga rims shig /de rnams dong nas de mthong ngo / /des bsams pa/ bdag gis ji'ultar7thung nga las dbab par bya snyam mo/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ 'geg thag chod sta renyekhyer te thag pa gcod yipar brtsams pa las ji tsam na rtsig tho)pa yin par mthong nas/de nas 'khrul 'khor mkhan gyi slob dpon de skyengs par gyur to/ /de de ltar skyengs par gyur pasnyedang / ri mo mkhan gyi slob dpon de sgo lkog nas phyung ste smras pa/ kye nang rje khyod kyis ni kho bo gcig pu zhig tu skyengs par byas te/khyod ni rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang du skyengs par byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi ri mo mkhan gyi slobanyedapon gang yin pa de ni dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'dis 'di bzos pham par byas so/ /da ltar yang 'dis 'di rdzu 'phrul gyis pham par byas so/ /gzhan yang 47ltar 'dis 'di bzos pham par byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or gzhan zhig na ri mo mkhan gyi slob dpon gnyis shig byung ba las rtsod par gyur te/ gcig gis smras pa/ nga ni bzo legs par — 2—661

shes so/ /cig shos kyis smras pa/ nga ni de bas kyang lhag par legs par shes so/ /de gnyis phan tshun 'grananyepar gyur nas rgyal po'i drung du dong ste de'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te gcig gis smras pa/ lha bdag ni bzo legs par 'tshal to/ /cig shos7kyis kyang smras pa/ lha bdag ni de bas kyang lhag parakhulegs par 'tshal to/ /rgyal pos de gnyis la sgo khang bstan nas khyed gnyis gang mkhas ni ngas mi shes mod kyi / 'on kyang gcig gis ni rtsig ngos gcig la brisakyil/ cig shos kyis kyang gcig la bris0shig dang / de lta na khyedashecag⑧gnyis gang bzo legs par shes pa ngas legs par shes par 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis kyi bar yol bas bcad nas ri mo bri bar brtsams7te/ de la gcig gis ni7 zla ba drug gis ri mo'i las zin to/ /cig shos kyis ni zla ba drug tu rtsig ngos bstar to/ /ri mo'i las zin pa gang yin pa de rgyal po'i drung du song ste son pa dang / smras pa/ lha bdag ginyeri mo'i las bgyis lags na spyang brim du gsol/ de nas rgyal po blon po dang lhan cig sgor byung nasalgemathong ba dang / ri mo'i las mkhas so zhes shin tu mgu'o/ /cig shos kyis kyang rkang pa gnyis la gtugs7te smras pa/ da bdag gi7ri mo'i las la gzigs su gsol / des bar chad kyi yol ba bshus7dang / gcig gi )gzugs brnyan de la shar ba rgyal pos mthong nas ri mo'i las la lhag par 'di mkhas so zhes shin tu ya mtshan skyes so/ /de nas des slar yol bas bar bcad nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lha 'di ni ri mo'i las ma lags te/ 'on kyang rtsig ngos bstar ba lags so/ /de nas rgyal po je 0ya mtshan skyes nas smras pa/'di ni bzo la lhag par mkhas pa yin no/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/2—662

gang gis zla ba drug tu rtsig ngos bstar ba ①de ni dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di nyid yin no/ /gang gis zla ba drug tu ri mo'i las byas pa de ni de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong mod gal gyi bu 'di nyid desayin te/ de na⑧yang 'dis 'di bzos pham par byas so/ /da ltar yang 'dis 'di rdzu 'phrul gyis pham par byas so/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'dis 'di pham par byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba0bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na drang srong dung dang / bris pa7zhes bya ba gnyis shig nye bar rtenarnyucing gnas so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na lhas7char phab pas rdzab tu gyur te/ dung dred7de rdzab tu deg 'chos nas ril ba chag par gyur to/ /de nas des dmod pa bor ba/ rang bzhin ngan pa khyod kyis da phan chad lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bebs par gyur cig ces byas so/ /rgyal po tshangs sbyin dang bā rā ṇa sbo na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis thos nas/de nas de rnams de'i drung du song ste gsol ba btab pa/ drang srong chen po de ltar ma mdzad cig /des smras pa/ bdag gis rang bzhin ngan pa bzod par mi⑥nus te/ bdag gi5)dmod pas bcom pa des lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bebasalgepar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs sbyin dang / skye bo'i tshogs des brisalgepa la gsol ba btab nas des gsol ba byas te lhas char phab bo /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi drang srong dung gang yin pa de ni dge slong mod gal gyi bu 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bris pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong shā ri'i bu yin te/ de na yang 'dis 'di rdzu 'phrul gyis pham par byas so/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'dis 'di rdzu 'phrul gyis pham par byas pa de nyon cig /bris pas dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi5)phyir dung gi rkang pa 2—663

gnyis la gtugasalgepa las dung gi rkang pa gnyis kyis ral pa mnan pa dang bris pas smras pa/ nyi ma 'char ku'i⑧dus kyi tshe khyod kyi spyi bo gas par gyur cig /dung gis smras pa/ de ltar na⑧nyi ma 'char bar ma gyur cig ces byas pa dang /'jig rten du nam sros par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po dang / bram ze dang /khyim bdag gis dung la gsol ba btab pa/ drang srong chen po de lta bu ma mdzad cig /des smras pa/ nyi ma shar bar gyur na gdon mi za bar bdag gikyimago 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /bris pas de la smras pa/ gal te de lta na 'ji bkyilas byas pa'i mgo zhig byos shig /ji tsam na 'ji bakhulas dung gi mgo zhig byas pa las nyi ma shar ba dang gas par gyur to/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ dung gang yin pa de ni dge slong mod gal gyi bu 'di nyid de⑥yin no/ /bris pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di nyid de7yin te/ de na yang 'dis pham par byas so/ /gzhan yang ji ltar pham par byas pa de nyon cig /yul dbus su ba so mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig byung nas ba so 'bras tsam bre'u chung gang khyer nas yul nas can du song ste/ de ri mo mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig gi khyim du zhugs na de yang stong par 'dug nas7de'i chung ma la smras pa/ grogs po'i chung ma 'bras bre'u chung gang po 'di tshos la byin cig ces de bzhag ste song ngo / /des btso bar brtsams pa las shing zad7par gyur kyang ma tshos so de nas de'i khyim thab 'ongasalgenas smras pa/ bzang mo 'di ci zhig yin/ des rgyas par smras pa dang / des de brtags pa las ba so 'bras tsam she dag tu mthong nas des de la co dri bar smras pa/ bzang mo 'di tshwarwanyechu yin gyis(nye/ chu bzang po gzhan zhig khyer te 'ongs dang / des 'bras 'di tshosalgepar 'gyur 2—664

ro / /des ba so mkhan gyi slob dpon la chu bzang po zhig khyer te shog shig ces smras sel/ /des de la smras nas/ des phyogs gzhan zhig tu rdzing bu zhig bris te / der khyi ro bam pa zhig kyang bris so/ /de nas ba so mkhan gyi slob dpon de bum pa khyer nas rdzing bu yin no snyam nas phyogs der phyin te/ khyi ro bam pa mthong ba dang / des sna bkab nas brtag parakhubatsams pa las ji tsam na de'i chu snod de chagashenas ba so mkhan gyi slob dpon de skyengs par gyur to/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ ba so mkhan gyi slob dpon gang yin pa de ni dge slong mod gal gyi bu 'di nyid de0yin no/ /ri mo mkhan gyi slob dpon gang yin pa de ni dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di nyid de yin no/ /'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pas brnyes pa'i bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa gang dag0yin pa de dag gi ming yang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis mi shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis thob pa gang dag yin pa de dag gi ming yang dge slong shā ri'i bus mi shes so/ /dge slong shā ri'i bus thob pa gang dag yin pa de dag gi ming yang dge slong mod gal gyi bus mi shes so/ /dge slong mod gal gyi bus thob pa gang yin pa de dag gi ming yang nyan thos gzhan rnams kyis mi shes te/ dge slong mod gal gyi bu bas dge slong shā ri'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che mod kyil/des mang du gnas pa la dgongs nas ngas rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /shā ri'i bu dang mod gal gyi bu'i le'u'o// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po rang gi las kyisargyu ba lung ston par byed de/ smras pa/ de ni der7song sngon nas spyad pa dang / /rjes mthun02—665

tshig dag shin tu sgrogs7pa na/ /gang zhig byas pas 'bras bu che myong ba/ /chung ngu gcig pu de ni myur dran nas/ /ji ltar seng ge ri yi phug gnas pa/ /'jigs pa med par spyod yul 'gro ba ltar/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i nyan thos 'od srung de/ /sngon gyi gnas nas spyad pa sgrogs7byed pa/ /zag med tha ba med pa rnamasagrol sems/ /nyon mongs med par gnas pa skyon med yid/ /de la chos mchog yod par yid ches nas/ /de yi chos la yid kyis smon byas te/ /rang sangs rgyas la bdag gis yon du ni/ /khre rgod bre'u chung0gang zhig rab phul bas/ /de 'dra ba dang kun du phrad gyur cesaX/ /smon pas sgra mi snyan du skyes pa ni/ /las de gcig pu nyid kyi 'bras bu yis/ /lus can bdag gir 'dzin med tshe ring ba/ /khyad par 'gro zhing spyod pa mi dman pa/ /sgra mi snyan du lan stong skyes par gyur/ /las de gcig pu nyid kyi 'bras bu yis/ /lan stong sum bcu rtsa gsum par skyes te/ /me tog phreng rgyan byug⑧pa sna tshogs dang / /mthu chen lus mdzes pa dang ldan par gyur/ /de nas 'phos bdag sgra mi snyan du skyes/ /slar yang lha dgeshedaga' bar byed pa dang / /sems kyi smon lam dbang gis slar yang bdag /mi ni dge〈nye ba rnams kyi nang du skyes/ /las de gcig pu nyid kyi 'bras bus〈nyebadag /bram ze sāsnyil chen po'i rigs skyes te / /nor mang skyes pa bud med rnams kyis bkuratso/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga don mi gnyer yang / /bdag gis ston7pa lan 'ga'angasnyim mthong zhing / /mtshungs med nyan thos bdag gis ma mthong nas/ /bdag gi seng ras tshem gyon 'jig rten na/ /dgra bcom rnams la phyag〈nye'atshal rab tu byung / /bdag ni de ltar rab tu byung ba dang / /rgyal ba bu mngasatshwanyemachod rten na bzhugs 2wa 666

mthong / /thub zhabs phyag 'tshal bcom ldan bdag gi ston/ /bdag ni khyod kyi nyan thos gyur ces gsol/ /'od srung ji skad7smras7bzhin byas te 'dir/ /khyod ston nga yinas nga yi7nyan thos0khyod/ /gal te sdug bsngal kun las thar 'dod na/ /khyod kyis snyan par bshad pa'i chos snyan nyon/ /gang yang bdagakyil skyes mchog skyob pa ni/ /thugs rje chen po yis ni chos bshad pa/ /bsam gtan bzhi stobs dbang po byang chub kyi/ /yan lag lam gyi yan lag rnam par thar / /de dag bsgom pa bdag gis dga' mgur thob/ /zag pa zad cing lus kyi tha ma bzung / /lus kyi tha ma 'dzin pa rdul med pa/ /drang po 'di dag dang ni bdag gir phrad/ /de bzhin gshegs rgyal phun sum tshogs pa gsungs/ /tshul khrims ldan pa gang 'dod 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag gi yid la ci dang ci bsams pa/ /thams cad grub ste srid pa'i tha ma 'di/ /bdag gi skye ba zad cing 'ching ba dang / /srid7pa kun nas langs pa nyid bcad de/ /bdag ni chos rgyal thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ /nyon mongs tshogs rnams zad pas mya ngan 'da'/ /bdag ni thams cad gzigs pa yis/ /sbyangs la gnas pa mchog tu bstan()/ dzizag pa med cing nyes pa bsal/ /go 'phang mi g.yo bdag gis 'thobatso/ /gnas brtan 'od srung de lta bur/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du / /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to / /'od srung gi le'u ste dang po'o// //'dul ba gzhi7/ bam po lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan0rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras 2—667

so / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i busatulas ci zhig byas na las de'i rnam pare smin pas shes rab chen po dang spobs pa chen po dang ldan par gyur des smras pa/bdag gis dgon par rang sangs rgyas/ /drang srong dge sbyong zhir7gyur pa/ /skal dang ldan pa chos gos ni/ /de tshe rnying pasagyon pa mthong / /de la bdag gis0sems dad pasaphyi/ /bang brgyugs nas kyang chos gos ni/ /drubs0shing kha bsgyur de bzhin du/ /de la yang dang yang du gtugasadu/ /de nas bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /de ni bar snang la 'phags nas/ /rang gi gzi brjid kyis 'bar zhing / /de nas mkha' la gshegs par gyur/ /bdag gis thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /ji ltar bdag ni 'di 'dra bar/ /dbang rnon shes rab cher shog ces/ /de lta bur7ni smon lam btab/ /bdag ni phyug po'i rigs su 'amanyaske/ /ma rabs dag tu mi skye bar/ /bar ma'i rigs su skye 'gyer zhing / /rtag tu rab 'byung mang bar shog /dge ba'i rtsa ba des na bdag /bdag ni tshe rabs lnga brgyar yang / /mi yi rnyed pa thob nas ni/ /khyim med parasani rab tu byung / /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ /mi yi srid thob 'di yin te/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis rab byung thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /btsun pa bdag gis zla phyed kyis/ /'gro ba'i pha rol phyin pa thob(nye/ /dge slong dge 'dun gud bzhugs nas/ /ston pas bdag ni mngon sum du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rjes skor0ba/ /shes rab can gyi0 gtso bor bstan/ /shes rab chen po shāri'i bu / /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /2—668

rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /shā ri'i bu'i7le'u stesheganyis pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ni rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis /da ni khyod kyis kyang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag sngon drang srong gyur pa'i tshe/ /nags mtha'ikhudagon par gnas pa na/ /der ni skyes pa zhig 'ongs nas/ /bdag la rab byung gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gis brgyugasakyinas de yi0skra/ /bregs nas kyang ni chos gos dag /kha dog bsgyurakhunas〈de la byin/ /de yid7dga' gyur de yi tshe/ /phyogs gcig tu ni nyer song nas/ /skyil mo krung bcas 'dug nas des/ /rang byang chub ni reg7gyur te/ /de nas mkha' la song bar gyur/ /bdag gis dad bskyed nyer song nas8/ /de nas thal mo legs sbyar te/ /de na rdzu 'phrul mchog gsol zhing / /smon lam gdab pa byas pa ni/ /drang srong che 'di ci 'dra ba'i/ /bdag gi rdzu 'phrul de 'drar shog /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yis na8/ /gang dang gang du skyes par ni/ /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yi/ /lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur/ /bdag gi srid pa tha ma0ni/ /mi yi srid thob 'di yin te/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis rab byung thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom 2—669

pa ni bdag gis thob/ /thams cad gzigs pas rdzu 'phrul can/ /rnams kyi mchog tu bdag bstan to/ /dge ba chung ngu byas pa7ni/ /bde ba mang po nyams su myong / /mi dge ba yi las gang yin/ /bdag gis lung bstan mnyan par gyis/ /grongasnyomachog rgyal po'i khab tu ni/ /bdag nishetshong dpon khye'u gyur nas/ /khyim gyi phyi rol rtse rtse nas/ /zan gyi phyir yang zhugs pa las/ /de na pha ma gnyis ka ni/ /dben par 'dug pa bdag gis mthong / /de gnyis mthong bsasnyibadag brdegs shing / /skyengs pas kyang ni spyo ba byas/ /pha dang ma ni gnyis ka la/ /yid kyis nyes pa byas pa ni/ /gang tshe chen por gyur pa na / /'dam7bu bcom pa bzhin bsad7snyam/ /bdag gi yid kyis nyes byas kyi7/ /lus kyis7byas pa ma yin na'ang / /bdag ni dmyal ba thig nag tu / /sdug bsngal mi bzad nyams su myong / /de yi las kyi lhag ma yis8/ /bdag gi srid pa tha ma 'dir/ /mu stegs gzhan gyi dge sbyong gis/ /'dam bu bcom bzhin bdag gtog 'gyur/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal de nyid kyis/ /shi bar 'gyur7te de nas ni/ /las rnams kyi ni lhagatsom yang / /tha ma zad par 'gyur ba yin/ /de bas pha dang ma dag la/ /sems ni rab tu dad par bya(nye/ /sems dad pa yi rgyu yis ni/ /sems can 'gro ba bzang por 'gro/ /de ltar gnas brtan pang nas skyes/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to8/ /pang nas skyes kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa 2—670

mdzes ldan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mdzes ldan tshe dang ldan panyepang nas skyes kyisaphurang gi las kyi rgyu ba lungashebastan zin gyis④/ da ni tshe dang ldan pa mdzes ldan gyis kyang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mdzes ldan gyis dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi mdun du rang gi⑧las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa/ dge 'dun kun dgar bdag son na/ /khyams de'i phyag dar mthong nas ni/ /bdag gis phyagasalgem blangs nas su/ /de tshe dga' bas phyag dar byas/ /de nas bdag gisasnyisems dad pasadu/ /khyams de gtsang mar mthong nas ni/ /ji ltar khyams de gtsang ba ltar/ /nyon mongs med par gyur cig smras/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yis ni0 / /gang dang gang du skyes par yang / /bdag gi gzugs ni bzang ba dang / /bltarwaten sdug cing mdzes par gyur/ /de yi las kyi lhag mas ni/ /bdag gi lus ni tha ma la/ /bdag gi pha dang ma gnyis kyis/ /bdag ming mdzes ldan kho nar btags/ /mdzes ldan bdag ni btsas gyur te/ /gang tshe gnyen tshogs mdun phyin pa/ /de tshe gnyen ni thams cad kyis/ /mgu zhing yid dga' bkur ste byas/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gisanyon mongs med gyur ces/ /smon lam btab pa gang yin pa/ /bya ba byas te nyon mongs med/ /dgra bcom zag pa med pa yin/ /'dzam bu'i gling ni thams cad kyang / /ka shi'i gos kyis phyags pa bas/ /gang gis〈nye'adod chags bral ba yi/ /drang srong 'chags cigacig phyags (nyepa'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling na drang srong gi/ /'chag sa thams cad phyags pa bas/ /gang gis phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi/ /2—671

re lde tsam dag phyags pa 'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling na dge 'dun gyi/ /kun dga' ra ba kun phyags7pas/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i mchod rten ni/ /khru gang tsam zhig phyagasalgepa 'o/ /bdag nyid kyis ni gang rtogs pa'i/ /khyad par de dag shes byas nas/ /bderashegashegs mchod rten phyagasakyinas ni/ /sems kyang rab tu dang bar gyis/ /de ltas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyikhru/ /yon tan mang po shes pa yis/ /mchod rten rnams la bkur sti byos/ /'bras bu chen po dag tu 'gyur/ /btsun pa bdag gis dge ba ni/ /gang byas dran pa 'di lags te//de0yi 'bras bu sdug pa dang / /'dod pa yid 'ong nyams su myong / /de bas rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /mchod pa dag ni bzang po gyis/ /btsun pa 'di ni bsod nams zhing / /dam pa bla na med pa yin/ /rdzogs sangs de bzhin gshegs pa 'am/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos la/ /sems ni rab tu dang byas pa'i/ /yon ni chung ngur 'gyur ma yin/ /de ltar gnas brtan mdzes ldan gyis/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma drosalgepa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /mdzes ldan gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis 0tshe dang ldan pa sna ma'i me tog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sna ma'i me tog tshe dang ldan pa mdzes ldan gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis(nye / da ni tshe dang ldan pas kyang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /sna ma'i me tog rna rgyan byas / /mgo la me tog phreng bcings nas/ /ne'u zla rnams kyis yongs bskor te / /skyed7mos tshal gyisnyiganas su byung / /de na7thub pa chen po pa/ /rnam 2—672

par gzigs kyi mchod rten la/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen thams cad nas/ /legs par mchod pa bdag gis mthong / /de nas ne'u zla rnams7khrid nas/ /rang rang gi ni phreng ba kun/ /sems ni dad par ②byas nas su/ /mchod rten de la gdags pa byas/ /de na⑧bdag gis de dag dang / /skye bo mang po gzhan mthong nas/ /sna ma rna ba las bkrol0te/ /de tshe mchod rten gdagasalgepa byas / /dge ba'i rtsa ba des na bdag /gang dang gang du skyes par(yang / /bsod nams byas pa⑥mdzes pa yi/ /lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yis/ /ded dpon 'disheni mnyes par byas mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /me tog gcig ni btang bas na/ /lo ni bye ba brgya phraganyetu/ /bdag gis lha yi yongs spyad nas/ /de yi lhag mas mya ngan 'das/ /btsun pa gal te sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan phal cher 'tshal gyur nas/ /sems ni shin tu dad pa7yis/ /phyir zhing bsnyen bkur bgyis pa zhig /de ltas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan mang po shes pa yis / /mchod rten rnams la bkur ste byos/ /'bras bu chen po dag tu 'gyur/ /rdzogs sangs de bzhin gshegs pa 'am/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos la/ /sems ni rab tu dang byas pa'i/ /yon ni chung bar 'gyur ma yin/ /btsun pa bdag gis〈nyedage ba ni/ /gang byas dran pa 'di lags te/ / de yi7'bras bu sdug pa dang / /'dod pa yid 'ong nyams su myong / /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /yang5)srid skye ba zad pa dang / /nyon mongs bcom nas bsil gyur pa'i/ /bdag ni dgra bcom mya ngan 'das/ /bdag ni yang srid nyal ba dang / /'khor ba gang du'ang nyal ma nyeyin/ /2—673

bdag gisheskye ba tha ma ni/ /'di yin len pa med par 'gyur②/ /de nyid kyi ni rgyu yis bdag /sna ma'i me tog ming 'di btagasal/ /sdug bsngal 0kun las bdag grol zhing / /srid pa'i mtsho las rgal bar gyur/ /de ltar gnas brtan sna ma ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /sna ma'i me tog gi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa bye ba nyi shu pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa bye ba nyi shu pa tshe dang ldan pa sna ma'i me tog gis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisaX/ tshe dang ldan pas kyang da ni rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /tshe dang ldan pa bye ba nyi shu pas ⑦ci zhig byas na las des bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑧brtson 'grus rtsom pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan/ des smras pa/ rnam par gzigs kyi gsung rab la//rgyal po'i pho brang bshes ldan du/ /bdag gis phyogs bzhi'i7dge 'dun gyi/ /gnas khang gcig cig brtsigs nas ni/ tsho/bdag gis gnas khang de yi gzhir(nya/ /ras phran rnams kyis sa gzhi g.yogs/ /sems dga' ba dang yid bde bas/ /de tshe smon lam btab pa ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas ni mnyes byas te//bsnyen par rdzogs pa thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog zhi bzha /rga med go 'phang reg par shog /bdag gi bsod nams des ni bdag /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yi/ /bskal pa dgu bcur lha dang ni/ /mi rnams su ni 'khor bar gyur/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /bdag gi lus ni tha ma la/ /tsam par tshong dpon mchog gi yang / /bu gcig par ni bdag skyes so/ /2—674

bdag ni btsas ma thag tu yang / /pha yis thos nas 'dun ①gyur pa/ /gzhon nu la ni bdag gis ②rnar/ /bye ba nyi shu sbyin par bya/ /bdag gi rkang mthil gnyi ga'isaspu/ /shin tu phra zhing mnyen pa dang / /reg na bde zhing 'jam pa yi/ /shing bal 'dab lta'i sor bzhi skyes/ /'das pa'i bskal pa dgu bcu dang / /bskal pa gcig 'di lhag par ni/ /sa gzhi gding bas ma g.yogs paraX/ /rkang pa 'jog ni ma myong ngo / /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /thams cad gzigs pas brtson 'grus can/ /rnams kyishemachog tu bdag bstan to/ /zag med nyes pa spangs pa yitsho go 'phang mi g.yo bdag gis thob/ /gnas brtan bye ba nyi shu pa/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /de ltar ma dros mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /bye ba nyi shu pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa ngag dbang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ngag dbang tshe dang ldan pa bye ba nyi shu pas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis7/ tshe dang ldan pas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /des smras pa/ 'das pa'i bskal pa dgu bcur ni/ /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yinya/ /lha rnams dang ni mir skyes te/ /bdag gis ngan 'gro mi shes so/ /bdag gis dge ba mi shes te/ /phan tshun zla bltas 'ba' zhig gis/ /rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten ni/ /mthong nas de tshe bsnyen bkur byas/ / 'gron bu drug bcu rnams kyis ni/ /2—675

dri dang phreng ba byug nyos te/ /mchod rten la ni gdags7byas pas/ /bdag ni log par nyungasam gyur/ /dge ba chung ngu byas bsnyeni/ /bde ba mang po nyams su myong / /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dudagra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /gal te rdzogs sangs shes7gyur la/ /mchod rten de la bdag gis su/ /bkur ste byas par gyur na ni/ /legs pa0mang byed 'gyur ba zhig /de ltas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan mang po shes pa yis/ /mchod rten bkur ste byos shig dang / /'bras bu chen po dag tu 'gyur/ /thams cad gzigs pas mang thosarkyudang / /sna tshogs gtam dang dge ba yis/ /spobs ldan tshigs bcad byed pa ni/ /rnams kyi mchog tu bdag bstan to/ /de ltar gnas brtan ngag dbang ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi7mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /ngag dbang gi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa bha ra dwa dza bsod snyoms len la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa bha ra dwa dza bsod snyoms len7tshe dang ldan pa ngag dbang gis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis8/ tshe dang ldan pas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa bha ra dā dza bsod snyoms len gyis7smras pas/ bdag ni tshong dpon bur gyur nas/ /pha yi khyim na dbang byed tshe/ /bdag gis pha ni yid7bsrungs5)shing / /ma la log pa mi mthun byas/ /pha dang sring mo spun dang ni/ /bran dang las byed rnams la yang / /zas dang skom gyis tshim byas 2—676

kyang / /ma la spyo ba byas nas su/ /bdag ni seratusnas zil non pasal/ /ma la zas ni ma byin par/ /khros pas tshig tu smras pa ni/ /zas su rdo ba zo shig byas / /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /rab tu tsha dang thig nag gi/ /dmyal bar lan mang lhung nas ni/ /sdug bsngal mi nyung thob par gyur/ /dmyal ba de nas shi 'phos nas/ /mi yi srid pa thob pa na②/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /bdag ni rdo ba za bar gyur/ /skye ba de dang de dag tu/ /bdag gisasrerdo ba mang zos0shing / /de bzhin bkres skom sdug bsngal gyis/ /bdag ni 'chi0ba'i dus byas so/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ /mi srid thob pa 'di yin te/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis rab byung thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /thams cad gzigs pas seng ge yis/ /sgra sgrogasalgepa yi mchog tu bstan/ /bdag gis nyon mongs thams cad spangs/ /nyon mongs bral bas zag pa med/ /da dung du yang btsun pa dag /de ltar rdzu 'phrul thob gyur kyang7/ /phug na bdag gi zas mchis pa(spre/ /rdo ba nyid du gyur lags so/ /btsun pa bdag gis sdig pa ni/ /gang bgyis dran pa 'di lags te/ /las rnams chud mi za bas na/ /de yi tu)'bras bu nyams su myong / / bha ra dwa7dza bsod snyoms len/ zhadage slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ / de ltar ma dros mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ / bha ra dwa dza bsod snyoms len gyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa 2—677

legs 'ongasatul 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs tshe dang ldan pa bha ra dwa7dza bsod snyoms len gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis la/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs༄kyis7kyang da rang gikyilas kyi rgyu ba lung ston0cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa legasaX'ongs kyis7de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ rgyal po'i pho brang bshes5)ldan du/ /tshong dpon bu phor gyur nas ni/ /bdag ni nor dang 'bru mang zhing / /skye po'i tshogs kyis bkur ba dang / /rgyal po dang ni grong mi dang / /gsang tshig brjod pa rnams kyis7bkur/ /blta na sdug cing mdzes pa dang / /dar la bab pa gzugs kyis rgyags8/ /de nas bdag ni shing rtar zhugs/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyis mdun byas nas/ /'dod pa kun dang ldan gyur cing / / skyed mos tshal gyi gnas su byungasnyi/ /skyed mos tshal der dge sbyong ni/ /dbang po legs par bsdams pa dang / /dbang po zhi bas rgyu byed pa/ /chos gos rnyingasnyepa can zhig mthong / /dge sbyong de mthong bdag gis ni/ /yid mi bde ba skyes gyur te/ /de skyon med kyang mi sdug nas/ /smad cing spyo ba byas pa5)ni/ /kha dog ngan cing 'jigs par snang / /mdze can lus ni lus rma can/ /sha bri ngan cing rtsa 'thon pa/ /rab tu byung 'di su yi yin/ /ngagashe gi nyes pa spyad pa dang / /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /de nas 'chi 'pho'i dus byas nas/ /dmyal ba rnams su skyes par nyegyur/ /dmyal ba nas ni shi 'phos bdag /kha dog ngan cing sdug bsngal ldan/ /mdze can lus ni lus rma can/ /sha bri ngan cing rtsa 'thon gyur/ /lag na gyo mo thogs shing rgyu/ /sha na'i nyeras kyi smad g.yogs gyonas/ /phyag dar phung po'i steng na nyal/ /gnas med mgon med skyob pa 2—678

med/ /zas kyi ched du sprang ba dngatu/ /gang dang gang du song na yang / /dbyug⑧pa can gyis7phyir bzlogarnyucing / /de dag bdag la smod par byed/ /de ltar tshe rabs lngarnyubargyar ni/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa der/ /bkres dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /bdag ni 'chikhuba'i dus byas so/ /sems can kun gyis bdag gi ming / /nyes 'ongs pa zhes smad pa byas/ /kun gyisayid du mi 'ong bas7/ /de tshe smad pa byed par 'gyur(nye/ /bdag gis5)rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun gyis byas/ /skye bo'i tshogs ni chen po la/ /dam pa'i gnas ni ston pa mthong / /skye bo'i tshogs de mthong nas ni / /ji tsam 'dod pa'i zas dang skom/ /rnyed par gyur na stes7snyam nas/ /myur du brgyugs te phyin pa dang / /skye po'i tshogs ni chos kyi phyir/ /'dug pa de ni mthong nas kyang / /zas sbyin pa ni med do zhes/ /bdag ni re chad slar log go/ /de nas thub pa thugs rje can/ /mgon pos bdag la bka' stsal pa//'ongs pa legs tshur khyod bde 'am/ /stan 'di la ni khyodaca'adug shig /bdag ni dga' ba thob gyur nas/ /thal mo legs sbyar de'i 'og tu/ /ston pa'i zhabs la phyag byas nas/ /phyogs gcig tu ni bdag 'dug go/ /de nas ston pa thugs rje can/ /gau tam rjes su thugs brtse bas/ /rim pa bzhin gyi gtam gsungs pas/ /bdag ni bden pa mthong bar bgyis/ /bden pa mthong nas thub chen la/ /de nas bdag gis rab 'byung gsol/ /gi tamanyethugs rje chen pos bdag /rjes su brtse bas rab tu phyungasnyi / /'jig rten gyi ni 'dren pa yis/ /bdag ming legs 'ongs5)zhes btags shing / / me yi khams la snyoms 'jug nyepa/ / rnams kyi stemachog tu bdag bstan to/ /de ltar 2—679

gnas brtan legs 'ongs kyis/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros ①pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /legs 'ongs kyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa dga' yod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dga' yod tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis②/ tshe dang ldan pa dga' yod kyis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' yod kyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ grong mchog rgyal po'i khab tu ni/ /tshong dpon phyug por gyur pa na/ /de nishesu ge byung gyur nas/ /drang srong rnams ni gso skal dgos/ /de na0bdag gi gso skal du/ /skal dang ldan pa'i rang sangs rgyas/ /zag pa med pa'i bsil gyur pa'i / /drang srong mdzes pa gcig cig byon/ /sems ni ser sna'i skyon can gyis/ /bdag gisasnyisdig pa bsams pa ni/ /da lta'i dus su dge sbyong 'di/ /lo bdun du ni su zhig gso/ /khyi yi gcin0ni bskol ba yis/ /de nas 'bras kyi chan btsos te/ /de nasadrang srong za ru bcug /de tshe de ni 'chi dus byas//sdig pa'i las ni de byas pas/ /bsdus gzhom dang ni ngu 'bod dang / /de bzhin tsha bturab tsha ba'i/ /dmyal ba rnams su yun ring btsos/ /dmyal ba nas ni shi 'phos bdag / mi yi srid pa thob na yang / /nad bu can la gzhan dbang dang / /sdug bsngal gyis ni bdag dus byas/ /de ltar tshe rabasalgelnga brgyar ni/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa na/ /mi sdug nad dang mi bzad pas//2—680

rtag tu bdag ni dus byas so/ /bdag gi skye ba'inyetha ma ni/ / mi yisasrid thobasa'adi yin te/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gisakhurab byung thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur paX/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdagashegis thob/ /btsun pa da ltar na yang bdag /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing zag med kyang / /nad bu can la 'gre ldog pa/ /de lta bus ni bdag 'tsho 'o/ /de ltar gnas brtan dga' yod kyis/ /dge slong dge 'dunasamadun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen dul/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /ma 'gags ⑩pa'i grogs po dga' yod kyi le'u ste bcu pa'o// //sdom ni/ 'od srung shā ri'i bu dang ni/ /mod gal bu dang mdzes ldan dang ske/ /sna ma gro bzhin ngag dbang dang / /bsod snyoms legs 'ongs dga' yod do//de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa grags pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' yod kyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis8/ tshe dang ldan pa grags pas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pas de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ bdag sngon dgon pa'i drang srong gyur/ /grong du bsod snyoms phyir song na/ /rnam par sngos shing bam pa yis0/ /bud med kyi ni ro zhig mthong / /bdag gis tshul bzhin brtagasabyas te/ / skyil mo krung bcas 'dug nas ni/ /rtse gcig shin 2—681

tu mnyam bzhaganyepas/ /der ni mi sdug bsgomasapa byas/ /bdag 'dug pa las de yirnyusto/ /rdol nas 'jigs pa'i sgra byung ba/ /thos par gyur nas bdag kyang ni/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs par gyur/ /de yi lto na yod pa yi//ngan skyugs dang ni khrag dang ni/ /rul pa'i dri dang mi gtsang ba/ /kun nas rab tu 'dzag pa mthong / /rgyu ma gnye ma mkhal ma dang / /snying dang de bzhin glo ba 'dzo/ /srin bu brgya phrag za byed nas/ /slar yang sems ni mnyam par bzhag /de duci ⑨'dra bar 'di de 'dra/ /'di ci 'dra bar de de 'drar⑩/ / phyi yi57ro ni mthong gyur nas/ /rang gi lus la gtod par7byed/ /de nas ting7'dzin las langs nas/ /bste gnas su ni slar log stetsho/ /de tshe bsod snyoms ma spyad de/ /zas kyang bza' ba ma byas so/ /gang tshe bdag kyanganyegrong khyer du/ /zas kyi ched du zhugs pa na/ /yid 'phrog pa yi gzugs mthong nas//de la mi gtsang bsgom byas pa/ /de yi ro ni ci 'dra bar/ /gzugs gtogs de kun de 'dra ste/ /khong5)pa mi gtsang bas gang btunye/ /thams cad smadanepa yin no zhes/ /de ltar yang dang yang bsgoms pas/ /bdag gis 'dod chags bral ba thob/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa tshad7 med pa/ /bzhi po legs par bsgoms (1byas pas/ /de nas 'chi ba'i dus byas te/ /tshangs pa yi ni 'jig rten skyes/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten shi 'phos bdag /bā rā ṇa sī'i grong du skyes / /tshong dpon mchog gi bu gcig par/ /dpal ldan 6)bdag nyid der skyes te( nye/ /kun la sdug cing yid 'ong ba/ /mthar phyin gnas ni thob par gyur / /bdag ni nyin mo yongs rgyu zhing / /mtshan mo dag ni nyal bar byed/ /myur bar de nas langasasnyi pa na/ /de na bud med mang po dag /rdza rnga dang ni rnga 2—682

chen dang / / khar rnga pi bang sngas bcuganyenas/ /sgren mor blakhurdol byed pa dang / /lag brkyang nas ni gnyid log mthong / /de nas bdag gi sngon gyi rgyu/ /mthu chen po ni skyesalgepar gyur/ /bdag la de nas bud med la/ /dur khrod mi gtsangs 'du shes byungasnyi/ /de nas skyo bar gyur nas ni/ /bdag gis sngangs pa'i tshig smras pa/ /grogs posnyebadag ni gtses gyur te/ /kun nas 'tshe bas reg par gyur/ /de nas mal nas langs nas ni/ /khang bzangasashenas ni shod du babs/ /lhas ni rjes su snying brtse bas/ /bdag gi sgo ni rnam par phye/ /grong khyer nas ni mngon byung nasayi/ /'bab chu'i〈mengogs su nye bar song /bdag gis pha rol 'gram na ni/ /dge sbyong dbang po bsdams pa mthong / /bdag gis dge sbyong de mthong nas/ /sgra gsang stod7de smras pa ni/ /dge sbyong bdag5)ni gtses gyur te/ /grogs po bdag la 'tshe bas reg /de nas ston pas bdag la yang / /de tshe bdud rtsi'i tshigatsogasungs pas/ /gzhon nu ma 'jigs khyod tshur shog /'dir ni khyodal 〉la 'tshe ba med/ /bdag gis nor bu'i lham phud de/ /'bab chu yi ni ngogs rgal〈nyenas/ /sangs rgyas gang zag zla med pa/ /thugs rje can gyi spyan sngar song / /de nas bdag skom0thugs chud nas/ /gang zag zla med ston pa des/ /snyan pa'i chos ni bka' stsal pa/ /de ni so sor bdag gis rtogs/ /de nas bdag gis bden mthong nas/ /thub chen rab 'byung nyegasol ba btab/ /gau tam thugs rje chen po yis/ /thugs brtse dub yis rab tu phyung / /mtshan gcig lon nas de nas ni/ /nyi ma 'char ku tsam na ni/ /bdag gi zag pa kun zad cing / /bdag ni bsil gyur mya ngan 'das/ /de nyeltar gnas brtan grags pa ni/ /dge slong dge 2—683

'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa7yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /gnas brtan grags pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa dpal skyed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dpal skyed tshe dang ldan pa grags pas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisal/ tshe dang ldan pa dpal skyed kyis kyang ①rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dpal skyed kyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer du/ /ston pa 'od srung mya ngan 'das/ /rgyal po kṛ khris rin chen las/ /byas pa'i mchod rten chen po brtsigs/ /rgyal po kṛ kri0grags ldan bu/ /bdag ni thu bor gyur pa na/ /bdag gis thog mar gdugs kyis ni//rgyal ba'i mchod rten la gdags byas/ /dge ba'i las ni de byas pas/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa na/ /bsod nams byas pasalgemadzes pa yi/ /lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur/ /skye ba de dang de dag tu/ /phyug cing longs spyod che ba dang / /nor dang 'brur ni ldan pa yi/ /bdag ni yon bdag chen por gyur/ /bdag gis tshe rabs lnga brgyar ni/ /sbyin pa mi nyung btang byas te/ /slong ba pa dang dge sbyong dang / /bram ze so sor tshim par byas/ /shin tu dang ba'i〈sems kyis ni/ /'dod chags bral zhing zag med pa/ /tha ba med pa'i rang sangs rgyas / /lnga brgya po dag tshim par byas/ /dge ba'i las ni de byas pas/ /srid pa tha ma 'di la ni/ /shākya phyug po'i rigs su skyes/ /btsas ma thag tu tshig smras pa/ /khyim 'di na ni nor 'bru dag /ji ga cungashezad cig yod dam/ /2—684

'di ltar sbyin pa ngas btang stephyi/ /dbul po rnams ni〈tshim par bya / /dbul po rnams la zas byin dang / /gtong bas ngoms par 'gyur ba med/ — /ji ga nor lta yod dam khyed/ ci /bdag la myur du legs par smros/ /de dag bdag gi tshig thos nas/ /yid skyo bar ni gyur nas su/ /ma ma gtogs par phyogs dang ni/ /phyogs su rnam par rgyug par byed/ /ma ni bu la byams pa yis/ /de tshe bdag la 'di skad smras/ ci /lha 'am mi 'am gnod sbyin nam/ — /khyod su bdag la myur du smos/ ci /ma gcigasakhyod kyi bu bdag ni/ /mi lags srin po ma lags tedu/ /sbyin bdag tshe rabs dran pas na/ /rtag tu sbyin pa gtong ba0spro/ /bdag gi tshigashede mas thos nas/ /yid ni dga' bar gyur nas kyang / /dbugs 'byin byed cing smras pa ni/ /bu gcig ci dga'arnyuphyin pa thongashe/ /yo byad mang po rnams kyis kyang / /bdag la mas ni gso ba byas/ /kun la sdug cing yid 'ong ba/ /bdag ni blta bas ngoms mi myong / /bdag ni btsas ma thag tu yang / /khyim de nor dang 'bru rnams dang / ci /gser dang bran dang las byed pa/ /rnams kyang rtag tu 'phel bar gyur(nye/ /dpal skyed khye'u zhig btsas gyur la/ /btsas ma thag tu smras pas na/ /bdag gi ming ni gnyen rnams kyis/ /dpal skyed ces ni bya bar btags/ /de nas bdag gis sbyin btang zhing / /dbul po rnams ni tshim byas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyes byas nas/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /bdag ni rnyed med 'jigs pa 'am/ /bu lon nyen pas rab byungasamin/ /de tshe dad pas rab byung nas/ ci/mngon shes drug po bdag gis thob/ /bdag ni rgyal po blon po dang / —/de bzhin grong mi rnams kyis mchod/ ci /zas dang btung ba gos dang ni//2—685

gnas mal yang ni rnyed par gyur/ /de ltar gnas brtan dpal skyed kyis/ /dge slong dge 'dunatumadun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yisamatsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /dpal skyed kyi le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // de nas ③dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rab tu mang po rnams kyis/tshe dang ldan pa bskusal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa bskusnyil tshe dang ldan pa dpal skyed kyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan )zin gyisargya/ tshe dang ldan pa bskusalas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa bskushelas de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ rgyal po'i pho brang bshes ldan du/ /bdag sngon spos 'tshong gyur pa las(te/ /rnam par gzigs kyi gsung rab kyi/ /dge slong dge 'dun spyan drangs nas(nye/ /khyed cag ji snyed bzhed pa yonye/ /snyun sman bdag gis dbul bgyis te/ /shun pa rtsa ba 'bras bu'i sman/ /dge 'dun bdag gis tshim par bgyisaci/ /dge 'dun dbyar ni spyan drangs nas/ /bdag la dge slong gcig cig gis/ /a ru ra gcig ma gtogs par/ /de na 'ga' yang slong ba med/ /bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu/ /bdag ni log par lhung ma gyur/ /sman sbyin pa yi rnam smin ni/ /mthu chen 'di ni blta bar gyis/ /dge ba chung ngu byas pas ni//bde ba mang po nyams su myong / /a ru ra ni gcig byin pas/ /yun ring mtho ris rnams su dga'/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /bdag gis mi yi srid thob nas/ /yul 'khor bsod snyoms len pa dag(spre /slob pa na yang ma myong ngo ske/ /nub gsum kho na rig pa ni/ /gsum po bdag gis nyemangon sum byas//2—686

ngan ngon gyis ni 'tsho byas shing / /phyag dar khrod kyi7chos gos 'chang / /khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba dang / /bdag ni 'dres par mi gnas te/ /bdag gi tshe ni lo brgya dang / /drug bcu lhag cig lon na yang / /dasatsam bar du'ang bdag gis ni/ /na bsnyemangon par mi dran te/ /btsun pa bdag gis dge ba ni/ /chung ngu bgyis pa 'di dran te/ /de yi 'bras bu yid 'ong 'dod/ /bde ba 'byung ba nyams su myong / /de ltar gnas brtan bsku las⑤/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /bsku la'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan gnas brtan zhes bya ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan gnas brtan nitshe dang ldan pa bskulalas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisakyi/ tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan gnas brtananyegyis kyang da rang gi las kyi (nyergyu ba lung ston 0cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan gnas brtan stezhes bya bas de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su/ /bdag ni lham mkhan gyur pa na/ /mu ge byung nas de nas7bdag /ko ba'i ras ma rnams 'tshed do/ /bza' bar bya ba kho na'i phyir/ /ko ba'i ras ma 'tshed7pa las/ /dge sbyong gzhan zhig zas kyi phyir/ /bsod snyoms (nyel ni byon pa dang / /de la bdag gis sems dad pas( spre/ /ko ras kyi nyani thug pa byin/ /dge sbyong nyedes ni longs spyad nas/ /de nas nyenam mkhar 'phags par gyur/ /bdag ni rab tu dga' gyur 2—687

nas/ /thal mo legs par sbyar byas te/ /de nas gang dang gang du ni/ /song ba kun du 'breng7byas so/ /dga' ba rgya chen thob nas kyang / /de tshe smon lam btab pa ni/ /gnas brtan 'di lta bu dang bdag /lhan cig 'dug par gyur par shog /dge slong 'di yi las kyis ni/ /dri med chos ni gang reg⑧pa/ ci /bdag gis chos de rig⑧gyur cesaX/ /de tshe smon lam btab par gyur/ /kha dog ldan pa ma yin zhing / /dri ni smadakhupar gyur pa dang / /ro dang ldan pa ma yin pa'i/ /sbyin pa0bdag gis de tshe btang / /dge ba chung ngu byas pas kyang —/ /bde ba mang po myong bar gyur/ /bsod nams byas pasasnyemadzes pa yinya/ /lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur/ /bdag ni skye ba tha ma ni/ /mi'i srid thob pa7'di yin te/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /bdag gisatshwa smon lam gang btab pa'i/ /byang chub dam pa 'di reg5nyeste/ /bdag gis da ltar bsil gyur pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa legs par thob/ /de nas gnas brtan chen po ni/ /gnas brtan zhes bya mthu chen gyis8/ /ma dros pa tsoyi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /gnas brtan gnas brtan zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// // de nas dge slong gnas brten gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan ༵ lteng rgyas 'od srung la sogs pa gnas brtan gsum la 'di skad ces smras so/ 9tshe dang ldan pa dag gnas brtan gnas brtan zhes bya bas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis0 / tshe dang ldan pa deg gis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas de rnams kyis kyang lung bstan par brtsams pa/ bdag 2—688

cag gsum ni spun gyur nas/ci /gi /lhan cig tshong dpon gyur pa na/ji la /'od srungashemachod rten ral pa dngashe/ / /shag shig 'dug⑧pa mthong gyur nas/ /tshong0pa thams cad bsdus nas ni/ — /des ni7slar yang sar pas brtsigs/ sgo /spun rnams dag ni lhan cig tu/ — /gdugs gsum zhig ni gdagasalgeparnyubyas/ 4 ci/dge ba'i las ni de byas pas/ /mtho ris gnas su yun ringashedaga'/ /mi rnams su ni slar 'ongs nas/ ci /phyug po'i rigs chen medag tu skyes/ ji /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma mthong nas/ /mu stegs gzhan las rab tu byung / / nai rardzo na'ichu'ogs sa cho'aphralamadzadapamathonganasani denasadelarab rig / ci ci / zir / / 'byung phyir/ ci /bdag cag gis kyang gsol bsnyibatab/ ci /de nas thugs rje can gyi ni/ ci/thugasabartses bdag cag rab tu phyung / /bdag cag ga yā mgor son nas/— /gi ta ma'i bstan pa thos/ /de nas brtson 'grus brtsams pas ni/ /mya ngan 'a das pa dam pa thob⑥/tsho /da5)ltar ston pa bkur byas shing / /de tshe mchod rten mngon btud pas/ /bdag cag kun ni rab byung nas/ /bsil bar gyur te mya ngan 'das/ /lteng nyergyas dang ni chu klung dang /ci /ga lnga nye'od srung gnas brtan gsum/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /lteng rgyas dang /ca chu klung dang / tsho ga yā 'od srung rnams kyi le'u ste bcwa lnga pa'o// ci //ci ci ci ci ci gyu rtso ༷ — — de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa grags pa tshe dang ldan pa lteng ) rgyas dang / r+shachu klung dang / r+sha ga ālo'od srung rnams kyis rang gi las kyi 2—689

rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis①/ tshe dang ldan pa grags pas kyang dakhurang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pas kyang de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ bdag sngon⑧dri 'tshong gyur pa na/ /dri rnams 'tshong la mkhas gyur pasabya/ /der0ni de tshe nyo ba'i phyir/ /bud med gzhon nu ma dag 'ongs/ /der ni bdag gis0gzugs ldan ma'i/ /bud med 'ongs pa mthong nas ni/ /'dren brkyang gisasheni tshig smras shings/ /chags pa'i sems kyis regashepar byas/ /'du zhing lhan cig 'khod pa 'amatsho/ /mi tshangs spyod pa spro med kyang / /ma brtags gzhan gyi bud med la/ /lag pas rig par byas pas na / /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams su skyes/ /slar yang mir ni 'ongs pa na/ /lag pa g.yas pa bskams par gyur/ /de ltar tshe rabs lnga brgyar ni/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa na/ /rtag tu bdag gi lag pa ni/ /g.yas pa zha zhing rnam par bskams / /bdag gis sangs rgyas mnyes byas nas/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /mya ngan 'das pa'i bder gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /btsun pa bdag gis mi dge ba/ /gang bgyis dran pa 'di lags te/ /las rnams chud mi za bas na / / de yi 8'bras bu nyams su myong / /da dung du ⑥yang btsun pa dag(nye /bdag ni rdzu 'phrul ldan gyur na'ang / /lag pa g.yas 'di ji lta bar/ /g.yon pa de lta ma lags so/ /skyes pa'am bud med gang yang rung / /byi bo byed pa gang yin pa/ /sems can dmyal bar skyes nas ni(nye/ /de ni sdug bsngal tshor ba myong / /mkhas pa blo dang ldan pa'i mis/ /rab 'bar me ni ji lta bar/ /gzhan gyi bud med rnam spang zhing / /rang gi chung mas chog 2—690

par gyis/ /gzhan gyi bud7med mthong nas ni/ /skyes pa gang zhig de la chags/ /dmyal ba'i tshor bas nyen ②pa yis/ /sdug bsngal dumang po myong bar 'gyur/ / de dag gis0de ltar sdig byas pas/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan du na0/ /yun ring dmyal bar de yi ni/ /'bras bu mi nyung nyams su myong / /bdag gi skye ba tha ma 'diral/ /bla na med pa'i gnas thob nas/ /sdug bsngal kun las bdag grol zhing / /bsil bar gyur cingashemya ngan 'das/ /de lta bas na bde 'dod cing / /sdug bsngal nyid ni mi 'dod pas/ /gzhan gyi bud med 'gro mi bya/ /de ltar sdug bsngal mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas speganas brtan grags pas7ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan nos/ /gnas brtan grags pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa me skyes la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa me skyes tshe dang ldan pa grags pas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis / tshe dang ldan pa me skyes kyis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa me skyes kyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de8/ rgyal po'i pho brang bshes ldan du/ /rnam par gzigs kyi7tshangs spyod tshe/ /nyon mongs med ces bya ba yi/ /tshong dpon nor mang zhig tu gyur/ /thub chen rnam par gzigs pa yi/ /'khor ni stong phrag brgya dag dang / /drug bcu rtsa gnyis yod par gyur/ /de tshe rgyal po bshes ldan dang / /bdag gis mi yi khyu mchog ni/ /zla ba gsum du spyan drangs nas/ /phyir zhing bshos thang bskyed pa yis(nye/ /tshogs dang bcas 2wa 691

te tshim par⑥byas/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas zla gsum du/ ka —/bshos gso'akhade nas bshes ldan gyis/ swā /de tshe rjes gcod ston mo ni/ /bza' bca' dang ni na bza' dang / ci /gnas mal dag dang ldan pa gso'ag ci /de nas skyed mos tshal bstarasapa/4 /rgyal po des ni phul bar gyur/ /de bzhin dge slong re re la /gos kyis kun nas g.yogs pa'i stan/ cici/brgya stong dag dang de yis tshe/ — /gser gyi dra༄bas g.yogs pa yi/ /glang po shin tu legs brgyan pa/ /mi nyungakyib dag sbyin par btang / /dge slong re re'i spyi bor ni/ /de tshe gdugs kyang 'dzin par byed/ /de nas0bud med legs brgyan lusal/ /tsan dan a gsherus bskus pa/ /de dgashedage slong re re la'ang0/ /bsnyen bkur dag ni byed du bcug /rgyal po desarwagyeni de lta bu'i/ /rjes gcod pa la7bkur ste byas/ lke/drang srong gtso bo rnam par 'dren/ /rgyal pos tshim par byas pa dang / /stan de phun sum tshogs mthong nas/ la /de nas bdag gis bsams pa ni/— ci /bdag la bza' dang bca' yod kyang / ci /'di 'dra ba yi stan med de/ — /phun sum tshogs pa de 'dra dang / /glang po bdag la ga la bdog /lha yi dbang po dbang sgyurasnyib/ /brgya byin bdag gi drung du 'ongs/ ci /de nas brgya byin bdag la smras/ byu /khyod kyi grogs po ngas bya zhes/ — /des na lha yi7skyed mos tshal )/ /mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba sprul/—— / lha yi gdan ni bshams nas ni/ /lha yi g.yogs pa rnams kyis g.yogs/ /de nas bdag gis bcom ldan 'das//rnam nyegazigs 'jig rten gyis bkur ba/snye /mi mchog de ni nyan thos bcas — /gdugs tshod la ni spyan drangasalge nas/ ci /sa srung la sogs glang po rnams/ ci ci/lha yi rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa/ — /dge slong re re'i spyi bor ni/ /de tshe gdugs 2—692

dag 'dzin par byedagye/ ci /de nas rnam par 'dren pa ni/ / lha yi7zhal zas rnams kyis bstabasal/ ri /thub pa nyan thos thabs cig la/ /bdag gis lha yisagos kyis g.yogs/ /dge ba'i las ni de byas pas/ /bde ba mang po nyams su myong /srung/bsod nams byas pas lha dang ni/ du/mi yi nang du mdzes0gyur pasakyi /bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu/ ci 'i/ngan 'gro bdag gis mi shes so/ /rnam par gzigs pa dpal ldan sol/ /drang srong chen pos7bsnyen bkur bas/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma 'di/ /rgyal po'i khab tu bdag skyes so/ — /gzugs can snying po'i grong khyer du/snye /nor chen phyug po'i khyim du ni/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos ni/ci /de tshe bdag rjed bkur ste byas/ /blon po rnams dang grong mi la/ /kun nas sdug cing yid du 'ong / / lha yi5)'dod pas rtag tu ni/ /srid pa 'dir ni bdag tshim byas/ /mir gyur na yang lha rnams kyi/ /'dod pa yid 'ong nyams su myong /ci /de nas ded dpon bla na med/ ci /sangs rgyas rnam par 'dren pa po(nye/ /thub pa chen po thugs brtse bas/ /rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas shes rab chen po ni/ ci /rgyal po'i khab byon bdag gis thos/ /bcom ldan thub de gang na bar/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis song ba dang / /'jig rten gsal ba 'od mdzad pa/ /sgron ma 'dzin pa mthong nas ni/ /de tshe babs te rkang pas ni/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar song nas kyang / /thub pa che la bdag mgu bas/ ci /zhabs gnyis la ni mgos phyag byas/ /skyes mchog la ni phyag byas nas/ci /phyogs gcig tu ni 'dug nas su/ /'gro bas bsnyen bkur byas pa yi/ /dpa' chen bdud kyi 'ching ba bcad/ /ded dpon mi yi nyi ma ni8/ /ring po ma thogs mnyes par byas/ /'jig rten ston pa bla med pa'/ /des ni bdag 2—693

la thugs brtse bas/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bshad de/ /de tshe bdag gis so sor rtogs/ /de nas bdag gis7thugs rje can/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la 'di skad gsol/ /dpa' bo bdag ni rab 'byung zhing / /bsnyen par rdzogs parakhuthob par 'tshal/ /de nas shes rab dam pa can/ /sangs rgyas gang zag zlasamed pas/ /dge slong tshur shog ces gsungs pas/ /bdag ni bsnyen par rdzogs par gyur/ /des na bdag ni bag yod cing / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan brtan po yis/ /bdud rtsi mya ngan 'das zhi ba'i/ /gnas kyi dam pa reg par gyur/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur paX/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /srid par 'khor bar skye ba dang / /'chi ba rnams las bdag grol cingashe/ /mya ngan smre sngags 'don pa las/ /thams cad du ni bdag grol to/ /de ltar gnas brtan me skyes kyisal/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /me skyes kyi le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// // de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong tshe dang ldan pa me skyes kyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisal/ tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ka shi'i yul 'khor dar byed pa/ /rgyal po kṛ kri zhes bya byung / /rgyal po kṛ 2—694

khri'i7bu tha chungs②/ /de yi tshe na bdag gyur to/ /'od srung dpal dang ldan pa yi/ /mchod rten chen po brtsigs pa dang / /pha yi yid ni bsrungasaba'i phyir//de la gdugs bu chung zhig phul/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis mchod rtenasrel/ /gdugs ni gdags pa byas pa des/ /rab byung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /lhan cig 'grogs gyur smon lam btab/ /dge ba'i las ni de byas pas/ /gang dang gang du skyes par ni/ /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yi/ /lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma 'di/ /bang mdzod stug por bdag skyes te/ /der yang tshong dpon khyim du skyes/ /rigs kyi bu gcig par0gyur te/ /mi dbang kau rab bya dang ni/ /de bzhin kun sdug yid du 'ong / /de bzhin yul mi rnamasashedang nini/ /bdag ni gnyen tshogs yid du 'ong / /mdzes shing blta na sdug pa dang / /gzugs bzang shin tu dbyibs legs shing //mi yi 'byor pa rnams kyis ni/ /'dod pa thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /ston pa dga' zhing yid 'ong ba/ /bang mdzod stugashepor gshegs pa ni/ /bdag gis mthong nas sems dad pas / /rab tu 'byung bar gsol ba btab/ /ston pa gang zag zla med de/ /bsam pa kun la mkhas gyur pas/ /bdag gi bsam pa des mkhyen nas/ /rab tu byung ba las bzlog pa/ /pha ma dag gis ma gnang ba'i/ /gang zag dge yang sangs rgyas rnams/ /rab tu 'byin par mi mdzad kyisas/ /song la bdag nyid thar bar gyis/ /de nas khyim du bdag song nas/ /pha ma gnyis la smras pa ni/ /yab gcig gnang bar mdzod cig bdag /khyim ma mchis par rab 'byung ngo / /pha mas bdag las thos nas ni/ /de tshe khrod mi bder gyur nas/ /bu gcig khyod ni bdag cag gnyis/ /2—695

shi bar gyur na'ang mi gnanganyengo / ci/de thos nas ni bdag gis su/ rnyi /gal te mi gnang 'di nyid du/ ci /zas mi 'tshal bar bdag 'gum zhes/—— /sa la yang ni nyal bci byas/ca / /de tshe dkar po'i chos dag gis/ sgyu /bskul nas rab 'byung don gnyer zhing / /thar par 'dod pas zhag drugasatu/ /zan ma zos par 'dug pa dang / /de nas bdag dang mdza' ba yi/ ci ci /ne'u zlas pha ma la smras pa/ gi ci'adi ni gnang bar gyur na legs/ ri /khyed la shi bas ci zhig bya0/ /gal te 'di ni rab 'byung bar/ /dga' na phyis kyang khyed cag gis/ /gson po nyid du bltas so cog⑦ /shi bar gyur na ci zhig rung / /gal te rab tu byung ba la/ /'di ni dga' bar ma gyur na/ ci /khyed kyir zad mod pha ma las/ /gzhan nanyebu gnas ga la yod/ ci /bdag gi snyan smra ne'u zla la/ /pha ma gnyis kyis7smras pa ni / /gal te rab 'byung lta byed na/ /de lta na btang gzhan du min/ /de nas ne'u zla bdag gi drung / /nye bar 'ongs nas smras pa ni/ ci /mkhas pa khyod ni pha ma yis/ci /rab tu 'byung bar gnang ba ni/ /khyod la pha ma gnyis na re/ /gal te rab tu byung nas khyod/ — —/phyis kyang lta5)bar byed na ni/ /bu gcig song la rab tu byung / /legs zhes bdag gis mnyan byas te / / /de nas nyam ni brtas byas nas/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar song nas ni/ kā /'di skad ces ni tshig gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni gnang lags na/ /thub chen khyod kyi bstan pa la / /bde gshegs rab 'byung gsol 'debs na/ /rgyal ba bdag ni rab tu phyung / /de nas bdag ni rab byung nas/ /ston pa'i bstan la 'di ltar gnas/ /bdag gi kun sbyor thams cad zad/ ci /zag pa rnams ni bcom par gyur/ ci /bdag gis gdugs gcig btang bas ni/ /bde ba mang po myong bar 2—696
