gyur/ — /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yi/ /lha dang mi yinyernams su gyur/ /thams cad gzigs pa sa dgon pa pa/ /rnams kyi mchog tu bdag bstan to/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /de ltar thugs rje che rgyal la/ /yid ni rab tu dad byas te/ /mchod rten la ni bkur stesabyas / /'jigs pa che las rnam thar gyis/ /gnas brtan phyag dar khrod pa ni/ /yul 'khor skyong zhes grags pa yisaX/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ — /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /yul 'khor skyong gi le'u ste bcwa brgyad pa'o// ci // — — — ci ri ci 'dul ba gzhil/ bam po lnga bcu rtsashegasum pa/ de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa sa ga la 'di skad ces smras so/ — /tshe dang ldan pa sa ga tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisayi/ tshe dang ldan pa sa gas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sa gas de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de⑩/ rgyal po'i khab kyi tshong dpon gyi/ /gtso bo nor chen bdag gyur to / /dbyar gyi dus su drang srong ni/ /lnga brgya dag ni nye bar byon/ /der ni tshong dpon lnga brgya yang / /thams cad 'dus par gyur nas ni/ /kun gyis drang srong re re zhig /khyim khyim du ni bgo bar bya8/ /rang gi don du kha zas ni/ /ji lta bu dag g.yo byed pa/ /dka' thub can de re re la'ang / /rtag tu de 'dra kho na sbyin/ /de'i nang drang srong7rgan po gang / /de ni bdag gi skal bar 'ongs/ /tshong dpon mchog la de bzhin du/ /thub pa mchog ste 'tsham 2—697

par gyur/ /bdag la lnga brgya pa yi zas/ ci /snod gang nas ni 'dren byed pa/ /de 'dra ba yi kha zas nyid/ /bdag gis dge slong de la byin/ /de nas de la bdag la ni/ /ser sna shin tu mi bzad skyes/ /'di lta bu yi7kha zas ni/ /bdag gis7chung masabyin ma myong / /sring mo ma yin de bzhin du/ /bu dang bu mo dag dang ni/ /phusan la yangasam byin na/ /dge slong 'di la zla gsum du/ /sbyin pa lta zhig smos ci dgos/ /bdag ni lnga brgya po dag gis/ /gong tshogasakyichen por〈'dir gyur gyisani/ /ma la bdag gis dge sbyong 'di/ /gsad7pa la ni brtson byas te/ /'di ni shi ba'i dus byas na/ /bdag la 'god pa mi 'byung zhes(nye/ /de nas bdag gi sdig sems kyis/ /rta yi gcin ni bskol byas nasayi/ /nyes med pa ni gsad bya bar/ /kha zas rnams dang lhan cig byin/ /der ni zos ma thag tu yang / /mi bzad pa yi nad langs te/ /rgyu ma gnye ma mkhal ma dag /ro smad nas ni zags par gyur/ /thub pa chos kyi yon tan dga'/ /shes bzhin de nas dus las 'das/ /lha dang gnod sbyin gcig la gcig /sgra ni shin tu sgrogs byed pa/ /kye ma'o tshong dpon 'di re sdig /'di yis thub pa rang sangs rgyas/ /bsil bar gyur cing zag med pa/ /dbang ldan 'di ni bkrongs par gyur/ /nye du kun kyang 'khrugs nas ni/ /de nas bdag la smod byed pa/ /gang phyir thub pa 'di bsad pas/ / khyod kyis nyebasod nams min mang bskyed/ /nye du rnams kyi tshig thos nas/ /bdag kyang yid mi bde bar nyegyuras/ /drang srong de dag bsags nas ni/ /de nas bdag gis nyes pa bshags/ /bzod pa gsol nas de nas nyeyang / /nyes pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /lnga brgya la ni zhal zas kyis / /gus dang bcas 2—698

pas tshim par byas/ /bdag gisanyesdig pa de bshags nas/ /bzodakhugasol drang srong de dag ni/ /zas dang btung bas tshim byas nas/ /de tshe smon lam btab pa ni/ /gnas brtan 'di 'dra dag dang ni/ /bdag ni lhan cig 'grogs par shog /ji ltar 'di kun grol gyur pal/ /de bzhin 'chingakhulas grol bar shog /bkren pa rnams kyi khyim du bdag /lan 'ga'ang skye bar ma gyur cig /bdag gi sems ni lan 'ga' yang / /ser sna skye bar ma gyur cig /bdag gis rang sangs rgyas bsad pa'i/ /shin tu mi bzad las byas pas/ /de nas 'chi 'pho dus byas nas/ /dmyal ba rnams su skyes nas ni/ /yun ringasalo ni stong dag tu/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong / /slar yang mir ni 'ongs pa na/ /phyug cing nor chen gyur pa7dang / /'jig rten rnams kyis mchod bkur na'ang0/ /bdag ni myur du 'chi5)'gyur cing / /rtag tu bdag ni nang grol dag /'dzagacapas 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /khyim pa'i rtags rnams spangs nas ni/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /bstan la brtson 'grus byas pas na/ /'dod chags thams cad yang dag btona3nye/ /gang tshe len pa med pa yi/ /mya ngan 'das par bdag gyur na'ang / /rgyu ma gnye ma mkhal ma nang / /de dag kyang ni 'dzagatshwanyepar gyur/ /bdag gis sdig las byas pa dang / /dge ba'i las byas gang yin pa/ /dge dang sdig pa de dag gi/ /'bras bu de dag nyams su myong / /mnyan yod dbus na skyes pa yi/ /dge slong mthu chen sa gas ni/ dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /⑪ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /sa ga'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o//2—699

srung byin pa can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung byin pa can dge slong sa gas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis①/ da tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung byin pa can gyis kyangakhurang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung byin pa can gyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ mu ge dag ni byung ba na/ /grong khyer ba ni mtha' dag gis/ /lo bdun tshang bar dge slong gi/ /dge 'dun dag ni spyan drangs so/ sna /de nasabadag gi skal bar ni/ /rang sangs rgyas ni skal ldan pa/ /bsil bar gyur cing zag med pa'i/ /thub pa mdzes pa gcig cig 'ongs/ /bdag gis dam bcas byas pa ni/ /las mi byed na bu dang ni/ /nang mi yang rung su la yang ci /bdag gis zas ni mi sbyin no/ /de ltar rnam par bsams nas ni/ /bdag gis sdig pa'i blo bsams pa/ /dge slong las mi byed pa 'di/ /bdag gis ci ste zasasasbyin zhes/ /de nas drang srong bdag 'grogs nas/ /zhing las mtha' rnams blta ba'i phyir/ /mtha' dag tu ni bskor nas su/ /de yi 'og tu zas zar bcug /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /bsdus gzhom dang ni tsha ba yi/ /dmyal ba rnams su skyes nas ni/ /sdug bsngal kho na'i tshor ba thob/ /dmyal ba rnams nas shi 'phos bdag /gang dang gang du skyes par ni/ /de tshe brtson pa0mang byas na'ang / /sdug bsngal kho nas zas rnyed do/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni / /mi'irnyusrid thob pa 'di yin te/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yi/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /yang dag dad pas rab byung nas/ /2—700

bdag gisanyezag pa rnams bcom ste/ /bdag gisalgemangon shes drug reg nas/ /dgra bcom nyid kyang thob par gyur/ /da dung du yang btsun pa bdag /'di ltar rdzu 'phrul ldan lags na'ang / /da lta lan mang song nas ni/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni zas sgrubasnyepo/ /lam ni ring por song nas kyang / /bdag ni zas dag bsgrubasnyipa na/ /gang tshe bdag ni dub gyur nas/ / de yisnyi'og tu zas 'grub po/ /rus0ni 'od srung las kyi ming / /byin pa can ni mthu chen posaX/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /'od srung byin pa can gyi le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //sdom ni/ grags ldan dang ni dpal skyed dang / /bskusalashegasum grags pa dang / /me skyes dang ni yul 'khor skyong / /sa ga 'od srung byin7pa can//de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa lam phran bstan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa lam phran bstan tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung byin pa can gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis(nye/tshe dang ldan pas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa lam phran bstan gyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su/ /bdag ni phag rdzir gyur pa na/ /phag rnams kha ni bcings nas su/ /'bab chu las ni sgrol bar byed/ /'bab chu las ni bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis chu dbus phyin pa dang / /bskyod par gyur pas dbugs subasalgenas/ /phag rnams thams cad shi bar gyur/ /skyob pa med cing mgon med pas/ /bdag kyang 'bab chus khyer ba las/ /drang 2—701

srong rjes su brtse ba dag /'ongs nas bdag ni phyungatubar gyur/ /de dag gis bdag de las bsgral/ /de nas bdag gis rab tu byungakhu/ /bdag gis gdams ngag med par ni/ /'du shes med la snyoms par zhugs/ /de nas 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ /lha rnams su ni bdag skyes so)/ / lha yi0'jig rten shi 'phos nas/ /bdag gis mi yi srid pa thob/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyes byas nas/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /rmongs0shing g.yer po ma yin pas/ /bshad pa bdag gis ma rtogs so/ /btsun pa bdag gis zla gsum du / /tshigs bcad gcig la zhugs nas ni/ /tshig bzhi pa yi rkang pa gcig /rtogs pas 'dod chags kun bton to/ /btsun pa de ltar bdag gis ni/ /las gang bgyis pa dran lags te/ /bskal pa mi nyung yun ring du/ /'khor ba 'dirabani bdag gis brgyugs/ /'jig rten mgon gyi spyan sngar ni/ /lam phran bstan gyis ⑧dkar gnag ⑨las/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /lung ni (nyebastan pa ⑪byas pa yinas/ /lam phran bstan gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa0gcig pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa sprul khol la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sprul khol tshe dang ldan pa lam phran bstan gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis8/ tshe dang ldan pas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sprul khol gyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ sangs rgyas 'od srung mya ngan 'das/ /tha mar byung ba'i dge slong ni/ /sde snod gsum ldan mang du thos / /chos kyi ser sna can du gyur/ /dge slong gzhan dag shes gyur na⑩/ /2—702

bdag dang mtshungs7par 'gyur 'ong zhes/ /bdag gis dge slong rnams la chos / / ma stonakhucing ni ma bshad do/ /bdag gi drung du dge slong gang / /nye bar 'ongasasnyenas 'dri byed na'ang / /thams cad gdams ngag ma byin par//thams cad du ni spyos shing bgyirgya/ /dge slong rnams ni nyer 'ongs nas/ /de tshe bdag la bkur sti byed/ /chos ni rab tu mi ston pa/ /khyod kyi de ni bzangakyimin zer/ /de nas 'chi ba'i dus bab tshe/ /bdag gis chos ni gzhan dag la//ma bstan de ni legs min zhes/ /bdag ni yid la 'gyod par gyur/ /tshe yi lhag ma zhung ngu zhig /zhag bdun lus nas bdag gis ni/ /rab tu byung ba rnams bsogasashete/ /de nas nyes pa bshags pasnyebyas/ /bdag gis nyes pa bshags byas shing / /ser sna de ni rnamanyebasal nas/ /de tshe bdag gis nub bdun du/ /don bzang ba yi7chos bshad do/ /bdag gis7blo la ci lcogs pas/ /legs par bshad pa'i chos thos nas/ /phan tshun 'doms shing gcig la gcig /smra bar yang ni byed du bcug /de tshe bdag gis nub bdun du/ /chos ni cung zad gcig bshad pas/ /'dod pa thams cad 'byor pa yi/ /lha yi 'jig rten dag tu dga'/ /lha yi 'jig rten shi 'phos te/ /bdag gis mi yi srid thob nas/ /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi dag tu/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i rigs su skyes/ /nor chen longs spyod chen po dang / /gzugs bzang blta na sdug pa dang | /thams cad la sdugatsoyid 'ong zhing / /phun sum tshogs pa'i mthar phyin to8/ /khyim re nas ni skyes pa re/ /khyim med par ni rab 'byung las/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod 'byor pas na(nye/ /bdag ni rab byungasnyim btub po/ /rdzogs sangs gang zag zla med payi/ /bdag nyid la ni thugs brtse'i phyir/ /2—703

yang dang yang du rab 'byungatub/ /yang dag len pasaskul ma mdzad/ /de nas ded dpon zlasamed pa/ /sangs rgyas la ni bdag gis0gsol/ /re zhig bdag gis lo bdun du/ /sbyin pa mi nyung gtang bar bgyiX/ /bdag gis sbyin pa dag btang nas/ /lo bdun lon par gyur pa dang / /shes rab mchog can khyod las ni/ /de nas bdag niphurab tu 'byung / /lo bdun dag ni thogs ches la/ /tshe ni cung zad tsam yin pas/ /sang nyid 'chi yang susheshes kyis0/ /de ring nyid du brtul te gyis/ /bdag gis gus pasanyesangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung ni slar bzlogasnyem byas paratso/ /btsun pa bdag ni dgung bdun na/ /thugs brtses rab tu dbyung bar mdzod/ /bdag gis zhag bdun sbyin btang ste/ /phongs pa rnams ni tshim byas nas/ /bdag gi phyir ni nye du dag /grong khyer du ni mel tshe0btsugs/ /snang ba chen po rnams kyis ni/ /grong khyer mchog ni gsal bar byas/ /skye bo dag gis ma tshor bar rab 'byung phyir ni mngon0du byung / /bdag ni dad pas rab byung nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la brtson byas te/ /lo ni nyi shu lnga lon yang / /sems mnyam pa yang ma thob bo/ /de nas bdag gi〈 )sdig pa'i sems/ /'dod la zhen pa0skyes pa ni/ /bdud rtsi rtogs par ma gyur gyis( spre/ /dman par slar ni bdag ldog snyam / /de nas ngo tsha khrel yod pa/ /don chen dag ni skyes gyur pa/ /bdag la nye du'i tshogs smod cing / /skyon du yang ni 'grang 'gyur ba/ /de ni bdag dang 'tsham min zhing / /de ni bzang po ma yin gyis / /bdag lta gson na'ang ci ru rung / /mtshon gyis gdab par bya'o snyam/ /mtshon rnon bdag gis blangs nas su/ / skyil mo krung ⑥ni bcas nas kyang / /mtshon ni ske la 2—704

gtang btulas/ /de nas sems ni rnam par grol/ /bdag sems tha ba las grol nas/ /yang dang yang du brjod pa ni/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun②/ /e ma'o chos nyid e re bzang / /sngon ni bdag gi 'du shes gang / /so so'i skye bo shi bla snyam/ /bdag gis srog lasam0bltas pas/ /zhi ba dam pa thob par gyur/ /sngon ni 'khums par gyur pa yis/ /dam chos ser sna byas pa gang / /btsun ①pa rjode yi 'bras bu ni/ /sdug bsngal ba yis rnam par grol/ /bdag gis 'chi ba'i dus na chos/ /dam pa rab bstan gang yin pa'i/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i pha rol phyin/ /shākya'i bu pho dbang po brtulanya/ /sprul khol mthu chen ldan pas ni/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /sprul khol gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gagasalgepa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags7pa tshe dang ldan pa sprul khol gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis0 / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gagasalgepas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ sngon ni phrag khur khyer ba yi/ / rtswa thun dbul por gyur pa na/ /bdag gis dge sbyong grags ldan pa/ /nyon mongs bcom la bsod snyoms phul/ /shākya'i rigs la bdag skyes na'ang / /bdag ni ma 'gags yin par shes/ /rol mo glu la mkhas gyur pas/ /pheg sgra phyadanepas bslang ba na/ /rdzogs sangs ga las bsnyengs7med pa/ /ston pa bdag gis mthong bar gyur/ /mthong nas 2—705

bdag ni sems dad pas/ /khyim med par yang rab tu byung / /bdag gis de yi gsung thos nas/ /bstan la dga' bas gnas gyur te/ /rtag tu pha rol gnon brtan zhing / /gzabasanyepa'i bdag nyid brtson 'grus brtsams/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mthar phyung nas/ /rig pa gsum ni rjes su thob/ /bdag sngon gang na 'dug pa yi/ /sngon gyisaganas ni shes gyur te/ /sum bcu rtsa gsum lha rnams su/ /bdag gis lan bdun skye ba blangs / /slar yang mi yi nang du ni/ /mi yi dbang po lan bdun byas/ /de tshe 'dzam tshal dbang phyug gi / /rgyal rigs spyi bor dbang bskur to/ /'dir ni bdun dang der bdun te④/ /bdag gisakyilan ni bcu bzhir 'khor/ /bdag sngon gang na 'dug pa yi / /gnas ni sngon du shes gyur te/ /las kyi 'bras bu de lta bu/ /bdag gis de tshe nyams su myong / /gang dang gang du skyes pa na⑥/ /dga' ba dag gis rgyu bar byed/ /sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang / /'ong ba dang ni 'gro'ub dang / /'di lta bu dang gzhan gyur shes/ /'phags pa'i yan lag lnga ldan dga'/ /yan lag lnga pa'i ting7'dzin la/ /'i/ ba phyogs gcig goms byas shing / /shin tu sbyangs thob lam gyis ni/ /lha yi spyan ni rnam par sbyangs/ /ston pa 'jig rten bla med kyis() / /bdag gi kun rtogasumakhyen nas kyang / /yid las byung ba'i sku yis ni/ /bdag drung rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas/ /ston pa spros med la dgyes pas/ /spros pa dang ni bral ba bshad/ /bdag gis de yi gsung thos nas/ /bstan la dga' bas gnas gyur te/ /rtag par pha rol gnon brtan zhing / /gzabs pa'i bdag nyid brtson 'grus brtsams/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mthar phyung nas/ /rig pa gsum ni rjes su thob/ /'chi 2—706

ba'ang mngon par mi dga' zhing / /'tsho ba'ang mngon par mi7dga' ste/ /shes bzhin dran dang ldan pa yis/ /dus la so sor rtog par byed/ /yangs pa'i 'od ma'i grong khyer gyi/ /'od ma'ikhutshang tshing de'i drung du/ /bdag gi srog ni zad nas kyang / /zag med mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis bsod snyoms byin pas ni/ /'bras bu thob pa 'di yin te/ /rdzogs sangs gang zag zla med pa'i/ /ston pa bdag gis mnyes par byas/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /thams cad gzigs pas bsod nams can/ /rnams kyi mchog tu bdag⑧bstan to/ /de ltar gnas brtan ma 'gagasalgepas/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun0'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gikyilas ni lung bstan to/ /ma 'gags pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po la 'de skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nag po tshe dang ldan⑧pa ma 'gagasalgepas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisaX/ tshe dang ldan pas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag pos de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de / bu ram sbyor ba'i khang pa na/ /bu ram shing rnams 'tshir ba las rang sangs rgyas ni skal ldan pa/ /nad pa gsor rung zhig 'ongs nas/ /bdag gis thub pa nub bdun du/ /bu ram til mar bsnyen bkur0byas/ /skal ldan zhag bdun 'das pa dang / /de nas de ni mkha' la 'phags/ /de nas bran 2—707

de nyer 'ongs nas/ /bdag la smras par gyur pa ni/ /yon gnas rab tu byung gyur pa/ /de lta bu ni song bar gyur/ /drang srong mkha' la7song ngo zhes/ /bdag gis de lasakhutshig thos nas/ /sems mgu ba dang yid bde bas/ /de yi tshe na dad pasabyas/ /sems rab dang ba desadang ni/ /bu ram sbyin par btang ba des/ /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yi/ /lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur / /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ /mi'i srid thob pa7'di yin te/ /rdzogs sangs bla na med pa yis/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis rab 'byung7thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /da dung du yang btsun pa dag /bdag gi chos gos bsod snyoms dang / /yo byad dang ni gnas mal minya/ /rnyed pa mang po skye bar gyur8/ /bdag ni chos gos 'drub pa na0/ /bu ram btung ba blud pa'i phyir/ /bdag la bu ram snod7bzhi zhig /dgos so snyam du bsams pa dang / /rgyal po gzugs can snying po la/ /de nas lha yis smras pa ni/ /ri dgas 'dzin bu nag po la/ /bu ram btung ba byin cig dang / /mi yi dbang po khyod kyis ni/ /bu ram btung ba don chen 'gyur / /'tsho byed a mra'i tshal du ni/ /ri dgas bu la bu ram skyol/ /rgyal po'i mchog ni mthu chen po/ /gzugs can snying pos bdag la ni/ /snod chen bu ram gyis bkang ba/ /bzhi po dag ni bskur bar gyur/ /de nas des ni bu ram dag /ro dang ldan pa khyer 'ongs nas/ /stong ni nyis brgya lnga bcu yi/ /dge slong dge 'dun tshim par byas/ /ri dgas 'dzin bu dgra bcom pa/ /mngon shes drug ldan mthu chen po/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi0las ni lung bstan 2—708

to/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa sgra canatuzin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sgra canakhuzin tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag pos rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisal/tshe dang ldan pa sgra can zin gyis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sgra can zin gyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ bdag sngon lus 'phags mi thi la'i/ /bdag po rgyal por gyur pa na/ /dgos pa zhig gi phyir 'dug nas/ /skye bo rjes su bstan0pa na/ /de nas drang srong dka' thub che/ /gzi brjid mchog 'jigs 'ongs gyur te/ /de ni nye bar 'ongs nas kyang / /bdag la 'di skad tshig smras so/ /sa bdag bdag ni rkun ma ste/ /bdag gis ma byin chab 'tshal gyisaX/ /rkun po'i chad pa ji lta bar/ /khyod kyis de bzhin gcan⑧du gsol/ /drang srong chos kyi yon tan dga'/ /de la bdag gis der smras pa/ /khyod la chu ni gnang bar byas /khyod ni song la ci bder spyod/ /rgyal po bdag gi 'gyod pa ni/ /de ltas bsalasheba'i rngo mi thog⑩ /bdag la chad pas gcod mdzod dang / /'gyod pa dag dang 'bral bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis de ni skyed mos tshalanya/ /gzhir ni zhag drug spang ba byas/ /de ni zhag drug lon nas phyir/ /rang gi bsti gnas gnas su song / /zhe snang med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sdig pa bdag gis byas pas kyang / /rab tu tsha dang thig nag tu/ /lo ni drug bcu rnams su btsos/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /bdag gi lus ni tha ma la/ /ma yi mngal du lo drug 2—709

ni / / tshang bar yangatuni 'dug par gyur/ /bdag ni zhe sdang med bzhin du/ /lus dang ngag gi las byas pargya/ /las rnams chud mi za bas na/ /de yi 'bras bu nyams su myongs/ /de ltar gnas brtan sgra can0zin/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yisamatsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /sgra can zin gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo tshe dang ldan pa sgra can gzin gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisani/ tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos kyang de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ rnam par gzigs kyi gsung rab la/ /bdag gis lan gcig khrus byas te/ /dge slong dge 'dun7khrus byas nas/ /de tshe smon lam btab pa ni/ /gnas brtan 'di lta bu dag dang / /bdag ni lhan cig 'grogs par shog /dag cing dri ma med pa dang / /nyon mongs med cing zag bral shog /kha dog bzang po dag dang ni//gzugs bzang gyur ces smon lam btab/ /de nas 'chi 'pho'irnyudus byas nas / /lha rnams su ni skyes par gyur/ /bdag ni gser gyi mdog 'dra ba'i/ /mi dang lha ni rnams su gyur/ /gang dang gang du skyes par ni/ /longs spyod chen pos shin tu gnas/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten ni/ /shin tu dkar po bdag gis brtsigs/ /de nas byug pas thams cad ni/ /ser por gyur pa de ltar byugs/ /de nas mtshan rnams 'dod pa'i phyir/ /gser gyi mdog tu 2—710

'gyur btudang / / gzugs bzangasnyedabyibs ni legs 'gyur bar/ /smon lam du ni gdabasnyepa byas/ / dge ba'ikhulas ni de byas pas/ /grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr ni/ /ka shi'i rgyal po kṛ 5⑧yi/ /bu pho 'bring por bdag skyes so/ /'od srung mchod rten mthong nas ni/ /de nas dad pa'i sems bskyed de/ /mchod rten de la bdag gis ni/ /gdugs 'bring zhig ni gdags pa byas/ /khrus de dang ni bsro gang0dang / /yung gi byug pas byugs pa dang / /gdugs ni gdags pa byas pa yis/ /bde ba mang po nyams su myong / /de nas las kyisalhag mas niX/ /bdag gi ste 0yang srid tha ma 'dir/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i rigs skyes nas/ /sangs rgyas skyobarwa)pa'i mched du gyur/ /bdag gi lus ni 'di la yang / /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan yod pa/ /sum bcu lhag pa ma yin pa'i / /sum bcu dman pa ma yin pa'o/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis rab 'byung thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /thams cad gzigs pas mdzes pa yi/ /rnams kyi mchog tu bdag bstan to/ /nyes bsal zag pa zad nas ni/ /go 'phang dam pa thob par gyuratso/ /de ltar gnas brtan dga' bos ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi lasalgeni lung bstan to/ /dga' bo'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu 2—711

nor gyis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor gyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung stonanyepar byed de/ 'di nisnyebadag sngon tshong pa ni/ /nya pa zhes ni bya bar gyur/ /tshong pa'i lam du zhugs pa na/ /dbang du gyur cing zag med pa/ /nyon mongs med pa'i rang sangs rgyas/ /drang srong zhig ni 'gron⑧par 'ongs/ /de yi bar du bdag gis ni/ /rtag par zas la mgron du bos/ /gang du brang ni 'debasasnyi'agyur ba/ /der ni gding ba dag kyang bshams/ /rkang pa'i chu dang til mar dang / /de yikyimar me dag kyang bshams/ /ji srid lam yod de srid du/ /bdag gis de la bkur ste byas/ /tshong pa rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phyin pa dang / /dge slongs gye drung7nyer 'ongs nas/ /bdag gis de la smras pa ni/ /btsun pa rgya mtsho 'di la ni/ /nor gyi slad du bzhud dam ci/ /btsun pa bdag cag phongs pas na/ /'dod pa dag gi phyir yang ni/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu tshogs7la/ /nyen can du ni 'jug par byed/ /bdag la dge slong des smras pa/ /bdag ni mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /khyed cag gnyen kun lhan cig tu/ /nor cher bsod nams che bder gyur/ /de tshe de la bdag gis ni/ /rab dga'as chos gos bzang po phul/ /mgo bos phyag ni byas nas yang / /de la bskor ba dag byas so/ /de nas bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /des ni chos gos blangs nas ni/ /de dag thams cad lta bzhin du/ /de yi 'og tu mkha' la 'phags/ /cho 'phrul byed pa de mthong nas/ /de tshe bdag ni skyo gyur nas/ /bdag gis thal mo sbyar byas te/ /de nas smon lam btab pa ni/ /gnas brtan 'di lta bu dag dang / /bdag ni lhan cig 'grogs par shog /2—712

'di yis7chos ni gang dag thob/ /de dag bdag gis thobalgepar shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas ni mnyes byed cing / /rab tu 'byungasab thob pa dang / /dge 'dun la yang rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rnam 'phrul bkur ste byed par shog /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yis ni/ /lha yi 'jig rten rab tu dga'/ /mi yi 'thob pa thob nas kyang / /bde ba mang pokhunyams su myong / /skye ba de dang de dag tu/ /bdag ni nor chen phyug pa dang / /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yis lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur/ /bskal pa tha ma 'di la ni/ /srid pa tha ma 'di la yang | /ku shi zhes bya'i gyad rnams kyi/ /rgyad kyi bur ni bdag skyes te/ /blta na sdug cing mdzes pa dang / /gzugs bzang spyod pa mdzes pa dang / /thams cad la sdug yid 'ong zhing / /phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin noX/ /sangs rgyas shākya seng ge ni/ /bla na med pa mnyes par byas/ /mthong nas bdag sems dad byas te/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /ma ga r+sā7yi ri brgyudashenas / /'od ma'i7tshal du gnas byas na0/ /dge slong dge 'dun mtho 'tshamanyepa'i/ /nyan thos dag cig der lhags te/ /gnas mal dag ni bskos na yang / /dge slong rnams la spyo byed de/ /rnam par 'tshe zhing smod pa dang / /yang dang yang du gshe bar byed/ /tshangs mtshungs spyod pa rnams mthong nas/ /bdag ni snying rje bar gyur te⑩/ /bdag ni zag pa zad gyur kyang / /nyid kyis dge slong bsnyen bkur bya/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus brtsams nas ni8/ /bstan pa 'di la brtson byas pas/ /dgra bcom bdag gis thob nas ni/ /mngon shes drug la dbang byas so/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar song nas ni/ /thub la mgo bos phyag byas te/ /thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas su/ /skyes bu dam pa la 2—713

gsol pa/ /'dod chags gti mug gis ma lags/ /byams sems gus dang bcas pa yis/ /thub pa bdag ni dge slong gi/ /rim gro bgyid paratuganang bar mdzod/ /pha rol sems la mkhas pa yi/ /ston pas bdag gsol mkhyen nas ni/ /nyid kyis dge slong dge 'dun mdun/ /gnyug ma'i rim gro byed du bcug /byams pa'i lus kyisalas dang ni/ /de bzhin ngag dang yid kyis kyang ske/ /bdag gis rtag tu sems smad nas/ /dge slong dge 'dun rim gro byasal/ /spyod pa la ni zhugs pa dang / /lam nas 'ongs pa'i dge slong dag /bdag gis mthong nasasridaga' ba dngasre/ /so sor yid ni bde gyur nasaX/ /til mar rab 'bar lta bu yi/ /bdag gi sor lnga'i sgron ma yi/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan byas nas/ /gnas mal dag ni 'cha' bar byed/ /dge slong gang dag bdag gi ni/ /cho 'phrul 'di ni lta 'dod na/ /nam ni sros par gyur pa dang / /mun khung bdag drung lhags nas ni/ /de rnams la ni ci rigs par / /byams sems gus dang bcas pa yisal/ /gnas mal dag ni 'cha' byed cing / /skye bo mang po skyo ba skyed/ /bdag gis bsams pa gang yin dang / /bdag gis smon lam gang btab pa/ /bdag gis7bzang po de grub cing / /go 'phang mi g.yo bdag gis thob/ /de lta bur ni rgyad bu nor/ /zag pa med cing dbang gyur pas/ /ma dros〈nyepa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /gyad bu nor gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa0)bdun pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa nye sde la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nye sde tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor gyis 2—714

rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa nye7sdes kyang dakhurang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa nye sdes de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ 'das pa dag gi dus na bdag /rngon pa dag tu gyur pa na/ /nags chen nyams dga'akhubyul ba dang / /ri dgas rnam0pa sna tshogs mthong / /dug gis bskus pa'i mda' rnams dang / /gzhu yi tshogs dag blangs nas ni/ /ri dgas mang po'isnyi'i yi rdzong / /de yangakhuder ni bdag gis brgyus/ /bdag gis ri dgas rnams mthong na⑦/ /gdugasnyepa'i sems ni nyer bzhag nas/ /dug gis bskus pa'i mda' rnams kyis/ /ri dgas mang po rab tu bsnun⑨/ /bdag gi lag na gzhu dang ni/ /dug gis bskus pa'i mda' srel bzhin/ /rang sangs rgyas shig ljon shing gi/ /drung na bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur/ /bdag gis〈nyedage sbyong de mthong nas/ /de tshe yid ni mi bder gyur/ /de nas thub pa gnod med pa'i/ /lus la mdas〈nyeni bsnun par gyur/ /de yi 'og tu dge slong de/ /mda' yi zug rngu'i sdug bsngal ldan/ /shing de nyid kyi drung du ni/ /len pa med par mya ngan 'das/ /rtsub pa'i las de byas pas na/ /sems can dmyal bar skyes nas ni/ /de la lo ni stong phrag tu/ /bdag gis sdug bsngal tshor ba myong / /de nas dmyal las shi 'phos nas/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas song nas ni/ /ri yi rdzong ni de nyid du/ /bdag ni ri dgas rnams su skyes/ /rtag tu 'jigs shing bag tsha zhing / /bkres shing skom pas nyen pas na/ /rid cing shin tu sdug bsngal bas/ /bdag ni de dang der rgyu'o/ /rdzong der rngon pa gdugasapa ni/ /shin tu mi bzad pa rnams kyis/ /dug gis bskus pa'i mda' rnon gyis/ /bdag gi 2—715

lus la bsnun par gyur/ /bdag 'gyel de dag gis mthong nas/ /bdag ni gson zhing 'gul bzhin du/ /mtshon gyis yan lag rnams kyi sha /bcad nas de rnams khyer zhing 'dong / /bdag ni sa phyogs de nyid du/ /sha yi ched du bsad byas te/ /de ltar tshe rabs lnga brgyar ni/ /sdug bsngal mang po bsgrubs pa yin/ /ri bo de nyid ngos natuni/ /dka' thub ldan la mthu che zhing / /rdzu 'phrul che gzi mi bzad pa'i/ /drang srong rab tu mang po mthong / /bdag gis drang srong de mthong nas/ /de nas byams pa'i sems bsgoms te/ /blo bzang byams dang ldan pa la/ /yang dang yang du blta byas so/ /dka' thub ldan pa de rnams la/ /bdag gis gus bcas semasasnyedad byas/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yis ni / /bdag gis mi yi srid pa thob/ /zas don gnyer ba'i slong ba ni/ /rang sangs rgyas shig mthong nas ni/ /gus pa yis ni rtag par de/ /bdag gis zas lasaspyan drangs so/ /btsun pa de tshim byas nas su/ /de tshe smon lam btab pa ni/ /drang srong 'di lta bu dag dang / /bdag ni lhan cig 'grogs par shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas ni mnyes byed0cing / /bdag gis rab 'byungasathob nas ni/ /'jigs shing skrag pa med pa yi/ /zag pa med la gnas par shog /dge ba'i las de byas pas na/ /lha yi 'jig rten rab tu dga'/ /mi nyid rnyed pa thob nas kyang / /phyug cing nor ni mang bar gyural/ /rdzogs sangs gang zag zla med pa/ /ston pa bdag gis mnyes par byasani/ /bdag gis shākya thub mthong nas/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /dad pas rab tu byung nas kyang / /bstan la dga' bas gnas byas pas/ /bdag gis dgra bcom thob nas ni/ /mngon shes drug la dbang byas so/ /da dung du yang 2—716

btsun pa dag /bdag ni thams cad dbang gyur na'ang / /phug gi nang du zhugs nas su/ /'chi btunye bar gyur pa na/ /sbrul gdug⑧shin tu mi bzad pa/ /bdag gi lus la 'bab par gyur②/ /btsun pa bdag gis nyes spyad padu//gang bgyis dran pa 'di lagasasate/ /las ni chud mi za bas na/ /de yi 'bras bu nyams su myong / /de ltar gnas brtan nye sde yis / /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /nye sde'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa bzang ldan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa bzang ldan tshe dang ldan pa nye sdes rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa bzang ldan gyis kyang ⑧da rang gi las ①kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis de'i tshe rang gi lasarwa〉kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de / dgon pa shin tu 'jigs chen gyi/ /mu ge dag ni byung ba na/ /rang gi zas ni don gnyer ba/ /slong ba po ni lnga brgya yi/ /de rnams kun gyi dpon gyur cing / /de dag kun gyis gtsor bkur te/ /de rnams kun gyis bslangs pa gyi/ /zas ni bdag la 'bul bar byed/ /de dag bzang ngam ngan pa'ang rung / /thob pa bdag la 'ged par byed/ /bdag gi nyetshig gis gnas pas na/ /de dag bdag la brnyas mi byed/ /mi zhig snum khur zhig khyer nas/ /tshong 'dus nang nas 'gro ba las/ /bdag gis de las mthus phrogs te⑩/ /khyer nas de nas song ba dang / /de nas bdag gis brgyugs pa dang / /phyi 2—717

bzhin du ni snyegasatum byung / /smyugs7bcad bros par gyur pa na/ /de dag gis ni gzungasam nus/ /'bab chu'i pha rol rgal0nas ni/ /bdag ni phyogs gcig 'dug nas su/ /'ga' zhig 'ong bar 'gyur snyam nas/ /mtha' dag tu ni ltasnyibar byedadu/ /snum la g.yos legs byas zin pa'i/ /snum khur bdag gis zos na ni/ / des na bdag nirnyusto 'grangs7pas/ /nyin zhag gcig ni thub 'gyur snyam/ /de nas skal ldan rang sangs rgyas/ /yang srid skye ba zad gyur pa/ /rdzu 'phrul che gzi mi bzad pa/ /drang srong 'jigs pa zhig 'ongs so//bdag gi sems la bsams pa ni/ /sdug bsngal bkren par gyur pa ni/ /sngon chad bsod nams ma byas pas/ /des bdag 'di ltar bkren par gyur/ /ma la bdag gis dge sbyong 'di/ /snum khur gtsang ma 'di sbyin te/ /bdag ni ltogs par shi bla yi/ /'di ltarwanyebakren pa mi rung ngo / /de la bdag sems dad byas nas/ /yid mgu ba dang rangs pa yis/ /dge slong dam pa mchod 'os pa'i/ /yon gnas de la snum khur phul/ /skal ldan gyis ni de blangs nas//bdag nyid la ni snying brtse'i phyir/ /de nyid du ni longs spyad nas/ /de nas mkha' la 'phags par gyur/ /de nas smon lam btab pa ni/ /bdag ni bkren par mi 'gyur zhing / /kha dog bzang posarnams dang ni/ /rigs btsun pa yang don du gnyer/ /gnas brtan 'di lta bu dag dang / /bdag ni lhan cig 'grogs par shog /khyod nyid kyis ni gang rtogs pa/ /de 'dra'i chos kyang shes par shog /dge ba'i las de byas pas na/ /bde ba mang po nyams su myong / /bsod nams byas pas mdzes pa yi/ /lha dang mi ni rnams su gyur / /lha dang mi yi rgyal srid kyang / /bdag gis mang po nyams su myong / /2—718

las de yis ni lan 'ga' yang / /bdag ni ngan 'gror ma song ngo / /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /bdag gi yang srid tha ma 'dir/ /shākya rnams kyi grong mchog tu/ /rigs btsun par ni bdag skyes so/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ /mi'i0srid thob pasa'adi yin te/ /yang dganyesangs rgyas bla med pa/ /shākya seng ge 'di mnyes byas/ /gang tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /nye du'ikhuganas su gshegs pa na/ /de tshe bdag ni nye du yi/ /mdun du bdar nas rab tu byung / /bdag gi smon pa gang yin pa/ /de ni bdag gis yongs rdzogs te/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /rgyal po'i rgyud las rab byung ba/ /sangs rgyas nye du bzang ldan gyis/ / dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /⑤ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa mdzes bzang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mdzes bzang tshe dang ldan pa shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyisasherang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis/tshe dang ldan pa mdzes bzang gis kyang dakhurang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mdzes bzang gis de'i tshe rang gi ⑨las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ skyob pa log par dad sel gyi0/ /mchod rten zhig ni rtsiganyepa na / /de tshe bdag ni mkhar len7pa/ /gla mir gyur te de nas ni/ /bdag gis mchod rten rtsig pa la/ /yang dang yang du dpyad pa ni/ /mchod rten 'di ni che ches pas/ /nam zhig na ni mthar phyin 'gyur/ /mchod rten 'di 2—719

ni 'phangatudama' zhing / /chung ngu zhig tu byas gyur na②/ /'god pa chung zhing nyon mongs med/ /myur du mthar yang phyin par 'gyur/ /las kyi rnam smin de dang ni/ /ngag gi nyes parasaspyad pa des/ /de nas 'chi 'pho'i dus byas te/ /dmyal ba rnams su skyes par gyur/ /dmyal ba nas ni shi 'phos bdag /gang dang gang du skyes par ni/ /kha dog ngan cing bong chungakyil/ /bdag ni yongs kyis smad par gyur/ /'od srung gi ni gsung rab tshe/ /sngon ni khu byug phor gyur nas / /bā rā ṇa sī'i lam gyi bar/ /tshal stug po yi nang na gnas/ /de nasa'ajig rten rab gsal mdzad/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun byas 'kha/ /bdag gis 'jam dbyangs skad phyung zhing / /nam mkha' las ni der bskor to / /ji tsam yang dag sangs rgyas ni/ /bsod snyoms don phyir gshegs mthong na / /'byung ba dang ni gshegs pa las/ /rtag tu yang ni bskor7ba byas/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yis ni/ /bdag gis mi yi srid thob nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla med pa/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis rab byung thob nas ni/ /mya7ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag ni thams cad gzigs pa yis/ /'jam dbyangs rnams kyi mchog dang ni/ /mang du thos dang chos 'dzin dang / /dge ba'i spobs pa can du bstan/ /lha 'am yang na mi yang rung / /'khor bzhi po dag bdag las ni/ /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i chos thos nas/ /thams cad rab tu5)dga' bar 'gyur8/ /dge ba nyung ngu byas pa dang ske/ /mi dge mang po byas pa yi/ /las rnams chud mi za bas na/ /de yi 'bras bu nyams su myong / /de ltar gnas brtan mdzes bzang gis/ /dge 2—720

slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /mdzes bzangatugi le'u ste sum bcu pa'o// //sdom ni/ lam phran sprul kholasam 'gagasasnyedang / /nag po lnga pa sgra can dang / /dga' bo nor dang nye sde dang / /bzang ldan dang ni mdzes bzang ngo //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gnas 'jog ③sprang rtsi can tshe dang ldan pa mdzes bzang gis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisaX/ tshe dang ldan pa gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi can gyisashekyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung stonasacig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi can gyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ bdag ni sngon ni yangs pa yi/ /spra chen spre'ushedabang gyur pa na/ /lhung bzed mang po mthong nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i lhung bzed blangs pa las/ /dge slong rnams kyis bdag bkag nas/ /de nas bcom ldan bka' stsal pa/ /'di ni lhung bzed mi gcog gis0/ /dge slong rnams kyis ma dgag zhig /ston pa'i lhung bzed khyer nas ni/ /shing gi khar ni 'dzegs nas tsarnya/ /sbrang rtsis yongs su bkang nas kyang / /dal bus rim gyis babs nas ni/ /lhung bzed sbrang rtsi can thogs te/ /ston pa la ni phul ba las/ /ston pas srog chags bcas par ni/ /mkhyen te bdag las ma bzhes nas/ /bdag gis phyogs gcig song nas ni/ /de la srog chags yod mthong nas/ /srog chags med par gtsang7byas te/ /ston pa la ni phul ba dang / /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /bdag las 2—721

sbrang rtsi ma bzhes par①/ /ma brtags thugs su chud nas ni/ /bde bar gshegs pas ma bzhes snyam/ /de nas lhung bzed sbrang rtsi can/ /de tshe bdag gis chus btab nas/ /sems ni mgu dngasridaga' ba yis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phul ba las/ /de nas gang zag zla med pa/ /ston pa'i phyag 'jam gnyis kyis su/ /bdag lasalhung bzed bzhes nas ni/ /de ni nyan thos rnams la gtad/ /bdag ni rab tu dga' gyurarnyunas/ /thal mo legs par sbyar byas te/ /de nas chos rgyal spyan snga nas/ /gar byed cing nisnyede nas song / /de nas smon lam btab pa ni/ /mi nyid dag ni thob nas su/ /ston pa 'di la brten nas nisti/ /byang chub dam pa 'di reg shog /dge ba'i rtsa ba des na bdag /mi yi srid pa thob nas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla med pa/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis byang chubakhuthob nas kyang / /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i⑧/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag ni dgra bcom dbang gyur7cing / /mngon shes drug ldan rdzu 'phrul che/ /dge slong rnams kyis bdag la ni/ /gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi can du shes/ /bsod nams byas pas grags ldan pa/ /bdag ni rtag tu bkur zhing mchod/ /dge slong dge 'dun yongs bskor nas/ /bdag ni rgyu zhing song ba na/ /de nas dgon pa'i lam du ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun skom gyur nas/ /de na tesems la smon pa ni/ /de ring sbrang rtsi rnyed gyur cig /de nas mi ma yin rnams kyis/ /bdag smon shes te phyogs bzhi nas/ /sbrang rtsi khur gyis blangs nas ni(nye/ /de dag tu ni 'bul bar byed/ /bdag gis sbrang rtsi ci dgos pa/ /bzang po dag las blangs nas ni/ /dge slong 2—722

dge 'dun tshim byas te/ / de nas7lhag par legs par gyur/ /'das ma thag pa'i skye ba la/ /spre'u'i⑧rgyal po de byas pas/ /log parasanyung nas bdag 'phos nas / /'chi med go 'phang reg dugyur te/ /ji skad bdag gis smon pa yiX/ /thams cad 'byor pa nyid du gyur/ /ston pa bkur sti byas pas0'dir/ /rang gi don ni yongs su rdzogs/ /btsun pa bdag gis dge ba gang / /bgyis pa dran pa 'di lags te/ /de yi 'bras bu sdug pa dang / /bde 'byung 'dod pa nyams su myong | /de ltar gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi can/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas / /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi can gyi le'u ste sum bcu rtsashegacig pa'o// //'dul ba gzhi0/ bam po lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ /de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa rgyu can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rgyumanyecan tshe dang ldan pa gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi can gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rgyu7can gyis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rgyu7can gyis de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ bshes ldan grong du bdag gis sngon//bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig na/ /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs pa ni/ /grong khyer dam par 'jug pa mthong / /thugs rje che ldan mthong nas ni/ /me tog sil mas gtor nas der/ /me tog rtsa bas yar bteg cing / /gyen du kha bltas khang bzangs gnas/ /de nas bdag ni rab dga' bsatso/ /thub pa'i zhabs la mgos gtugs nas/ /thal mo legs par sbyar nas ni/ /de la 2—723

bskor ba byas par gyur/ zhabadag gis chos ni ma thos shing / /bdag ni skyabs su ma song bar/ /sems dad nyidakhucig byas nas ni/ /bde gshegs drung nas bdag song ngo / /mthu chen rnam par gzigs pa la/ /dge ba'i las de byas pas na/ /bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu/ /ngan 'gro mngon par mi shes so/ /bdag ni lha lus rab dga' zhing / /lha yi 'dod pa yang dag 'byor/ /mi nyid rnyed pa thob nas kyang / /bdag ni nor chen phyug por gyur/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ ri /mi'irnyusrid thob pa 'di yin te/ /nor che longs spyod che ba yi/ /bram ze rnams kyi0rigs su gyur/ /sgra nges sbyor dang shes gsal bcas/ /skyes bu chen pokhumatshan dang ni/ /tshig gi don bcas ston pa yisal/ /gsang tshig rnams kyi pha rol phyin/ /bram ze lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /tshal du gsang tshig brjod pa'i phyir/ /bram ze rnams kyis yongs bskor nas/ /bdag ni khyim nas byung ba las/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun bdar nas/ /dpa' bo chen po ma ga d+ma'i0/ /grong mchog tu ni 'jug pa mthong / /bdag gis thugs rje ldan mthong nas/ /yid dga' bar ni gyur pa dang / /sngon gyi rgyu ni de dag gis/ /mtshan rnams la ni brtags pa las/ /'jig rten mgon po'i mtshan rnams ni/ /sum bcu rtsa gnyis yongs rdzogs shing / /dpe byad rnams kyis mdzes pa yi/ /grags par ldan pa7mthong bar gyur/ /mtshan dang ldan pa de mthong nas/ /mgo bo yis ni phyag byas te/ /phyogs gcig 'dug nas gus pas ni/ /'dren pa de la mngon bstod pa/ /ji ltar gsang tshig la gda' ba/ /khyod la de bzhin de gda' bas/ /khyod sangs rgyas par the tshom med/ /'jig rten gyi ni ston pa 2—724

mchog /khyod ni tshangs pa brgya byin khyod/ /khyod las lhag pa ma mchis te/ /khyod ni nyi ma khyab 'jug lags/ /khyod ni 'jig rten bla na med/ /rgyal ba khyod 'dra'ang ma mthong na/ /lhag pa lta zhig ga la zhig /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /khyod ni rgyal ba bdud zil non①/ /khyod ni mgon med rnams kyisaganas/ /rten med rnams kyi skyabs kyang lags/ /khyod kyi nyan thos nyid du mchis/ /khyod ni bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig /de nas gser gyi mchod sdong lta'i / /phyag ni de yis7brkyang mdzad de/ /rgyal ba'i phyag ni smadakyimadzad nas/ /bdag gi mgo la kun du byugs/ /yid ni rab tu dang byas pas/ /khyod kyis bsod nams mang po bskyed/ /sems ni rab tu dang rnams kyi0/ /yon chung bar ni mi 'gyur ro/ /yon gnas bla na med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas la ni khyod kyis bsten/ /bram ze khye'u yis mchod sbyin byasabya/ /zhing rab la ni sa bon btab/ /ngan song gi ni lam bcad pas/ /khyod la ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med/ /bram ze khye'u yis7bdud rtsi yisabya/ /sgo phye bar ni dogs med byos/ /khyod ni rab tu 'byung 'dod na/ /ral pa kun ni myur spangs te/ /nga yi spyan sngar rab byung la/ /bram ze tha ba med par gyis/ /bdag ni chos nyid la dga' nas7/ /de na slob ma'i tshogs smra ba/ /khyod ni bram zer gyur zin nas/ /ji ltar dge sbyong mgo reg 'gyur/ /dkar po'i rigs 'di spangs nas ni/ /nag po'i rigs 'di khas len nam/ /'jig rten na ni bram ze gtso//pha rol phyin cing tshangs pa yi/ /snying dang kha nas skyes pa yin8/ /bram ze tshangs pas sprul pa yin/ / khyed cag kun ni mi mkhas pa/ 9khyed cag kun ni mi shes pa/ /'di na bdag ci gsang tshig gi/ /de nyid rig〈nyecing pha rol 2—725

phyin / /bdag ni shes rab mtha' yas kyis/ /gsungs pa ji ltar shes pa bzhin / /de bzhin du ni bdag byed kyis①/ /gang dag der 'gro mi 'dod pa/ /ci sems ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /gar dga' der ni 'dengaphul rag /bdag ni gsang tshig don mi gnyer/ /ltos par yang ni mi byed do/ /de nas bdag gi slob ma'i tshogs/ /mchi mas brnangs shingasangu bzhin gyis/ /snying ni0rje rje skad smras nas⑤/ /de nas de rnams phyogs phyogs dong / /de nas thugs rje che ldan pa'i/ /thub pas bdag la gsungs pa ni/ /dge slong tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /bdag ni bsnyen par rdzogs par gyur/ /khyim rnams nas ni khyim med par/ /yang dag dad pas rab tu byung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa chub byas nas/ /mngon par shes kun reg gyur te/ /sngon gyi gnas ni rjes su dran/ /lha yi mig ni rnam par dag /bdag sngon gang na 'dug pa yi/ /'chi 'pho skye ba shes par gyur/ /zag pa zad pa thob pas na/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul mngon du byas/ /de ltar gnas brtan rgyu can gyis/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to / /gnas brtan rgyu can gyi le'u ste sum bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍisan+ya la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi ⑨na tshe dang ldan pa rgyu can gyis rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisaX/ tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi spre)rgyas kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi rgyas de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ sngon ni thub chen 'od srung 2—726

gi / /dam pa'i chos ni nub pa na/ /nyan thos thams cad 'dus nas su/ /phan tshun/dag tu smras pa ni/ /ston pa thugs rjitu'od sung ni/ /mya ngan 'das pas nges par yang / /rab tu byung ba srab gyur cing / /dam chos kyang ni ston mi 'gyur/ /bdag cag ji skad thos pa'i chos/ /phan tshun yang dag gsal byas nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan lasarnyuspro ba dang / /brtson 'grus brtsamasapas gnas par bya/ /de dag ri la 'dzegs nas ni/ /zag pa zad pa ma thob par/ /re zhig 'di nas mi ldang zhes/ /rtswa yi gding ba dag la 'khod/ /srog la yang ni mi lta bar⑤/ /brtson 'grus brtsams te gnas pa na/ /bdun gyis mngon par shes la reg /dge slong dag ni mya ngan 'das/ /de yi bdun pa bdag yin te/ /dbang po brtul zhing bsod nams chung / /snyoms med sbyorashel brtson pa yi/ /so so'i skye bosa'achi dus byas/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus ma btang0)zhing / /de bzhin rab tu brtson gnas pas/ /dga' ldan rnams dang skal mnyam pa'i/ /lha yi 'jig rten rnams su skyes/ /de na7shākya seng ge yi/ /thub chen byang chub sems dpa' mthong / /thub pa lha yi tshogs la ni/ /skyo bar 'gyur ba'i chos ston mdzad/ /bdag gis de yi chos bshad pa/ /thos nas rtse gcig yid gyur te/ /dam chos yid la byed pa ni/ /lan 'ga'ang5)rnam par ma spangs so/ /lha yi 'jig rten bdag son nas/ /grong khyer ser skya zhes bya ba'i/ /kauṇ+ḍi rgya rus bram ze yi/ /rigs can du ni skyes par gyuraci/ /byang chub sems dpa'i grags chen ldan/ /zas gtsang sras por gyur nas ni/ /dad pas byung nas dka' spyod pa/ /spyad par gyur pa de yi tshe/ /rgyal po'i mchog ni zas gtsang gis/ /bdag hubakug nas kyang smras pa ni/ /rab tu 2—727

'byung b.ratu'adod par gyisal/ /der ni de yi nad g.yoganyebyos/ /de tshe bdag gis yid dad pas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rim gro byas/ /lam 'di'isarnam dag 'gyur min zhes/ /yid byung nas ni gshegs par gyur/ /gang tshe shākya thub pas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /kun gyi thog mar bdag gis ni/ /de yi dam chos rtogs par gyur/ /'od srung gi ni gsung rab la/ /tshangs par spyod la bdag gis gnas/ /sangs rgyas bdag gis mnyes byas shing / /zag pa zad pa thob par gyur/ /de ltar gnas brtan kauṇ+ḍi0rgyas/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /kauṇ+ḍi0rgya'i le'u ste sum bcu rtsashegasum pa'o/ / //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa nye bsnye'akhor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nye bshe'akhor tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi rgyas rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyisayi/ tshe dang ldan pa nye bsnye'akhor gyis kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig zhatshe dang ldan pa nye bsnye'akhor gyis kyang de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ bdag ni sngon gyi tshe rabs na/ /bā rā ṇa sri'i7rgyal khab tu/ /rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba'i/ /'dreg mkhan du ni gyur pa na/ /de yi skra dang kha spu rnams/ /'dreg cing 'chos par byed pa na/ /de nas mngon par rangs gyur nas/ /bgo ba dag ni bdag la byin8/ /gus dang bcas pa'i sdug sems kyis/ /rgyal po'i rim gro byed pa na/ /mnyes nas de nas de la ni/ /ma thos pa yi tshigs bcad bsgrags/ /'dod pa rnams ni mnog chung zhing / /sdig pa'i rtsa dang mya ngan 2—728

rtsa/ /rnam par smin pa rtsub pa yin①/ /bram ze'i khye'u ni〈gang zhig gis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan spangs nas ni/ /rab byungasathob pa legs thob yin/ /ma thos tshigs bcad des thos nas/ /de nas skyo0bar gyur pa dang / /rgyal po bdag ni gnang bar mdzodag/ /khyim ma mchis par rab 'byung ngo / /de nas rgyal pos bdag la smras/ /gal te rab tu byung nas kyang / /phyirashekyang bdag la lta ba yi/ /khas blang bsheni bya ba'i rigs/ /rgyal dbang khyod la bdag gis ni/ /de bzhin bgyi bar dam bca' yis0 / /bdag rab byung nas slar yang ni/ /ltarwarnyabar bdag la thugs ches mdzod/ /de nas rgyal pos gnang nas ni/ /bdag gis dgon pa'i nags song nas/ /gzhung can drung du nyer song ste/ /khyim med par ni rab tu byung / /ji ltar rigs par rab byung nas/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi po yi/ /tshad med pa la rab bsgoms pas/ /bdag gis 'dod chags bral ba thob/ /rgyal po de yi tshe la ni/ /de tshe bdag ming gang sngalgeskyong / /'byor pa che zhing mthu yang che/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyis mchod par gyur/ /gzhung can drung du song nas ni/ /mgo bo yis ni phyag byas te/ /bdag gis phyogs gcig 'dug nas ni/ /'di skad kyi ni tshig smras so/ /slob dpon bdag gi tshig gson cig /mi yi dbang po tshangs sbyin la/ /slar yang lta bar bgyi ba yi/ /dam bcas pa ni chung7zhig mchis/ /gnang bar bya'o bram ze khyod/ /bā rā ṇa sri'i grong khyer song / /khyod ni brdzun du mi 'gyur bar/ /dam bcas pa yi7mthar phyung shig /gnang bar bya yis0khyod song la/ /kho bo yi5)ni tshig bzhin gyis/ /'di nas song la mi dbang po/ /tshangs sbyin dad pa skyed par gyis/ /gzhung can gyis ni bdag gnang nas/ /drang srong bskor ba 2—729

byas nas ni/ /bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer du/ /rim bzhin du ni song ba las /de bzhin der ni bdag 'ongs zhes/ /tshangs sbyin nyid kyisatuthos nas ni/ /rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen pos ni/ /bdag gi drung du nye bar 'ongs/ /shing rta las babs bdag gi ni/ /rkang pa gnyis lasaphyag byas nas / /phyogs gcig tu ni 'dug par gyur/ /'dod pa rnams las rgal 'gyur ba'iX/ /de la chos ni bshad pa dang / /rgyal pos thos nas yid dga' bsaX/ /'dod pa0don du mi gnyer gyur/ /rgya che'i sems dang yid dga' bsaX/ /tshangs sbyin gyis ni 'di skad smras/ /bdag 'dod don du gnyer min pas/ /bdag kyang rab tu 'byung bar byani/ /rgyal po tshur spyon dgon pa'i nags/ /dben pa dag tu bzhud par bgyi/ /bram ze drang srong gzhung can gyiX/ /drung du nye bar bzhud par mdzod/ /rgyal po des ni bu thu bo/ /'jigs〈nyemed rgyal srid la bzhag ste/ /rgyal mchog rgyal srid spangs nas ni/ /khyim med par yang rab tu byung / /nang mi dang ni blon chen dang / /grong khyer pa ni thams cad dang / /gnyen gyi tshogs kyis yongs bskor nas/ /rab tu 'byung phyir mngon du byung / /gzhung can drung du song nas ni/ /mgo bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /rgyal pos thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /rab tu 'byung bar gsol ba btab/ /stong phrag dag ni du ma dang ske/ /khyim med par ni〈nyerab byung stonye/ /skra dang kha spu bregs nas kyang / /ngur smrig gos ni bgos par gyur/ /gzhung can shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur ba'i8/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi po yi/ /chos ni kun la bshad par byas/ /gus dang bcas pa'i byams sems kyis/ /rgyal po de yi rim gro byas/ /de nas 'chi 'pho'i dus byas te/ /'od gsal 2—730

rnams su song bar gyur/ /'od gsal nas ni shi 'phos nas/ /slar yang 'dir ni 'ongs pa na/ /gang dang gang du skyes par ni/ /nor che ba dang phyug por gyur/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams kyi/ /bde ba mang po nyams su myong / /dus kyi btum 'di la ni/ /bdag gi lus kyi tha ma la/ /shākya rnams kyi yul du ni / /grong khyer ser skya zhes byar skyes/ /spyod yul spyod pa phun tshogs pa'i/ /shākya rnams kyi 'dregasnyomakhan gyur/ /shākasrisras thugs brtse'i bdag nyid can/ /nyan thos bcas la rim gro byas/ /rgyal po chen po'i 'byor pas ni/ /rab tu 'byung bar mngon 'byungasnyib/ /de rnams bdag gis skra bregs nas/ /'di skad kyi7ni tshig smras so/ /dpon po 'tsho ba ma stsal na/ /bdag ni ji ltar 'tsho bar 'gyuraX/ /de yi rgyan ni gang yin dang / /gos rnams gyon pasnyegang yin pa/ /'di ni khyod kyi 'tsho ba'o zhes/ /des ni kun dga' bdag la byin/ /rin chen mang po brtags nas ni/ /de la bdag ni skyo gyur nas/ /'di dag thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bdag ni rab 'byungasnyigasol ba bya/ /bkren pa bdag la 'di lta bu'i/ /rin chen rnams kyis ci zhig bya/ /gzhan 'ga' zhig gis thos na ni/ /srog la gdon lto za bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis nyid kyi snod spyad ni(nye/ /gang yin shing la btags nas su/ /bor nas bdag ninyekhyim dag nas/ /byung ste nges par 'byung bar bya8/ /bdag ni rin chen don gnyer min/ /bdag kyang rab tu 'byung bar bya8/ /bdag gi tshig de shākya yi/ /rgyal pos thos nas 'di skad smras/ /khyod ni thog mar rab byung dang / /rgan pa nyid du khyod 'gyur ro/ /rjes su thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /bdag la dge slong tshur shog gsungs/ /bdag ni thog mar rab tu byung / /de nas rgyal rigs 2—731

rab byung nas/ /bdag gi 0rkang la phyag byas pas/ /shākya ②de rnams nga ③rgyal bor/ /de ༷ltar bdag ni rab byung bas/ /mngon par shes pa drug reg nasadu/ /dgra bcom mngon shes drug ldan zhing / /bdag ni 'dul ba'i pha rol phyin/ /ston pa nyid kyis 'dul ba 'dzin/ /rnams kyi mchog tu bsngags pa ste/ / dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /⑥ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /nye bshe'akhor gyis las lung bstan/ /nye bsnye'akhor gyi le'u ste sum bcu rtsa0bzhi pa'o// // de nas 'jig rten mgon pos ni/ /gnas brtan 'od byed la gsungs pa/ /khyod kyis sngon byas gang yin pa'i/ /rang gi las ni lung ston cig /rgyal ba'i gsung dbyangs thos nas ni/ /sngon chad bdag gis gang bgyis pa'i/ /rang gi las ni dran pa gang / /de ni thub pa'i spyan sngar gsol/ /'jig rten gtso bo skyob pa po/ /sangs rgyas pad ma bla ma yi/ /mchod rten tshal stug bzhugs pa ni8/ /ri dgas gdug pa rnams kyis bsten/ /mchod rten de la phyag bgyid pa/ /rngo thog pa ni 'ga' ma mchis/ /mi de rnams ni bsod nams dang / /sdig pa rab tu ma 'tshal to/ /bdag gis song nas shing rnams dang / /rtswa rnams bsal ba bgyis nas ni/ /phyags ma dag ni blangs nas kyang / /de nas thams cad phyag dar bgyis/ /bskor ba brgyad dang phyag bgyis te/ /mchod pa bgyis nas slar log lags/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba des na bdag /lha rnams su ni skyes pa na/ /'dod pa thams cad 'byor gyur cing / /sum bcu rtsa gsum rnams su dga'/ /lha yul lha yi rgyal srid ni/ /sum bcu rtsa drug bar du bgyis / /de nanyebadag giloganas mchis pa/ /gser gyi 'od ni shin tu gsal//2—732

rgyar ni dpag tshad sum bcu drug /khor yug dpag tshad drug bcu tham/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten de phyags nas/ /ngo mtshar byung ba gzhan yang ni/ /mi yi nang du mi dbang ni/ /lan bdun bar du bgyis par gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten de phyags nas/ /ngo mtshar byung ba gzhan yang ni/ /bdag gi7lus kyikhugazi brjid ni/ /gser gyi kha dog lta bur gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten de phyags nas / /ngo mtshar byung ba gzhan yang ni/ /bram ze dang ni rgyal rigs dang / /rigs gnyis su ni bdag skyes lags/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten phyags nas ni/ /bdag la ngo mtshar gzhan byung ba/ /khyogs dang glang chen stongasnyedang ni/ /bzhonasapa mchog ni rnams kyis mchi'u/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten phyags nas ni/ /bdag la ngo mtshar gzhan byung ba/ /bdag gi mdun na sdong dum dang / /tsher ma gyo mo rang nyid sel/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten de phyags nas/ /ngo mtshar byung ba gzhan yang ni/ /skad cig tsam yang bdag gis su/ /bro 'tshal0bar ni mi dran lags/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten phyags nas ni/ /bdag la ngo mtshar gzhan byung ba/ /gang dang gang du bdag mchi bar/ /kun du bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten de phyags nas/ /ngo mtshar byung ba gzhan yang ni/ /rtag tu bkur zhingashemachod pas na/ /lha yi spyod pa lta bu mtsho/ /skyobasnyepa'i mchod rten phyags nas ni/ /ngo mtshar byung ba gzhan yang ni/ /bdag gis lus la lan 'ga' yang / /gnod pa byung bar mi dran lags/ /de ltar sangs rgyas sangs rgyas chos/ /dri ma med pa bsamanyemi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la mngon dad pa'i/ /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu che/ /de bas rga shi zad pa dang / /phun sum 'byor pa 'dod pas ni/ /rgyal ba yi ni mchod rten la/ /2—733

mchod pa bla na med pa gyis/ /btsun pa bdag gis dge ba gang / /bgyis pa dran pa 'di lags te/ /de yi 'bras bu yid 'ong zhing / /bde 'byung 'dod pa nyams su myong / /de ltar dge slong 'od byed kyis/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan tol/ /'od byed kyi le'u ste sum bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan ①gnas brtan ②rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa nam gru la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru tshe dang ldan⑧pa 'od byed kyisaXrang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa nam grus kyang da rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa nam grus de'i tshe rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par byed de/ 'di nas bskal pa bye ba'i sngon / /sangs rgyas kun zil gnon de la/ /bdag gis dge ba gang bgyis pa/ /btsun pa bdag gis dran lags te/ /brgya stong phrag ni du ma yi/ /nyan thos rnams kyis mdun bdar nas/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dpe med du/ /skyes bu dam pa0gshegs pa na⑥/ /bdag kyang dgos pa zhig gi phyir/ /grong khyer gzhan nas der phyin nas/ /de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /mtshan mchog sum bcu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /me dang nor bu glog 'od dang / /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od 'dra mthong / /'od kun zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /sangs rgyas gzi brjid khyad par 'phags/ /gzi brjid me phung lta bu ste/ /sngon ma mthong ba mthong nas ni / /bdag gi mdun na 'dug pa yi/ /bram ze zhig la dris pa dang / /dris pas bdag la 'di skad smras/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rnamasa'adren pa/ /lha dang 2—734

mi mchog rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zla med pa yi gang zag yin/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas sgra thos nas/ /de tshe bdag ni rab dgar gyur/ /dga' zhing mgu ba skyes pas na①/ /lus ni thams cad bde bar gyur/ /mi ma yin rnams lha yul gyi/ /rol mo'i sgra rnams 'byin pa thos/ /lha yi tsan dan phye ma yang / /grong khyer dam pa de ru bab/ /kha cig ut+pal tsam pa gzhan/ /de bzhin pa ri sha ka dang / /gzhan dag tsan dan phye ma 'thor/ /bdag ni thal mo sbyar byas nas / /yid ni mgu zhing rangs pa yis/ /nam mkha' la ni 'phags te gnas/ /dga' dang rab tu dga' ba yis/ /lus kun tu ni khyab par gyur/ /dri dang phreng ba la sogs phyir/ /mtha' dag tu ni brgyugasalgepa las/ /de yi tshe na bskor kyang ni/ /me tog gcig kyang ma rnyed do/ /de tshe de na bdag gis ni/ /ha cang ring ba ma yin par/ /gdugs byed pa yi tshong khang na/ /dung ltar dkar ba'i gdugs shig mthong / /gdugs phyir bdag gis de la ni/ /gsol btab nas ni gdugs blangs te/ /sems ni rab tu dang ba yis sangs rgyas la ni gdugs bzung ngo / /bdag gisalag nas gdugs shor ba/ /bar snang dag la mngon 'phags nas/ /ston pa gshegs nasregadugs 'gro zhing / /bzhugs pa na yang sdod par gyur/ /nam mkha'i ngos la sprin lta bur/ /sangs rgyas la ni grib ma byed/ /thub pa'i sku ni mi 'dor bar/ /bar snang la ni 'dug par gyur/ /de nas bdag dang skye bo gzhan/ /cho 'phrul rnams la brtags nas ni/ /thal mo legs par sbyar byas te/ /de bzhin gshegs la mgos phyag byas/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /nyan thos mtshan ma bzung nas ni/ /rjes su dran pas yid dga' zhing / /khyim gyi las kyi mtha' 2—735

byas so/ /kye ma'i thob pa legs thob stetsho/ /sangs rgyas mthong nas dran pa rnyed/ /yon tan bla na med pa ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la bdag gis phul/ /yon gnas bla na med pa la/ /bdag gis gdugs phul gang yin pa'i/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba des na bdag② /rin chen bdun dang ldan par gyur/ /de nas sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i/ /lha yi nang du bdag skyes te/ /lha yi rgyal por bdag gyur nas/ /lha ni bye ba rnams kyis mchod/ /slar yang mir ni 'ongs pa na/ /stobs kyis sgyurasnyeba'i rgyal gyur cing / /nor chen brtson 'grus che ba ste/ /rgyal po rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /bdag gis las 'di byas pas ni/ /yang dang yang du 'khor ba na'ang / /bdag byed pa yi las de ni/ /lan 'ga'ang bar ni ma bcad do/ /de lta bu yi yon gnas la/ /bdag gis dad pas phul ba yiX/ /dge ba'i las de byas pasalgen/ /ngan 'gror song ba mi dran no/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ /mi'irnyusrid thob pa 'di yin te/ /yang dag sangs rgyas bla med pa/ /ded dpon 'di ni mnyes par byas/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bdag gis rab byung thob nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa bsil gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa yang bdag gis thob/ /bdud kyis lus ni lus chen po/ /ri bo lta bu dpag tshad tsam/ /nam mkha' la ni sprin lta bur//mdog ni sdug pa sprul pa dang / /de nas bdag ni g.yeng byed pa/ /'di ko su zhig snyam pa las/ /'di ni mtho 'tsham byed pa yi/ /bdud yin par ni myur du shes/ /sdig can khyod 'dir ci dgar zad/ /lus ni7khor yug gcig lta bu(spre/ /mgo yang lhun po lta bur ni/ /byas te 'dir ni 'ong la rag /bdag ni medagra bcom dbang gyur pa/ /rig gsum ldan pa'i dge sbyong ste/ /2—736

sangs rgyas kyis gsungasatugang yin pa'i/ /bde bar gnas pa rnams kyang thob//bsod snyoms byas pa lan gcig gis/ /zhag bdun du yang 'dug nas ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i dga' myong ba/ /de lta bu dag bdag gis bsgoms②/ /btsun pa bdag gis dge ba ni/ /gang bgyis dran pa 'di lags te/ /de yi 'bras bu yid 'ong zhings/ /bde 'byung 'dod pa nyams su myong / /de ltar nam gru blo ldan gyis/ /dge slong dge 'dun mdun 'dug nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /rang gi las ni lung bstan to/ /nam gru'i le'u ste0sum bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis rang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag gis rgyarang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan lags kyisal/bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de ①nyid kyi phrin ⑩las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan yipa'i rigs lags sotso/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin7las ci zhig mdzad na/ des na byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas na yang gor ma'i dum bus zhabs kyi mthe bo rma byung bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis7sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas(nye/'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or zhig na khyim bdag ciganyeganas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/2—737

dga' mgur spyod par byed ces bya ba nas/ khye'u zhig btsas nas bskyed bsrings te chen por gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /de'i ma shi nas de nas khyim bdag des chung ma gzhan zhig blangs te/ deshedang lhan cig rtse bar byed ces bya ba nas de las kyang khye'u zhig btsas so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas khyim bdag des khye'u phu bo shos chung ma blangs nas de rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u dang bu mo mang du btsas so/ /ji tsam dus phyisazhig na khyim bdag dngasachung ma dang bcas te shi nas bu de phu bo nyid kyi drung du song ba dang / chung mas smras pa/ rje'i sras khye'u 'di khyod kyi cir mchi lags/ des smras pa/ spun du 'ong ngo / /rje'i sras ci 'di yang khyim gyi0bgo skal dbang ngam/ 'di la yang phyed la bdag cag la yang phyedakyiyin no/ /rje'i sras 'di ni mi gcig pa lags na/ ji ltar 'di la yang phyed la bdag cag mang po la yang phyed lags/ bzang mo 'di ni 'jig rten gyi chos yin no/ /rje'i sras gal te de lta na 'di khums shig /bzang mo nor gyi phyir nu bo bsadakyidu ga la rung / des de la yang dang yang du smras pa dang 'dod pa la bstan⑧pas ni sdig pa'i las mi bya ba ci yang med pas des khas blangs so/ /des bsams pa/ gal te grong du gsadashen ni skye bo mang pos tshor bar 'gyur gyis0/ dgon par gsad par bya'o snyam nas des de bos te smras pa/ nu bo me tog dang yam sreg shing gi phyir dgon par 'dong ngo / /de de dang lhan cig dgon par dong ba las de nas des ri phug tu rdos bsnun te bsad do/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na gang gis khyim bdag gi bu yisatswakhyim gyi nu bo de dgon par rdos gsod pa de ni 2—738

nga nyid yin te/ nga yisatukhyim gyi nu bo nor gyi phyir dgon par rdos bsnun te bsad pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas nga lo mang po dang / lo brgya phrag mang po dang / lo stong phrag mang po dang / lo brgya stong phrag mang por sems can dmyal ba rnams su btsos so/ /las de kho na'i lhag mas de bzhin gshegs pa ngakhumangon par rdzogs par byang chub na yang zhabs kyi mthe bo rdo'i dum bus rma byungasabar gyur to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrinakyilas ci zhig mdzad na phrinasalas de'i rnam par smin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams gsu las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas/'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba gnas shig na ded dpon gnyis shigasheganas pa las/ de gnyis kyis7gru bo che legs par bsgrubs nas nor bsgrubalgepa'i phyir rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa dang rjes su mthunarwa)pa'i rlung gis rin po che'i gling du phyin to/ /de na gcig gis ni bag yod par rin po che rnams kyis gru bkang ngo / /cig shos kyis ni bag med par ro/ /de gnyis chas pa las ji tsam na de'i gru bag med par bkang ba de bying bar gyur to/ /gru bying ba des smras pa/ bdag 'o nir chug shig /des de srang la bcal te rin po che las bor nas gru bo cher bcug go/ /de der zhugs nas bsams pa/ 'di ni don grub pas 'gro la bdag ni don med pa 'di lta mi srid kyis 'di'i gru dbug par bya'o snyam nas/des dben par dal bus dbug par brtsams pa las ded dpon des rig nas 2—739

smras pa/ ded dpon gru ma dbug zhig thams cad tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar gyur ta re/ phrag dog la mngon par zhen pa'i blo can de slar bzlog kyang ma btub nas/ de nas des mdung thung gis bsad do/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na ded dpon gang gis ded dpon gsod pa de ni nga nyid yin te/ ngas ded dpon mdung thung gis bsad pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas nga7lo mang po dang / lo brgya phrag mang po dang /lo stong phrag mang po dang / lo brgya stong phrag mang por sems can dmyal ba rnams su btsos so/ /las de'i lhag ma kho nas de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par byang chub na yang zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pasakhuzug par gyur to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrinasalas ci zhig mdzad na phrinakhulas de'i rnam par smin pas yul sa lar ji ltar dulhung bzed bkrus pas zhugs pa'i lhung bzed bkrus pa de kho na bzhin du phyir gshegs te bsod snyoms gcig kyang ma brnyes0par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na bram ze'i khye'u zhig gnasasheso/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang / ngan pa la snying brtse ba can/bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe rang sangs rgyas nyon mongs 'joms zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung nas/ de0bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na drang srong smra ba ri dgas 2—740

kyi nags na nye bar rten7cing gnas so/ /de snga dro shamakhuthabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gosasathogs te bā rā ṇa sīr0bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /bram ze'i khye'u zhig kyang zas kyi phyir bsod snyoms la khyim zhig tu zhugs pa las des zas ma thob nas de phyir byung ngo / /rang sangs rgyas nyon mongs med kyis khyim der bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /bram ze'i khye'u des de zhugs pa mthong nas des bsams pa/ rab tu byung ba de ci dag byed pa blta'o snyam nas de slar log ste de'i phyi bzhin du 'brang zhing sgo phag tu bsdad pa las/ ji tsam na khyim bdag gi chung mas rang sangs rgyas de lus mdzes shing sems dang ba ⑦mthong nas/ de nas de dad pa skyes te de'i lhung bzed gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' bas bkang ngo / /des de thogs te phyir byung ba bram ze'i khye'u des mthong nas smras pa/ kye rab tu byung ba re zhig khyod kyis bsod snyoms ci 'dra ba zhig grub pa lta'o⑧/ /de ma bsams par ye shes mthong ba mi 'jug pas des bstan to/ /de nas phrag dog la mngon par zhen pa'i blo can des de'i lag par thal mos bsnun pa dang lhung bzed lhung bas kha zas rnams sa la bo ba dang bram ze'i khye'u des rdog pas brdzis (nyeso/ /rang sangs rgyas des de la smras pa/bzhin bzangs khyod kyis ci'i phyir kha zas rnams chud gzan/ ci ste khyod slong bar gyur na ngas byin par 'gyur ba zhig /des rang sangs rgyas de la smad pa mang du byas nas/ slar log pa dang drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags su song nas 'dug go/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bram ze gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te/ phrag dog la mngon par zhen pa'i blo can ngas rang sangs rgyas kyi zas bcad pa byas pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin 2—741

pas lo mang po zhes bya ba nas/ sems can dmyal ba rnams su btsos so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /las kyi lhag ma de kho nas da ltar nga mngon par rdzogs par byang chub na yang yul sa lar zan gcadatupa byas so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrinakhulas ci zhig mdzad na/ phrinashelas de'i rnam par smin pas kun tu rgyu mo mdzes mas yang dag pa ma lags pas skur pa btab lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de'i gsung rab la spun gnyis shig rab tu byung bar gyur te/ gnas 'jog dang / bha ra dwakyidza zhes bya'o/ /de nas gnas 'jog gis ni brtson pa dang / 'bad pa dang / brtsal ba byas pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /bha nir dwa7dzas kyang bklags shing btonatshwanyepas sde snod gsum la byang bar gyur te⑩/ sde snod gsum gyi chos kyi gtam la rigs pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /des ji tsam na khyim bdag gcig la bskul nas/ des de'i ched du gtsug lag khang yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa zhig rtsigasnyitu bcug go/ /de nas des phu bo gnas 'jog la spring ba/ lhan cig 'khod kyis shog shig /des thos nas 'ongs so/ /de nas khyim bdag des spyod lam zhi ba/lus mdzes pa/ sems dang ba de mthong ngo / /de ⑩mthong nas mngon par 2—742

dad paratugyur te/ desridad pa skyes nas kha zas bsod pas tshim par byas te chen po la 'os pa'i ras zung gcig bskon to/ /de nas bhaker dwakyidza phrag dog skyes nas bdag ni 'di'i thams cad la sngon du 'gro ba yin na/ bdag la ni 'dis lan 'ga' yang ras ma byin/ 'di ni 'ongs nas ring por ma7lon pa kho nar ras zung bskon no snyam nas/ de phu bo gnas 'jog la nyes pa'i glags tshol bar gyur to/ /des de tshor nas bsams pa/ 'di ni phrag dog gi rang bzhin can yin pas gal te⑦/ bdag gis 'di lasaras zung 'di ma byin par gyur na lhag par yang mi dga' ba myong bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ des7de la byin na 'on kyang de nyes pa'i glags tshol ba lhur len cing 'dug go/ /khyim bdag de'i mngag gzhug ma bu mo zhig gtsug lag khang der song zhing byi dor gyi las byed do/ /bha7ra dwa dzas de la smras pa/ bu mo kho bos ras zung 'di khyod la sbyin gyis(nye/ khyod kyis kho bo'i tshig bzhin byos shig /des smras pa/'phags pa bdag gis ci zhig bgyi/ khyod kho bo'i ras zung 'di gyon la khyim gyi byi dor gyi las byos shig /gal te khyim bdag gis khyod kyi ras zung 'di ga las 'ongs zhes 'dri dang / 'phags pa gnas 'jog gis bdag la stsal to zhes smros shig /gal te ci'i phyir 'drirwanyedang / dpon po skyes pa rnams kyis bud med rnams la ci'i slad du stsol ba de yang 'dri'am zhes smros shig /de nas des ji skad bsgo7ba bzhin du thams cad byas pa dang / de nas khyim bdag des gnas 'jog la ma dad pa ⑥ bskyed pa dang bdag nyid chen po de dag ni bkur ste ma yin pas skrag pas de langs te song ngo / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bha (sprer dwa (nyedza gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te/2—743
